bod gangs can gyi ljongs su dbu ma'i 'chad nyan ji ltar dar tshul/nanda la zhus te/ parnyi de nyid kyis mdzad pa'i dbu ma 'jug pa'i 'grel bshad don gsal bar byed pa zhes bya ba bsgyur pa dang / lo tsā pa cog ro ting nge 'dzin bzang pos slob dpan parnyi tsand+ra ha ri la zhus te/ slob dpon de nyid kyis mdzad pa'i dbu ma rin po che'i phreng ba zhes bya ba bsgyur—/ lo tsā pa khu ston mdo sde 'bar gyis kha che'i parnyi dza ya ā nanda la zhus te/ de nyid kyis mdzad pa'i rtog ge tho ba'i tshig le'ur byas pa dang —/ zhib mo rnam par 'thag pa zhes bya ba'i rab tu byed pa gnyis bsgyur pa dang / cog ro klu'i rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur pa'i rtsod pa bzlog pa'i tshig le'ur byas pa la tshig don leṭa par bcos nas gtan la phab/lo tsā ba gzhon nu shes rab kyis yi ge brgya pa dang / yi ge brgya pa'i rang 'grel bsgyur pa dang / slad kyi lo tsā pa grags 'byor shes rab kyis 'gyur bcos mdzad/ lo tsā pa dge bsnyen zha ma seng rgyal gyis zhen med kyi lta ba zhes bya ba dang stong nyid snying rje'i lta ba zhes bya ba gnyis bsgyur—/ lo tsā ba gzhon nu mchog gis stong nyid bdun cu pa'i tshig le'ur byas pa dang / slob dpon gzhan la phan pas mdzad pa'i stong nyid bdun cu pa'i rnam par bshad pa zhes pa bsgyur pa dang / lo tsā pa surya tī rtis skye med rin po che'i mdzod ces bya ba bsgyur pa dang / lo tsā pa zla ba gzhon nus dbu ma srid pa 'pho ba dang / parnyi byams pa mgon pos mdzad pa'i srid pa 'pho ba'i ṭīkka gnyis bsgyur pa'o/ /sarba maṅga lo/53

dbu ma'i spyi don zab don gsal byed 'phrul gyi me long /(2)bod kyi mkhas dbang rim byon gyis 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi sgo nas dbu ma'i lugs rgyas par mdzad tshul/de yang gangs dkar ra bas mu khyud du bskor ba'i ljongs 'dir skye dgu yongs kyi 'phral phugs kyi phan bde ma lus pa 'byung ba'i gnas gcig pu bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa rin po che ji ltar phebs pa'i tshul ni/ mdo sde padma dkar po las/ ston pa 'od ma'i tshal na bzhugs pa'i dus na/ smin mtshams kyi mdzod spu las 'od zer kha dog lnga 'phros te byang phyogs kha ba can gyi rgyal khams la song / der gzigs te zhal 'dzum mdzad pas byang chub sems dpa' sgrib pa rnam par sel bas de'i rgyu rkyen bshad du gsol zhes zhus pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas gang gis kyang gdul byar ma gyur pa'i gnas/ 'dre srin du mas gang ba'i mtha' 'khob kha ba can gyi rgyal khams der/ ma 'ongs pa'i dus su dam pa'i chos nyi ma shar ba lta bu zhig dar zhing rgyas par 'dug ste sems can de rnams kyang thar pa byang chub kyi lam la 'god par 'gyur ro/ /mtha' 'khob de 'dul ba'i gnyen po ni 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs yin no—/ /zhes dang / lha mo dri ma med pa'i zhus pa'i mdo las/ nga mya ngan 'das nas lo nyis stong lnga brgya na gdong dmar can gyi yul du dam pa'i chos dar bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin 54

bod gangs can gyi ljongs su dbu ma'i 'chad nyan ji ltar dar tshul/pa brgyad stong pa'i mdo'i yul yongs su sbyong bar/ yul dbus nas lho phyogs su dar bar 'gyur ro/ /lho phyogs nas byang phyogs su dar bar 'gyur ro/ /byang phyogs nas byang phyogs su dar bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes bod gangs can gyi ljongs 'di nyid 'phags mchog phyag na padmo'i thun mong ma yin pa'i gdul zhing dang ma 'ongs pa'i dus su dam pa'i chos yongs su dar bar mdo rgyud du ma las gsal bar lung gis bsngags pa ltar—/ gangs ri'i khrod 'dir rgyal khams dar gos ltar 'jam pa'i chos khrims kyis bskyangs pa'i rgyal rabs mu tig gi phreng ba mtshar du dngar ba las bod rje lha tho tho ri snyan shal gyi ring la spang skong phyag rgya ba dang / mdo sde za ma tog yi ge drug pa'i mdo sogs kyi glegs bam 'byor te sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i dbu brnyes/ chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i sku ring la yi ge'i srol btod pa dang / gsung rab bstan bcos bsgyur ba'i dbu btsugs/ sku rten jo bo mi bskyod rdo rje dang shākya mu ne sogs spyan drangs/ ra sa 'phrul snang gi gtsug lag khang dang /rgya stag ra mo che'i gtsug lag khang sogs rten dang brten pa mang po gsar du bzhengs te dam pa'i chos kyi srol rgya cher phyes/ btsan po khri srong lde'u btsan gyi ring la slob dpon padma 'byung gnas dang mkhan chen zhi 'tsho yab sras rnams gdan drangs te/ sad mi mi bdun rab tu byung —/ bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang 55

dbu ma'i spyi don zab don gsal gyed 'phrul gyi me long /bzhengs pa dang / rgya nag ha shang gi lta log tshar bcad pa/ rgya bal sogs yul gru gzhan gyi parnyi ta dang bod kyi lo tsā ba mang po lhan cig tu gdan 'dzoms nas 'chad nyan 'gyur gsum gyi chos gzhi btsugs te 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi sgo nas rgyal ba'i bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par mdzad pa'i lo rgyus yongs su grags shing / bstan pa 'phel 'grib kyi dbang gis snga dar dang phyi dar gnyis su dbye ba las snga dar la lo tsā ba mkhan po thon mi sasto ṭas mdo ting nge 'dzin rgyal po dang sher phyin stong phrag brgya ba sogs phar phyin gyi gzhung gtsigs che ba 'ga' zhig bsgyur bar chos 'byung snga ma rnams su 'byung la/ chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan gyi skabs su lo tsā ba ska cog zhang gsum gyis zab rgyas kyi gzhung lugs mang du bsgyur ba dang / de yang sher phyin gyi dngos bstan stong nyid kyi rim pa rtsal du bton nas 'chad nyan dang nyams len byed pa la dbu ma par grags pas/ cog ro klu'i rgyal mtshan gyis rtsa ba shes rab dang / dbu ma rtsa ba'i 'grel pa buddha pā li ta/ dbu ma rtsa ba'i 'grel pa shes rab sgron ma dang de'i 'grel bshad spyan ras gzigs brtul zhugs/ dbu ma rtsa ba'i 'grel pa ga las 'jigs med sogs bsgyur bshad mdzad pa dang / slob dpon zhi 'tsho yab sras kyis dbu ma'i 'chad nyan spel ba nas bod 'dir dbu ma thal rang gi bshad srol byung bar mngon zhing / chos rgyal gyis mkhan chen zhi 'tsho'i lugs kho na 56

bod gangs can gyi ljongs su dbu ma'i 'chad nyan ji ltar dar tshul/byed dgos pa 'i bkas bcad mdzad pa ltar gtso cher dbu ma rang rgyud pa'i lugs dar bar nges kyang phyi dar gyi bar du 'chad nyan gyi rgyun chad par gyur/ bstan pa phyi dar gyi dus su lha ma bla ma khu dbon gyi thugs bskyed la bsten nas rgya brtson 'grus seng ge dang nag tsho lo tsā ba gnyis kyis mnyam med jo bo chen po (spyi lokū82—1054)bod du spyan drangs shing / jo bo chen pos rig pa'i khu byug che chung gnyis bla mar bsten pas rang lugs dbu ma thal 'gyur ba yin yang lugs thun mong ma yin pa 'di nyid 'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas gtso byas pa'i snod ldan 'ga' zhig la lkog chos kyi tshul du gnang ba las dgos dbang gis tshogs dbus su rtog ge 'bar ba lan mang du gsungs/ rgya brtson 'grus seng ges dbu ma'i gzhung rang rkang du brtsams pa(dbu ma bzhi brgya pa'i spyi don〉dang / gzhan jo bos mdzad pa'i bden pa gnyis la 'jug pa dang / dbu ma'i man ngag rin po che'i za ma tog kha phye ba/mdo kun las btus pa'i don bsdus pa sogs bsgyur ba dang / jo bo chen po spyan drangs nas bal yul du slebs dus (spyi lo 1040)sku gshegs/'di pa'i mdun nas nag tsho lo tsā ba tshul khrims rgyal bas (spyi lo1011—1064)dbu ma dang mngon pa sogs zhus pa dang / jo bo'i dbu ma'i man ngag che chung / dbu ma 'jug pa sogs bsgyur zhing 'gyur shin tu legs par rje bdag nyid chen po'i gsung las 'byung / rngog blo ldan shes rab 57

dbu ma'i spyi don zab don gsal gyed 'phrul gyi me long /kyis (spyi lo 1059—1109)shes rab sgron ma dang rtog ge 'bar ba sogs bsgyur ba dang / dbu phar tshad ma sogs la shin tu mkhas pas bod kyi lo tsā ba'i khrod na 'gyur gzhung ches mang shos yin yang / bee ro tsā na nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam/ /ska cog rnam gnyis nyi zla'i rna cha zung //rin chen bzang po tho rangs skar chen tsam/ /kho bo de'i drung srin 'bu me khyer bzhin/ /zhes khengs skyung ba'i tshul mdzad/ (dbu ma bden gnyis kyi 'grel pa〉(dbu ma rgyan gyi 'grel pa〉(spyod 'jug gi 'grel pa〉(shes rab sgron me'i bsdus don〉(dbu ma rtsa ba shes rab kyi bsdus don〉(dbu ma snang ba'i bsdus don〉(dbu ma'i de kho na nyid la 'jug pa'i bsdus don〉〈jo bo'i bden chung gi bsdus don〉(dbu ma'i man ngag gi bsdus don〉sogs brtsams par grags shing / rngog lo chen pos dbu ma rang rgyud pa'i lugs kyi 'chad nyan mdzad par mngon no/ /rngog blo ldan shes rab kyi thugs sras bzhi'i ya gyal 'bre shes rab 'bar gyis (dbu ma rtsa ba'i bshad pa 'thad pa rnam par nges pa zhes bya ba〉(dbu ma rtsa ba'i 'grel pa tshig gsal ba'i bshad pa nges don rnam par gzigs pa zhes bya ba〉sogs ljags rtsom mdzad pa dang /gzhan yang mngon rtogs rgyan gyi 'grel pa/ nyi khri'i 'grel pa/ mdo sdud pa'i 'grel pa sogs mang du brtsams shing / phar phyin la shin tu mkhas par grags so/ /dge bshes ston pa dang / pha dam pa sangs 58

bod gangs can gyi ljongs su dbu ma'i 'chad nyan ji ltar dar tshul/rgyas kyi slob ma ma cig lab sgron sogs kyis thal 'gyur ba'i lugs 'dzin pa dang / skabs der rwa lo tsā ba rdo rje grags dang sgra sgyur mar pa chos kyi blo gros gnyis kyang rgya gar du phebs nas snga mas rig pa'i khu byug gnyis dang phyi mas dpal ldan zla ba'i lugs kho na gtso bor 'dzin pa'i bal yul gyi paṇa chen nā ro pa dang me tre pa'i mdun nas dbu ma sogs zhus shing / phyir bod yul du byon nas lta ba'i yang rtse dang la ldan dbu ma thal 'gyur ba'i lugs spel bas sku tshe de nyid la zung 'jug gi sku brnyes pa'i rje btsun mi la ras pa sogs slob ma'i tshogs mang du byung / khyad par du pa tshab lo tsā pa nyi ma grags (spyi lo 1055lor 'phan yul pa tshab stod du sku 'khrungs)kha cher phebs te lo ngo nyi shu rtsa gsum ring la sa dzdza na'i sras parnyi ta sa ra ha ti dang ha su ma ti rnam gnyis dang —/ mkhan po ka na ka warma sogs la bsten nas dbu ma'i gzhung sogs la slob gnyer mthar phyin mdzad/ dbu ma bzhi brgya ba/ dbu ma bzhi brgya ba'i rgya cher 'grel pa/ rigs pa drug cu ba/ dbu ma rtsa ba'i 'grel ba tshig gsal/ dbu 'jug pa dang de'i rang 'grel sogs bod skad du bsgyur/ phyir phebs rjes 'phan yul du dbu ma thal 'gyur ba'i lugs rgya cher spel/ (dbu ma rtsa ba shes rab kyi 'grel pa〉 〈dbu ma bzhi brgya pa'i bsdus don〉zhes pa brtsams/ dge bshes sha ra bas dbu ma'i skor gyi dri ba bton pa la lan gnang bas thugs shin tu 59

dbu ma'i spyi don zab don gsal byed 'phrul gyi me long /dgyes nas slob ma mang po khong gi mdun sar dbu ma slob gnyer byed par bsngags/ slob ma mang du bskyangs pa las gtso bo pa tshab bu bzhir grags pa ste/ gtsang pa sar sbos/ rma bya byang chub ye shes/ dar yon tan grags/ zhang thang sag pa ye shes 'byung gnas bcas so/ /stag tshang lo tsā bas mdzad pa'i grub mtha' kun shes rtsa 'grel las/ tshig la mkhas pa gang ba she'u/ don la mkhas pa gtsang ba 'bre sgur/ gnyis ka la mkhas pa rma bya byang brtson/ gnyis ka la mi mkhas pa zhang thang sag pa zhes gsungs pas/ bu bzhi la rtsi tshul mi 'dra bar snang ngo / /rma bya byang chub brtson 'grus kyis (dbu ma rigs tshogs kyi rgyan de kho na nyid snang ba〉(dbu ma 'jug pa'i sa bcad〉(rtsa shes kyi 'grel pa 'thad pa'i rgyan〉(rtog ge tho ba'i ṭīkka〉(tshig gsal stong thun gyi 'grel pa〉sogs brtsams pa dang / zhang thang sag pas(dbu ma 'jug pa'i ṭīka〉sogs mdzad nas pa tshab kyi bshad rgyun spel yang / kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang pos/ sha ra ba'i dris lan du yang gzhi la bden pa gnyis dang lam la thabs shes gnyis 'bras bu la sku gnyis zung du 'jug pa dgos tshul nan tan du bsgrubs pas zhang thang sag pa sogs kyi 'dod tshul de pa tshab lo chen rin po che'i bzhed par mi snang zhes 'khrul bral mkhas pa'i gsung las 'byung ngo zhes gsungs pa ltar/rang gi bla ma'i dgongs pa ji bzhin ma lon par dgag bya khyab che ba ste 60

bod gangs can gyi ljongs su dbu ma'i 'chad nyan ji ltar dar tshul/tha snyad tshad grub mi 'dod pa'i rnam gzhag byas par rje thams cad mkhyen pa yab sras dang rjes 'jug mkhas grub rnams kyi dri ma med pa'i gsung sgros chen po rnams su lung rigs rnam dag gi lam nas sun 'byin mdzad 'dug pa dus phyis kyi mkhyen spyan yangs pa'i rtogs ldan rnams la lhang nger gsal ba ltar dang / gang ba she'u blo gros byang chub dang khyung rin chen grags gnyis kyi zhabs la gtugs pa'i rgya dmar ba byang chub grags kyis (dbu ma'i de kho na nyid gtan la dbab pa〉 (dbu ma bden gnyis kyi 'grel pa〉sogs brtsams pa dang / phywa ba chos kyi seng ge dang karma dus gsum mkhyen pa sogs la dbu tshad gsungs/phywa ba chos kyi seng ges(spyi lo 1109—1169)(dbu ma bden gnyis kyi rnam par bshad pa yi ge nyung ngus gsal bar byed pa〉 (dbu ma rgyan gyi 'grel pa rgya cher bshad pa〉 (dbu ma snang ba'i gzhung gi don rigs pa'i tshul dang mi 'gal zhing blo chung bas kyang bde blag tu rtogs pa byis pa'i 'jug ngogs su sbyar ba bzhugs〉 (dbu ma de kho na nyid bsdus pa'am shar gsum dbu ma'i stong thun〉sogs brtsams pa dang /dpal ldan zla ba grags pa'i lugs la dgag bzhag mang du mdzad/ pa tshab kyis lo tsā byas te kha che'i parnyi ta dza ya ā nanta dang phywa ba gnyis dbu ma thal rang la rtsod pas phywa ba chos seng rgyal/ parnyi ta rgya nag ri bo rtse lngar byon nas rje btsun 'jam dpal bsgrubs/ (dbu ma 'jug 61

dbu ma'i spyi don zab don gsal byed 'azul gyi me long /pa'i 'grel pa rtog ge tho ba〉mdzad nas slar rtsod par phebs dus phywa ba gshegs zin par grags/ khong gi gsung las skyes pa'i slob ma seng chen brgyad dang / jo sras bzhi/ shes rab can bzhi sogs mkhas pa mang du byon/ slob ma grags che ba rnams las gtsang nag pa brtson 'grus seng ge dang rma bya ba 'ga' zhig gis thal 'gyur ba'i lugs 'dzin pa ma gtogs gzhan dag gis rang gi bla ma'i khrid rgyun ltar rang rgyud pa'i lugs khyab brdal du spel/ gtsang nag pa brtson 'grus seng ges rang gi slob dpon phywa pa chos kyi seng ges dpal ldan zla ba grags par skyon brgyad sogs nyes pa du ma brjod pa don dang mi mthun par dgongs nas/ dpal ldan zla ba grags pa'i gzhung lugs la/ /sbyangs pa'i stobs kyis gzhung don nges gyur pa/ /nga 'dra'i skye bo slad chad 'byung mi 'gyur/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa dang / phywa par stong par mtshan mar blta ba'i dbu ma pa zer bzhin dmigs phugs pa'i dgag sgrub du ma mdzad pa dang / pa tshab lo tsā pa'i mdun nas dpal ldan zla ba'i gzhung la sbyangs te thal 'gyur ba'i lugs spel/ (dbu ma bzhi brgya pa'i dka' gnad bshad pa〉(dbu ma'i bsdus don〉che chung sogs mang du brtsams/ rma bya byang brtson(spyi lo 1185lor gshegs)gyis pa tshab bu bzhi'i nang tshan rma bya byang chub ye shes dang kha che'i parnyi ta dza ya a nanta las dbu ma thal 'gyur ba'i lugs dang phywa ba chos kyi seng 62

bod gangs can gyi ljongs su dbu ma'i 'chad nyan ji ltar dar tshul/ge'i mdun nas dbu ma rang rgyud pa'i lugs la thos bsam gnang /thal rang gnyis las dbu ma thal 'gyur ba'i lugs kyis thugs 'phrogs te pa tshab dang dza ya a nanta'i dbu ma'i bshad srol rgya cher spel ba dang / (dbu ma rtsa ba shes rab kyi 'grel pa 'thad pa'i rgyan〉dang ske/ (dbu ma tshig gsal stong thun gyi 'grel pa/〉〈dbu ma bsdu ba'i 'grel pa/〉 (rtog ge tho ba'i 'grel ba〉 ('jug 'grel gyi bsdus don〉(dbu ma rigs pa'i tshogs kyi de kho na nyid snang ba〉 (dbu ma rigs pa'i tshogs kyi rgyan de nyid snang ba〉sogs ljags rtsom mdzad/ rma bya byang brtson la sa skya paṇa gyis zhus pa dang / rma bya byang brtson gyi slob ma rma bya shāka seng nas rje btsun red mda' ba chen po'i bar du dbu ma'i khrid rgyun ma nyams par byung / 'og tu gangs ri'i khrod 'dir rgyal bstan spyi dang zab mo dbu ma'i lugs dar zhing rgyas par mdzad pa/ la phyag rjes shin tu che ba'i mkhas shing grub pa'i bdag nyid chen ngo rnams kyi rnam par thar pa rgya mtsho lta bu las mdzad rnam rgyas bsdus 'tsham pa rang blos gang dpog cig 'god par bya ste/sa skya parnyi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan ni/ rab byung gsum pa 'i chu pho stag gi (spyi lo 1182)lor gtsang du sku bltams/ rma bya byang brtson dang / rang gi khu bo grags pa rgyal mtshan/ zhi don rdo rje skyabs/ tshur ston gzhon seng / spyi bo lhas pa byang chub 'od/ kha che'i paṇa chen shākya 63

dbu ma'i spyi don zab don gsal byed 'phrul gyi me long /shri dang de'i slob ma sagha shri/ su gha ta shri sogs bsten nas bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas la sbyang brtson dpyis phyin pa mdzad pas mkhas pa'i rtser son par gyur/ mkhas pa'i grags pa gangs can 'dzin ma'i khyon las brgal te rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du khyab pa na rgya gar lho phyogs kyi mu stegs 'phrog byed dga' bo sogs phyi rol pa'i ston pa drug nang pa'i rtsod zlar 'ong bar rigs pas tshar bcad/ rtsod pas pha rol rgol pa las rnam par rgyal ba'i rtags su mu stegs ston pa'i ral ba bregs pa sa skya'i dbu rtse rnying ba'i mgon khang du dus phyis kyi bar du yod par grags—/ de ltar sa skya parnyi ta'i mtshan snyan grags kun tu khyab pa na/glen pa skor zhig gis ri mo 'khyag 'khyog sus kyang mi shes pa 'ga' bris nas/ 'di dag la rang cag gis ka kha zer/ sa skya paṇa chen gyis e mkhyen blta zer nas gzigs 'bul zhus pas/ chos rje sa paṇa gyis cang mi shes gsungs pas/ 'di yi ge ka ma red dam/ 'di kha ma red dam zhes zur za byas pa dang / lkog tu sa skya paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa ma red ces phyogs kun tu bsgrags pa na/ rnam dpyod can zhig gis 'khyal gtam de thos nas/ glen pa 'ga' yis gros byas nas//kyag kyog cig la ka zhes btags/ /sa skya paṇa chen blun por bsgrags/ /zhes gsungs pa'i gtam rgyud dgod bro ba zhig kyang 'dug chosarje 'di pas tshad ma rigs pa'i gter zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos dang de'i 64

bod gangs can gyi ljongs su dbu ma'i 'chad nyan ji ltar dar tshul/rang 'grel/ legs par bshad pa'i rin po che'i gter zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos/ rol mo'i bstan bcos/ mkhas pa la 'jug pa'i sgo zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos sogs thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rig pa'i gzhung lugs mang du mdzad/ khong gi lta dgongs mthar thug dbu ma thal 'gyur ba'i lugs su gnas kyang / lta ba'i cha rtsal du bton nas dbu ma'i gzhung rang rkang du brtsams pa mi snang ngo / /skabs der bod 'dir lta ba'i phyogs nas log bshad 'byams su klas pas—/ bod kyi grub mtha' spyi'i lta ba'i 'khrul sel du sngon chad mkhas pa sus kyang ngag las ma thon pa'i legs bshad kyi gter mdzod chen mo (sdom pa gsum rab tu dbye ba'i bstan bcos〉zhes bya ba ljags rtsom mdzad/ de nyid las/ kha cig grangs can lugs bzhin du/ /yod pa'i dge ba zhes bya ba/ /rang byung du ni grub par 'dod/ /de la bde gshegs snying po zer/ /grangs can lugs 'di mi 'thad pas/ /lung dang rigs pas dgag par bya/ /bde bshegs snying po zhes bya ba/ /chos dbyings 'gyur med nyid la gsungs/ /de skad du yang rgyud bla las—/ /sems ni rang bzhin 'od gsal ba/ /nam mkha' bzhin du 'gyur med gsungs/ /mdo las de bzhin gshegs pa yi/ /snying ngo 'gyur med yin zhes bshad/ /klu sgrub kyis kyang dbu ma las/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rang bzhin med/ /'gro ba 'di yi rang bzhin med//65

dbu ma'i spyi don zab don gsal byed 'phrul gyi me long ces gsungs pa yang de nyid yin/ /zhes dang / phyag rgya chen po bsgom na yang / /rtog pa kha 'chol nyid bsgom gyi/ /rim gnyis las byung ye shes la/ /phyag rgya chen por mi shes so/ /blun po phyag rgya che bsgom pa/ /phal cher dud 'gro'i rgyu ru gsungs/ /min na gzugs med khams su skye—/ /yang na nyan thos 'gog par ltung / /gal te de ni bsgom legs kyang —/ /dbu ma'i bsgom las lhag pa med/ /ces dang / phyi nas rgyal khrims nub pa dang / /rgya nag mkhan po'i gzhung lugs kyi/ /yi ge tsam la brten nas ni/ /phyag rgya chen por ming bsgyur nas/ /da lta'i phyag rgya chen po ni/ /phal cher rgya nag chos lugs yin/ /zhes dang / lag len thams cad sangs rgyas kyi/ /bstan dang mthun na bstan pa yin/ /des na mdo sde ma dkrug par/ /sangs rgyas gsung bzhin nyams su longs/ /sangs rgyas rab tu byung ba yi/ /phyag tu mtshon cha bskur ba mthong / /khyim pa'i cha lugs can dag la/ /rgyan dang mtshon cha sogs srid kyi/ /rab byung rnams la 'di mi srid/ /ces sogs gsungs nas skabs de'i gangs ri khrod kyi lta spyod gnyis ka'i 'khrul ba thams cad sun phyung nas bstan pa la dag ther mdzad/ gzhung 'dir legs bshad seng ge rnam bsgyings kyi tshul du gsungs pa dag rje'i rjes 'jug rnams kyis kyang lung 'dren mang du mdzad 'dug pa gzhung chen po rnams thar chags su bklags pas rtogs nus shing / bstan bcos chen po 'di ji ltar 66

bod gangs can gyi ljongs su dbu ma'i 'chad nyan ji ltar dar tshulamadzad pa'i tshul yang / sdom gsum rab dbye'i phyed brtsams zin dus bod kyi chos pa rnams kyis sa paṇa gyis chags sdang gi gtam byas/ zhes chos nyan du 'ong ba'i gegs su song bas zangs tsha sogs bu slob rnams kyis mi rtsom par zhus pas/ ngas lo 'dod dang nga rgyal min/ bstan pa kho na bsam pa yin kyang thams cad mi dga' na bzhag pas chog ces gsungs pas/ mnal lam du sangs rgyas kyi sku mi gtsang bas gos pa zhig byi dor byas pa la mi mang po ma dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur la brten bzhag pa na/ slar mi gtsang ba mang po bsku ba dang / 'phags pa 'jam dpal sku rgyab brten nas bsnyung tshul ston pa sogs rmis pas/brtsam na mi mi dga' na yang / ma brtsams na lha mi dga' bar dgongs nas rdzogs par brtsams pa yin zhes sdom gsum 'grel pa zla 'od nor bu zhes pa mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags kyis mdzad pa na snang ngo / /zhes dbal mang parnyi ta dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i bden gtam snying rje'i rol mtsho las zur du phyung ba sa rnying bka' brgyud sogs kyi khyad par mgo smos tsam mu to'i rgyangs 'bod kyi tshul du bya gtong snyan sgron bdud rtsi'i bsang gtor zhes pa las gsungs so/ /mdor na chos rje sa paṇa gyis bod mi mang po'i tshe srog dang rgyu nor longs spyod sogs hor dmag gi 'jigs pa las bskyabs pa dang bstan pa la byi dor mdzad pa sogs bod kyi chos srid gnyis kar phyag 67

dbu ma'i spyi don zab don gsal byed 'phrul gyi me long rjes 'gran zla dang bral ba mdzad/ rab byung bzhi ba'i lcags mo phag (spyi lo 1251)lor yul lang grur sku gshegs/skyo ston smon lam tshul khrims ni/ rab byung bzhi pa'i sa yos(spyi lo1219)lor gtsang rta nag yang yul du sku bltams/ sangs rgyas sgom pa dang mchims nam mkha' grags gnyis kyi mdun nas bka' gdams gong ma'i chos skor yongs rdzogs la gsan bzhes mdzad/ lo bcu gcig gi ring la phyag na rdo rje'i bsnyen sgrub la 'bad pas grub pa'i go 'phang brnyes/ sangs rgyas sgom pa ni 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dang —/ mchims nam mkha' grags 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ dam pa 'di pa phyag na rdo rje ste dpon slob gsum rigs gsum mgon po'i rnam 'phrul du grags/ mchims nam mkha' grags gshegs rjes lo bco lnga'i ring la snar thang dgon pa'i gdan sa bskyangs/ dbu ma'i skor la(dbu ma tshig gsal gyi bsdus don〉(dbu ma tshig gsal gyi dka' gnad legs par bshad pa theg pa mchog gi rgyan〉(theg chen dbu ma'i gdams pa〉(rten 'brel lag len du dril ba〉sogs brtsams/rab byung lnga pa'i sa phag (spyi lo1399)lor snar thang dgon du sku gshegs/thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston lo tsā ba rin chen grub ni/ rab byung lnga pa'i lcags pho stag gi (spyi lo 1290lor)lor gtsang stod khro phu'i phyogs kyi shab smad sgom gnas zhes pa'i yul du sku 'khrungs/ chung dus nas bla 68

bod gangs can gyi ljongs su dbu ma'i 'chad nyan ji ltar dar tshul ma tshul khrims rgyal dpal bzang dang / khro phu'i mkhan chen yang rtse ba rin chen seng ge/ slob dpon bsod nams mgon/ lo tsā ba thar lo nyi ma rgyal mtshan sogs slob dpon du bsten te/ rig pa'i gnas kun la sbyangs pa rtag 'grus su mdzad/ dgung lo nyer gcig gi steng dbus gtsang gi chos sde chen po rnams su grwa skor mdzad/ skabs der mkhas par grags pa'i dbus kyi shākya gzhon nu dang / kha rag byang gzhon/gtsang gi mkhas pa dpal ldan seng ge dang 'jam skya sogs lung rigs kyis spa bkong ste mi smra ba'i brtul zhugs la bkod pas/ mkhas pa'i grags snyan gyis dbus gtsang kun tu khyab par gyur/ thams cad kyis pha ston pa la bu ston pa byung 'dug ces bsngags brjod mdzad pas/ bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa zhes pa'i mtshan thogs/ bu ston rin po ches snar thang gi bstan 'gyur la zhus dag mdzad de (dkar chag yid bzhin nor bu dbang gi rgyal po'i phreng ba〉brtsams pa sogs khyon bsdoms po ti nyer drug tsam bzhugs/ jo nang pa'i gzhan stong gi lta ba tshar gcod pa'i bstan bcos(bder gshegs snying po gsal zhing mdzes pa'i rgyan zhes bya ba〉ljags rtsom mdzad pa/ dang / gzhan yang /(rten 'brel gyi rnam bshad lung kun las btus pa〉(lta ba dag sel〉zhes pa sogs brtsams/ spyir rgya gar du kun mkhyen dbyig gnyen dang bod du bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa sbyangs pa'i pha rol tu son pa'i 69

dbu ma'i spyi don zab don gsal byed 'phrul gyi me long /tshad du brtsi yang sbyangs pa ltar thugs su ma chud pa dang / rgyal ngo pe har gyis bar chad byas te/ sa ris sogs la g.yeng du bcug pas sku tshe der mchog gi dngos grub ma brnyes par mkhas pa'i gsung sgros las kāgi/ nga/ ngo / /rab byung drug pa'i shing pho 'brug (spyi lo1364)lor sku 'das kun mkhyen dol bu ba shes rab rgyal mtshan ni/ rab byung lnga pa'i chu pho 'brug (spyi lo1292)lor gtsang stod mnga' ris dol po gru gsum gyi nang tshan spu mdor sku 'khrungs/ skyi ston bla ma 'jam dbyangs las byams chos sde lnga dang dbu ma'i gzhung mang du gsan/ chos rje yon tan rgya mtsho dang zla mgon gyi slob ma sgro ston gnam la brtsegs las dus 'khor rgyud 'grel sogs zab chos mang po zhib tu gsan/ 'u yug tu byon nas sgrub pa nyams bzhes mdzad pas/ mngon shes dang sprul bsgyur sogs kyi grub rtags brnyes/ gzhan stong gi lta ba thugs la 'khrungs te lta ba ston pa'i gzhung 〈ri chos nges don rgya mtsho〉zhes bya ba brtsams—/ kun spangs thugs rje brtson 'grus kyis gtsang gi lha rtse rdzong khongs jo mo nang du dgon pa btab par der bzhugs te gzhan stong gi lta ba spel bas jo nang pa zhes bod yul kun tu grags/ bo dong phyogs las rnam rgyal gyis de snga sa skya'i grub mtha' 'dzin pa la gzhan stong gi lta ba 'thad par ma mthong nas dol bu ba dang brtsad pas pham par 70

bod gangs can gyi ljongs su dbu ma'i 'chad nyan ji ltar dar tshul/byas te slob mar gyur/ lo tsā ba blo gros dpal dang / sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen sogs slob ma mkhas pa mang du bskyangs pa dang / bstan bcos brgya lhag tsam mdzad par grags/ rab byung drug pa'i lcags mo glang (spyi lo1361)lor sku gshegs/ nges don rgya mtsho las chos thams cad yin lugs don dam pa'i bden pa de rtag pa ther zug pa/ de nyid kun gzhi la rnam shes dang ye shes gnyis su yod pa'i ye shes yin zhing —/ zhes dang / kun rdzob kyi cha 'di rnams ni rang stong / chad stong /dgag stong / nyi tshe ba'i stong pa ye nas med pa thar 'dod pa rnams kyis rnam pa thams cad du dor bar bya ba yin no/ /zhes gsungs pas/don dam bden pa rtag brtan ther zug tu khas blangs pas rtag mthar lhung ba dang / kun rdzob sangs rgyas sa na gtan med du 'dod pas chad mthar lhung ba ste/ rtag chad gnyis ka'i gol sar lhung bas sa dge bka' rnying gi mkhas grub mang pos lung rigs brgya phrag gis sun phyung nas gsor mi rung gi lta ngan du bsgrubs/ rgyal dbang lnga pa'i sku ring la jo nang pa'i dgon pa thams cad dge lugs par bsgyur/ deng sang si khron rnga ba khul dang dzam thang du jo nang pa'i dgon pa nyung shas tsam las med par mngon no/ /rje btsun red mda' ba gzhon nu blo gros ni/ rab byung drug pa'i sa mo glang gi (spyi lo1349)lor sa skya dang khed nye ba'i khab sor sku 71

dbu ma'i spyi don zab don gsal byed 'azul gyi me long /'khrungs / sa skya'i mdo phyogs kyi bstan pa 'dzin pa'i ka chen g.yag gzhon gnyis zhes grags pa'i ya gyal te/ nya dbon kun dga' dpal dang —/ rgyal sras thogs med bzang po/ lo chen skyabs mchog dpal bzang sogs mkhas chen mang du bsten nas mdo rgyud gzhung lugs mtha' dag la gsan sbyang mdzad pas mkhas pa'i rtser son par gyur/de yang / 'dzam gling mdzes pa'i rgyan mchog bka' chen bzhi/ /rtsa 'jug bzhi gsum theg chen rgyud bla ma/ /chos mngon mdzod dang dpal ldan 'dus pa ste/ /rnam bshad mdzad pa'i gzhung lugs bcu phrag gcig /ces gsungs pa ltar/ dbu ma'i gzhung (theg pa chen po dbu ma lugs kyi gzhi lam 'bras gsum gsal bar byed pa〉(bdag med pa rnam pa gnyis kyi gnas lugs kyi don thos bsam gyi shes rab kyis gtan la phab ste phyin ci ma log par nyams su blang ba'i rim pa〉(dbu ma rtsa ba shes rab kyi ṭīkka〉(dbu ma 'jug pa'i rnam bshad de kho nyid gsal ba'i sgron me〉(rnal 'byor spyod pa bzhi brgya pa'i 'grel pa tshig don tsam gsal byed bzhugs〉(bden gnyis rnam par 'byed pa gnad kyi zla zer〉(lung kun las btus pa〉(rgyud bla ma'i ṭīkka〉sogs ljags rtsom gnang nas dpal ldan dbu ma thal 'gyur ba'i lugs rgya cher spel bas/ gsung las skyes pa'i slob ma rje thams cad mkhyen pa yab sras dang / kun mkhyen sher 'od/ kun dga' dpal 72

bod gangs can gyi ljongs su dbu ma'i 'chad nyan ji ltar dar tshul/bzang / dpal 'byor shes rab/ bsod nams shes rab sogs bstan pa 'dzin pa'i skyes chen mang du byon/ rje btsun red mda' ba'i gsung las—/ nga dang por slob gnyer byed dus sa skya sogs na dbu ma'i dpe cha zhig 'dug zer nas nor mi cher byed 'dug deng sang dbu ma'i dpe cha la rtsis su byed pa 'di yang kho bos bstan pa la bya ba byas pa yin gsungs pa dang / mkhas dbang karma dkon gzhon mchog gi zhal snga nas/ deng sang gangs ri'i khrod na mkhas rmongs kun kha dbu ma sna dbu ma zer ba 'di rje red mda' ba'i drin yin/ de gong du thang sag na dbu ma shi ro zhig 'dug zer/ gzhan yod pa'i lab ma thos zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rje rin po che'i yar sngon du dbu ma thal 'gyur ba'i lta ba rnyed pa'i mkhas pa nyung zad cig byon yang / sa 'og gi gter bton pa bzhin thal 'gyur ba'i lugs kyi dka' gnad mang po ches cher gsal bar mdzad pa la rje btsun dam pa 'di kho na bka' drin shin tu che zhes gzur gnas mkhas pa thams cad mgrin gcig tu gleng ngo / /rje btsun red mda' pa chen mos zab mo stong pa nyid thugs la 'khrungs pa'i tshul yang / bla ma 'od zer rgyal mtshan gyi dris lan du/rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i yid ches dang / /rten 'brel stong par rtogs pa'i shes rab gnyis/ /'bral med zung du chud par nam gyur pa—/ /de'i tshe mtha' bral dbu ma'i lam la zhugs/ /ji ltar snang zhing 73

dbu ma'i spyi don zab don gsal byed 'phrul gyi me long /grags pa'i dngos 'di la/ /rang gzhan grub mthas btags pa'i kun brtags dang / /lhan skyes yid kyi dngos 'dzin mun pa rnams/ /rnam dag lung rigs zer gyis rab gsal te/ /snang dus nyid na stong par rtogs pa dang / /stong pa rtogs tshe snang ba mi 'gog pa/ /zung 'jug tshul la nges pa nam rnyed pa/ /de'i tshe rgyal ba'i dgongs pa rtogs pa yin—/ /zhes dang/ mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pa'i ne ring sgrub pa dpal gyis zhus pa'i dris lan du/ rje red mda' pa dang rje bla ma yab sras gnyis po/ tshig gi brjod tshul phran tshegs ma gtogs/ dgongs pa mi gcig pa gtan med/ ces gsungs pas rjes su dpogs par nus so/ /rab byung bdun pa'i chu pho 'brug gi (spyi lo1412)lor dgongs pa chos dbyings su thim/'jam mgon chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa blo bzang grags pa ni/rab byung drug pa'i me mo bya (spyi lo1357)lor mdo smad tsong kha zhes grags pa'i yul du yab da ra kha che klu 'bum dang yum shing bza' a chos gnyis kyi sras su ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang bcas te sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo gsum bzhes pa'i tshe karma rol pa'i rdo rje las dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa mnos te/ mtshan la kun dga' snying po zhes gsol/ dgung lo bdun pa'i steng chos rje don grub rin chen dang ko'u ba gzhon nu byang chub las tshigs snga ma dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes te/ mtshan la blo bzang 74

bod gangs can gyi ljongs su dbu ma'i 'chad nyan ji ltar dar tshul/grags pa zhes gsol/ dgung lo bcu drug gi steng chos rje don grub rin chen gyis bskul pa ltar dbus gtsang du slob gnyer la phebs/ snye thang bkra shis seng ge dang / bla ma 'jam rin pa/ nya dbon kun dga' dpal/ rje btsun red mda' ba sogs gtsug nor mkhas dbang mang du bsten pa dang / phyis su rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi zhal mngon sum du gzigs shing / rje btsun mkhyen pa'i gter nyid bla mar bsten nas mdo sngags gzhung lugs rgya mtsho lta bur thos bsam sgom gsum dang 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyis sku tshe snyoms par mdzad pas/ nges pa don gyis gangs can mkhas grub thams cad kyi gtsug gi rgyan du gyur/de yang dbu ma'i gzhung la thos bsam mdzad tshul ni/ rje rang gi zhal nas—/ mdo sngags gzhung la ngal ba mang byas kyang / /zab don nyams su len dang smra ba dang / /gang yang ma bslabs ci yang mi shes pa'i/ /lta ba'i tshul las ring du ma song bar/ /mthong nas lhag par klu sgrub gzhung lugs kyi/ /yang dag lta ba 'dren pa'i gnad kun la/ /legs par sbyangs te the tshom chod par byas/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar te/ skabs der bod du dbu ma'i 'chad nyan shin tu nas nyams 'dug par brten/dbu ma'i gzhung gi lung rgyun tsam len pa'i yul yang brgya lam du srid pa tsam du snang bas/ thog mar rje btsun red mda' ba las dbu ma 'jug pa tshar gcig gsan pa las gzhan dag gi khrid lung ma thob rje 75

dbu ma'i spyi don zab don gsal byed 'phrul gyi me long /btsun pas kyang gzhan la dbu ma gsung ba'i thog ma der 'dug dbu ma rigs tshogs thams cad kyi lung snar thang mkhan po kun dga' rgyal mtshan dang / bde ba can pa'i bla ma 'jam rin pa las gsan pa yin zhing —/ rje btsun red mda' ba'i spyan sngar lo gcig lhag tsam bzhugs nas dbu ma 'jug pa dang tshad ma sogs zab chos mang du zhus/ dbu tshad kyi rigs pa'i sgo dang po rje btsun 'di las rnyed pas 'gran zla med pa'i bla ma'i gtso bor mdzad/ phyis su rje btsun red mda' ba chen por—/ dri med mkhyen pa'i dbang po 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /tshad med brtse ba'i gter chen spyan ras gzigs/ /gangs can mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan red mda' ba/ /gzhon nu blo gros zhabs kyi padmo la/ /thar 'dod bung ba bdag kyang bskyab tu gsol/ /zhes che brjod mdzad pas/rje btsun gyis tshig sna bsgyur te/ dmigs med brtse ba'i gter chen spyan ras gzigs/ /dri med mkhyen pa'i dbang po 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /gangs can mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan tsong kha pa/ /blo bzang grags pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes 'bul bar mdzad/ rjes su dben sa snyan brgyud lugs su/ bdud dpung ma lus 'joms mdzad gsang ba'i bdag /ces kha bskangs par mdzad do/ /gzhung la bsam bzhes gnang ba'i gnas skabs su 'dul ba mdo rtsa'i rgya cher 'grel gyi dbu nas nyin re zhing mda' tshad ma bcu bdun re chag med du thugs 'dzin 76

bod gangs can gyi ljongs su dbu ma'i 'chad nyan ji ltar dar tshul/mdzad/ slob ma rnams la dam pa gong ma rnams kyi rnam thar 'chad pa'i skabs su/ bka' bzhi pa sher seng gis chos thog gcig la po ti bcu gcig gsungs 'dug dus phyis su 'di las lhag pa ma byung bar snang ngo — /zhes gsungs pas/ dge bshes sha ston sogs kyis 'dir rje nas kyang de tsam zhig gsung bar 'tshal zhes gsol ba btab pas/ tshad ma rnam 'grel/ mngon pa gong 'og 'dul ba mdo rtsa/ byams chos phyi ma bzhi—/ dbu ma rigs tshogs lnga/ dbu ma 'jug pa/ bzhi brgya pa/ spyod 'jug ste bstan bcos bcu bdun bod kyi ṭīka chen rnams kyi lta ba'i bzhed mtshams dang phan tshun go bsdur nas dgag sgrub dang bcas legs par gtan la phab nas thams cad chos kyi dga' ston gyis tshim par mdzad/ drang nges legs bshad snying po las/ gzhung lugs mang thos rigs pa'i lam du yang / /ngal ba mang bsten mngon par rtogs pa yi/ /yon tan tshogs kyis mi dman du mas kyang / /'bad kyang rtogs par ma gyur gnas de ni/ /'jam dbyangs bla ma'i drin gyis legs mthong nas/ /shin tu brtse ba'i bsam pas bdag gis bshad/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ skabs shig bla ma dbu ma pa brtson 'grus seng ge dang mjal/ bla ma dbu ma pa khong la chung dus nas rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sku dang gsung gi snang ba nar mar 'ong bas/ skabs de tsam na rje'i thugs la'ang khas len ci yang med par gzhan ngor 'ba' 77

dbu ma'i spyi don zab don gsal byed 'phrul gyi me long /zhig la skyel ba'i dbu ma'i lta ba de cung zad bde bar yod pas/ bla ma dbu ma pa lo tsā bar bcol nas rje btsun la bdag gi lta ba 'di thal rang gang gi lta ba yin zhus pas/ gang gi'ang min gsungs shing / da phyin chad bla ma dang yi dam tha mi dad du byas la gsol ba 'debs pa dang —/ tshogs bsags sgrib sbyong la 'bad pa/ gzhung lugs la dpyod pa gsum sum sgril gyis la nyams su longs shig dang / ring bor mi thogs par lta ba rnyed par 'gyur/ da lta nas bshad pa byas kyang phan thogs pa mi 'ong bas/ dben pa bsten te sgrub pa snying po gyis shig ces bka' stsal bas/ slob dpon 'jam dkar ba dpal ldan bzang po—/ bla ma rtogs ldan 'jam dpal rgya mtsho sogs 'khor dag pa rnam brgyad phyag phyir khrid de 'ol kha chos lung du phebs/ rdo leb steng du macel phul bas phyag ngar brdol ba dang / zhabs rjen du skor ba phebs pas zhabs brdol ba sogs dka' spyad drag po sku nyams su bzhes/ de nas 'o de gung rgyal gyi lha zhol dben gnas lha sdings su byon te der lo gcig bzhugs te zab chos mang du gsungs/ gnas der tshogs bsags sgrib sbyong la 'bad kyin gzhung la rtog dpyod mdzad pas/nub gcig mnal lam du slob dpon klu sgrub dang 'phags pa lha/sangs rgyas bskyangs/ dpal ldan zla ba grags pa/ slob dpon legs ldan 'byed rnams rang bzhin yod med la bgro gleng mdzad kyin 'dug 78

bod sangs can gyi ljongs su dbu ma'i 'chad nyan ji ltar dar tshul/pa'i nang nas slob dpon sangs rgyas bskyangs kyis rgya dpe dbu la bzhag nas byin gyis brlabs pa'i mtshan ma byung bas/ phyi nyin rtsa she'i 'grel pa burta pā ta la gzigs pas/ rtsa she'i rab byed bco brgyad pa'i/gal te phung po bdag yin na/ /skye dang 'jig pa can du 'gyur/ /gal te phung po rnams las gzhan/ /phung po'i mtshan nyid med par 'gyur/ /zhes pa'i thad kyi 'grel pa nas mtha' gzhan du dogs pa'i sgro 'dogs lhag ma med par chod nas zab mo stong pa nyid ji lta ba bzhin du thugs la 'khrungs pa'i tshul mdzad do/ /rje'i rjes 'jug rnams kyis rtsa she'i 'grel pa burta pā li ta la gzigs na stong nyid rtogs pa la rten 'brel che zhes mkhas pa'i gsung sgros las 'byung ngo / /de ltar chos nyid zab mo la nges pa gting tshugs pa rnyed pas/ ston pa la shes nas mi phyed pa'i dad pa rma med pa 'khrungs te/ rten 'byung gsung ba'i sgo nas ston pa la bstod pa rje'i legs par bshad pa thams cad kyi yang snying /legs bshad snying po chung bar grags pa ste (rten 'brel bstod pa〉thugs rtsom gnang / rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi zhal mngon sum du yang yang gzigs shing / dbu ma'i gzhung gi dka' gnad shin tu phra mo dag rje btsun la dngos su zhus te gtan la phab/ se ra chos sdings su rtsa she'i 'grel pa rgyas pa mdzad par bzhed pa la rigs pa'i gsang tshig 'ga' zhig la cung zad dpyad dka' ba byung bas/ bla ma dang rje 79

dbu ma'i spyi don zab don gsal byed 'phrul gyi me long /btsun ngo bo dbyer med la gsol ba drag tu btab pas/ sher mdo'i stong nyid nyi shu'i 'grel rkang brgya rtsa brgyad gser btso ma'i yi ger bkod pa'i rnam pas bar snang gang bar gzigs pa yang yang byung bas/rtsa she'i rigs pa phra mo rnams la nges pa bde blag tu rnyed nas(dbu ma rtsa ba'i tshig le'ur byas pa'i rnam bshad rigs pa'i rgya mtsho〉mdzad/de nas (drang ba dang nges pa'i don rnam par 'byed pa'i bstan bcos legs bshad snying po〉(dpal ldan sa skya'i mkhas pa g.yag gzhon gnyis kyi ya gyal g.yag phrug sangs rgyas dpal gyis drang nges las brtsams pa'i dri ba mang du zhus pa'i lan du legs bshad snying po thugs rtsom gnang bar se ra rje btsun pas mdzad pa'i mkhas grub je'i rnam thar las gsungs/)(dbu ma la 'jug pa'i rnam bshad dgongs pa rab gsal〉 (zhi lhag gnyis kyi dka' gnas rgyal ba'i dgongs pa bzhin bshad pa〉(lhag mthong che chung gnyis gcig tu brtsis pa'i lta ba'i legs bshad chen ngo lnga zer)sogs mdzad nas gangs ri'i khrod kyi lta ngan mun pa'i tshogs mtha' dag mthar bskrad de/ bstan pa'i bdag po thub dbang bcom ldan 'das nas 'phags pa klu sgrub yab sras la brgyud pa'i nges pa'i don mthar thug pa lta ba'i yang rtse dpal ldan dbu ma thal 'gyur ba'i lugs bzang dri ma med pa 'di nyid gangs can gyi ljongs su nyin mo ltar ches cher gsal bar mdzad pa dang / rje bla ma 'jig rten du byon pa'i dgos pa'ang mdo phyogs kyi dbu ma dang sngags phyogs kyi gsang 'dus kyi dgongs don gsal bar byed pa'i slad du bsam bzhin du skye 80

bod gangs can gyi ljongs su dbu ma'i 'chad nyan ji ltar dar tshul/ba lhur bzhes pa yin zhing / rje bdag nyid chen po'i 'phrin las kyi gdugs dkar po yug cig gis gangs can gyi khor mo yug kun tu khyab par gyur pa na/ sa skya'i mjes rgyan dgu ru grags pa'i nang tshan go shāg stag gsum las/ chags sdang rmongs gsum gyis yid gzir ba'i go rams pa bsod nams seng ge dang paṇa chen du grags pa'i shākya mchog ldan gnyis kyis sgrub byed ltar snang mang du bkod nas rje'i dgongs bzhed dri ma med par zur za mang du mdzad par rje'i rjes 'jug se ra rje btsun pa yab sras sogs kyis dbu nas mjug bar lung rigs brgya phrag gis sun phyung nas rmeg med du btang ba dang / stag tshang lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen dang / karma mi bskyod rdo rje/ ngor ba kun dga' bzang po/ 'brug pa padma dkar po/ bo dong phyogs rgyal ba sogs kyis kyang dang por rje bla ma'i mdo sngags kyi dgongs bzhed du mar dgag pa'i stangs ka byas kyang / phyis su 'gyod bshags dang bcas bsngags brjod kyi me tog lan brgyar 'thor bar mdzad/ zang zang ne ring pa 'chi med rab rgyas kyi gsung las/ yang skal ba med pa dang / shes rab med pa dang / log lta can tshos ni res 'ga' log pa dang min par go ba dang / res 'ga' rgya 'grel la bltas pa bzhin du tshig don go mi nus pa du ma zhig kyang byung ba ni/ rang gi skyon dang gsung rab brling drags pa'i rang shugs yin pas rje rin po che'i 81

dbu ma'i spyi don zab don gsal byed 'phrul gyi me long /gsung rnams kyi skyon du ma 'dzin cig 'o na/ paṇa chen phyogs las rnam rgyal sogs kyis skyon brjod dang / dgag tshig mdzad pa ci yin snyam na/ paṇa chen gyis ni dpyad gzhi tsam du mdzad pa yin pa las skyon can gyi dgag pa mdzad pa mi 'dug gzhan dgag tshig byed pa du ma ni/ la las phyogs snga tsam yang ma lon pa dang / la las gsung rab spyi'i mtha' phugs cher ma brtags pa dang / la las mdo rgyud spyi'i gnas tshul ma shes pa dang / la las rang gi blo la bdud zhugs te phyogs 'dzin pa dang / shes 'dod che zhing chags sdang gi dbang du song ba'i skyon yin par 'dug go zhes gsungs pas rtogs sla'o/ /mdor na/rje bla mas 'dul ba kā ri ka nas bzung ste/ rgyud kyi rgyal po dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i bar gyi lta spyod thams cad gang zag gcig 'tshang rgya ba'i cha rkyen du lung rigs brgya phrag gis gtan la phab pa dang /snyigs dus kyi tshe thung gcig la dus yun thung ngu tsam gyi nang zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang bde blag tu thob par byed pa'i mdo sngags zung 'brel gyi lam bzang rgyas par mdzad pas/ sku tshe de nyid la zhi ba mchog gi sar gshegs pa'i dben sa snyan brgyud kyi phreng ba dang lung rtogs yon tan nam mkha' mdzod la mnga' bsgyur ba'i mkhas grub nyi zer gyi rdul grangs dang mnyam pa mtha' yas pa byon nas/gser sbyangs btso ma lta bu'i zhwa ser 'chang ba'i ring lugs dri ma med 82

bod sangs can gyi ljongs su dbu ma'i 'chad nyan ji ltar dar tshul/pa 'di nyid stod dza ti'i dri ngad rnam par ldang ba nas smad rgya mtsho'i mtha' la thug par 'byams brdal yug cig tu khyab par gyur pa yin pas / rje thams cad mkhyen pa'i bka' drin gangs can pa rnams kyis nam yang bsab par sla ba ma yin no/ /de ltar rje bla mas sku dngos kyi gdul bya rnams rnam grol gyi lam bzang la bkod nas/ phyi rabs rjes 'jug rnams brtse ba chen pos rjes su gzung phyir (byang chub lam rim chen mo〉(sngags rim chen mo〉(rim lnga gsal sgron〉(legs bshad gser phreng〉sogs legs par bshad pa'i yig 'jog mang du mdzad nas / rab byung bdun pa'i sa mo phag gi (spyo lo1419)lor mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshul bstan to/ /rgyal tshab dar ma rin chen ni/ rab byung drug pa'i shing pho 'brug (spyi lo1364)lor gtsang nyang stod du sku bltams/ dgung lo bcu par gnas rnying du mkhan chen red mda' ba las dbu ma sogs gzhung bka' pod lnga dang / gsang 'dus sogs gsang sngags phal che ba gsan—/ sa skya dang / gsang phu/ rtse thang bcas su po ti dka' ba bcu'i grwa skor mdzad/ rong ston shākya rgyal mtshan dang / mkhan chen g.yag pa sogs sa skya'i bstan 'dzin chen po rnams dang rtsod pas mi smra ba'i brtul zhugs la bkod pas/ mkhas grags kyis dbus gtsang kun tu khyab—/ dka' bcu pa'i mtshan btags bzhes/ rje'i snyan pa gsan te 83

dbu ma'i spyi don zab don gsal byed 'phrul gyi me long /gnyal gyi ra stod du rtsod par 'ong bar/ rje bla ma'i lung rtogs kyi yon tan gyis thugs rab tu 'phrog nas slob mar gyur/ de nas lo bcu gnyis bar du rje rin po che gtsug rgyan du tshul bzhin du bsten te mdo sngags gzhung lugs thams cad la gsan sbyang dpyis phyin pa mdzad pas mkhyen rab kyi klong brdol bar gyur/ rje rin po ches dbu ma'i gzhung gi bshad khrid rgyas par gnang skabs su/ (dbu ma rgyan gyi brjed byang〉(rigs pa drug cu pa'i zin bris〉(spyod 'jug shes rab le'u'i zin bris〉sogs mdzad pa dang / rje rin po che nas sher phyin gsung skabs 'khor rnams la mar me 'bul ba'i zhal ta gnang bar/rgyal tshab rjes zangs snod chen po zhig tu mar me btsugs te phul bas/rje bla mas rten 'brel khyad par can la dgongs nas mar me thams cad der bsdus/ rgyal tshab la zin bris gyis zhes bskul pa ltar/ snga rabs mkhas pa sus kyang zhal las ma thon pa'i dri ma med pa'i legs par bshad pa'i rin po che'i gter mdzod chen mo 〈rnam bshad snying po'i rgyan〉zhes bya ba'i gzhung dam pa 'di nyid mdzad pa yin zhing / byang chub sems dpa' chen po 'dul 'dzin grags pa rgyal mtshan dang rgyal tshab gnyis la rje'i sras kyi thu bo gnyis zhes grags/ rje mya ngan las mda' khar sku ber dang dbu paṇa gnang ste don gyis rgyal tshab la dbang bskur—/ rgyal tshab rje zhes pa'i mtshan yang de nas thogs/ (bden 84

bod gangs can gyi ljongs su dbu ma'i 'chad nyan ji ltar dar tshul/gnyis kyi rnam bzhag dang lta khrid rin po che'i phreng ba〉 (dbu ma rin chen phreng ba'i snying po'i don gsal bar byed pa〉 (bzhi brgya pa'i rnam bshad legs bshad snying po〉 (bstan bcos chen mo dbu ma la 'jug pa'i bsdus don〉 (rigs pa drug cu pa'i ṭīkka〉 (lta khrid lhag mthong sgom tshul〉sogs mdzad/ lo bcu gsum tsam la 'jam mgon bla ma'i legs bshad dri ma med pa'i gsung rgyun rgya cher spel/ dgung lo drug cu re brgyad bzhes pa'i tshe mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang rgyal tshab la mnga' gsol/ dgung lo drug cu bzhes pa rab byung bdun pa'i chu pho byi (spyi lo1432)lor rtse po ta lar sku gshegs/mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang ni/ rab byung drug pa'i shing mo glang gi (spyi lo1385)lor gtsang la stod du sku 'khrungs/ mkhas grub seng ge rgyal mtshan las rab tu byung ste/ mtshan la mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang po zhes gsol/ dgung lo bcu drug par ngam ring chos sde ru bo dong paṇa chen phyogs las rnam par rgyal bas rigs gter bkag pa la rigs pa'i rol rtsal 'gran pas/ bo dong bas skabs shig nas rgyu las ma skyes pa'i 'dus byas khas len dgos pa byung nas kha skyengs te/ de grub mtha'i nang 'gal red gsungs nas kha spu 'thogs pas mkhas grub kyis rgyu las ma skyes pa'i 'dus byas yod pa dang / de mdo sde pa'i nang 'gal yin pa dang / kha spu 'thogs pa'i las la 85

dbu ma'i spyi don zab don gsal byed 'phul gyi me long brtson par gyis shig ces gsungs par grags/ da lta sde bdun yid kyi mun sel phal cher de dus kyi rtsod tshul mkhas pa rnams kyis zin bris byas pa la phyis su sbyar byang sogs mdzad pa yin zhes gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me'i zab mo lta ba'i zin bris las gsungs so/ /mkhas grub rje'i bstod pa (bung ba gzhon nu rnam par rtsen pa'i rgyud mangs〉zhes pa bo dong bas phul bar grags kyang / zhang zhung chos dbang grags pas sbyar bar mkhas pa kha cig gsungs pa thugs mad par mngon no/ /dgung lo nyer gcig par rje btsun red mda' ba mkhan po dang / rje dpal 'byor shes rab las slob/ mnyam med blo gros mtshungs med kyis gsang ston mdzad nas dge slong gi sdom pa bzhes/ jo nang pa'i lta ba 'gog pa la (sangs rgyas kyi ming can bdag rtag pa'i mthar 'dzin pa'i lta ba 'joms par byed pa yid kyi mun sel〉zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos ljags rtsom mdzad de/ mjug tu/ lta ba 'di'i phyogs la dgag pa byas pa ma gzod na/ 'di kho na nyid yin gyi/ gzhan ni gti mug go snyam pa'i zhen pa yod la/ lung dang rigs pa'i sgrub byed mthar thug pa yod cing rtsod par bzod pa yod na/ mdo rgyud man ngag dang bcas pa dang —/ rgya bod kyi shing rta chen po rnams dang / phyi nang gi grub mtha' kun dpang du btsugs nas gang dang mthun rtsod pa lags pas/ yul dus gang yin rtsod pa'i skabs 'byed par zhu zhes rtsod par mi 'jigs 86

bod gangs can gyi ljongs su dbu ma'i 'chad nyan ji ltar dar tshul/pa'i gdong lnga'i gad rgyangs phyogs su bsgrags/ dgung lo nyer gsum par dbus su rje thams cad masmo pa dang mjal/ de nas bzung rje sku mdun du bzhugs te mtshan mo tshun du bla slob phan tshun dbu sngas sbrel te mdo sngags man ngag dang bcas pa ngoms pa med par gsan bzhes mdzad pas/ rje bla ma'i nang thugs kyi sras gcig pur gyur/ rgyal tshab dar ma rin chen dang / 'dul 'dzin 'jam dkar ba sogs las kyang zab chos mang du zhus/ dpal ldan sa skya'i mkhas chen rong ston smra ba'i seng ges khong dang rtsod zer nas yi ge yang yang bskur bas/ mkhas grub rje dpal 'khor chos sder rtsod par phebs pa na rong ston dpa' zhum te thabs du mas bshol thabs mdzad pas/ mkhas grub rin po ches—/ byis pa mkhas par rlom pa gang / /ring na gnas tshe kho bo dang / /lhan cig brgal lan bya'o zhes/ /gyu gyu'i yid ldan drang srong gi /smod pa'i tshig bzhin yang yang sgrogs/ /de nas nam zhig 'dir phyin tshe/ /zhum pa bzhin dang skrag pa bzhin/ /nongs pa bzhin dang 'gyod pa bzhin/ /skyabs med gzhan du skyabs 'tshol byed/ /ces sogs gsungs nas sgo yig sbyar ba dang / dgung lo zhe bdun bzhes pa'i tshe rgyal tshab rjes dga' ldan gser khrir dbang bskur/ ngor ba kun bzang bas rje'i sngags kyi dgongs bzhed du mar dgag pa mdzad pas/mkhas grub rin po ches(phyin ci log gi gtam gyi sbyor ba smra ngan 'thag 87

dbu ma'i spyi don zab don gsal byed 'phrul gyi me long /pa'i bstan bcos gnam lcags 'khor lo〉zhes bya ba mdzad nas bskur bas lan ma thebs par ci bya brtol med gyur te chos can mi gcig ces kha 'phangs pas/ ngor ba rnams kyis/ nged kyi ngor ba kun dga' bzang po 'di/ /lcang ra chos mdzad dang ni rtsod pa'i tshe/ /'khor gsum brgya phrag dngos 'gal byas na yang / /chos can mi gcig gsungs la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes 'phya bzhad byas par grags/gung ru rgyan mtshan bzang po sogs kyis rje bla mas lta ba'i dpyad pa ma rdzogs pa'i skabs kyi gsung sgros la brten nas stong nyid ma yin dgag tu 'chad pa sogs rje'i rang lugs mthar thug dang mi mthun pas/rje'i legs bshad rnams dkrugs par dogs nas lung rigs kyis sun phyung ba dang / dbu ma'i gzhung (dbu ma'i rnam bshad stong thun skal bzang mig 'byed〉(dbu ma thal 'gyur ba'i lugs kyi lta khrid〉(lta khrid mun sel sgron me〉(lta ba'i zhal shes yig chung〉sogs mdzad nas 'jam 'gon bla ma'i thun mong ma yin pa'i ring lugs dri ma med pa phyogs mthar spel ba la phyag rjes 'gran zla dang bral ba mdzad/ dgung lo lnga bzhi pa sa rta (spyi lo1438)lor gzugs sku'i bkod pa chos dbyings su bsdus/lo chen skyabs mchog dpal bzang ni/ rab byung drug pa'i nang tsam du sku 'khrungs/ 'di pa'i mdzad rnam zhib mo ma rnyed/ dbu ma'i 88

bod gangs can gyi ljongs su dbu ma'i 'chad nyan ji ltar dar tshul/skor la(dbu ma rtsa ba shes rab kyi 'grel pa don gsal〉(dbu ma la 'jug pa'i rgya cher bshad pa gsung rab rgya mtsho'i de kho na nyid rab tu gsal ba〉zhes pa'i gzhung gnyis ljags rtsom mdzad/ sku che'i stod du dbu ma'i lta ba'i cha nas bod snga rabs pa'i bshad rgyun 'dzin yang /phyis su rje tsong kha pa'i slob mar gyur pas grub mtha' snga ma dor te dge lugs pa'i bstan 'dzin chen por gyur/ rje rin po che la(lam rim chen mo〉dang (sngags rim chen mo〉rtsom skul zhu ba po yin pa gsung sgros chen po gnyis kyi mjug byang du gsal lo/ /gung ru rgyal mtshan bzang po ni/ rab byung drug pa'i chu mo phag (spyi lo1383)lor mdo khams stod du sku 'khrungs/ rje tsong kha pa dang / byang sems ra sgreng pa shākya bsod nams sogs kyi zhabs pa da spyi bor bsten nas mdo sngags rig gnas thams cad la gsan sbyang mthar phyin pa mdzad—/ chen po dwags po ba dang / slob dpon dge legs rgyal mtshan gnyis dang brtsad pas rnam par rgyal/ 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi spobs pa gzengs su mtho bas zhal slob mkhas pa/'ang mang du byon/dbu ma'i gzhung (dbu ma rtsa ba shes rab kyi don bsdus〉(dbu ma 'jug pa'i 'grel pa〉dzodabu ma'i stong thun〉rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum sogs brtsams/ zha lu tshul khrims rin chen gyi rnam thar las/ tshul rin pa 'jam dbyangs chos rje'i drung du chos gsan par byon pas rten 89

dbu ma'i spyi don zab don gsal byed 'phrul gyi me long /'brel ma 'dzoms pas/ se rar mtshungs med chos rje las chos gsan par—/ lta ba'i 'chad tshul rje'i dngos slob rnams kyi bshad tshul dang mi mthun pa byung ba la rgyu mtshan zhus par/ rgyan bzang bas khong gzhan la ci gsungs ma shes/ nged la rje bla mas stong nyid ma yin dgag gi sgom tshul 'di bzhin gsungs pa yin/ zhes gsungs zhes 'byung ba dang /gung ru rgyan bzang ba'i gsung las/ dgag bya bkag shul gyi 'dzin stangs sbyor ba 'di mkhas grub dge legs pa rang gis rtsal bshad byos pa'i kha 'dzin ri bo dge ldan pa yongs kyis sgrog par snang / rje rin po che dang bla ma rje btsun red mda' ba gnyis dgag bya ngos 'dzin phra zhib dpyod tshul bag tsam rtsing zhib las/ mnyam bzhag skyong tshul 'dra/zhes gsungs kyang / stong nyid med dgag tu bzhed pa 'di mkhas grub rin po ches rang bzo byas pa ma yin par rje thams cad mkhyen pa'i dgongs bzhed mthar thug yin pa blo gros can gyis rje'i phyi rtsom rtsa 'jug gi ṭīka chen gnyis dang lhag mthong chen mo sogs mthar chags su bklags pas rtogs sla'o/ /khong gi gsung rtsom rnams skabs der se ra smad grwa tshang gi yig cha yin kyang / dbu ma'i lta ba'i cha nas rje'i lta ba'i dpyad pa ma rdzogs pa'i skabs kyi gsung sgros bskyangs pa dang / rje bla ma'i lta ba'i bzhed tshul dang mi mthun pa'i gzhan gyi bshad pa rnams la'ang thugs gtsigs cher mdzad pa'i dbang gis mkhas grub rin po 90

bod gangs can gyi ljongs su dbu ma'i 'chad nyan ji ltar dar tshul/ches bka' bkyon mdzad nas/ gsung rtsom rnams chos rgyal la gtad gnyer byas te khrid rgyun spel du ma bcug pas/ rgyan bzang bas mi rnams phal cher grags pa'i rjes su 'brang / /blo bzang grags pa dga' ldan gnas su gshegs/ /byams chen chos rje mi dbang gtsug na mdzes//rgyal mtshan bzang po gangs ri'i khrod du lus/ /zhes sogs thugs skyo ba'i gtam gsungs/ thu'u bkwan chos kyi nyi mas/ deng sang dge bshes su rlom pa tshos rgyan bzang ba dang kun mkhyen gyi yig cha(kun mkhyen par grags pa blo gros rin chen seng ge)mig gis lta ba tsam yang rung ba'i tshod du byed mod/ blo gros can gyis mthong na mkhas pa mgu ba'i legs bshad kyi gter du snang ngo / /zhes chos rje 'di pa'i gsung gi skyon yon so sor phye nas legs bshad kyi cha rnams la gdeng 'jog mdzad pa ni gzur gnas mkhas pa'i spyod tshul bla na med pa nyid du rtogs par bya'o—/ /rab byung brgyad pa'i lcags pho rta (spyi lo1450)lor se ra dgon du sku gshegs/rong ston shes bya kun rig shākya rgyal mtshan ni/ rab byung drug pa'i me mo lug (spyi lo1367)lor shar rgyal mo rong du sku 'khrungs/ chung dus su yab kyi mdun nas rig gnas dang bon chos sogs la slob gnyer gnang —/ dgung lo bco brgyad steng dbus su phebs te gling stod pa rin chen rnam rgyal dang kong ston blo gros dbang phyug sogs la bsten nas 91

dbu ma'i spyi don zab don gsal byed 'phrul gyi me long rngog legs pa'i shes rab nas brgyud pa'i phar phyin dang / tshad ma/dbu ma rang rgyud pa'i bshad srol sogs la thos bsam legs par mdzad pa dang / lo chen skyabs mchog dpal bzang dang / kun mkhyen sher 'od/ karma dkon gzhon sogs kyi mdun nas kyang zab chos ci rigs gsan/ rtsod rigs la shin tu byang bas rong ston smra ba'i seng ge zhes grags/ (dbu ma rtsa ba'i rnam bshad zab mo'i de kho na nyid snang ba zhes bya ba〉(dbu ma bden gnyis kyi rnam par bshad pa yi ge nyung ngus gsal bar byed pa bzhugs〉(zhib mo rnam 'thag gi 'grel pa rtog ge'i 'khrul 'joms rdo rje'i tho ba bzhugs〉(rigs pa drug cu pa'i 'grel pa〉(stong nyid bdun cu pa'i 'grel pa〉(rin chen phreng ba'i 'grel pa〉(rtsod pa bzlog pa'i 'grel pa〉(sher snying rgya cher 'grel pa〉(dbu ma 'jug pa'i 'grel pa〉(dbu ma rgyan gyi 'grel pa〉(dbu ma chos dbyings bstod pa'i 'grel pa〉(dbu ma rigs tshogs kyi spyi don〉che chung gnyis sogs gzhung chen zhe gcig gi rnam bshad mdzad pa sogs mkhas pa'i bya ba rnam gsum gyis dus mda' bas slob ma mkhas pa mang du byung / smar khams pa grags pa bzang po dang /gung ru rgyal mtshan bzang po/ snar thar rje shes rab seng ge sogs kyis kyang dang por khong gi mdun nas thos bsam mdzad kyang / phyis su rje tsong kha pa'i slob mar gyur/ bod kyi dpal na lend+ra'i dgon pa phyag 92

bod gangs can gyi ljongs su dbu ma'i 'chad nyan ji ltar dar tshul/'debs mdzad pa dang / phar phyin dang dbu ma rang rgyud pa'i lugs 'dzin spel bgyis pa la phyag rjes shin tu che bar grags/ rab byung brgyad pa'i sa mo sbrul (spyi lo1449)lor sku gshegs/bo dong paṇa chen phyogs las rnam rgyal ni/ rab byung drug pa'i shing mo yos (spyi lo1375)lor gtsang la stod lho phyogs dbyig gu zhes pa'i yul du sku bltams/ mkhan chen grags pa rgyal mtshan dang / mkhas dbang chos kyi rdo rje gnyis kyi mdun nas tshad ma'i gzhung mang du gsan/ lha mo dbyangs can ma bsgrubs pas zhal mngon sum du gzigs shing byin gyis brlabs pas/ snyan ngag dang gzhung chen po rtsom pa la thogs rdugs med par gyur/ g.yag sde paṇa chen dang rong ṭīka pa gnyis ka rtsod pas pham par mdzad/ (bden pa nges pa〉(dbu ma'i bstan bcos de kho na nyid rnam par nges pa〉〈byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa'i 'grel pa〉sogs po ti che chung brgya dang so gnyis tsam ljags rtsom mdzad pas/ gangs can bod du bstan bcos brtsams pa la grangs 'di las mang ba med par grags pa dang / 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyis sku tshe bskyal bas slob ma mkhas pa khri phrag brgal ba tsam byung —/ khong nas dang por rje rin po che'i dgongs pa'i gting ma dpog par dpyad gzhi'i tshul du dgag yig bris kyang / phyis su rje bdag nyid chen por bsngags brjod kyi zhu 'phrin phul ba ste/ mkhas pa ngang ba'i 93

dbu ma'i spyi don zab don gsal byed 'phrul gyi me long /rgyal po blo bzang mchog /grags pa mgrin pa'i rdza rnga sgrog can/ /legs bshad smra ba'i dbang po'i zhabs drung du/ /'jigs med bung ba gzhon nus 'di skad zhu/ /zhes dang / bdag ni 'jig rten 'di nas pha rol tu—/ /myur bar dus kyi pho nyas ma bos na/ /sangs rgyas sprul sku khyod nyid mjal ba dang / /der bzhugs mkhas grub rnams dang mjal nas kyang —/ /dam pa khyod dang chos kyi bka' mchid la/ /de phyogs bgrod la rtse gcig yid zhugs pa/ /rtag tu ngu de sher phyin 'tshol ba ltar/ /zhes sogs mang du gsungs so/ /rab byung brgyad pa'i lcags lug (spyi lo1451)lor zhi bar gshegs/'brong rtse lha btsun rin chen rgya mtsho ni/ dus rabs bcu bzhi pa'i dus mjug tsam du gtsang gi 'brong rtse zhes par bod btsan po'i gdung rgyud du sku bltams/ mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang sogs mkhas pa mang du bsten nas mdo sngags gzhung lugs mang por thos bsam mdzad—/ khong gi mtshan gzhan la blo gros dpal bzang dang 'brong rtse lha sras zhes kyang gsol/ dbu ma'i gzhung(dbu ma'i lta ba'i yig chung〉(dbu ma'i lta ba sgom tshul〉(dbu ma la 'jug pa'i tshig 'grel〉sogs brtsams—/ khong gi 'khrungs 'das kyi lo tshigs mi gsal bas dpyad par bya'o/ /rgyal ba dge 'dun grub pa ni/ rab byung bdun pa'i lcags mo lug 94

bod gangs can gyi ljongs su dbu ma'i 'chad nyan ji ltar dar tshul/(spyi lo1391)lor dpal ldan sa skya'i nye 'dabs srad kyi lung lag gur mo ru ba zhes pa'i yul du sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo bco lnga par mkhan chen grub pa shes rab las rab tu byung zhing dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes pas/mtshan la dge 'dun grub pa dpal bzang po zhes gsol/ rje tsong kha nga dang —/ mkhan chen grub pa shes rab/ mkhas grub shes rab seng ge sogs gtsug nor mkhas pa drug cu lhag bsten nas mdo sngags rig gnas mtha' dag la thos bsam dpyis phyin pa mdzad pas mkhas pa'i rtser son par gyur/ tshad ma rigs rgyan dang / 'dul ba'i gleng 'bum/'dul ba'i bslab khrims chen mo sogs gzhung chen mo'i yig 'jog mang du gnang ba dang / zab mo stong pa nyid gtan la 'bebs pa'i bstan bcos (dbu ma'i lta khrid〉 (dbu ma rtsa ba shes rab kyi ngag don bshad pa rin po che'i phreng ba〉(dbu ma 'jug pa'i rnam bshad dgongs pa rab tu gsal ba'i me long〉sogs brtsams/ dgung lo lnga bdun par bkra shis lhun po dpal gyi chos 'khor gling phyag btab nas sku gsung thugs rten mang po 'gro ba'i bsod nams kyi zhing du gsar bzhengs mdzad/ dam pa khong nyid rgyal ba sku phreng dang po yin zhing /dgung lo so lnga nas gya bzhi'i bar bstan pa'i bdag po mdzad de 'chad nyan gnang bas/ 'dul 'dzin dpal ldan bzang po dang / rdo rje slob dpon bzang po bkra shis/ 'jam dpal dbyangs kun dga' bde 95

dbu ma'i spyi don zab don gsal byed 'phrul gyi me long /legs—/ rin chen rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po sogs mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyis phyug pa'i zhal slob mkhas pa mang po gangs can gyi ljongs su khyab par gyur/ rab byung brgyad pa'i shing pho rta (spyi lo1474)lor zhi bar gshegs/paṇa chen bzang po bkra shis ni/ rab byung bdun pa'i lcags stag(spyi lo1410)lor la stod byang du sa skya dang khad nye ba'i phul byung zhes pa'i yul du sku bltams/ rje shes rab seng ge dang / rje dge 'dun grub pa/rje blo gros chos skyong / 'dul 'dzin blo gros sbas pa/ chos rje blo gros chos skyong / dwags po kun dga' bkra shis/ bla ma tsandan pa/ chos rje tshul rgyal ba/ 'phags pa 'od pa la sogs mkhas grub mang po'i zhabs la gtugs te mdo sngags chos tshul rgya mtsho lta bu la thos bsam rgya cher mdzad pas mkhas pa'i mtshan snyan thob/ sa dge rnying gsum gyi gsang sngags 'chad tshul la mkhyen rab shin tu rgyas par grags/ rab byung brgyad pa'i lcags stag lor gangs can chos 'phel dgon phyag btab pa dang / dgung lo re lnga bzhes pa rab byung brgyad pa'i shing rta(spyi lo1474)lor rje dge 'dun grub pa'i zhal bkod ltar bkra shis lhun po'i khri thog gnyis par phebs te 'chad nyan mdzad/ 'di pa'i gsung rtsom gyi skor la(grub mtha'i rnam gzhag ces bya ba〉(dbu ma'i lta khrid zab lam mun pa sel ba'i sgron me 'bar gsal〉sogs chos tshan so bdun 96

bod gangs can gyi ljongs su dbu ma'i 'chad nyan ji ltar dar tshul /tsam bzhugs pa deng sang po ti chen po gcig tu byas nas dpar du btab 'dug dgung grangs re dgu bzhes pa rab byung brgyad pa'i sa khyi(spyi lo1778)lor dgongs pa gzhan don du gshegs/spyan snga blo gros rgyal mtshan ni/ rab byung bdun pa'i chu pho rta lor (spyi lo1402)yul dbus stod lhas lung ba chos grwa dgon gyi zhol grwa rnam khang zhes bya ba'i yul du sku bltams/ dgung lo bdun pa'i steng khu bo kun dga' blo gros kyi drung du rab tu byung bas/ mtshan la blo gros rgyal mtshan zhes gsol/ chos rgyal dpal bzang dang / mkhan chen bsod nams shes rab kyi mdun nas phar phyin dang / tshad ma/ mdo rtsa sogs gsan—/ phyis su rje yab sras dang / 'dul 'dzin grags pa rgyal mtshan/rtogs ldan 'jam dpal rgya mtsho sogs dge ba'i bshes gnyen du bsten nas mdo sngags gzhung lugs rab 'byams la gsan sbyang rgya cher mdzad pas mkhas pa'i phul du phyin par gyur/ 'jam mgon bla ma'i dngos slob spyan snga brgyad ces grags pa'i gras yin zhing / (dbu ma'i lta khrid zab lam mthar thug〉(mthal bral dbu ma'i lta khrid kyi snyan brgyud lta ngan mun sel〉 (mtha' bral dbu ma'i nyams len lta ngan mun sel gyi 'grel pa〉(srid zhi mnyam nyid kyi lta khrid snyan brgyud rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis bla ma dbu ma pa dang rje rin po che gnyis la gnang ba bzhugs so〉 (rnam 'grel la brten pa'i lta khrid〉97

dbu ma'i spyi don zab don gsal byed 'phrul gyi me long /sogs ljags rtsom gnang ba dang / zhal slob bstan 'dzin chen po rab 'byams pa smon lam dpal bzang dang / chos rje kun legs pa/ chos rje rab 'byams pa blo bzang sogs mang du byon/ rab byung brgyad pa'i chu pho 'brug (spyi lo1472)lor sku gshegs/ba so chos kyi rgyal mtshan ni/ rab byung bdun pa'i chu pho rta (spyi lo1402)lor gtsang la stod ldog gzhung du sku 'khrungs/ dam pa 'di pa mkhas grub rin po che'i gcung po yin zhing / je thams cad mkhyen pa yab sras las sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi la mtha' chod par sbyangs pas mkhas pa'i mkhas pa chen por gyur/ gcen po mkhas grub rje dang rtogs ldan 'jam dpal rgya mtsho gnyis las rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis rje bla mar gnang ba'i dge ldan sprul pa'i glegs bam du grags pa'i man ngag thams cad rdzogs par zhus/ man ngag zab mo 'di snod ldan gyi slob ma rdo rje mched gsum du grags pa ste/ grub chen chos kyi rdo rje dang / stod lung dpal ldan rdo rje/ khams pa rin chen rdo rje gsum las gzhan su la'ang ma gsungs shing / dam pa 'di gsum gyis man ngag zab mo thugs nyams su bzhes pas 'chi med rdo rje'i sku brnyes—/ rjes su rgyal ba dben sa pa blo bzang don grub kyis grub chen chos kyi rdo rje'i zhal gzigs shing snyan brgyud sprul pa'i glegs bam dang bcas pa gnang bas dben sa snyan brgyud ces grags/ ba so lhun grub 98

bod gangs can gyi ljongs su dbu ma'i 'chad nyan ji ltar dar tshul/bde chen du yun ring bzhugs nas 'chad nyan gnang bas ba so chos rgyan du grags/ dgung lo re gnyis bzhes pa'i tshe dga' ldan gser khrir phebs te/ rgyal ba gnyis pa'i ring lugs thun mong ma yin pa rgya cher spel/ 〈dbu ma'i lta ba'i khrid legs bshad man ngag gi rgya mtsho〉 (dbu ma'i lta mgur〉zhes bya ba ljags rtsom mdzad/ dam pa khong nyid rta tshag sku phreng dang po yin zhing / rab byung brgyad pa'i chu mo sbrul (spyi lo1473)lor dgongs pa chos dbyings su thim/zhang zhung chos dbang grags pa ni/ rab byung bdun pa'i shing pho sprel (spyi lo1404)lor stod mnga' ris zhang zhung du sku 'khrungs/ rje yab sras dang gung ru rgyal mtshan bzang po sogs dge ba'i bshes gnyen du bsten nas thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rig pa'i gnas mtha' dag la sbyangs pa dpyis phyin pa mdzad/ rje'i slob ma rnams las mus sad pa rin chen seng ge dang / zhang zhung chos dbang grags pa gnyis la rnam dpyod phul du byung ba'i mkhas pa gnyis zhes grags/ ngag gi rig byed la dbang 'byor bas (rgyal po rā ma ṇa'i rtogs brjod〉ces bya ba brtsams/ rje'i rjes 'jug rnams las snyan ngag la 'di las mkhas pa ma byung bar grags/ dbu ma'i gzhung (dbu ma rtsa ba'i 'grel pa tshig gsal gyi mtha' bzhi'i skye ba 'gog pa'i ston thun〉(rten 'brel bstod pa'i 'grel pa〉(lta khrid〉sogs ljags rtsom mdzad/ rab 99

dbu ma'i spyi don zab don gsal byed 'phrul gyi me long /byung brgyad pa'i sa mo glang (spyi lo1469)lor sku gshegs/stag tshang lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen ni/ rab byung bdun pa'i (spyi lo1405)gtsang gi phyogs yar 'brog stag lung du sku 'khrungs/ dam pa 'di nyid dpal ldan sa skya'i mdo sngags rig gnas thams cad la mkhas pa go shāka stag gsum zhes grags pa'i nang tshan yin zhing / dge ba'i bshes gnyen seng ge rgyal mtshan las rab tu byung bas/ mtshan la shes rab rin chen zhes gsol/ rje byang sems pa dang / 'jam dbyangs kun dga' chos 'phel/ khā lu rin chen bsod nams lhun grub—/ lo chen skyabs mchog dpal bzang sogs mkhas dbang mang du bsten nas mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas par sbyang brtson nan tur mdzad pas/ sa skya'i grub mtha' 'dzin pa'i mkhas pa chen po gyur/'dul ba dang / mngon pa/ tshad ma/ legs sbyar sgra rig pa/ mngon rtogs rgyan/ byams chos sde lnga sogs kyi ṭīka chen mdzad pa dang / dbu ma'i gzhung(mtha' bral dbu ma'itsholta ba mtha' gnyis mun sel〉zhes bya ba brtsams/ stag tshang lo tsā pa 'di pa lo chen skyabs mchog dpal bzang gi sras kyi thu bo yin zhing / lo chen tshang gis thal 'gyur ba'i lta ba dri ma med pa ma rnyed par mkhan po ngag dbang dge legs kyi lam rim bde lam zin bris las gsungs pa dang / stag tshang pa'i sku tshe'i stod du lta ba'i thad nas dbu ma thal 'gyur ba'i lugs la tha snyad tshad 100

bod gangs can gyi ljongs su dbu ma'i 'chad nyan ji ltar dar tshul/grub mi bzhed par 'dod pas/ rje tsong kha pa'i lta ba'i phyogs la skyon rtog byas nas (grub mtha' kun shes rtsa 'grel〉brtsams te dgag pa mdzad pa ste/ de nyid las/ gang dag dpal ldan zla ba'i rjes 'brangs nas—/ /ma dag 'khrul ba'i snang ba tshad grub tu/ /rigs pa du mas dpyad nas khas len pa/ /'di la 'gal ba'i khur chen 'di ltar yod/ /ces pa nas/ rdzas yod bdag smra gnas ma bur nges dang / /rnam shes bdag smra'i dbu sems yod pa 'gal/ /zhes gsungs nas rje'i dgongs bzhed du mar 'gal khur bco brgyad btang / phyis su rje bla ma'i legs bshad gzhan rnams dngos su gzigs nas dgongs pa ji lta ba bzhin du khong du chud pas shin tu 'gyod nas bsngags brjod mdzad pa ste/ na mo gu ru mdzi gho ṣā ya/ blo chen rgyal ba rnams kyi spyan snga ru/ /bzang po'i smon lam rlabs chen grub pa'i mthus/ /grags pa'i sgra chen thub bstan 'gro ba'i dpal/ /blo bzang grags pa'i dpa la la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes pa nas/ khyod la gtsor byas ha cang mchog 'dzin gyi/ /phyogs lhung gdon gyis bstan pa dkrugs pa yang / /dag snang phyogs med mnga' ba khyod nyid kyis/ /myur du bsal nas bstan 'dzin mthun gyur cig /ces sho lo ka bcu drug gi bdag nyid can (snyan dngags bstod pa tshig gi nyi ma〉zhes bya ba'i bstod pa brtsams/dam pa 'di nyid gzur gnas mang thos chen po yin pa'i cha nas/101

dbu ma'i spyi don zab don gsal byed 'phrul gyi me long /'brug rgyal dbang chos rjes/ rje tsong kha pa'i chen po'i gsung rab kyi dgongs don/ mdo sngags kyi dka' gnad khyad par can ches zab cing phra ba rnams ji lta ba bzhin dgongs nas bcos min gyi dad pa 'khrungs te rab btags dang 'khyog brjod sogs ma yin par rang bzhin drang bor brjod pa kho nas bstod bsngags mdzad pa ni/ dbang rnon chos kyi rjes 'brang gi dad pa skye tshul du snang ste/ dpyod ldan gzhan gyis kyang rje'i gsung rnams tshul 'di bzhin du dpyod shes na dad pa dang gus pa mi skye ba'i rang dbang med do/ /zhes tshad mthon pos gdeng 'jog gnang ba dang / kun gzigs lnga pa chen pos/ shes byar srid kun mang thos gser sgong du/ /rnam daphyod drod kyis smin pa tshangs pa'i spun/ /'jig rten mig gcig stag tshang lo tsā ba/ /nges pa don ldan ma hā parnyi ta/ /zhes dang / (rang rnam du ku la'i gos bzang〉las—/ rig pa'i gnas thams cad la 'khrul ba'i dri ma tsam yang spangs pa stag tshang lo tsā ba/ zhes bstod pa nar mar mdzad do/ /khong gi 'das lo mi gsal bas dpyad gzhir bzhag pa'o/ /kun mkhyen blo gros rin chen seng ge ni/ rab byung bdun pa'i nang tsam du gtsang la stod du sku 'khrungs/ rje thams cad mkhyen pa dang /mkhas grub rje/ 'jam dbyangs chos rje sogs bla mar bsten nas mdo sngags gzhung lugs thams cad la thos bsam mthar phyin mdzad pas/102

bod gangs can gyi ljongs su dbu ma'i 'chad nyan ji ltar dar tshul/kun mkhyen zhes pa'i mtshan thogs/ shing bza' parnyi ta'i drang nges rnam 'byed kyi zin bris las/ kun mkhyen pa blo gros rin chen seng ge de ni 'bras spungs su bzhugs stabs ma bde ba zhig gis bros nas phebs pa lta bu zhig red/ khong gi rjes la grwa ba brgya tsam 'brangs nas phebs te deng sang gi sngags khang de na se ra 'tshogs pa'i skabs red/der g.yas gral phu nas bzhugs rtsis byas par phu na gnas brtan brag ri ma bzhugs pa'i nang nas yan lag 'byung gis phyag g.yas pa brkyangs te/ byes pa byas nas byon pa legs/ /kun mkhyen chen po byon pa legs/ /bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzugs lags sam/ /zhes gsungs pas byes pa grwa tshang du grags pa red/ kun mkhyen pa 'di rgyal ba shākya thub pa'i sprul sku yin pa sku 'phreng gi bstod pa zhig na yod gsungs—/ zhes gsungs shing / se ra'i mkhan por bzhugs rjes gnyal ston dpal 'byor lhun grub dang slob dpon dpal ldan blo gros sogs khrid rgyun 'dzin pa'i mkhas pa mang du bskyangs/ (dbu ma'i rnam bshad dgongs pa rab gsal gyi de nyid gsal byed〉(tshad ma'i stong thun mkhas pa'i yid 'phrog〉sogs brtsams/ 'khrungs 'das kyi lo tshugs mjal yul du ma gyur to/ /paṇa chen shākya mchog ldan ni/ rab byung bdun pa'i sa pho sprel (spyi lo1428)lor gsang phu'i bar tshigs zhes par sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo 103

dbu ma'i snyi don zab don gsal byed 'phrul gyi me long /brgyad par skyor mo lung du rong ston smra ba'i seng ge las rab tu byung zhing mtshan la shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blo gros su gsol/rong ston dang / ngor chen kun dga' bzang po/ brag dkar sems pa chen po sogs gtsug nor mkhas pa bzhi bcu tsam gyi zhabs la gtugs te zab rgyas kyi gzhung lugs mang por mkhas par sbyangs/ 〈dbu ma la 'jug pa'i rnam par bshad pa nges don gnad kyi ṭīka〉(dbu ma la 'jug pa'i dka' ba'i gnas 'ga' zhig rnam par bshad pa ku mud kyi phreng mdzes〉 (stong thun chen mo〉(zab zhi spros bral gyi rnam par bshad pa stong nyid bdud rtsi'i lam po che〉(dbu ma rtsa ba'i rnam par bshad pa skal bzang 'jug ngogs〉(dbu ma'i sgom rim la 'khrul pa spong zhing thal rang gi grub mtha' dang lta ba'i rnam gzhag tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyi rnga sgra〉(theg pa chen po dbu ma rnam par nges pa'i chos kyi bang mdzod lung dang rigs pa'i rgya mtsho〉(shing rta chen po rnam gnyis kyi rnam par bshad pa nges don gcig tu bsgrubs pa'i bstan bcos〉sogs brtsams—/ dbu ma rnam nges las/ yang gang dag gzhung 'dis/ bdag med gnyis po dgag bya'i sgo nas mi 'byed par chos can gyis 'byed par bstan pa yin no/ /zhes zer ba ni 'grel pa dang mi mthun zhing /zhes dang / kho bo ni bdag 'dzin gnyis po 'dzin stangs kyis 'byed pa zla ba'i zhabs kyi dgongs par 'chad de/ zhes dang / lugs gnyis 104

bod gangs can gyi ljongs su dbu ma'i 'chad nyan ji ltar dar tshul/rnam 'byed las/ yum rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum las bshad pa'i stong nyid chad stong med dgag yin gyi/ bsgom pas nyams su blang bya ma yin/zhes sogs gsungs nas dbu ma'i dka' gnad mang po'i thad du rje bdag nyid chen po'i legs bshad rnams dang mi mthun pa'i phyin ci log 'ba' zhig smras nas skur 'debs tshabs po che byas 'dug par/se ra rje btsun pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis go shāka gi lan (zab mo stong nyid kyi lta ba la log rtog 'gog par byed pa'i bstan bcos lta ba ngan pa'i mun sel〉zhes bya ba mdzad nas lung rigs kyi rkya bar nas drangs pa'i rigs tshul dri ma med pa'i bskal pa'i zhugs chen gyis log par rtog pa'i dug gi tshang tshing ma lus par thal bar btang zin pa gzi bo'i blos dgag yig la zhib tu gzigs pas nges shes rnyed thub/ rab byung dgu pa'i me mo yos (spyi lo1507)lor sku gshegs/gnyal ston dpal 'byor lhun grub ni/ rab byung bdun pa'i me lug (spyi lo1427)lor gnyal khul du sku 'khrungs/ chung dus su gsang phur chos rje rin chen byang chub kyi mdun nas chos bka' ci rigs gsan / rjes su se ra dang dga' ldan du phebs nas kun mkhyen blo gros rin chen seng ge dang ba so chos rje sogs kyi zhabs la gtugs te gzhung don la phu thag chod par sbyangs pas rtogs pa'i go 'phang mthon por gshegs/ sa skya'i paṇa chen shākya mchog ldan dang rtsod pa bgyis te 105

dbu ma'i spyi don zab don gsal byed 'phrul gyi me long /lung rigs kyis mi smra ba'i brtul zhugs la bkod/ rtse nyag pa'ang rtsod pas pham par mdzad pas mkhas pa'i grags pas kun tu khyab/ (rgyal ba'i gsung rab kyi drang nges 'byed pa'i rnam bshad legs bshad snying po'i don gsal bar byed pa'i bstan pa'i sgron me〉sogs legs bshad mang du brtsams/ shing bza' parnyi ta'i zhal snga nas/ rje'i gsung rab thams cad kyi snying po dang rtse mo mthar thug pa legs par bshad pa'i snying po zhes bya ba 'di nyid 'chad pa la/ mkhas pa'i bshad srol mtha' yas pa yod kyang khyad par du 'phags pa ni gnyal ston dpal 'byor lhan grub pa'i dka' 'grel 'di nyid yin/ de'i rgyu mtshan gnyan ston pas kun mkhyen pa la gsan/ kun mkhyen pas 'jam dbyangs chos rje la gsan/ des rje rin po che la dngos su gsan/ de'i phyir gnyan ston pa'i bshad pa 'di 'jam dbyangs chos rje nas brgyud pa yin/ de yang kun mkhyen pas 'jam dbyangs chos rje la gsan pa'i sa bcad zhig yod pa de la gzhi byas nas dka' 'grel brtsams pa yin/ de'i gnad kyis lcang skya rin po ches 'di'i sa bcad zur du bkol nas dpar phud 'dug zer zhes bsngags brjod mdzad 'dug go /dam pa khong nyid rab byung dgu pa'i shing khyi(spyi lo1514)lor sku gshegs/go bo rab 'byams pa bsod nams seng ge ni/ rab byung bdun pa'i sa mo bya (spyi lo 1429)lor khams phyogs go bo'i yul du sku 'khrungs/106

bod gangs can gyi ljongs su dbu ma'i 'chad nyan ji ltar dar tshul/rong ston chos rje dang / ngor chen kun dga' bzang po/ mkhun po mus chen— dkon mchog rgyal mtshan sogs bla ma mang du bsten nas mdo sngags gzhung lugs mang por slob gnyer mdzad pas sa skya'i bstan 'dzin kun gyi gtsug rgyan du gyur/ khong gis dbu ma'i gzhung (dbu ma rtsa ba shes rab kyi rnam par bshad pa yang dag lta ba'i 'od zer〉(rgyal ba thams cad kyi thugs kyi dgongs pa zab mo dbu ma'i de kho na nyid spyi'i ngag gi don ston pa nges don rab gsal〉(rten 'brel gyi rnam bzhag 'khor 'das rab gsal〉(lta ba'i shan 'byed theg mchog gnad kyi zla zer〉sogs brtsams pa dang / bden med dang bden grub gnyis ka'i mtha' las 'das pa'i dbu ma'i lta ba de ni 'phags pa klu sgrub yab sras dang zla grags kyi lugs las ches khyad du 'phags par bshad nas gzhung ci rigs su 'jam mgon bla ma'i gsung la zur za mang du byas 'dug pa dang / sgos su (dbu ma la 'jug pa'i dkyus kyi sa bcad dang gzhung so so'i dka' ba'i gnas la dpyad pa lta ba ngan sel〉zhes bya ba mdzad nas/ rje rin po che'i (dbu ma la 'jug pa/'i rnam bshad dgongs pa rab gsal〉gyi gsung phal cher drangs nas ma rtogs log rtog gi sgo nas rje thams cad mkhyen pa ra skur zhus kham po che byas 'dug par/ se ra rje btsun pas go shāka gi rtsod lan (bstan bcos lta ngan mun sel〉mdzad pa dang / de las shāka lan rdzogs par 107

dbu ma'i spyi don zab don gsal byed 'phrul gyi me long /brtsams nas/ rkyen dbang gis go lan rtsom 'phror lus pas/ rje 'di pa'i thugs sras 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i blo gros kyis/ go shāka gnyis phrag dog skyes te/ dgag pa'i bstan bcos mang du bris 'dug pa la/ bdag gi bla ma rje btsun chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis/ shāka lan rdzogs par mdzad nas/ go lan gyi 'phro lus 'dug pa/ bdag gis mdor bsdus tsam zhig brjod pa bya ste zhes gsungs nas mjug grub par mdzad pa dang / gzhan yang (spyi lo1477)go lan(lta ba ngan pa thams cad tshar gcod pa'i bstan bcos gnam lcags 'khor lo〉zhes bya ba ljags rtsom mdzad nas/ go shāka gnyis kyi log rtog nyes bshad thams cad sun phyung bar mdzad do/ /dgag yig 'di brtsams nas lo bcu gsum pa rab byung brgyad pa'i sa mo bya lor (khyi lo1489)go bo rab 'byams pa sa skya dgon du sku gshegs/'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i blo gros ni/ rab byung bdun pa'i sa mo bya (spyi lo1429)lor tshal du sku 'khrungs/ gung ru chos blo dang / slob dpon dpal blo gros/ slob dpon gnas brtan pa/ ba so chos kyi rgyal mtshan sogs bla mar bsten nas mdo sngags gzhung lugs thams cad la bsam gsan rgya chen mdzad pas mkhas pa chen por gyur/ dam pa 'di pa'i mtshan gzhan la 'jam dbyangs legs pa chos 'byor zhes gsol yang / rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi zhal mngon sum du 108

bod gangs can gyi ljongs su dbu ma'i 'chad nyan ji ltar dar tshul gzigs te/ khyod kyi blo gros 'di yod na dga' ba la zhes gsungs pas/phyis su 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i blo gros su mtshan thogs/ go rams pa bsod nams seng ges rje rin po che'i dbu ma thal 'gyur ba'i lugs kyi 'grel tshul dang khyad par du lta ba'i gnad mang po zhig khong du chud ma nus par rigs pa ltar snang 'ba' zhig bkod nas dgag sgrub kyi khur blangs pas/ mkhas dbang 'di pas (lta ba ngan pa tshar gcod pa'i bstan bcos gnam lcags 'khor lo〉zhes bya ba ljags rtsom mdzad nas go rams pa'i lta ngan tshar bcad pa dang / gzhan yang 〈lta ba'i khrid yig de nyid gsal byed〉 (lta ba'i mtha' dpyod mkhas pa'i snying gtam〉 (lta ba'i khrid yig bsdus pa 'jam dpal zhal lung〉(dbu ma rtsa ba'i ṭīkka〉 (dbu ma 'jug pa'i gzhung 'grel dgongs pa rab gsal〉 (rten 'brel gyi rnam bshad thar pa'i them skas〉 (dbu ma la 'jug pa'i tshig don rnam par dbye ba'i brgal lan skal bzang rna rgyan〉 〈dbu ma rtsa ba'i tshig le'ur byas pa'i gzhung 'grel rigs pa 'i rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru rdzings〉(legs bshad nyi ma'i 'od zer las zab don dbu ma'i spyi don lung rigs mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan〉sogs brtsams/ khong gi gsung las skyes pa'i slob ma mkhas pa rgyal ba dge 'dun rgya mtsho dang / chos rje chos kyi bshes gnyen/ chos skyong rgya mtsho—/ dka' bcu pa blo gros grags pa sogs mang du byon/ dpal ldan 109

dbu ma'i spyi don zab don gsal byed 'phrul gyi me long /'bras spungs kyi khri la bzhugs te dbu ma'i 'chad nyan sogs kyis sku tshe bskyal—/ rab byung brgyad pa'i chu mo phag (spyi lo/503)lor zhi bar gshegs—/klo bo mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub ni/ rab byung bdun pa'i lcags mo bya (spyi lo1441)lor sa skya drung chen pa'i sras su sku bltams/chos rje yon tan chos rgyal dang tshul khrims rgyal mtshan sogs las dbu ma dang / sdom gsum rab dbye/ gsang 'dus sogs mdo sngags kyi gzhung mang du gsan pas mkhas pa chen por gyur/ dbu ma'i gzhung (dbu ma chos kyi dbyings su bstod pa'i rnam par bshad pa don dam snying po〉(rje btsun mi la ras pa'i mthar thug gi lta ba ji ltar bzhed lugs 'khrul med snang ba〉mdzad/ rab byung dgu pa'i shing mo bya (spyi lo1525)lor sku gshegs/se ra rje btsun pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan ni/ rab byung brgyad pa'i sa mo glang (spyi lo1469)lor nyang stod du sku bltams/ dgung lo bdun par gnas rnying chos rje kun dga' bde legs rin chen gyi mdun nas dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa bzhes te/ mtshan la chos kyi rgyal mtshan zhes su gsol/kun mkhyen chos 'byor dpal bzang dang / paṇa chen ye shes rtse mo gnyis las dbu ma sogs gzhung bka' pod lnga dang / gnyal ston dpal 'byor lhun grub las rtsa 'jug gnyis kyi ṭīkka dang / drang nges 110

bod gangs can gyi ljongs su dbu ma'i 'chad nyan ji ltar dar tshul sogs zab chos mang du zhus/ mkhas pa'i grags snyan dbus gtsang gi yul gru kun tu khyab pas/ sde pa sger pas po ta la dang gzhis ka sne'u rnams su dpal ldan sa skya pa'i mkhas pa mang po bsdus nas rje 'di nyid dang rtsod pa mdzad pas thams cad lung rigs kyis pham par mdzad/ zab mo dbu ma'i gzhung (drang nges rnam 'byed kyi spyi don rgol ngan tshar gcod rin po che'i phreng ba〉dang / go shāka gnyis kyi lan (zab mo stong pa nyid kyi lta ba la log rtog 'gog par byed pa'i bstan bcos lta ba ngan pa mun sel〉kar lan (gsung lan klu sgrub dgongs rgyan〉 (bstan bcos dbu ma 'jug pa'i rnam bshad dgongs pa rab gsal gyi dka' gnas gsal bar byed pa'i spyi don legs bshad skal bzang mgul rgyan〉 〈rten 'brel gyi spyi don klu dbang rol mtsho〉 (grub mtha'i rnam bzhag〉sogs legs par bshad pa'i bstan bcos mang du mdzad pa dang / snga phyir ser byes mkhas mang grwa tshang gi mkhan po dang /se ra'i chos khri la bzhugs te 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi sgo nas rgyal ba gnyis pa kun mkhyen tsong kha pa chen po'i ring lugs 'khrul bral gser sbyangs btso ma lta bu phyogs mthar spel ba la phyag rjes bsgrun du med pa bzhag pas/ se ra rje btsun pa'i yig cha zhes grags snyan gyi me tog bod gangs can gyi ljongs su 'thor/ rab byung dgu pa'i shing 'brug (spyi lo1544)lor gzugs sku'i bkod pa chos dbyings su bsdus/ se ra rje 111
