dbu ma'i spyi don zab don sasal byed 'phrul gyi me long /btsun pa'i gcung po dang slob ma gnyis ka yin pa'i khyung phrug byams pa bkra shis kyis (zab mo rten 'brel gyi rnam bzhag mkhas pa dgyes pa'i mdzum zhal〉(drang nges rnam 'byed kyi thal phreng phas rgol 'joms pa'i gnam lcags mkhas pa'i blo mtsho 'phel ba'i legs bshad kyi chu rgyun〉(bstan bcos chen po dbu ma la 'jug pa'i rnam bshad dgongs pa rab gsal gyi tshig don gsal bar byed pa'i mtha' dpyod pa phas rgol 'joms pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba〉sogs ljags rtsom mdzad do/ /paṇa chen bde legs nyi ma ni/ dus rabs bcu drug pa'i dkyil tsam du byang bre ba'i rigs su sku 'khrungs/ sku na phra dus bkra shis lhun po'i thos bsam gling gi chos grwar zhugs te gzhung bka' pod lnga la thos bsam mdzad/ phyis su se ra rje btsun pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan bla mar bsten nas dbu phar sogs la mtha' chod par sbyangs pas mkhas grags shin tu rgyas/ dbu ma'i skor la(dbu ma'i dgongs rgyan rin po che'i phreng ba〉dang / se ra rje btsun pas go shāka gnyis tshar bcad pa'i dgag yig ste (bstan bcos lta ngan mun sel〉zhes bya ba'i gzhung nyid rtsom 'phror lus pa la rje 'di pas mjug rdzogs par brtsams pa dang ske/ mdzod kyi spyi don dang phar phyin spyi don sogs legs par bshad pa'i bstan bcos mang po phyi rabs rjes 'jug rnams la skyes su bstsal/sgom sde shar chen nam mkha' rgyal mtshan gyis paṇa chen bde legs nyi ma 112

bod gangs can gyi ljongs su dbu ma'i 'chad nyan ji ltar dar tshuladang / mkhas grub dpal 'byor rgya mtsho/ bsod nams dpal bzang sogs kyi zhabs la gtugs te gzhung bka' pod lnga la dpyis phyin par sbyangs—/ 'brug pa pad ma dkar pos rje rin po che'i dbu ma'i lta ba'i skor la dgag pa mdzad par/ dam pa 'di pa sa 'brog ri bo che dga' ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling du (byang chub sems 'grel gyi rnam par bshad pa'i zhar byung 'brug mi pham pa pad ma dkar pos phyag chen gyi bshad sbyar rgyal ba'i gan mdzod ces par rje tsong kha pa la dgag pa mdzad pa'i gsung lan zhes bya ba〉ljags rtsom mdzad pa dang / gzhan yang —/ (bstan bcos chen po dbu ma la 'jug pa'i rnam bshad thar 'dod 'jug ngogs/〉(dbu ma la 'jug pa'i rgya cher bshad pa dgongs pa rab gsal bshad thabs kyi man ngag dgongs rgyan〉〈thal bzlog dka' gnas gtan 'bebs tshig gsal lde mig〉(dbu ma'i mtha' dpyod lung rigs gter mdzod zab don kun gsal skal bzang 'jug ngogs〉sogs brtsams nas dbu ma'i 'chad nyan rgya cher spel/khong yab sras gnyis kyi rnam thar zhib mo ma rnyed pas phangs so/ /rgyal ba dge 'dun rgya mtsho ni/ rab byung brgyad pa'i me sprel (spyi lo1476)lor gtsang rta nag tu sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo bcu gcig gi steng gtsang bkra shis lhun por phebs te paṇa chen lung rigs rgya mtsho las rab tu byung / mtshan la dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i dpal zhes gsol/113

dbu ma'i spyi don zab don gsal byed 'phrul gyi me long /'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes gnyen dang mkhas grub nor bzang rgya mtsho sogs bla mar bsten nas mdo sngags gzhung lugs thams cad la gsan sbyang legs par mdzad/ bkra shis lhun por bzhugs pa la paṇa chen ye shes rtse mos phrag dog gi rnam pa mdzad pas 'bras spungs su phebs te khri pa mdzad/ sne gdong mi dbang bkra shis grags pas 'bras spungs rdo khang sngon po khong la phul bas ming dga' ldan pho brang du bsgyur—/ chos 'khor rgyal gyi dgon pa phyag btab nas 'chad nyan mdzad pas 'phrin las shin tu rgyas pa dang / paṇa chen ye shes rtse mos kyang nan gyis zhus pas bkra shis lhun po'i gdan sar bzhugs/ phyis su se ra theg chen gling gi khri pa'ang mdzad/ dbu ma'i bstan bcos (drang ba dang nges pa'i don rnam par 'byed pa legs par bshad pa'i snying po zhes bya ba'i dgongs pa gsal bar byed pa'i sgron me〉(dbu ma 'jug pa'i rnam bshad dgongs pa rab tu gsal ba'i rgyan〉(stong nyid bdun cu pa'i rnam bshad dbu ma'i lam gsal bar byed pa'i sgron me〉(rten 'brel bstod pa'i tshig don gsal byed bla med 'jug ngogs〉(dbu ma'i lta khrid〉sogs brtsams nas 'jam mgon bla ma'i ring lugs dri ma med pa phyogs thams cad du rgyas par mdzad/ rab byung dgu pa'i chu stag (spyi lo1542)lor dgongs pa chos dbyings su thim/paṇa chen bsod nams grags pa ni/ rab byung brgyad pa'i sa khyi (114

bod gangs can gyi ljongs su dbu ma'i 'chad nyan ji ltar dar tshul /spyi lo1478)lor lho kha rtsed thang du nang par lam pa'i sras su sku 'khrungs/rtsed thang las chen pa bsod nams bkra shis las rab tu byung zhing /mtshan la bsod nams grags pa zhes gsol/ chung dus su rtsed thang dgon dang g.ya' bzang dgon du slob gnyer gnang / dgung lo bcu drug par se ra theg chen gling gi chos grwar zhugs/ snga phyir kun mkhyen don yod mkhas grub dang / gnyal ston dpal 'byor lhun grub/ thon pa mkhas btsun yon tan rgya mtsho/ las chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan/mkhan chen chos ldan blo gros sogs bla mar bsten nas mdo sngags gzhung lugs la slob gnyer rdo rus thug pa gnang bas/ gzhung brgya'i sbas don ji lta ba bzhin khong du chud par gyur cing / mkhas pa'i grags snyan gangs can gyi 'dzin ma'i khongs las brgal/ dgung lo nga gcig pa sa glang lor (dbu ma'i spyi don zab don gsal ba'i sgron me〉ljags rtsom mdzad pa dang / dgung lo lnga bzhi pa lcags yos lor〈dbu ma la 'jug pa'i brgal lan zab don yang gsal sgron me〉brtsams/gzhan yang skabs de dag tu snga phyir 〈gsung rab kun gyi drang ba dang nges pa'i don rnam par 'byed pa legs par bshad pa'i snying po'i brgal lan gyi rnam par 'byed pa utpa la'i phreng ba〉(dam pa'i chos phyag rgya chen po mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan drug〉sogs bstan bcos mang du mdzad pa dang / 'bras spungs dang dga' ldan sogs kyi 'chad 115

dbu ma'i spyi don zab don gsal byed 'phrul gyi me long nyan gyi khri la bzhugs te dpal mnyam med dge lugs pa'i ring lugs dri ma med pa rgya cher spel bas/ paṇa chen yig cha zhes grags snyan gyi dbyar skyes rnga gseng gangs ri'i ljongs su khyab pa'i khrid rgyun thun mong ma yin pa de nyid dbyar gyi mtsho mo rdol ba ltar da lta'i bar du ma nyams par dar so che ru byung / dam pa khong nyid rab byung dgu pa'i shing pho stag (khyi lo1554)lor dpal ldan 'bras spungs su zhi ba'i dbyings su gshegs/khri chen dge 'dun bstan pa dar rgyas ni/ rab byung brgyad pa'i chu glang (spyi lo1493)lor 'phan po klung shod 'od snar sku 'khrungs/ mal dro cha dkar dgon dang se ra smad grwa tshang du zhugs nas dge ba'i bshes gnyen du ma bsten nas gzhung bka' pod lngar gsan bsam mthar phyin pa mdzad pas mkhas pa'i grags snyan thob/ cha dkar dgon dang se ra smad grwa tshang gi 'chad nyan slob dpon dang dga' ldan khri pa sogs mdzad/ shes rab kyi rtsal phul du phyin pas kun gzigs lnga pa chen po dang / rgyal dbang sku phreng bdun pa rnam gnyis kyis snga phyir bsngags brjod rgya cher gnang / zab mo dbu ma'i lta ba gsal bar ston pa'i gzhung (bstan bcos chen po dbu ma 'jug pa'i spyi don〉 (dbu ma'i rnam bshad dgongs pa rab gsal gyi dgongs pa gsal bar byed pa'i blo gsal sgron me〉 (dbu ma'i rnam bshad dgongs pa rab gsal 116

bod gangs can gyi ljongs su dbu ma'i 'chad nyan ji ltar dar tshul/gyi mtha' dpyod rigs pa'i rgya mtsho blo gsal gyi 'jug ngogs〉(rten 'brel gyi spyi don legs par bshad pa'i snying po padma dkar ngo 'i phreng ba〉(rten 'brel gyi mtha' dpyod〉sogs ljags rtsom mdzad pa dang /se ra smad grwa tshang gi yig char byed pa'i gung ru rgyal mtshan bzang po'i gsung sgros skor zhig rje bdag nyid chen po'i dgongs bzhed dang mi mthun par brten/ dam pa 'di pas thugs thog nas 'chad pa'i dbu ma dang / phar phyin/ mtha' dpyod rnams zhal slob dag gis zin bris su btab pa dus phyis su ser smad grwa tshang gi yig char byed do/ /rab byung bcu pa'i sa 'brug (spyi lo1568)lor sku gshegs/kun mkhyen legs pa don grub ni/ rab byung brgyad pa 'i (spyi lo1505)nang tsam du shangs mda' bye phu zhes par sku bltams/ dgung lo gzhon dus gtsang bkras lhun dgon pa'i slob dpon 'jam dbyangs legs pa'i blo gros kyi mdun nas rab tu byung ste mtshan la legs nga don grub ces su gsol/ snga phyir paṇa chen ye shes rtse mo dang / mkhas btsun yon tan rgya mtsho/ thams cad mkhyen pa yon tan rgya mtsho/ rje blo gros rgya mtsho sogs dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang po bsam sbyor gnyis kyis tshul bzhin du bsten nas mdo sngags gzhung lugs mtha' dag la thos bsam rgya chen gnang ste thugs su chud par mdzad pas mkhas pa'i dbang por son par gyur/ dpal ldan 'bras spungs sogs dgon sde 117

dbu ma'i spyi don zab don gsal byed 'phrul gyi me long /mang por phebs te chos kyi 'khor lo rgya cher bskor/ bkras lhun shar rtse grwa tshang gi khri 'dzin lnga ba gnang / (drang nges mtha' dpyod〉(dbu ma'i mtha' dpyod〉(rten 'brel mtha' dpyod〉sogs gzhung chen mang po ljags rtsom mdzad/ rje 'di'i thugs sras kun mkhyen blo gros legs bzang gis shar rtse grwa tshang gi khri 'dzin drug pa dang bkra shis lhun po'i khri 'dzin dgu pa gnang / dpal 'khor chos sder rab 'byams pa'i grwa skor mdzad pas mkhas pa'i snyan grags rgyas/ 〈dbu ma la 'jug pa'i spyi don dgongs pa rab gsal gyi rgyan〉(dbu ma'i mtha' dpyod〉sogs bstan bcos mang po bka' rtsom gnang / spyir yab sras gnyis kyis brtsams pa'i legs bshad kyi bstan bcos mang du bzhugs kyang /rkyen dbang gis gsung rtsom re zung ma gtogs phon che ba dag dbu chung bris ma yin stabs dpe rgyun shin tu dkon par snang bas/ 'di'i phyogs la rgyus mnga' che ba'i mkhyen spyan yangs pa'i dam pa rnams kyis shar rtse kun mkhyen legs pa don grub yab sras kyis mdzad pa'i bka' rtsom rnams kyi dpe rgyun mi nyams pa'i phyir du ma dpe myur skyob legs bsgrigs bgyis te dpar du 'debs par shin tu rigs so/ /karma mi bskyod rdo rje ni/ rab byung dgu pa'i me yos (spyi lo1507)lor chab mdo'i ngom chu'i rgyud g.yas lung ka ra ti phugs tam gyi grong du sku 'khrungs—/ dgung lo bdun gyi steng karma zhwa nag pa'i sku phreng brgyad par 118

bod gangs can gyi ljongs su dbu ma'i 'chad nyan ji ltar dar tshul ngos 'dzin mdzad/ go shri rin po che dang / sangs rgyas mnyan pa/ karma lo tsā ba rin chen bkra shis sogs mkhas dbang mang po bsten nas mdo sngags rig gnas bcas pa la gsan bzhes nan tur mdzad/ 7rma pa'i yon bdag rnams kyis kong po khul gyi dge lugs pa'i dgon sde rnams rtsa gtor gtong ba'i sbyor ba bshams par khong nas thabs mkhas kyis 'gog par mdzad/ gang nyid kyi gsung rtsom la pod nyer brgyad yod par grags kyang / da lta dngos su po ti bcu gsum bzhugs/dam pa 'di pas dbu ma'i gzhung (dbu ma la 'jug pa'i rnam bshad dpal ldan dus gsum mkhyen pa'i zhal lung dwags brgyud grub pa'i me long〉(stong nyid gsal sgron〉zhes pa mdzad pa dang / 'grel pa don gsal gyi ṭīka chen thugs rtsom gnang nas yum gyi mdo dang mngon rtogs rgyan gyi 'grel pa dang bcas pa'i dgongs pa thogs med sku mched bzhed pa dang mthun pa'i rnam brdzun lugs kyi dbu ma chen por bkral te/ dpyod ldan rnams kyis dgag sgrub gyis shig ces bka' bstsal pa ltar/ se ra rje btsun pas gsung lan klu sgrub dgongs rgyan zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos mdzad nas lta ba'i nor 'khrul bsal bas thugs shin tu mnyes/ rje btsun par go shāka gi rtsod lan yang bskul par mdzad/ se ra rje btsun par bka' lan phul ba las/ khyed kyi dgag bzhag de kun go shāka gi phyogs su legs par song 'dug sa skya 119

dbu ma'i spyi don zab don gsal byed 'phrul gyi me long /pa'i mkhas rlom rnams blo gzu bor gnas na blo skyed thon par mchis/kho bo ni rje tsong kha pa chen po la 'jig rten 'di'i ngo 'dzin tsam ma yin pa'i dad pa brtan po yod pa'i stobs kyis/ go shāka ltar lugs 'di nor ba yin snyam pa gtan nas med/ de lta na'ang nged kyi slob ma rnams la da lta bod snga rabs pa dag gi 'khrid lugs las rje'i lugs ltar skyong gi med/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang lugs de shin tu phra bas phyi rabs pa dag gis tshul bzhin du go dka' zhing / lhag par sa kar phyogs 'di grub mtha' kun tsha slong che bas 'chad ma spobs zhes thugs skyo ba'i gtam gsungs pa dang / rje'i legs bshad rnams la zhe gting nas dad par mngon yang / gzhan ngo mi ldog pa tsam du dgag pa/ mdzad par mkhas pa'i gsung sgros las 'byung / phyis su rje rin po che'i zhal gzigs pas shin tu 'gyod nas bsngags brjod mdzad pa ste/byang gi phyogs 'dir rgyal ba'i bstan pa la/ /phal cher log pa 'ba' zhig spyod pa'i skabs/ /'khrul med byi dor mdzad pa'i tsong kha pa/ /ri bo dga' ldan pa la bstod par bgyi/ /zhes dang / gzugs sogs gzugs kyi ngo bos mi stong yang / /rang bzhin gyis grub gzugs kyis stong pa yi/ /stong nyid smra ba'i khyu mchog tsong kha pa/ /zhes dang / rje blo bzang grags pa bya ba des/ /bcom ldan shāka thub kyi tshul bzung nas/ /ngur smrig gi rgyal mtshan 'dzin mdzad pas/ /sngon shā ri'i bu 'dra bgrang 120

bod gangs can gyi ljongs su dbu ma'i 'chad nyan ji ltar dar tshul/yas kyis/ /'dzam gling gi rgyal khams gang bar mdzad/ /rje de la mi dad su la dad/ /sngon phrag dog gi dri mas sdang zhen skyes/ /dus de ring 'gyod pas mthol zhing bshags/ /sdig grogs kyis zin pa ma shes par//gti mug gis bgyis pa gnong zhing 'gyod/ /skye ba nas tshe rabs su rjes 'dzin mdzod/ /ces sogs gsungs so/ /rab byung dgu pa'i chu pho stag(spyi lo1554)lor kong po zho khar sku gshegs so/ /'brug pa padma dkar po ni/ rab byung dgu pa'i me mo phag gi (spyilo1527)lor mchims yul du sku bltams/ slob dpon shes rab go cha dang / shes rab bstan 'phel/ kun mkhyen bkra shis sogs mkhas pa mang du bsten nas rig pa'i gnas thams cad la sbyang brtson mdzad pas / 'brug pa bka' brgyud pa'i ring lugs 'dzin pa/'i mkhas pa'i phul du phyin pa ra gyur/ khong gis (dbu ma yang dag par brjod pa 'i rtsa ba〉dang de'i rang 'grel(dbu ma'i gzhung lugs gsum gsal bar bshad pa nges don grub pa'i shing rta〉(shes rab snying po'i rnam bshad klu sgrub kyi dgongs pa gsal bar bstan pa〉(spyod 'jug gi 'bru 'grel dbu ma'i lam gyi sgron ma〉(rten 'brel gyi dkar chag〉(rten 'brel kho bo lugs kyi chos thams cad kyi snying po len pa〉(rten 'brel rnam bshad zhib mo rnam 'thag〉(rten 'brel gyi sgom rim dam pa'i chos kyi za ma tog〉(phyag rgya chen po'i man ngag gi bshad sbyar rgyal ba'i 121

dbu ma'i spyi don zab don gsal gyed 'phrul gyi me long /gnamadzod〉 (phyag chen zin bris〉 (phyag chen rnal 'byor bzhi'i bshad pa sdes don lta ba'i mig〉 (zab lam gyi rnam par bshad pa zab lam gyi snye ma/sogs mdzad nas dbu ma'i 'chad nyan khyab brdal du spel/bonganas dang thog rje'i lta ba'i skor la dgag pa mdzad kyang / phyis su rje'i legs bshad mang po gzigs pas dad pa rma med pa 'khrungs te/sang dang rgyal ba kun gyi yon tan ni/ /srang la gzhal tshe lci yang ma mchis pas/ /lnga brgya ba yi gtsug rgyan du 'os pa/ /thams cad mkhyen pa tsād la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes dang / 'gran zla kun bral rje btsun tsong la par/ /'gran zla bgyi ba'i mkhas pa mang na yang / /'gran zla bra' ba khyod nyid gcig pu zhes/ /'gran zlar mi byed pad ma dkar pos bstod/ /ces gzu bor gnas pa'i blos ngo thog don la gnas pa'i bsngags brjod nar mar mdzad/ rab byung bcu pa'i me pho sprel (spyi 'o15snye6)lor sku gshegs/paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan ni/ rab byung bcu pa'i lcags rta (spyi pho1570)lor yul gtsang stod lhun drug brgya ba'i spe'u zhes pa'i yul du sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo lnga par paṇa chen sku phreng gsum pa dben sa blo bzang don grub kyi slob ma mkhas grub sangs rgyas ye shes kyis dben sa pa'i yang srid du ngos 'dzin mdzad/ khong gi mdun du dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes te mtshan la blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan zhes su gsol/ se 12nyu

bod gangs can gyi ljongs su dbu ma'i 'chad nyan ji ltar dar tshul/'bras dge gsum gyi dge bshes rnams kyis lha sa smon lam chen mor dam bca' 'jog pa dang / ang rim bya dga' gnang ba sogs dge bshes lha rams pa'i lugs srol thog mar gsar gtod mdzad/ zab mo dbu ma'i lta ba rtsal du bton nas brtsams pa'i bstan bcos (zab mo dbu ma'i lta ba nyams su len tshul〉(zab mo dbu ma'i lta ba bsgom tshul lta khrid snying por dril ba〉(zab mo'i lta khrid mdor bsdus〉(gzhi lam 'bras gsum phyag rgya chen po'i ngo bo ngos 'dzin las brtsams pa'i shes rab dang bdag 'dzin gnyis kyi gshags 'debs〉〈sgra pa shes rab rin chen pa'i rtsod lan lung rigs seng ge'i nga ro〉(dge ldan bka' brgyud rin po che'i phyag chen rgyal ba'i gzhung lam〉(dge ldan bka' brgyud rin po che'i phyag rgya chen po'i rtsa ba rgyas par bshad pa yang gsal sgron me〉(dri ba lhag bsam rab dkar gyi dris lan blo bzang bzhad pa'i sgra dbyangs〉sogs bzhugs/ rab byung bcu gcig pa'i chu pho stag (spyi lo1662)lor re zhig gzugs sku'i bkod pa chos kyi dbyings su bsdus pa'i tshul bstan to/ /jo nang tā ra nā tha'am jo nang rje btsun kun dga' snying po ni/rab byung bcu pa'i shing phag (snyi lo1575)lor chos 'khor sdings su sku bltams—/ sprul pa'i bshes gnyen rgya gar pa dzwa la nā tha mchog gis/ tā ra nā tha zhes mtshan gsol ba'i gzigs snang byung / mkhan lung rigs 123

dbu ma'i spyi don zab don gsal byed 'phrul gyi me long /rgya mtsho'i drung nas dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud 'grel man ngag dang bcas pa gsan/ gzhan stong gi lta ba bod kyi mkhas grub mang pos dgag bzhag tshabs chen mdzad de snum zad kyi mar me ltar shin tu nyag phra bar gyur pas/ rje btsun 'dis (zab mo gzhan stong dbu ma'i brgyud 'debs〉(gzhan stong dbu ma snying po〉 (gzhan stong dbu ma'i rgyan ces bya ba〉(mthar thug dbu ma chen po 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos mthar thug〉(theg mchog shin tu rgyas pa'i dbu ma chen po rnam par nges pa zhes bya ba〉〈tshul gnyis rnam par 'byed pa'i nges pa'i don gyi 'jug ngogs〉 (gzhan stong dbu ma rgyan gyi lung sbyor〉 〈sher snying 'grel pa〉(rgyu 'bras dbu ma'i thig le〉(zab don nyer gcig pa bzhugs〉sogs brtsams pa dang / skabs der rin spungs sde ba karma bstan skyong dbang po dang gtsang sde srid phun tshogs rnam rgyal gnyis yon mchod du gyur pas chos srid gnyis ka'i dbu 'phang mtho bar gyur te/ rtag brtan dam chos gling nges don dga' ba'i tshal zhes pa'i dgon pa phyag 'debs mdzad de jo nang pa'i lugs rgya cher spel/rab byung bcu gsum pa'i (spyi lo1634)nang tsam du sku gshegs/ rjes su kun gzigs lnga pa chen pos jo nang pa'i dgon pa thams cad dge lugs par bsgyur pas/ dbus gtsang du jo nang pa'i gzhan stong dbu ma chen po'i lugs 'di nyid ming gi lhag ma tsam du gyur to/ /124

bod gangs can gyi ljongs su dbu ma'i 'chad nyan ji ltar dar tshul/shar skal ldan rgya mtsho ni/ rab byung bcu pa'i me mo lug (spyi lo1607)lor mdo smad reb gong rgyal thang du 'khrungs/ dgung lo drug par chos pa rin po che blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan las dge bsnyen dang /dgung lo bcu par rab tu byung ste mtshan la skal ldan tshogs gnyis su gsol—/ dgung lo bcu gcig par bla slob gnyis dbus gtsang du phebs—/ dga' ldan dgon du stag lung brag pa mkhan chen blo gros rgya mtsho las dge tshul gyi sdom pa mnos te/ mtshan la skal ldan rgya mtsho zhes gsol/ byang rtse'i grwa tshang gi rje 'jam dbyangs tshul khrims chos 'phel—/ gtsang pa dka' chen blo gros rnam rgyal/ rgyal rong pa mkhas grub bstan pa dar rgyas sogs dge ba'i bshes gnyen du bsten nas dbu tshad sogs la gsan bsam mdzad/ gzhan paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan/ khri chen blo gros rgya mtsho/ dwags po bsod nams nyi ma sogs las bka' chos ci rigs zhus pa dang / dgung grangs nyi shu bar gsang phur dka' chen bcu'i grwa skor dam bca' gnang bas mkhas pa'i grags pas sa steng khyab/ dgung lo nyer gcig par mdo smad du chibs kha bsgyur/ rong bo dgon du mtshan nyid grwa tshang gsar 'dzugs mdzad/dben gnas mang por phebs nas sgrub pa nyams bzhes mdzad pas mngon shes khyad par can rgyud la 'khrungs/ 〈dbu ma'i bstan bcos kyi rgyal po rtsa ba shes rab kyi ṭīkka dpag bsam ljon shing〉 〈dbu ma'i lta 25

dbu ma'i spyi don zab don gsal byed 'phrul gyi me long /khrid rten 'brel rigs pa'i yang snying rdo rje'i gzegs ma〉(dge ldan bka' brgyud phyag rgya chen po'i nyams khrid〉(rin chen phreng ba'i smon lam gyi ṭīkka〉(dbu ma'i lta khrid zhal gdams snying gi bdud rtsi〉(dge ldan phyag chen zab khrid gdams ngag rgya mtsho nas btus pa〉(dran pa bzhi ldan gyi sgo nas zab mo rgyun du skyong ba'i tshul thar 'dod mdzes rgyan〉(phyag chen gyi khrid yig〉sogs brtsams pa dang / slob ma mkhas pa g.yu rngog bsam gtan rgya mtsho/ rtis tshang ma ṇi ba shes rab bkra shis—/ blon chos blo bzang chos grags sogs mang du byon/ rab byung bcu gcig pa'i me mo sbrul (spyi lo1677)lor gzugs sku'i bkod pa chos kyi dbyings su bsdus/rgyal dbang lnga pa blo bzang rgya mtsho ni/ rab byung bcu pa'i me sbrul (spyi lo1617)lor lho kha 'phyongs rgyas 'phying ba stag rtser sku bltams/ paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan dang / dga' ldan khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel / 'khon ston lhun grub dpal 'byor/ smon 'gro 'jam dbyangs dbang rgyal rdo rje sogs la bsten nas mdo sngags rig gnas thams cad la mkhas par bslabs/ khong nyid skabs de'i bod kyi chos srid gnyis kyi bdag po gyur pas thabs mkhas kyi sgo nas grub mtha' thams cad ris med du bskyangs/ sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho dang kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhed pa gnyis kyang khong gi slob mar gyur/ dbu ma'i 126

bod gangs can gyi ljongs su dbu ma'i 'chad nyan ji ltar dar tshul/bstan bcos (zab mo dbu ma'i lta ba nyams su len tshul 'jam dpal snying po'i zhal lung〉 (bstan bcos chen po dbu ma la 'jug pa gsal bar byed pa theg chen rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru gzings〉sogs thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i yig 'jog mang du mdzad/ rab byung bcu gcig pa'i chu pho khyi (spyi lo1682)lor sku gshegs/lcang skya ngag dbang blo bzang chos ldan ni/ rab byung bcu gcig pa'i chu rta (spyi lo1642)lor mdo smad tsong kha'i nye 'dabs g.yi dge'i char gtogs rta phyug ces pa'i grong du sku 'khrungs/ thang ring dgon gyi khri pa tshul khrims rgya mtsho dang paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan gnyis kyis bla ma gong ma grags pa 'od zer gyi sprul skur ngos 'dzin gnang /dgung lo dgu par dgon lung dga' ldan byams pa gling gi chos grwar zhugs—/ dgung grangs nyi shu bzhes pa'i tshe dbus gtsang du phebs/ snga phyir rgyal dbang lnga pa chen mo las dge tshul dang bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa mnos te/ mtshan la blo bzang chos ldan zhes gsol/ 'bras spungs sgo mang grwa tshang du zhugs te/ sgo mang dpon slob ngag dbang blo gros las bka' chos mang du gsan/ dgung lo nyer bdun par gling bsre dang lha sa smon lam chen mo'i grwa skor mdzad/ dgung lo so gsum par gtsang du byon nas shar rtse'i mkhan po blo bzang padma dang sngags nga dpon slob dge 'dun don grub pa/ sngags chen dkon dkon mchog 127

dbu ma'i spyi don zab don gsal gyed 'phrul gyi me long /rgyal mtshan/ drung pa rgyal tshab pa sogs mkhas dbang mang po'i zhabs rdul spyi bos blangs te rje'i gsung 'bum gyi khrid sogs mdo sngags gzhung lugs rab 'byams la sbyangs pa mthar phyin mdzad pas/ mkhas pa'i grags pa bod yul kun tu khyab/ chu bya (spyo lo1693)lor gong ma khang zhis pe cin du spyan drangs te dbu blar mdzad/ snga phyir dbu ma'i gsung (lta khrid nges don rab gsal〉(lta khrid mdor bsdus〉(lta ba'i dogs gcod thor bu〉(lta ba phyag rgya chen po sgom tshul tshigs bcad ma〉(rten 'brel snying po'i rnam bshad bder gshegs dgongs rgyan〉sogs ljags rtsom mdzad pa dang / dgon sde gsar bzhengs dang dam pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsis dad ldan skya ser thams cad kyi re 'dun ji bzhin du bskangs pa sogs rnam dkar dge ba'i las kyis sku tshe snyoms par mdzad/ rab byung bcu bcu gnyis pa'i shing pho rta (spyi lo1714)lor gzugs sku bsdus pa'i tshul bstan to/ /mkhas grub bye ba'i gtsug rgyan dbal shul ngag dbang brtson 'grus sam sgo mang bla ma kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhed pa'i rdo rje ni/rab byung bcu gcig pa'i sa byi (spyi lo1648)lor da lta'i kan lho rgan gya'i nying ring du sku bltams/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i skyes chen dam pa 'di pas dbu ma'i gzhung la thos bsam mdzad tshul ni/ rang rnam tshigs bcad ma las/ thos bsam sgom gsum tshe 'dir legs mdzad pa/ /128

bod sangs can gyi smongs su dbu ma'i 'chad nyan ji ltar dar tshul/paṇa chen bka' 'gyur sbyin pa rgya mtsho las/ /zhes pa nas / rtsa 'jug rnam bshad gnyis dang 'grel chung dang / /legs bshad snying po dbu ma rigs tshogs drug / 'jug pa mdo rtsa sum brgya rtsa 'grel gnyis/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar/ paṇa chen bka' 'gyur ba sbyin pa rgya mtsho las dbu ma rigs tshogs drug dang / rtsa 'jug rnam bshad gnyis/ drang nges legs bshad snying po/ lam rim che chung sogs la gsan bsam gnang ba dang / rnam bshad snying po'i rgyan/ legs bshad gser phreng gi dka' gnad/ rnam bshad dgongs pa rab gsal sogs thugs 'dzin dang rtog dpyod chig dril du mdzad/ dgung lo nyer lnga bzhes pa'i tshe rigs pa smra ba'i mkhas mang 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i dbus su gzhung gi dka' gnad mang po'i thad du lung rigs kyis brgal brtag mdzad de phar phyin dam bca' bzhag pas mkhas pa'i grags pa phyogs kun tu khyab—/ klu sgrub yab sras gzhung gi dka' gnad la/ /legs par dpyad pas zab mo rten 'byung don/ /sangs rgyas bskyangs kyis bkral ba ji bzhin du/ /mngon sum gzigs shing zab mo rten 'byung don/ /sangs rgyas bskyangs kyis bkral ba ji bzhin du/ /mngon sum gzigs shing zab lam dga' ston myong / /zhes gsungs pa/ ltar/ dgung lo sum cu pa me sbrul lor ba sor bya bral tu byon te/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor srog tu byas pa'i sgo nas bsags sbyang la sgo du ma nas 'bad kyin lta ba'i 129

dbu ma'i spyi don zab don gsal gyed 'phrul gyi me long /dmigs rnam bskyangs pas/ ring bor ma thogs par mtshan 'dzin gyi dmigs gtad thams cad zhig nas zab mo'i don la mtha' gzhan du dogs pa'i sgro 'dogs lhag ma med par chod nas stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs par gyur/ dgung lo so bzhi pa lcags bya lor srad rgyud du phebs te rgyud chen dkon mchog yar 'phel la mjal phrad gnang /rgyud chen rin po ches dbu ma thal rang gi dka' gnad las 'phros te dri ba mdzad pas/ zab gsal myur ba'i shes rab kyis gnad du 'khel ba'i lan btab pas/ rgyud chen rin po che nas de kho na ltar lags zhes thugs mnyes mnyes mdzad/ dgung lo so brgyad pa shing glang gi lor (drang nges rnam 'byed kyi mtha' dpyod beeṭurya dkar po〉ces bya ba brtsams pa dang / dgung lo zhe gnyis pa sa sbrul lor (grub mtha'i rnam bzhag 'khrul spong gdong lnga'i sgra dbyangs〉zhes pa ljags rtsom mdzad—/ de nyid las/ khyad par zla ba'i lugs rlom kun mkhyen la/ /kun tu dgrar 'dzin khyod la 'gal 'khrul mang / /thams cad mkhyen yang ji snyed mi mkhyen 'gal/ /de med zad spyod lugs ngan dbu mar 'khrul—/ /zhes pa nas/ rdzogs sangs rgyas dang tshogs lam slar 'jug 'gal—/ /shes sgrib kun zad 'pho 'gyur bag chags 'gal/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar/ de snga stag tshang lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen gyis (grub mtha' kun shes rtsa 'grel〉brtsams nas 'jam mgon chos 130

bod gangs can gyi ljongs su dbu ma'i 'chad nyan ji ltar dar tshul/kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa chen por dbu ma'i lta ba'i phyogs nas 'gal khur bco brgyad btang bar kun mkhyen rin po che nas skyon spong mdzad nas stag tshang bar mi 'dod bzhin du theg dka' ba'i 'gal ba'i khres po nyer bdun brtsegs shing / rgyal dbang drug par spyan 'bebs zhus pas—/ brda sprod rtog ge gzhan dag tshar gcod chos/ /rjes 'dzin bzo gso tshig phreng mdzes byed rgyan/ /rang nyid kun shes nang don rig pa sogs—/ /kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad par gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes mkhas pa'i mtshan gyi cod paṇa gsol/ dgung lo zhe brgyad pa shing phag gi lor/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen bde chen chos grags rgya mtsho sogs mkhas dbang du mas bskul pa'i ngor (dbu ma la 'jug pa'i mtha' dpyod lung rigs gter mdzod zab don kun gsal skal bzang 'jug ngogs〉zhes pa brtsams pas/ yang dag pa'i lta ba'i gnad la sgro 'dogs chod pa'i rjes 'jug slob ma mkhas pa mang du byung / grub chen sangs rgyas chos 'phel gyis dpon slob mang por bla ma 'di lung gi yon tan rgyal ba tsong kha pa dang khyad par med/ de las lhag pa'i lung gi yon tan klu sgrub dang zla grags la yang med/ khyed rnams skal ba bzang zhes ngo thog don la gnas bsngags brjod mdzad/ dgung lo lnga gsum lcags 'brug lor rgyal dbang rin po che dang sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho gtsos slob 'khor mang pos nan gyis bskul pa la brten nas 131

dbu ma'i spyi don zab don gsal byed 'phrul gyi me long /dpal ldan bkra shis sgo mang gi mkhan po mdzad/ dge 'dun 'dus pa'i tshogs la rtsa shes dang 'jug pa rang 'grel/ drang nges rnam 'byed/stong thun sogs rgya bod kyi gzhung chen po rnams gung bsgrigs nas rtsal bshad zhib rgyas su bstsal/ skabs de dag tu snga phyir(drang nges rnam 'byed kyi mtha' dpyod mdor bsdus blo gsal mgrin rgyan〉dang / (tshig gsal stong mthun gyi tshad ma'i rnam bshad zab rgyas kun gsal 'od brgya 'bar ba skal bzang snying gi mun sel〉zhes pa'i dbu ma'i gzhung chen po gnyis kyang mdzad/ dgung lo re gnyis pa sa mo glang gi lor rje thams cad mkhyen pas dga' ldan btab pa'i lo dang khel bas rten 'brel khyad par can la dgongs nas chos sde chen po bla brang bkra shis 'khyil phyag 'debs mdzad pa ste/ mdor na rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che spyi dang khyad par du btso ma'i gser lta bu'i dpal mnyam med dge lugs pa'i bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan srid rtse'i bar du sgreng bar byed pa la rgyal ba tsong kha pa chen po slar yang 'jig rten du byon pa dang gnyis su ma mchis par/ mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyis thugs rgyud yongs su gtams pa dang 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyis rjes 'jug mkhas grub sa'i rdul grangs dang mnyam pa mtha' yas pa bskyangs pas/sgo mang mkhan po kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa zhes grags snyan gyi lha'i rnga sgra 'jig rten gsum du khyab par gyur/ dgung lo don bzhi 132

bod gangs can gyi ljongs su dbu ma'i 'chad nyan ji ltar dar tshul pa lcags mo glang (spyi lo1721)lor dgongs pa chos dbyings su thim/ /bse tshang ngag dbang bkra shis ni/ rab byung bcu gcig pa'i sa pho rta (spyi lo1678)lor mdo smad reb gong gi sa'i cha bse'i nya lung du sku bltams—/ grub chen skal ldan rgya mtsho'i dngos slob mgar gong tshe brtan rgya mtsho las rab tu byung zhing / mtshan la sbyin pa dar rgyas zhes gsol—/ dgung lo bcu drug par dbus gtsang du byon te 'bras spungs bkra shis sgo mang gi chos grwar zhugs nas dpon slob don grub rgya mcho3re drung du bsdus grwa'i tshig bzhag mnos/ skabs dus nas bzung rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi gzigs snang nam 'dod du 'char ba byung —/ dgung lo bcu bdun par stag tshang rwa ba stod du phebs te rje'i rtag par rtogs pa'i tshad khang du grags pa la skor ba byed srol ltar zhabs la khrag rdol gyi bar du skor ba mdzad pas/ tshad ma sde bdun gyi dgongs don thams cad khong du chud nas blo gsal rigs pa smra ba'i khrod du 'gran zla dang bral bar gyur/ slar bkra shis sgo mang du phebs te dpon slob 'od zer rgya mtsho'i mdun nas dbu ma gsan/ grub mtha'i rnam bzhag 'khrul spong gdong lnga'i sgra dbyangs/ nyi thang ba'i dbu ma'i zur bkol/ stag lung grags pa 'i dbu ma yongs rdzogs thugs 'dzin mdzad/ kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i drung du dbu ma yongs rdzogs kyi brtsi bzhag bshad pa bcas gsan pa dang /33

dbu ma'i spyi don zab don gsal byed 'phrul gyi me long /dbu ma lung rigs gter mdzod kyi smad cha yongs rdzogs dang / stod cha sems bskyed gsum pa'i bar du thugs 'dzin mdzad/ kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i nang thugs kyi sras gcig pur gyur/bsags sbyang la sgo du ma nas 'bad pas mnal lam du bya rgod phung po'i rir yang yang slebs pa dang / gtsug lag khang zhig na klu sgrub bzhugs pa'i mdun du slebs kyang dar dkar gyi yol ba zhig gis bsgribs 'dug pa yang yang rmis pa rje gong ma'i drung du zhus par khyod la stong nyid don spyi'i tshul gyis rtogs pa'i skal ba yod par snang zhes gsungs/ de ltar sbyangs pas dgung lo nyer drug gi tshe lta ba 'khrul med du rnyed par rnam thar las gsungs/ phyis su grwa slob 'ga' zhig la khyed tshos lta ba 'tshol 'dod na dgag bya ngos 'dzin la 'bad dgos/dgag bya bden grub bkag pa'i stong pa ma shar bar stong sang phal che ba re shar yang don chung / nga rang byis pa'i dus phyugs rdzi rnams kyis me 'bud pa la 'di ci yin dris pas/ me yin zer/ de ngas kyang shes mod / med zer don ci yin dris pas mi shes zer/ de bzhin du sa rdo ri brag gang la yang rang ming de mi 'byar ba zhig yod/ yang bdag gi khu bo zhig rta la sga sgron gyin 'dug par 'di ci yin dris pas rta yin zer—/ 'di'i mgo rkang lag gang la rta zer ba yin snyam bsam blo btang bas rta de med song ba lta bu zhig byung / de nas bzung ste snang ba de 134

bod gangs can gyi ljongs su dbu ma'i 'chad nyan ji ltar dar tshul/rgyun du 'char zhing / phyis su skabs 'gar srid rtse nas mnar med bar 'di thams cad stong cham gyis song ba'i snang ba brgya 'gyur du shar yang de lta ba'i phyogs na yang mi 'dug gsungs/ 'o na lta ba nam rtogs zhus pas/ buddha pā li ta'i tshig gcig gsungs nas rje rin po che dang /sku phyogs nas kyang tshig 'di'i steng nas lta ba brnyes pa'i tshul gnang bas ngas kyang byin rlabs kyi khyad bsam nas tshig de yang yang dpyad pas sems la phan pa zhig byung gsungs zhes gdan rabs lha'i rnga chen las 'byung ngo / /dgung lo so gnyis pa'i steng kun mkhyen rin po che'i zhabs phyir mdo smad du byon/ de kho na nyid gsal bar ston pa'i gzhung (rten 'brel bstod pa'i 'grel pa〉(dbu ma'i mtha' dpyod lung rigs gter mdzod kyi dgongs don gsal bar byed pa'i nyin byed snang ba zab lam lta ba'i mig 'byed〉(zab mo rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i mtha' dpyod legs par bshad pa'i rgya mtsho〉(dbu ma'i thal bzlog〉sogs mdzad/ kun mkhyen gyi bka' ltar bla brang dgon pa'i gdan sa'i khri la bzhugs te 'chad nyan gyis dus 'da' bas dbu ma'i lta bar phu thag chod pa'i slob ma mang du byon te lta mgur dang dbu ma'i gzhung brtsams pa kun gyi mjal yul du gyur/ dgung lo re gcig pa rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i sa pho rta (spyi lo /738)lor ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang bcas te zhi bar gshegs/135

dbu ma'i spyi don zab don gsal byed 'phrul gyi me long /rnga ba chos skyong rgya mtsho ni/ rab byung bcu gcig pa'i nang tsam du mdo smad rnga ba'i yul du sku bltams/ sku na gzhon dus nas bla brang bkra shis 'khyil ba'i thos bsam gling du zhugs te kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i nang thugs kyi sras gcig pu bse ngag dbang bkra shis mchog gi zhabs rdul spyi bor blangs te gzhung chen bka' pod lnga la thos bsam nan tur mdzad pas mkhas pa'i grags snyan thob/ dbu phar rnam 'grel 'dul mdzod bcas kyi tshig ṭīka thugs 'dzin mdzad pa dang / po ti lnga rgyun du zhal 'don mdzad par grags/ khong gi bla ma bse ngag dbang bkra shis tshang gis gzhung gang gsung thams cad reg zig tu btab pa ste zin bris bcu gsum du grags pa mdzad do/ /mkhas pa'i dbang po gang nyid kyi gsung zin brjed byang du bkod pa dag las dbu ma'i skor gyi zin tho(dbu ma'i zin bris nor bu'i phreng mdzes〉(dbu ma lung rigs gter mdzod kyi gsung bshad zin bris〉(dbu ma bzhi brgya pa'i zin bris〉(dgag bya ngos 'dzin gyi zin bris mkhas pa dgyes pa'i yid 'phrog〉(dbu ma'i dgag bya ngos 'dzin gyi gsung bshad zin bris〉〈thal ldog gi bshad pa'i zin bris legs bshad mkhas pa'i mgul rgyan〉(drang nges mtha' dpyod kyi zin bris〉(rten 'brel gyi yig cha rnying ba'i gsung bshad zin bris〉bcas bzhugs so—/ /dam pa khong gi rnam thar zhib gsal mthong chos su ma gyur pas 136

bod gangs can gyi ljongs su dbu ma'i 'chad nyan ji ltar dar tshul/'dir mtshon tsam smras pa'o/ /co ne grags pa bshad sgrub ni/ rab byung bcu gcig pa'i shing mo yos (spyi lo1675)lor mdo smad co ne'i g.yo sa nas sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo dgu par co ne'i dgon pa'i khri chen dge 'dun grags pa las rab tu byung / dgung lo nyer gcig par dbus su byon/ dgung lo nyer gnyis par ser smad thos bsam gling gi grwa tshang du zhugs/ rje bkra shis dpal bzang bla mar bsten nas dbu ma sogs gzhung bka' pod lnga la gsan bsam legs par mdzad pas mkhas pa chen por gyur/ dgung lo so gnyis par lha rams pa'i mtshan btags thob/ dgung lo so gnyis par mdo smad co ne'i dgon du phebs te mtshan nyid grwa tshang gsar du btsugs/ dgung lo bzhi bcu par dgon pa de'i khrir bzhugs—/ snga phyir zab mo stong pa nyid gsal bar ston pa'i dbu ma'i bstan bcos(dbu ma rtsa ba shes rab kyi ṭīkka rnam bshad rigs pa'i rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru gzings〉 (rjes 'jam dbyangs la zhus te re mda' bar gnang ba'i dris lan gyi 'grel pa〉 (dbu ma rtsa ba shes rab kyi bsdus don dka' 'grel zab mo〉(rten 'brel bstod pa'i ṭīrma rtag chad lta ba'i tsha gdung sel byed〉(rten 'brel bstod pa'i 'grel pa bla ma'i dgongs don gsal ba'i zla ba〉 (dbu ma la 'jug pa'i tshig 'grel mtha' gcod dang bcas pa〉(shes rab snying po'i ṭīkka〉(lta 137

dbu ma'i spyi don zab don gsal byed 'phrul gyi me long /ba'i rim pa rnam par bshad pa thar lam gsal byed〉(bden bzhi dang rten 'brel gyi rnam bzhag〉(phyi nang gi grub mtha'i rnam bzhag〉(grub mtha' bzhi'i lugs kyi bden gnyis rnam bzhag〉(grub mtha' bzhi'i lugs kyi lta ba'i rnam bzhag〉(rdo rje gcod pa'i 'grel pa〉sogs ljags rtsom gnang nas 'chad nyan gyis dus mda' bar mdzad pas—/ dbu ma'i lugs dar zhing rgyas par phyag rjes rlabs po che bsub tu med pa bzhag rab byung bcu gsum pa'i sa pho 'brug (spyi lo1748)lor sku mya ngan las 'das/phur lcog ngag dbang byams pa ni/ rab byung bcu gcig pa'i chu khyi (spyi lo1682)lor chab mdo dang khad nye ba'i yul tham kha grong sno rom zhes par sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo bcu gsum steng mdo khams mkhas dbang 'phags pa lha'i drung du dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes te mtshan la ngag dbang byams pa zhes su gsol/ dgung lo bco lnga bzhes pa'i tshe dbus su phebs te ser byas grwa tshang du zhugs/ mkhas dbang ngag dbang rgya mtsho dang dge bshes blo bzang rgyal mtshan gnyis las bsdus grwa dang /bya bral dge bshes blo bzang chos 'phel gyi mdun nas dbu phar sogs gsan bsam rgya chen gnang ste lha ldan smon lam chen mor grwa skor mdzad pas mkhas pa'i grags snyan rgyas/ dbu ma'i skor la(rten 'brel bstod pa'i ṭīkka 'od dkar phreng ba〉(bdag med pa'i chos kyi phyag rgya gtan 138

bod gangs can gyi ljongs su dbu ma'i 'chad nyan ji ltar dar tshul/la 'bebs pa yid kyi gdung sel〉(stag tshang lo tsā ba'i brgal lan rdo rje'i gzegs ma〉sogs brtsams/ dgung lo gya gcig bzhes pa rab byung bcu gsum pa'i chu pho rta(spyi lo1762)lor phur lcog ru khrod du sku gshegs /dus 'khor rgya nag pa 'jam dbyangs bstan pa'i sgron me ni/ rab byung bcu gcig pa'i me stag (spyi lo1686)lor hor yul a ru ho chen du sku bltams/ dgung lo bzhi par sde khri blo bzang don grub kyis dus 'khor rgya nag pa ngag dbang phun tshogs kyi yang srid du ngos 'dzin gnang —/ dgung lo bdun par sde khri rin po che las rab tu byung zhing /mtshan la 'jam dbyangs bstan pa'i nyi ma zhes gsol/ kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa dang / bla ma 'jam dpal dbyangs sogs mkhas grub du ma bsten nas gzhung bka' pod lnga la slob gnyer gting tshugs pa mdzad pas rigs pa smra ba la 'gran zla dang bral bar gyur/byams chos sde lnga dang dbu ma rigs tshogs drug thugs 'dzin mdzad de bla ma 'jam dpal dbyangs la rgyugs phul bas gzengs bstod mdzad/dgung lo nyer lnga par rdo rams pa'i mtshan gyi cod paṇa bzhes pas mkhas pa'i grags pa phyogs kun tu khyab/ dbu ma'i gsung (zab mo lta ba'i dmigs khrid thar pa'i sgo 'byed〉(lta mgur gyi 'grel pa mkhas pa dgyes pa'i mchod sprin〉zhes pa sogs brtsams te mdo sngags kyi 139

dbu ma'i spyi don zab don gsal gyed 'phrul gyi me long /'chad nyan rgya cher spel/ rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i sa rta (spyi lo1738)lor sku gshegs/bra ti rin chen don grub ni/ dus rabs bcu bdun pa'i dus smad tsam du sku 'khrungs/ chung dus nas se ra theg chen gling gi byes pa grwa tshang du zhugs/ zhogs don yod mkhas grub sogs dge bshes mang du bsten nas gzhung chen bka' pod lnga la sbyang brtson nan tur mdzad de mkhas pa'i go 'phang brnyes/ zab mo'i don ston pa'i gzhung (bdag med gtan la 'bebs pa'i rigs pa'i rnam bzhag〉(rtsa she'i mchod brjod kyi gzhung nyung ngur rnam par phye ba de nyid gsal ba〉(ri khrod pa mkhas grub pa'i dgag lan〉sogs thun min gyi bstan bcos dang / (bod kyi brda'i bstan bcos sum cu pa'i 'grel pa kun tu bzang po'i dgongs rgyan〉sogs mang du brtsams nas 'chad nyan spel bas 'phrin las shin tu rgyas par grags/ 'khrungs 'das kyi lo tshigs ma rnyed pas gzhan las shes par bya'o/ /yongs 'dzin ye shes rgyal mtshan ni/ rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i chu mo sbrul (spyi lo1713)lor gtsang stod skyid du grong sku 'khrungs/ paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan gyi mdun nas rab tu byung zhing / mtshan la ye shes rgyal mtshan zhes gsol to/ /paṇa chen rin po che dang / phur lcog byams pa rin po che sogs las gzhung bka' pod lnga la thos bsam 140

bod gangs can gyi ljongs su dbu ma'i 'chad nyan ji ltar dar tshul/gnang dgung lo re gnyis bzhes pa'i tshe rgyal dbang sku phreng brgyad pa'i yongs 'dzin mdzad/ lam rim bla ma brgyud pa'i rnam thar sogs gsung rtsom po ti che chung bcu dgu tsam bzhugs pa dang / dbu ma'i gsung 〈zab mo dbu ma'i lta khrid thun mong min pa blo bzang zhal lung〉(dga' ldan snyan brgyud kyi lta khrid zab mo dngos grub kun 'byung〉 (rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis kyi ngos 'dzin mdor bsdus pa〉sogs bka' rtsom gnang / rab byung bcu gsum pa 'i chu mo glang (spyi lo1793)lor sku gshegs/shing bza' parnyi ta blo bzang dar rgya mtsho ni/ rab byung bcu gsum pa'i sa mo yos(spyi lo1759)lor mdo smad a rig gi sar sku 'khrungs/dgung lo brgyad par gtsang rin po che blo bzang chos 'phel las rab tu byung / dgung lo bcu gsum bzhes pa'i tshe a rig dge bshes chen mo byams pa dge legs rgyal mtshan (mtshan sazhan la rgyal mtshan 'od zer zhes gsol)gyis shing bza' sgom chen pa'i sprul skur ngos 'dzin gnang / dgung lo bcu bdun par dbus su phebs nas ser byes grwa tshang gi chos sgor zhugs—/ paṇa chen dpal ldan ye shes las bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa mnos te mtshan la blo bzang dar rgyas rgya mtsho zhes gsol/ yongs 'dzin ye shes rgyal mtshan dang / klong rdol bla ma ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho/ rgyal sras mchog sprul rin po che/ lcags ra sprul sku sogs 141

dbu ma'i spyi don zab don gsal byed 'phrul gyi me long /mkhas dbang du ma'i zhabs pad spyi bor bsten nas mdo sngags gzhung lugs la gsan bzhes phul du phyin pa mdzad/ lha sa'i smon lam chen mor rab 'byams pa'i grwa skor mdzad de/ lha rams ang dang po'i mtshan btags bzhes/ lta ba'i legs bshad(drang ba dang nges pa'i don rnam par 'byed pa'i bstan bcos legs par bshad pa'i snying po'i zin bris dka' gnas gsal bar byed pa'i sgron me〉zhes bya ba brtsams—/ rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i shing pho sprel(spyi lo1824)lor gzugs sku'i bkod pa bsdus/sum pa mkhan po ye shes dpal 'byor ni/ rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i shing pho sprel (spyi lo1704)lor mtsho sngon erti ni tha'i ji tshangs pa skyabs kyi shog tu sku 'khrungs/ dgung grangs gsum lon pa'i tshe kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rjes sum pa bla ma'i sprul sku 'khrul med du ngos 'dzin gnang / thar shul chos skyong rgya mtsho slob dpon du bsten nas 'bri klog sogs legs par bslabs/ dgung lo bcu gsum par chu bzang rin po che ngag dbang thub bstan dbang phyug gi mdun nas dge tshul gyi sdom pa mnos/ dgung lo nyi shu par yul dbus lha ldan du grwa skor du phebs/ paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan las dge slong gi sdom pa bzhes/ mtshan la ye shes dpal 'byor zhes gsol/ 'bras spungs sgo mang grwa tshang du zhugs te la mo ngag dbang nam mkha' dang 142

bod gangs can gyi ljongs su dbu ma'i 'chad nyan ji ltar dar tshul/mog kyā rab 'byams pa 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho sogs mkhas grub mang du bsten nas bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas la sbyang brtson rgya cher mdzad pas—/ sum pa parnyi ta zhes mkhas pa'i grags snyan gyis bod yul kun tu khyab par gyur/ rgyal ba'i dgongs pa mthar thug pa gsal bar ston pa'i gzhung (dbu ma'i mtha' dpyod nyung bsdus zla 'od〉(sher snying nyams len mun sel sgron me〉 (thal 'gyur ba'i lugs kyi lta ba'i khrid yig cung zad rgyas tsam zhi bde'i zil mngar〉〈dbu ma'i lta khrid 'bring po legs bshad zla zer〉(dbu ma'i lta khrid shin tu mdor bsdus blo gzhon rna rgyan〉sogs brtsams te rgyal ba'i bstan pa gong du 'phel bar mdzad pa la phyag rjes rlabs po che bzhag rab byung bcu gsum pa'i sa pho sprel (spyi lo1788)lor sku gshegs/a kyā blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan ni/ rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i sa pho byi (spyi lo1708)lor mdo smad tsong kha'i yul du sku 'khrungs/khong ni sku 'bum byams pa gling gi khri rabs nyi shu pa yin zhing / dgung lo gzhon dus a kyā shes rab bzang po'i yang srid du ngos 'dzin mdzad/phyis su dbus lha ldan du phebs nas se ra theg chen gling gi chos grwar zhugs—/ dgung lo nyer brgyad steng phyir sku 'bum byams pa gling du byon/skabs thog der yul mdo smad du mdo sngags rig gnas thams cad la 'di las mkhas pa ma byung bar grags/ (legs bshad snying po las 143

dbu ma'i spyi don zab don gsal byed 'phrul gyi me long /brtsams pa'i dris lan〉(dbu ma pa'i bden gnyis las brtsams pa'i brgal lan log rtog brag ri 'joms pa'i rdo rje'i me char〉(legs bshad snying po las gsungs pa'i rang rgyud 'gog tshul lung tshig gis bcad pa〉(rang rgyud 'gog tshul gyi brjed byang〉sogs bka' rtsom mdzad do/ /dgung lo re drug bzhes pa rab byung bcu gsum pa'i sa byi(spyi lo1768)lor sku 'bum du sku gshegs/lcang skya rol pa'i rdo rje ni/ rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i me mo bya (spyi lo1717)lor mdo smad tsong kha'i byang phyogs kyi yul gru lang gru sde bzhir grags pa'i nub padmo'i sde'i char gtogs pa'i 'brog gnas brag dkar gyi lung bar sku 'khrungs/ kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang pos lcang skya ngag dbang chos ldan gyi sku skye ru ngos 'dzin mdzad/ gong ma yung tring gis pe cin du gdan drangs nas lcang skya sku gong ma'i khrir bkod/byams brtses 'gro ba yongs kyi spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba'i kun mkhyen bla ma zhes mtshan snyan dang gser gyi tham ka gnang nas dbu blar bkur/dka' chen shes rab dar rgyas slob dpon du bsten nas mdo sngags rig gnas thams cad la gsan sbyang phul du phyin pa mdzad pas mkhas pa'i rtser son par gyur/ gong ma yung rming gshegs rjes su chan lung gi dbu bla mdzad/ gong ma'i bka' ltar bstan 'gyur sog yig dang bka' 'gyur man ju'i skad du bsgyur/ grub mtha' thams cad kyi 144

bod gangs can gyi ljongs su dbu ma'i 'chad nyan ji ltar dar tshul/'dod tshul gsal bar ston pa'i bstan bcos shin tu grags che ba (grub mtha' thub bstan lhun po'i mdzes rgyan〉dang / rten 'brel bstod pa'i 'grel bshad thams cad kyi nang nas ches phul du byung ba'i (rten 'brel bstod pa'i ṭīkka legs bshad nor bu'i bang mdzod〉dang /mkhas pa kun gyis tshad mar 'dzin pa'i lta mgur a ma ngos 'dzin du grags pa'am (lta ba'i gsung mgur〉 (lta khrid〉(lta khrid mdor bsdus〉sogs mdzad nas 'jam mgon bla ma'i lta dgongs dri ma med pa nyid phyogs mthar spel bar phyag rjes zla med bzhag rab byung bcu gsum pa'i me pho rta (spyi lo1786)lor rgya nag ri bo rtse lngar gzugs sku'i bkod pa re zhig bsdus pa'i tshul bstan to/ /sngags rams pa bstan dar gyis (dbu ma snang ba'i brjed tho〉 (rten 'brel bstod pa'i 'grel pa tshig gsal don gsal〉(rten 'brel snying po'i dgongs 'grel thar pa'i 'jug ngogs〉sogs brtsams pa dang —/ dge bshes snang mdzad rdo rjes(zab mo dbu ma'i lta ba'i bsdus don〉(zab mo lta ba'i mgur dbyangs〉(dge ldan bka' srol phyag chen rtsa ba'i 'grel bshad rin po che'i snye ma〉〈bdag 'dzin gshag 'byed chos brgyad 'gugs 'joms〉(lhag mthong chen po'i dka' gnas las brtsams te dogs gcod 'ga' zhig brjed tho〉sogs ljags rtsom mdzad/ dam pa 'di gnyis kyi rnam thar mjal yul du ma 145

dbu ma'i spyi don zab don gsal byed 'phrul gyi me long /gyur pas dbu ma'i gzhung gi mtshan tho tsam bar 'dir bkod pa'o/ /a lag sha ngag dbang bstan dar lha rams pa ni/ rab byung bcu gsum pa'i sa yos(spyi lo1759)lor sog yul a la sha zhes pa'i yul du sku bltams—/ sku gzhon dus nas dpal ldan 'bras spungs sgo mang grwa tshang gi chos sgor zhugs/ rje klong rdol bla ma ngag dbang blo bzang dang /dka' chen ye shes rgyal mtshan sogs slob dpon du bsten nas gzhung bka' pod lnga la thugs gnyer lhod med gnang / lha ldan smon lam chen mor dge bshes lha rams pa'i grwa sgor mdzad pas/ mkhas pa'i grags snyan bod sog gi yul gru kun tu khyab/ dbu ma'i skor la (rten 'brel bstod pa'i dka' gnad las brtsams pa'i don 'grel rin chen phreng ba〉(gcig du bral gyi rnam bzhag legs bshad rgya mtsho las btus pa'i 'khrul spong bdud rtsi'i zegs ma〉(shes rab snying po'i 'grel pa〉(lam gtso rnam gsum gyi 'grel pa〉sogs mdzad/ khong gi 'das lo mi gsal/kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang po ni/ rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i sa sprel (spyi lo1728)lor mtsho sngon rma lho khul gcan tsha rdzong snang ra'i gser khang dang khad nye ba'i gram pa nang zhes pa'i yul du sku 'khrungs/mkha' spyod grub chen pa byon nas kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa mchog gi thugs kyi sprul pa yin par lung bstan/ sku na phra ba'i dus su 146

bod gangs can gyi ljongs su dbu ma'i 'chad nyan ji ltar dar tshul/khu bo stong 'khor rgya mtsho las zab chos mang du gsan/ dgung lo bcu drug par 'jam dbyangs bzhed pa'i yang srid ngos 'dzin mdzad de bla brang bkra shis 'khyil du gdan drangs/ 'gying rong ngag dbang bstan 'dzin dang / mkhas dbang rab brtan rgya mtsho sogs dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang po'i zhabs la gtugs te phar tshad dang tha snyad rig gnas sogs la slob gnyer mdzad/ dgung lo nyer gnyis par lcang skya rol ba'i rdo rje las bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa yang dag par mnos te/ mtshan la dkon mchog 'jigs med dbang po ye shes brtson 'grus grags pa'i sde zhes gsol/ mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi yon tan gyis thugs rgyud rab tu phyug pas/ lcang skya rin po che zhal snga nas/ bla ma zhig la sprul sku 'khrungs na 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa tshang 'dra ba re 'khrungs dgos zhes bsngags brjod kyi me tog 'thor bar mdzad/dgung lo nyer lnga pa la dbus gtsang du phebs te dpal ldan 'bras spungs sgo mang grwa tshang du zhugs/ klu 'bum blo bzang dar rgyas/ rgya seng gnyis slob dpon du bsten pa dang / rgyal dbang bdun pa blo bzang skal bzang rgya mtsho dang / paṇa chen sku phreng drug pa blo bzang dpal ldan ye shes/ dpon slob byams pa rin po che/ sa skya bdag chen kun dga' blo gros sogs mkhas grub mang po las mdo sngags kyi gzhung lugs mang po rgya cher gsan/ dbu ma rgyas pa/ dbu ma la 'jug pa'i /47

dbu ma'i spyi don zab don gsal byed 'phrul gyi me long /rnam bshad dgongs pa rab gsal/ 'grel chung don gsal/ rje dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i grub mtha' sogs gzhung chen mang po thugs 'dzin gnang —/ dbus su lo ngo brgyad kyi ring gzhung gi dka' gnas sogs la 'phags bod kyi rtsa 'grel rnams phan tshun gong bsgrigs nas zhib tu rtog dpyod mdzad pas rgyal ba'i gsung rab dang bstan bcos kyi dgongs don thams cad thugs su chud/ (bstan bcos chen mo dbu ma la 'jug pa'i mtha' dpyod lung rigs sgron me grub pa'i mtha' rnam par bzhag pa rin chen phreng ba〉(lta ba'i mgur gyi 'grel pa tshig gi sgron me〉sogs pod bcu phrag longs pa ljags rtsom gnang ba dang /sngon gyi mkhas pa'i gsung rtsom po ti khri phrag tsam bsdu sgrig mdzad/ khong gi gsung las skyes pa'i slob ma mkhas pa mkhan chen dge 'dun rgya mtsho/klong rdol grub dbang / rta tshag rje drung / sa skya bdag chen ngag dbang kun dga'/ thu'u bkwan chos kyi nyi ma/ gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me sogs mang du byon/ dgung lo re bzhi pa lcags phag (spyi lo1791)lor ka mdo gdong dmar snar sku gshegs/chings su tsug thu no mon han blo bzang nor bu shes rab ni/ rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i me mo sbrul(spyi lo1737)lor sog yul du sku bltams/mkhan po brtson 'grus bzang po dang / bka' 'gyur pa blo bzang tshul khrims / chos rje shes rab rgyal mtshan/ blo bzang dam pa sogs kyi 148

bod gangs can gyi ljongs su dbu ma'i 'chad nyan ji ltar dar tshul /mdun nas mdo sngags kyi gzhung lugs mang por thos bsam lhus things pa mdzad/ pe cin dang sog yul du bzhugs te dge lugs pa'i bstan pa rgya cher spel/ sog yul gyi gdan sa dge ldan bshad sgrub bstan 'phel gling du yig cha mang du brtsams pa las/ dbu ma'i skor la(zab pa dang rgya che ba'i tshul gsal bar byed pa dbu ma la 'jug pa'i 'grel pa tshig don rab tu gsal ba'i sgron me〉(zab mo dbu ma'i lta ba'i brjed byang nges don gsal ba'i sgron me〉zhes pa'i gzhung gnyis bzhugs so/ /khong gi 'das lo mi gsal/khal kha dam tshig rdo rje grags pa ni/ rab byung bcu gsum pa'i lcags glang (spyi lo1781)lor hal kha'i yul du sku bltams/ thu'u bkwan chos kyi nyi ma dang / se ra hal kha blo bzang sbyin pa/ khri chen ngag dbang snyan grags sogs dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang du bsten nas mdo sngags gzhung lugs mang por dka' spyad drag pos gsan sbyang mthar phyin mdzad pas/ mkhas pa'i yon tan mngon du gyur/ 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum la spobs pa rab tu rgyas pas/ dpal ldan dbu ma thal 'gyur ba'i lugs gsal bar ston pa'i gzhung (zab mo dbu ma'i lta khrid zab don snying po rab gsal〉(dbu ma la 'jug pa'i 'grel bshad rgyal sras rgya mtsho'i 'jug ngogs〉(shes rab snying po'i don 'grel nyung ngu rnam gsal〉('jam bzhad gong ma'i dbu ma'i mtha' 149

dbu ma'i spyi don zab don gsal byed 'phrul gyi me long /dpyod kyi smon tshig gi 'grel chung〉(thal 'gyur ba'i grub mtha'i rnam bzhag thar lam gsal byed〉(rten 'brel snying po'i don 'grel yig chung〉(dbu ma'i lta ba'i gsung mgur zab mo'i 'grel pa de nyid lta byed mig gi bcud len〉sogs brtsams nas dbu ma'i 'chad nyan shin tu rgyas par mdzad/ rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i shing yos (spyo lo1844)lor zhi bar gshegs/gu shri dka' bcu pa blo bzang tshe 'phel ni/ rab byung bcu gsum pa'i (spyi lo1760)nang du sog yul du sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo nyer gcig par paṇa chen dpal ldan ye shes las bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa bzhes/kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang po dang / gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me sogs dge bshes du ma las zab rgyas kyi chos rgyun mtha' yas pa gsan/dka' bcu pa'i mtshan btags bzhes/ (zab mo dbu ma'i lta khrid klu sgrub dgongs rgyan〉〈bstan bcos bzhi brgya pa'i lam bsgrigs thams cad mkhyen par bgrod pa'i lam mchog〉ces bya ba mdzad/ khong gi 'das lo mi gsal/gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me ni/ rab byung bcu gsum pa'i chu rta (spyi lo1762)los mdo smad mdzod dge the bo zhes pa'i yul du sku bltams/dgung lo bdun pa byi ba'i lor kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang pos khri chen dge 'dun phun tshogs kyi sku skye ru ngos 'dzin mdzad de bla brang 150

bod gangs can gyi smongs su dbu ma'i 'chad nyan ji ltar dar tshul/bkra shis 'khyil du gdan drangs/ kun mkhyen mchog las dge bsnyen rab byung dge tshul rnams dkyus gcig tu bsgrubs te/ mtshan la dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron me zhes gsol/ skyabs mgon rin po che las drang nges legs bshad snying po'i bshad lung sogs bka' chos mang du gsan/ dgung lo bcu bdun par dbus su byon te dpal ldan bkra shis sgo mang gi chos grwar 'dzin grwa gzhung gsar nas zhugs shing /hor dpon slob skal bzang dngos grub pa bla mar bsten/ skabs 'di nas bzung dbu ma'i 'dzin grwa mthar phyin pa'i bar du legs bshad snying po'i sems tsam skor/ yig cha'i drang nges rnam 'byed chen mo/dbu ma lung rigs gter mdzod stod cha/ dpon slob chos grags pa'i rten 'brel sogs gzhung chen mang po thugs 'dzin dang 'brel rgya bod kyi yig cha du mar zhib mo'i blos gzigs rtog mdzad/ yongs 'dzin ye shes rgyal mtshan dang / klong rdol bla ma rin po che gnyis las mdo sngags kyi chos rgyun sngar ma gsan pa mang du zhus/ dbus gtsang du lo ngo brgyad tsam bzhugs pa'i ring la dbu ma rigs tshogs drug rtsa 'grel dang —/ byams chos sde lnga/ bka' gdams gzhung drug sogs mdo phyogs kyi gzhung bka' pod lnga dang sngags phyogs kyi rgyud sde bzhi la zhib tu sbyangs pas mkhas pa'i rtser son par gyur/ rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis rje rin po cher gdams pa ltar bla ma dang yi dam dbyer 151

dbu ma'i spyi don zab don gsal byed 'phrul gyi me long /med la gsol 'debs/ tshogs gsog sgrib sbyong / gzhung chen mor dpyod pa sum sgril la 'bad pas dpal ldan dbu ma thal 'gyur ba'i lta ba ji lta ba bzhin du thugs su chud/ dgung lo nyer lnga par kun mkhyen rin po che'i bka' bkod ltar bla brang bkra shis 'khyil du zhabs pad bkod—/ snga phyir(rten 'brel gyi rnam bzhag lung rigs bang mdzod〉(zab mo lta ba'i zin bris thar lam snang ba〉(dbu ma la 'jug pa'i sa bcad〉(bden bzhi'i rnam bzhag thar 'dod 'jug ngogs mkhas pa'i dga' ston〉(dge ldan phyag rgya chen po'i zin bris zhal lung bdud rtsi'i thigs phreng〉(rje'i bstod pa don ldan rtsa 'grel〉(drang nges rnam 'byed kyi dka' 'grel legs bshad snying po'i yang snying〉rtsom 'phror lus pa sogs dbu ma'i bstan bcos kyis mtshon pa'i po ti bcu gnyis tsam/ ljags rtsom mdzad pa dang / dbal mang parnyi ta dkon mchog rgyal mtshan sogs slob ma bstan pa 'dzin pa'i mkhas pa mang du bskyangs pa bcas bstan 'gro la sman pa'i phyag rjes rlabs che ba bsgrun/rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i chu lug (spyi lo1823)lor gzugs sku'i bkod pa chos kyi dbyings su thim/mi nyag kun bzang bsod nams ni/ rab byung bcu bzhi ba'i dkyil tsam du mdo khams mi nyag gi yul du sku bltams/ sku na phra dus nas dpal sprul o rgyan 'jigs med chos kyi dbang po sogs rnying ma'i 152

bod gangs can gyi ljongs su dbu ma'i 'chad nyan ji ltar dar tshul/mkhas grub dam pa du ma'i zhabs pad yun ring du bsten nas rnying phyogs kyi chos skor la sbyang brtson nan tan mdzad pas mkhas pa 'i mtshan snyan gyi grags pa 'bar/ gsar rnying gi chos grwa du mar rigs pa'i grwa skor mdzad de thos bsam la rting skul bgyis/ dbu ma'i lta ba'i cha gtso bor ston pa'i ljags rtsom(spyod 'jug shes rab le'u'i gzhung 'grel zab mo rten 'byung de kho na nyid gsal ba'i sgron me〉(spyod 'jug shes rab le'u'i spyi don rim par phye ba zab mo rten 'byung gi de kho na nyid yang gsal sgron me〉zhes bya ba'i gzhung gnyis bzhugs so/ /rab byung bco lnga ba'i stod tsam du sku gshegs par mngon yang rnam thar cung zad rgyas pa ma mthong bas de tsam las spro bar ma nus so/ /dbal mang parnyi ta dkon mchog rgyal mtshan ni/ rab byung bcu gsum pa'i shing pho sprel (spyi 'o /764)lor mdo smad kan lho'i bsang chu rdzong bsang gzhung tshar tsha'i rgyud du sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo drug par kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang pos dbal mang blo bzang don grub kyi sku'i skye bar ngos 'dzin gnang / kun mkhyen rin po che'i 'dun nas rab tu byung zhing / mtshan la dkon mchog rgyal mtshan zhes gsol/dge bshes bsam gtan seng ge klog gi slob dpon du bsten nas 'don chos spyod yongs rdzogs dang rgyan 'jug sogs thugs 'dzin mdzad—/ dgung lo bcu gcig par lnga mchod skabs chos grwar zhugs 153

dbu ma'i spyi don zab don gsal byed 'phrul gyi me long /shing —/ dgun chos skabs smon lam grwa skor ba rnams la bgro gleng shar shar byed thub pa byung / drang nges rnam 'byed chen mo dang / grub mtha' chen mo/ grub mtha' rin chen phreng ba/ gung ru'i rten 'brel/blo rtags rang lugs sogs gzhung chen mo mang po thugs 'dzin mdzad/dgung lo nyer dgu'i steng rdo rams pa'i mtshan btags bzhes/ dgung lo so bzhi par kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang po'i yang srid slad du dbus gtsang du byon/ rgyal dbang paṇa chen dang / tre bo khri chen blo bzang bkra shis/ ba rig dge bshes khyab bdag bkras lhun yongs 'dzin zhal snga rnam gnyis sogs las sngar ma thob pa'i chos rgyun mang du gsan—/ sa rta lor mdo smad du slar phebs te mdzod dge dgon gsar rab rgyas gling phyag 'debs mdzad pa dang / snga phyir bla brang bkra shis 'khyil dang / rab rgyas gling / a chog dgon/ bstan 'phel gling sogs kyi khri pa mdzad/ dbu ma'i 'dzin grwas zhus te 〈dbu ma'i dogs slong〉zhes bya ba'i gzhung rmad du byung ba 'phral rtsom mdzad/ rwa sgreng khri chen rdo rje 'chang nas lcang skya rol pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa'i lta mgur sngags phyogs su bkral bar/ 'di ka'i slob gnyer ba la las dgag pa dang skor zhig gis lan sogs bris pa phyogs bsgrigs byas pa'i dpe deb snga mo nas yod par hal ha phyogs nas rigs smra mkhan grub chos rje dang / u ci mu chen nas tshe ldan lha rams pa rnam gnyis kyis dgag 154

bod gangs can gyi ljongs su dbu ma'i 'chad nyan ji ltar dar tshul yig de rje 'di'i yin pa'i dbang du byas nas dgag lan gyi yi ge 'byor bar/ rje 'di pa sa/ (dgag lan bden gtam bdud rtsir 'khyil ba'i snying rje'i rol mtsho〉dang (bden gtam snying rje'i rol mtsho las zur du phyung ba rnying ma bka' brgyud sogs kyi khyad par mgo smos tsam mu to'i rgyangs 'bod kyi tshul du bya gtong snyan sgron bdud rtsi'i bsang gtor〉gnyis ljags rtsom mdzad/ dgag yig 'bri mkhan gnyis nas gus pas bzod gsol gyi gsung 'phrin phul bar rtsod pa chos phyogs su zhi nas gser mdog cod paṇa 'chang ba'i ring lugs dri ma med pa rnam pa ra 'phel ba'i thabs tshul kho nar gyur to/ /gzhan yang zab mo lta ba ston pa'i gzhung〈rigs pa drug cu pa'i 'grel pa〉(legs bshad snying po'i gsung bshad zin bris su bkod pa kun mkhyen gsung gi chu rgyun dag byed mchod yon〉(rten 'brel bstod pa'i ṭīka dpag bsam ljon shing〉〈bla ma dam rnams kyi zhal las snga phyir thos pa'i lta ba'i zin bris 'od zer stong 'bar〉〈grub mtha'i dris lan phyogs lhung mun sel〉sogs brtsams te mkhas pa'i bya ba rnam gsum gyi sgo nas rgyal bstan phyogs mthar spel bar phyag rjes shin tu che bas/dbal mang parnyi ta zhes mkhas pa'i grags snyan gangs ri'i ljongs su khyab—/ slob ma mkhas pa bla brang a khu shes rab rgya mtsho dang / sde khri 'jam dbyangs thub bstan nyi ma/ su nyid dkon mchog nor bu sogs 155

dbu ma'i spyi don zab don gsal byed 'phrul gyi me long /mang du byon/ rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i chu mo glang (sbyi lo1853)lor zhi bar gshegs—/bis pa ngag dbang mi pham zla ba ni/ rab byung bcu gsum pa'i me phag (spyi lo1767)lor mdo smad mar nang 'tsho lngar bis thang 'ja' mo'i rigs su sku 'khrungs/ mkhan chen dngos slob bis pa dge bshes shes rab bstan 'dzin gyi sku skye ru ngos bzung / bde chen pa shes rab 'od zer dang a khyung ngag dbang mkhyen rab gnyis las sum rtags snyan ngag sogs byang chub par bslabs/ shar skal ldan dge 'dun 'phrin las rab rgyas las bsnyen par rdzogs/ mkhan chen drung yig blo bzang rgya mtsho dang / lcang lung khri rgan/ tshe mgon bla ma/ khri rgan sprul sku ngag dbang 'jam dbyangs bkra shis/ mkhan chen drung yig sogs dang /dgon lung du wang skal bzang ye shes dar rgyas/ zhang ba sgom chen blo bzang zla ba/ thu'u bkwan chos kyi nyi ma sogs dge bshes du ma bsten nas mdo sngags kyi gzhung lugs mang por gsan bzhes gnang /gzhung lugs rab 'byams smra ba la gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i spobs pa brnyes pas/ thu'u bkwan rin po che nas/ gung thang sprul pa'i sku dang /'di pa lta bu'i mdo sngags rig gnas thams cad la mkhas pa deng sang dkon zhes don dang mthun pa'i bsngags brjod mdzad/ zab don ston pa'i bstan bcos (phyag chen gaṅgā ma'i 'grel pa〉(dge ldan phyag rgya 156

bod gangs can gyi ljongs su dbu ma'i 'chad nyan ji ltar dar tshul/chen po'i gdams ngag me long〉(phyag chen nyams mgur dri med rdo rje'i gsung gi dka' 'grel〉(lta ba'i gsung mgur gyi ṭīkka〉(zab mo de kho na nyid kyi don la dpyad pa rnam par rtog pa'i 'gyu 'khril〉sogs bka' rtsom mdzad/ rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i me yos (spyi lo807)lor sku gshegs—/bla brang a khu shes rab rgya mtsho ni/ rab byung bcu gsum pa'i chu phag spyi lo(spyi lo1803)lor mdo smad rtse gzhung brag dmar mdo zhes pa'i yul du sku 'khrungs/ skyabs mgon thams cad mkhyen pa rje btsun blo bzang thub bstan 'jigs med rgya mtsho dang / gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me/ dbal mang parnyi ta/ mkhan chen grags pa rgyal mtshan/ sde khri rin po che 'jam dbyangs thub bstan nyi ma sogs dge bshes bcu phrag gsum lhag la bsten nas dbu ma sogs mdo phyogs kyi gzhung bka' pod lnga la rdo rus thug pa'i sbyang ba mdzad pas mkhas pa'i mtshan snyan thob—/ brtsams chos pod nyi shu bzhugs pa dang / dbu ma'i gzhung (dbu ma 'jug pa'i brjed byang zla ba'i 'od zer〉(rten 'brel bstod pa rtsa 'grel gyi brjed byang thub dbang dgyes pa'i mchod sprin〉gnyis ljags rtsom mdzad do/ /dgung lo don gsum pa rab byung bco lnga pa'i shing phag (spyi lo1875)lor sku gshegs/khal kha chos rje ngag dbang dpal ldan ni/ rab byung gsum pa'i me /57

dbu ma'i spyi don zab don gsal byed 'phrul gyi me long /pho stag (spyi lo1806)lor khal kha'i yul du sku 'khrungs/ gzhon dus su khu re dgon du sum rtags dang bsdus grwa sogs la slob gnyer gnang /rjes su dpal ldan 'bras spungs sgo mang grwa tshang du zhugs te gzhung bka' pod lnga la gsan bsam mdzad pas mkhas par gyur/ lta ba'i cha gtso bor ston pa'i gzhung (grub mtha' chen mo'i mchan 'grel dka' gnad mdud grol blo gsal gces nor〉('bras spungs blo gsal gling dang sgo mang gi yig cha'i bzhed tshul mi 'dra ba phyogs bkod blo gsal dga' ston〉 (dbu ma la 'jug pa'i tshig 'grel〉(dbu ma'i lta ba la bstod pa tshigs su bcad pa〉(grub mtha' bzhi'i lugs kyi kun rdzob dang don dam pa'i don rnam par bshad pa〉 (rnam dge ba'i lta ba'i rnam bzhag〉sogs brtsams/ rje 'di pa'i rnam thar zhib gsal ma rnyed pas 'dir mtshon tsam smras pa'o/ /brag dkar blo bzang dpal ldan bstan 'dzin snyan grags ni/rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i sa mo sbrul (spyi lo1809)lor mdo smad dzi kar sku bltams—/ dgung lo bcu bdun par 'bras spungs blo gsal gling gi chos grwar zhugs te dbu phar sogs gzhung chen bka' pod lnga la gsan sbyang mdzad/ dgung lo nyer gsum par mkhas dbang 'ju mi pham pas mdzad pa'i spyod 'jug shes rab le'u 'grel pa ke ta ka zhes bya bar lung rigs kyi gnod byed mang du mthong nas(zab mo dbu ma'i gnad 158

bod gangs can gyi ljongs su dbu ma 'i 'chad nyan ji ltar dar tshul/cung zad brjod pa blo gsal dga' ba'i gtam〉zhes bya ba'i dgag yig brtsams pa dang / 'ju mi pham pa'i brgal lan du 〈zab mo'i gtam〉zhes bya ba dang / de'i yang lan du (mi pham rnam rgyal gyi yang lan log lta'i khong khrag 'don pa'i skyugs sman〉zhes bya ba ljags rtsom mdzad—/ gzhan yang (dbu ma la 'jug pa'i rnam bshad dgongs pa rab tu gsal ba'i sgron me〉 (dbu ma la 'jug pa'i dka' gnad nges don gsal ba'i sgron me〉(zab mo'i tshig 'grel legs bshad gzhung bzang lta ba'i mig 'byed〉 (bstan bcos mngon rtogs rgyan gyi 'grel pa tshig don rab tu gsal ba'i sgron me〉 (rang dang gzhan gyi grub mtha'i rnam par bzhag pa'i bstan bcos legs par bshad pa'i sgron me〉 (theg pa chen po'i rgyud bla ma'i 'grel pa byams mgon dgyes pa'i mchod sprin〉sogs mdzad/ dam pa 'di pa'i 'das lo mi gsal bas gzhan las shes par bya'o/ /grub dbang 'jigs med bsam gtan ni/ rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i shing khyi (spyi lo1814)lor mdo smad reb gong lha zhol lte thang du sku 'khrungs—/ rdzong chung parnyi ta 'jigs med lung rigs rgya mtsho dang /rong po blo bzang chos dar/ rab 'byams pa blo bzang nyi ma/ rje gser khang pa blo bzang bstan pa'i rgya mtsho/ shing bza' rin po blo bzang dar rgyas—/ rdo rams pa 'jigs med bzang po sogs kyi zhabs la gtugs 159

dbu ma'i spyi don zab don gsal byed 'phrul gyi me long /te gzhung bka' pod lnga la gsan bzhes phu thag chod pa mdzad/ zab mo de kho na nyid kyi don ston pa'i gzhung (zab mo stong pa nyid rab tu gsal bar byed pa'i bstan bcos skal bzang mig 'byed〉dang / (dbu ma bzhi brgya pa'i sa bcad bsdus don〉zhes pa bya ba brtsams pa dang / mkhas grub gnyis ldan gyi slob ma shar thams cad mkhyen pa blo bzang skal ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ khri rgan 'jam dbyangs thub bstan rgya mtsho/ rgyal ba'i yongs 'dzin zhwa dmar parnyi ta/ bde yangs no mon han/ rje spyan snga dkon mchog phun tshogs sogs mang du byon/rab byung bco lnga pa'i me bya (spyi lo1897)lor ka ring du zhi bar gshegs/zhang ston bstan pa rgya mtsho ni/ rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i shing mo bya (spyi lo1825)lor mdo smad rma chu'i 'gram ngogs dang khad nye ba'i rtse gzhung zhes pa'i yul du sku bltams/ dgung grangs bdun gyi steng rje dkon mchog rgya mtsho'i mdun nas rab tu byung zhing mtshan la dkon mchog thabs mkhas zhes gsol/ dgung lo bcu gsum par chos sde chen po bla brang bkra shis 'khyil ba'i thos bsam gling gi chos grwar zhugs/ dgung grangs nyer gcig par 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa blo bzang 'jigs med rgya mtsho'i drung nas dge slong gi sdom pa mnos te mtshan la bstan pa rgya mtsho zhes su gsol/ snga phyir zhang lha'i dge slong blo gsal rgya mtsho dang /dbal mang dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ a khu bstan 'dzin/ gling sprul 160

bod gangs can gyi ljongs su dbu ma'i 'chad nyan ji ltar dar tshul/'jigs med blo gros rgya mtsho sogs mkhas grub du ma'i zhabs la gtugs te dbu phar mdzod 'dul rnam 'grel dang rgyud sde bzhi la gsan bsam slob gnyer nan tur mdzad pas mkhas pa'i rtser son par gyur/ 'jam bzhad sprul sku dang / thu'u bkwan sprul sku/ zhwa dmar sprul sku sogs skyes chen dang zhal slob mkhas pa mang du bskyangs/(dge ldan ring lugs gsal byed gdung sel bdud rtsi'i snying po〉(dmigs brtse ma'i 'grel pa zab don nor bu'i gter mdzod〉(dge ldan pa'i grub mtha'i rnam gzhag drang po'i gtam gyi tshangs thig〉(lam gtso'i 'grel pa tshig don gsal ba〉sogs ljags rtsom mdzad pa dang /khong gi gsung 'bum la khyon bsdoms po ti bzhi tsam bzhugs so/ /rab ṭwāṃdī /bco lnga pa'i me mo bya(spyi lo895)lor dgongs pa chos dbyings su dpa' ris blo bzang rab gsal ni/ rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i lcags pho byi (spyi lo1840)lor dpa' ris rdzong gi yar lung dgon pa'i nye sar sku 'khrungs/ snga phyir yar lung dgon dang bla brang bkra shis 'khyil du phebs nas dge bshes du ma bsten nas mdo sngags rig gnas thams cad la gsan sbyang mthar phyin mdzad nas rdo rams pa'i mtshan btags bzhes/ dgung grangs nga lngar bzhes pa'i tshe mdo smad kyi dgon sde mang por byon nas gzhung chen bka' pod lnga'i grwa skor mdzad/161

dbu ma'i spyi don zab don gsal byed 'phrul gyi me long bdag med gtan la 'bebs pa'i bstan bcos (drang ba dang nges pa'i don las brtsams pa blo gsal rol ba'i dga' ston〉(dbu ma'i ston thun zab don lta ba'i mig sman〉 (dbu ma'i sdom gyi blo gros padmo bzhad pa'i nyin byed〉sogs ljags rtsom mdzad pa dang / rnying ma'i phyogs kyi mkhas chen 'ju mi pham gyis spyod 'jug shes rab le'u'i 'grel pa mdzad pa la yar lung dge bshes chen mo 'di pas('jam dpal dbyangs kyi dgongs rgyan rigs pa'i gzi 'bar gdong lnga'i sgra dbyangs〉zhes bya ba'i dgag yig phul du byung ba de nyid spel ba dang /'ju mi pham gyi yang lan du (shes ldan yid kyi gdung sel rigs lam ga bur chu rgyun〉mdzad pas/ mkhas pa'i grags snyan gyis bod gangs can gyi ljongs su khyab/ dgag yig 'di'i mjug tu/ mi pham bshes gnyen tshig gi pho nya yis/ /bskul pa'i 'phrin lan ji bzhin deng 'dir bsgrags—/ /skyon bral padma dkar po'i phreng bstar bas/ /rab 'byams rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor mi bzad par/ /zab rgyas gdams pa'i de nyid ston mkhas pa'i/ /mi pham 'jam dbyangs mched du gyur cig gu/ /zhes dang —/ 'ju mi pham la phul ba'i zhu 'phrin du/ chos 'byor sprin gyi phung po 'khrigs pa'i klong / /khams zhes grags pa'i gser ldan dkyil 'khor du/ /grags snyan lha yi rnga chen ldir ba can/ /nges don chos kyi rgyal por yid re dga'/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar rtsod pa chos 162

bod gangs can gyi ljo ngas su dbu ma'i 'chad nyan ji ltar dar tshul/phyogs su zhi nas phan tshun la bsngags brjod mdzad pa dang / phan tshun bar dgag yig gi lam nas zab rgyas chos kyi 'bel gtam rgya cher gnang ba bstan pa'i zhabs 'degs su dmigs pa las chags sdang gi rgyal pham brtsad pa min par gsungs pa gzur gnas mkhas pa'i rnam thar rmad du byung ba nyid du shes par bya'o/ /rab byung bco lnga pa'i chu byi (spyi lo916)lor gzugs sku'i bkod pa bsdu ba'i tshul bstan to/ /'ju mi pham 'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal rgya mtsho ni/ rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i me rta (spyi lo1846)lor mdo khams sde dge'i nye 'dabs ya chu ding chung gi sa char yab mgon po dar rgyas dang yum sring chung gnyis kyi sras su sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo bcu gnyis steng rnying ma'i dgon pa gsang sngags chos gling dgon du byon nas grwa btsun mdzad/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po dang / dbang chen dgyes rab rdo rje/dpal sprul 'jigs med chos dbang sogs mkhas dbang mang du bsten nas bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas la sbyangs pa mtha' chod par gnang bas mkhyen rab kyi klong brdol/ sgra snyan sman rtsis sogs kyis mtshon pa'i thun mong ba'i bstan bcos mang du mdzad pa dang / dbu ma'i gzhung(dbu ma rtsa ba'i mchan 'grel gnas lugs rab gsal klu dbang dgongs rgyan〉〈dbu ma 'jug pa'i 'grel pa zla ba'i zhal lung dri med shel gyi me long〉(dbu ma rgyan gyi rnam bshad 'jam dbyangs bla ma 163

dbu ma'i spyi don zab don gsal byed 'phrul gyi me long /dgyes pa'i zhal lung〉(lcang skya'i lta mgur gyi 'grel pa〉(nges shes rin po che'i sgron me〉(rje btsun sa skya pa'i lta grub kyi gnad 'ga' la dri ba byung ba'i dogs sel〉(rdzogs pa chen po'i lta ba'i nyams mgur sgra snyan gyi rol mo〉(rten cing 'brel bar byung ba'i snying po'i tshig le'ur byas pa'i 'grel pa zab mo rnam par mthong ba〉sogs nang rig pa'i bstan bcos khyon bsdoms po ti sum cu lhag ljags rtsom mdzad nas bstan 'gro la sman pa'i don rgya chen po bsgrubs/ khong nyid nas (spyod 'jug shes rab le'u'i tshig don go sla bar rnam par bshad pa nor bu ke ta ka〉brtsams pa la mkhas dbang dpa' ris blo bzang rab gsal nas dgag yig spel bar/ de'i lan du(gzhan gyis rtsod pa'i lan mdor bsdus pa rigs lam rab gsal de nyid snang byed〉mdzad pa dang / mkhas mchog blo bzang rab gsal la phul ba'i zhu 'phrin las/rtog ge'i tshul 'dzin rtog ge las 'das pa'i/ /zab mo'i chos spyan ldan pa'i bshes gnyen drung / /rnam rtog rlabs kyis bskyod pa'i rtog ge pa/ /gang des zol med zhu mchid 'di ltar gsol/ /mkhyen rab 'od zer dra bas rab mdzes pa/ /khyed thugs dwangs gsal nam mkha' rnyog med la//bzod par gsol zhes zhu ba ma dgos kyang / /dus kyi mthar skyes byis pa bdag lta bus/ /ma brtag smra ba gzhan pa mang po'i rgyud/ /'khrugs bcas gyur gang de dag thams cad kun/ /sgrib med byang chub mchog gi 164

bod gangs can gyi ljongs su dbu ma'i 'chad nyan ji ltar dar tshul/rgyur gyur ces/ /smon pa de ltar o kyis mthun 'gyur mdzod/ /rang rgyud nyes pa'i dri ma sbyang ba'i slad/ /rab dkar lha rdzas ba dan mdzes pa dang / /shes rab phar phyin mdo dang mdo gzhan bcas/ /shing sbrul zla tshes dge bar phul ba lags/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa ni/ chos rje sa paṇa gyis/ legs bshad mkhas pa'i blo gros kyis/ /go yi blun pos de lta min/ /zhes gsungs pa'i dam pa'i ngang tshul kho na'o/ /gzhan yang dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi mkhas pa brag dkar blo bzang dpal ldan bstan 'dzin snyan grags nas spyod 'jug shes rab le'u'i 'grel par dgag pa mdzad pas/ de'i lan du(sher 'grel brgal lan nyin byed snang ba〉zhes bya ba brtsams pa dang / de nyid las/ spyir bod snga rabs pa dang phyis kyi mkhas pa dag gi bzhed tshul cung zad mi 'dra ba'i khyad par mchis pa las/ bdag ni skye ba 'dir snga 'gyur ba'i bstan zhabs su skyes shing bstan 'dzin chen po rnams kyi zhal gyi bdud ji nod pa las snga 'gyur gyi bstan pa dang de 'dzin la gus pa yar 'phel du gyur pa las/ dam pa'i ring lugs zab mo sun 'byin gyi blo ngan phung khrol ngan pa'i gdon gyis ma zin tsam gyi dwangs pa gtso bor byas nas gzhung lugs bshad pa cung zad re byas pa rnams sngon gyi dam pa dag gi rjes su brjod pa yin la/ zhes dang / bod gangs can na sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la 'phrin las 'gran zla dang bral ba rje btsun 165

dbu ma'i spyi don zab don gsal byed 'phrul gyi me long /chen po tsong kha pa'i gzhung gsal zhing legs par bshad pa rnams la gus shing bka' drin che bar shes mod/ snga rabs kyi dam pa mchog rnams kyi bzhed pa dang khyad par yod pa rnams la gcigs su byas nas lung dang rigs pas de sgrub pa ni grub mtha' smra ba spyi'i tshul lugs yin—/ zhes pa'i gsung zin la brtags pa las dam pa 'di pa'i dgongs pa'i phugs kyi gtad so gang yin rjes su dpog nus so/ /ṭwāṃ~X/ byung bco lnga pa'i chu byi (spyi lo1912)lor dgongs pa chos dbyings su khang gsar blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan ni/ rab byung bzhi pa'i sa pho sprel (spyi lo1848)lor khams dkar mdzes kyi sa khul du sku 'khrungs—/ chung dus nas 'bras spungs blo gsal gling du phebs te dbu ma sogs mdo sngags gzhung lugs mang por slob gnyer gnang /gsung rtsom pod gsum bzhugs pa dang / zab don ston pa'i gzhung (zab mo dbu ma'i lta khrid bdag 'dzin dgra dpung 'joms pa'i 'phrul 'khor〉zhes bya ba brtsams/ khong gi 'das lo mi gsal/kirti blo bzang 'phrin las ni/ rab byung bzhi pa'i sa bya (spyi lo1849)lor mdo smad rtse gzhung du sku bltams/ dgung lo lnga par kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa skal bzang thub bstan dbang phyug gis kirti sku phreng bdun pa'i sprul skur ngos 'dzin mdzad/ mtshan la blo bzang 166

bod sangasacan gyi ljongs su dbu ma'i 'chad nyan ji ltar dar tshul 'phrin las rgya mtsho zhes gsol/ dge bshes dkon mchog smon lam dang / thub bstan mtha' yas sogs bla ma du ma bsten nas mdo sngags gzhung lugs thams cad la sbyangs pa phul du phyin pa mdzad nga sa/mkhas pa'i grags snyan bod gangs can gyi ljongs su khyab/ dgung lo nyer lnga par si khron rnga ba'i yul du kirti dgon dge ldan legs bshad gling phyag 'debs mdzad/ ('jug pa'i sa bcad〉(rten 'brel bstod pa'i bsdus don zab don lta ba'i mig〉 (dbu ma'i sdom tshig〉sogs gzhung pod bcu gnyis ljags rtsom mdzad/ rab byung bco lnga pa'i shing ṭwāṃ la/ /(spyi lo1905)lor dgongs pa chos dbyings su bsdus pa'i tshul bstan gung thang blo gros rgya mtsho ni/ rab byung bzhi pa'i lcags mo phag (spyi lo1851)lor mdo smad du sku 'khrungs/ chung dus nas bla brang bkra shis 'khyil gyi chos grwar zhugs te rje shes rab rgya mtsho dang rje ngag dbang thub bstan rgya mtsho sogs dge bshes mang du bsten nas dbu phar sogs gzhung bka' pod yongs rdzogs la sbyangs pa mthar phyin mdzad pas mkhas pa chen por gyur/ dbu ma'i gzhung (dbu ma'i mtha' dpyod lung rigs gter mdzod kyi dgongs don gsal bar byed pa'i nyin byed snang ba zab lam lta ba'i mig 'byed〉 (drang ba dang nges pa'i don rnam par 'byed pa'i bstan bcos legs bshad snying po'i dka' 167

dbu ma'i spyi don zabadon gsal byed 'phrul gyi me long/'grel rin chen sgron me〉(dbu ma la 'jug pa rang 'grel dang bcas pa'i mchan 'grel bsdus don rin po che'i mig ces bya ba〉〈stong nyid bdun cu pa'i 'grel pa gnas don gsal byed〉 (zhib mo rnam par 'thag pa mchan dang bcas pa〉sogs ljags rtsom mdzad de 'chad nyan rgya cher spel/ rab byung bcu drug pa'i lcags rta (spyi lo1930)lor sku gshegs—/zhwa dmar pazlo dge 'dun bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho ni/ rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i chu byi (spyi lo1852)lor mdo smad mtsho sngon po'i nye 'gram chos lung du grags pa'i zhwa dmar tsho bar sku 'khrungs/ pan chen bstan pa'i nyi ma dang skyabs rje khang sar pa'i sku mched rje blo bzang bstan pa rgya mtsho gnyis kyis rje zhwa dmar ba'i sprul skur ngos 'dzin gnang / dgung lo brgyad par skyabs rje thar shul dge 'dun chos skyong rgya mtsho las rab tu byung zhing / mtshan dge 'dun bstan 'dzin bzang po zhes gsol/dge bshes stag ri rab 'byams pa blo bzang nyi ma dang / bla brang rje shes rab rgya mtsho/ skyabs rje dam pa blo bzang lung rigs rgya mtsho/ dge bshes sangs rgyas chos grags/ grub dbang 'jigs med bsam gtan/thar shul dge 'dun chos skyong rgya mtsho sogs gtsug nor mkhas dbang bcu phrag gsum lhag tsam la bsten nas sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi la dka' spyad drag pos gsan sbyang gnang bas gzhung brgya smra ba'i 168

bod gangs can gyi ljongs su dbu ma'i 'chad nyan ji ltar dar tshul/mkhas pa chen por gyur/ gong sa rgyal dbang bcu gsum pa chen po sku 'bum byams pa gling du phebs pa dang mjal phrad gnang bas/ rgyal dbang rin po che nas lnga pa chen mo 'di na 'dug ces bsngags brjod mdzad pa dang / rje 'di nyid las dbang lung man ngag mtha' yas pa zhus te/ yongs 'dzin chos kyi rgyal po ma ha parnyi ta zhes pa 'i mkhas pa'i mtshan gyi cod paṇa gnang / (lhag mthong chen mo'i dka' gnas rnams brjed byang du bkod pa dgongs zab snang ba'i sgron me〉 (lta khrid dran pa bzhi ldan gyi zin bris〉 (dge bshes sangs rgyas chos grags pa dang bka' bgros dbu ma'i dka' gnad snang gter〉 (drang nges legs bshad snying po'i zin bris〉 (bden gnyis kyi zhal tho grub mtha' rnam bzhi'i lam bzang〉 (zab mo dbu ma'i lta ba rtogs pa'i man ngag zla med rigs lam 'phrul lde'i zin tho〉(lhag mthong tho gsum dang dka' gnas la dpyad pa'i tho bcas〉sogs mdzad nas 'jam mgon bla ma tsong kha pa chen po yab sras nas brgyud pa'i dbu ma thal 'gyur ba'i lugs bzang rnam par dag pa rgya cher spel ba dang /rab byung bco lnga pa'i chu yos (spyi lo1903)lor chos sde chen po sde tsha dge ldan bkra shis chos sdings phyag 'debs mdzad de 'chad nyan gyi srol legs par btsugs/ thugs sras hor chen ye shes rgya mtsho dang / kha sgang sprel nag pa 'phrin las rgya mtsho/ bka' bcu pa dge 'dun mkhas 169

dbu ma'i spyi don zab don sasal byed 'phrul gyi me long /mchog lha rje ye shes rgya mtsho/ mdzod dge blo bzang rgya mtsho/ sgo'u steng blo bzang dpal ldan/ gser tog blo bzang tshul khrims/ dpyi sa blo gros rgya mtsho/ spyang lung khri rgan 'jam dbyangs thub bstan rgya mtsho/ rje 'jigs med dam chos rgya mtsho/ shing bza' sprul sku blo bzang bshad sgrub dam chos rgya mtsho/ bis mdo 'jam dbyangs grags pa sogs lung rigs smra ba'i zhal slob mkhas pa bgrang las 'das pa bskyangs/ dam pa 'di'i gsung rtsom la bstan bcos shin tu grags che ba(lam khrid dge legs 'od snang 'gyed pa'i nyin byed〉sogs khyon bsdoms po ti chen po bdun bzhugs so/ /rab byung lnga pa'i chu byi(spyi lo1912)lor gzugs sku'i bkod pa chos dbyings su bsdus pa'i tshul bstan to/ /rong tha blo bzang dam chos rgya mtsho ni/ rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i shing mo glang (spyi lo1865)lor mdo khams sga lung du sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo bcu dgu par yul rdzong gi rwa nyag phun tshogs gling gi chos grwar zhugs te rong tha sprul skur ngos 'dzin gnang / blo bzang chos 'byor lhun grub dang / bstan 'dzin thub stobs/ chos dbang rnam rgyal sogs bshes gnyen du mar bsten nas sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi la legs par sbyangs pas mkhas par gyur/ (mngon rtogs rgyan gyi zin tho phar phyin gzhung brgya gsal ba'i me long〉 (dbu ma la 'jug pa'i bstan bcos dgongs don rab tu gsal ba'i me long〉dang de'i rang 170

bod sangs can gyi ljongs su dbu ma 'i 'chad nyan ji ltar daratshul/'grel (kun phan zla ba'i 'od zer〉 (dbu ma'i bstan bcos rtsa ba shes rab kyi ngag don bshad pa rin po che'i phreng ba)dang de'i rang 'grel(zab don gzugs brgya 'char ba'i me long〉sogs ljags rtsom mdzad—/ 'bul sdud sprul sku blo bzang ye shes bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis spyi lo 1903lor khong gi mdun nas rtsis sogs gsan par grags pas skabs der da dung zhal bzhugs par mngon pas/ dgung lo dgu bcu lhag tsam la bzhugs nas 'chad rtsom rtsod gsum gyis dus 'da' bar mdzad kyang / 'das lo zhib gsal ma rnyed/bla kho 'jigs med 'phrin las rgya mtsho ni/ rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i me pho stag (spyi lo1866)lor yul mdo smad du sku bltams/ dgrang lo dgu bzhes pa 'i tshe bla brang bkra shis 'khyil ba'i rje shes rab rgya mtsho'i mdun nas dge tshul gyi sdom pa mnos/ snga phyir bde thang mkhan chen 'jam dbyangs thub bsta na rgya mtsho dang / 'jam dbyangs chos dar/ grags pa rgya mtsho/ ngag dbang thub bstan rgya mtsho/ kun mkhyen sku phreng bzhi pa skal bzang thub bstan dbang phyug sogs dge ba'i bshes gnyen bcu phrag lhag tsam gyi zhabs la gtugs te tha snyad rig gnas dang gzhung bka' pod lnga la nyin mtshan khor mo yug tu gsan sbyangs mdzad pas ring bor ma thogs par mkhas pa'i go 'phang brnyes/ spyir dam pa 'di pa tshang gis mdzad pa'i gsung rtsom la ngo da drug tsam bzhugs pa dang /171
