dbu ma'i spyi don zab don gsal byed 'phrul gyi me long /dbu ma'i gzhung (zab mo lta ba'i rnam bzhag phyogs tsam brjod pa blo bzang zhal lung〉(drang nges rnam 'byed kyi zin bris yab rje'i gsung gi bdud rtsi'i zegs ma〉(dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub la bstod pa'i don rnam par bshad pa dbu ma'i snang ba gsal ba〉(dbu ma rgyas pa'i dgag bya ngos 'dzin gyi zin bris mthar 'dzin gdung sel〉(grub mtha' rtsa 'grel gyi zin bris kun bzang nyin byed snang ba〉sogs brtsams—/ rab byung bcu drug pa'i me mo phag (spyi lo1947)lor sku gsheṭa/rje pha bong kha pa byams pa bstan 'dzin 'phrin las ni/ rab byung bco lnga pa'i sa pho stag (spyi lo1878)lor lha sa'i nub phyogs g.yu thog shar zhes pa'i yul du sku 'khrungs/ phur lcog byams pa rgya mtsho dang / brag ri rdo rje 'chang blo bzang thub bstan rnam rgyal dpal bzang po soṭa las gzhung bka' pod lnga dang rgyud sde bzhi la gsan bsam mthar phyin gnang —/ zab rgyas kyi chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bas dus 'da' bas zhal slob kyis dbus gtsang kun tu khyab par gyur/ gsung rtsom pod bcu gnyis bzhuṭa pa dang / dbu ma'i gzhung (drang nges leṭa bshad snying po'i zin bris mdo tsam du gnang ba〉(dbu ma la 'jug pa'i 'bru 'grel zab don snang ba'i 'od〉(dbu ma'i brjed byang nyung ngu〉soṭa mdzad / rab byung bcu drug pa'i lcaṭa mo sbrul (spyi lo/941)lor sku gsheṭa/brag g.yab rtogs ldan 'jam dbyangs blo gros ni/ rab byung bco 172

bod gangs can gyi ljongs su dbu ma'i 'chad nyan ji ltar dar tshul/lnga ba'i sa byi (spyi lo1888)lor mdo smad me stod byang dkar zhes pa'i yul du sku 'khrungs/ dgung grangs bcu bdun steng du grub chen bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi drung du rab tu byung zhing / mtshan la ngag dbang ye shes zhes su gsol/ dgung lo nyer gnyis steng rgyal ba blo bzang chos nyid kyi mdun du zab chos ci rigs gsan te mtshan la 'jam dbyangs blo gros zhes gsol/ dgong lo nyer gsum steng dbus su phebs te 'bras spungs blo gsal gling gi chos grwar zhugs te/ tre hor blo bzang sbyin pa dang / mi nyag 'jam dpal blo gros/ gser khang rje byams pa bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho sogs dge ba'i bshes gnyen du mar bsten nas gzhung lugs mtha' yas par slob gnyer mthar phyin mdzad pas mkhas pa'i go 'phang brnyes/ pha bong kha pa rje byams pa bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho'i drung du dge slong gi sdom pa legs par mnos/ dbu ma'i lta ba'i cha gtso bor ston pa'i gzhung (lhag mthong chen mo'i dka' gnad rin chen phreng ba〉 (lhag mthong chen mo'i dka' gnad kyi 'grel pa'i lcags thur〉 (nyams mgur gyi tshogs thabs shes gsang ba'i bang mdzod〉sogs bka' rtsom mdzad/ rab byung bcu drug pa'i lcags sbrul (spyi lo194/)lor dgongs pa chos dbyings su thim/sge'u steng blo bzang dpal ldan ni/ rab byung bco lnga pa'i lcags sbrul (spyi lo1881)lor mdo smad re skong tsho 'du zhes pa'i sde bar sku 173

dbu ma'i spyi don zab don gsal gyed 'phrul gyi me long /'khrungs—/ glang gya'i lha rams pa blo bzang chos grags las dge tshul gyi sdom pa mnos te mtshan la blo bzang dpal ldan zhes gsol/ zhwa dmar parnyi ta dge 'dun bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho dang / dge bshes hor chen ye shes rgya mtsho/ grub dbang 'jigs med bsam gtan/ tsho 'du'i yongs 'dzin byang chub kun spangs blo bzang sogs kyi zhabs pad bsten nas mdo sngags rig gnas thams cad la zhib tu sbyang brtson mdzad pas mkhas pa'i go 'phang brnyes/ dgung lo zhe bdun par shar skal ldan blo bzang 'phrin las lung rtogs rgya mtsho'i yongs 'dzin mdzad/ dbu ma'i skor la (dbu ma'i rtsa ba shes rab kyi sa gcod〉(dbu ma rtsa ba shes rab kyi rigs pa'i de nyid snang bar byed pa'i don sbyor ngag gi sgron me〉(lta ba'i myong byang〉〈gser phreng dris lan〉sogs ljags rtsom mdzad/dgung grangs nga lnga bzhes dus 'bras spungs klu 'bum lha rams pa rje btsun shes rab rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i rtsod yig rigs pa'i gad rgyangs la rnam par dpyad pa brgal lan bskal pa'i me dpung zhes bya ba'i dgag yig phyag tu 'byor bas/ de'i lan du ('jam dpal rnam par rol ba'i ting nge 'dzin las byung ba'i legs par bshad pa chu'i 'khrul 'khor〉zhes bya ba brtsams/ khong gi gsung las skyes pa'i slob ma 'jigs med dam chos rgya mtsho dang / rong chen kirti sku phreng bcu pa ngag dbang blo bzang bstan pa tshe ring / dpyi sa blo gros rgya mtsho sogs 174

bod gangs can gyi ljongs su dbu ma'i 'chad nyan ji ltar dar tshul/mkhas pa mang du byon/ rab byung bcu drug pa'i shing pho sprel (spyi lo1944)lor sku gshegs/rdo sbis dge bshes shes rab rgya mtsho ni/ rab byung bco lnga pa'i shing sprel (spyi 'o 984)lor mdo smad rdo sbis hor gro ba zhes pa'i sder sku 'khrungs— sgo mang lha rams pa nor bu rin po che dang / a khu gung thang blo gros tshang / kun mkhyen sku phreng bzhi pa skal bzang thub bstan dbang phyug 'bras sgo mkhas dbang 'bul sdud mchog grub dkar po blo bzang ye shes bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan sogs bla ma sum cu lhag tsam la bsten nas mdo sngags gzhung lugs rab 'byams la gsan bsam mthar phyin pa mdzad pas/ 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum dang mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyis thugs rgyud yongs su phyug pa'i mkhas pa'i yang rtser son par gyur/dgung grangs so gsum bzhes dus dmigs bsal gyi lha rams pa'i mtshan btags bzhes/ nor bu gling gi rtsod rgyugs skabs su ang dang po thob/ rgyal dbang sku phreng bcu gsum pa'i bka' ltar rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas pa ang dang po 'bras spungs sgo mang klu 'bum dge bshes shes rab rgya mtsho zhes mtshan snyan gser gyi me tog gis phyogs bcu'i bu mo'i snyan shal kun nas mdzes par byas/ sge'u steng blo bzang dpal ldan gyi thugs sras 'jigs med dam chos rgya mtshos bden pa bzhi las brtsams pa'i rtsod yig legs par bshad pa 'jigs med 175

dbu ma'i spyi don zab don gsal byed 'phrul gyi me long /rigs pa'i gad rgyangs zhes bya ba brtsams pa la/ de'i lan du (rtsod yig rigs pa'i gad rgyangs la rnam par dpyad pa bskal pa'i me dpung〉zhes bya ba ljags rtsom mdzad/ zab mo dbu ma'i skor la mkhas dbang dge 'dun chos 'phel gyi zhal khrid ltar zla ba bzang pos zhang thang sag pa dang / gtsang gi stag lo shes rab rin chen/ khams kyi go rams pa bsod nams seng ge sogs kyi dgag bya khyab che ba ste dpal ldan dbu ma thal 'gyur ba'i tha snyad tshad grub mi bzhed par 'dod pa'i lugs bskyar nas (dbu ma'i zab gnad snying por dril ba'i legs bshad klu sgrub dgongs rgyan〉zhes bya ba mdzad par/ rgyal dbang bcu bzhi pa'i yongs 'dzin skyabs rje khri byang rin po che dang yongs 'dzin glang tshang gnyis kyis de la dgag sgrub gyis shig ces nan gyis bskul pa'i ngor sa 'og gi gter mdzod brgya phrag cig car du bton pa ltar zab mo dbu ma'i dka' gnad mang po ches cher gsal bar mdzad pa'i legs bshad zla med pa(klu sgrub dgongs rgyan la che long du brtags pa mi 'jigs seṅge'i nga ro〉zhes bya ba bka' rtsom mdzad pa dang / yongs 'dzin khri byang rin po cher phul ba'i chab shog las/ dge chos rang yod na de ma thag spyi bos nod par kho bos nyams myong tshad ma brgya phrag gis grub mod/ de'i skal ba ma shar/ snying rje/ bdud 'joms zla bzang sogs mun nag shes mdog rdo 'jong gi rigs 'di tshad kyis mi 'jol 176

bod gangs can gyi ljongs su dbu ma'i 'chad nyan ji ltar dar tshul/te—/ da dung sprel smyon lag ring sdod mi tshugs na khungs dang bcas pas thal ba'i rdul du gtong ba la tshegs ci yang med pas thugs bde bar mdzod cig ces gsungs pa dang / gzhan yang brag yer ba gdong kong sprul sku che bas 'phags pa klu sgrub dang / rje tsong kha pa chen por sgro skur kham po che byas par/ de'i lan du(smra ba ngan pa rnam par 'thag pa mi shigs rdo rje'i thog mda'〉zhes pa'i dgag yig dang / ser byes mkhan po ngag dbang phun tshogs dang / sog po dge bshes mgon dkar skyabs kyis brgal lan brtsams pa la/ (log par smra ba tshar gcod pa'i ral gri rno ngar 'bum ldan〉zhes pa'i dgag yig dang / sgo me'i a lags yar 'phel la(dogs pa slong ba'i gtam la lan gyi rnam par bzhag pa dogs don rab tu gsal ba'i me long〉zhes pa'i dgag yig dang / gzhan yang / (chos kyi blo gros la gdams pa zab don rab gsal〉(dbu ma'i lta mgur〉(dbu ma'i lta ba'i skor〉(mtha' bral dbu ma chen po'i gtam yang dab / lta ba'i 'od 'byin〉(ṭīka chen dgongs pa rab gsal las gsungs pa'i rtsa ba'i sa bcad zur du bkol ba〉zhes bya ba sogs ljags rtsom mdzad/ khong gi slob ma mkhas pa lha rams pa skal bzang rgya mtsho dang dge bshes gzhung pa tshul khrims rgya mtsho sogs mang du byon/ bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa'i gsung 'bum dang bka' 'gyur gsar bzhengs kyi zhu chen mdzad pa sogs 177

dbu ma'i spyi don zab don gsal byed 'phrul gyi me long /bstan 'gro'i don rgya cher bsgrubs/ spyir rje btsun dam pa'i gsung rtsom la po ti bcu lhag tsam bzhugs kyang / bstan pa'i god chag gi dbang gis phal cher 'byung bzhi'i lto bar 'thims te da lta dpar du btab pa'i pod gsum las mi snang ngo / /rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa sprel (spyi lo1968)lor zhi bar gshegs/dge 'dun chos 'phel ni/ rab byung bco lnga pa'i chu yos (spyi lo1903)lor mdo smad re gong zho 'phong yul du sku bltams/ snga phyir lde tsha dgon dang / bla brang bkra shis 'khyil/ 'bras spungs sgo mang grwa tshang rnams su phebs te zhwa dmar parnyi ta dang / rdo sbis dge bshes chen mo sogs dge bshes du ma bsten nas gzhung bka' pod lnga la zhib tu sbyangs pas rigs pa smra ba'i phul du phyin du gyur/ dam pa 'di pa'i brtsams chos mi nyung ba zhig bzhugs pa las/ grags che ba ni (dbu ma'i zab gnad snying por dril ba'i legs bshad klu sgrub dgongs rgyan〉(deb thar dkar po〉(rgyal khams rig pas bskor ba'i gtam rgyud gser gyi thang ma〉rnams yin zhing / de dag las klu sgrub dgongs rgyan ni khong gi gsung rtsom yin min la dpyod ldan rnams bzhed tshul mi mtshungs te/ dge chos kyi zhal slob gtso bo raka ra sprul skus bris pa'i rnam thar du/ klu sgrub dgongs rgyan dran dbang dge 'dun chos 'phel gyi phyag rtsom min par zla bzang gis de 'dra'i log bshad byas par dge 178

bod sangs can gyi ljongs su dbu ma'i 'chad nyan ji ltar dar tshul chos thugs ma dgyes pa ra bka' bkyon mdzad pa dang / dge chos gshegs rjes su gzod kun gyi spyan lam du bkrams par gsungs shing /dge chos kyi dngos slob hor khang bsod nams dpal 'bar mchog gis 〈klu sgrub dgongs rgyan〉ni dam pa de'i gsung rtsom ngo ma yin min thad dge lugs dang rnying ma bar lta tshul mi mthun pa yod pa ni kha cig gis dge 'dun chos 'phel gyi gsung min par zla ba bzang po'i zin bris su kha snon btab pa mi nyung ba zhig mnyam bsres byas yod skad/kha cig gis dge chos kyi gsung rtsom ngo ma yin par ngos 'dzin pa gnyis yod kyang nga tshos da lam gsung rtsom gyi gras su bcug yod pas nga rang gi lta tshul byas na mkhas dbang nyid kyi bzhed tshig gtsang ma zhig yin min ma shes kyang gzhan 'dod la blo sgo phye ba'i dogs 'dri mdzad pa zhig ni yin pa gor ma chag pas kun gyis dpyad gzhir mdzad dgos—/ zhes gsungs te/ gzhung 'dir lta ba'i phyogs nas bod snga rabs pa'i mkhas dbang go shāka stag gsum gyi gsung sgros bskyangs te/sangs rgyas kyi sar kun rdzob kyi chos gzhi ma grub pa dang / tha snyad tshad grub mi 'dod pa/ tshad ma la don dam dpyod kyi tshad mas khyab pa/kun rdzob kyi rnam bzhag rang lugs la khas len pa rang rgyud pa dang /gzhan ngor khas len par dbu ma thal 'gyur pa yin pas/ rang lugs la dam bca' dang khas len med pa/ 'jig rten dang thun mong khas 179

dbu ma'i spyi don zab don gsal byed 'phrul gyi me long /len pa bya ba'i chos ci yang med pa de nyid chos can mthun snang ba med pa'i don dang / dgag bya la don dam gyi khyad par sbyor ba rang rgyud pa'i lugs dang de ltar mi sbyor ba thal 'gyur ba'i lugs yin pa/ yod min med min gyi lta ba de nyid gnas lugs mthar thug yin pa sogs rnam bzhag mang du mdzad de/ de nyid 'phags pa klu sgrub yab sras dang dpal ldan zla ba grags pa sogs kyis bzhed pa'i dbu ma thal 'gyur ba'i lugs yin tshul lung rigs gnyis las rigs pa rtsal du bton nas bsgrubs 'dug pa dpyod ldan sus kyang bsnyon mi nus shing /mkhas pa kha cig gis brtsams chos 'di ko dge chos kyi gsung rtsom ma yin par zla ba bzang pos kha g.yar bar 'dod pa la rgyu mtshan nges can zhig yod par snang ste/ gzhung gi klad du dge chos kyi mtshan nas dngos su smras te mchod brjod mdzad 'dug pa dang / mjug tu/ ma hā parnyi dge 'dun chos 'phel gyi zhal snga nas dbu ma'i zhal khrid bka' drin thob skabs su zin bris thar thor du yod pa kun rjes su spyan bstar zhus par/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi sku brnyan dang smon tshig dang bcas gnang nas zin bris kun phyogs gcig tu bsdom dgos zhes rje rang nyid kyi 'da' kha'i zhal chems snying la bcang mur zhes gsungs pas—/ gzhung 'di'i rtsom pa po nyag rong zla bzang yin pa las dge chos rang gi phyag rtsom dngos min pa shin tu gsal zhing / klu sgrub 180

bod gangs can gyi ljongs su dbu ma'i 'chad nyan ji ltar dar tshul/dgongs rgyan las dge lugs par zur za'i tshig mi nyung ba zhig byung 'dug par ma zad/ rje gung thang bstan pa 'i sgron me dang / paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan/ lcang skya rol pa'i rdo rje sogs kyi dgongs bzhed dri ma med pa rnams la skur zhus khungs med rdzun bzo 'ba' zhig byas te rang gi zhe 'dod dang dgongs pa gcig tu sgrub khul byas 'dug kyang /gus pas bris pa'i dbu ma'i spyi don las dam pa 'di dag gi lta dgongs mthar thug pa ji ltar gnas pa dang zla bzang rang nyid gzu bor mi gnas shing g.yo sgyu khram gsum la dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur gsal bor sun phyung zin pa sa der blta bar bya zhing / rgyal rabs deb thar dkar po las/ rang sde'i rigs la zhen pa dkar po'i mdangs/ /rang byung snying gi dbus na gnas pa 'dis/ /rang yul kha ba can gyi rje 'bangs la/ /rang gis nus pa'i sri zhu cung zad sgrub/ /ces dang / rgya gar gnas chen khag la bgrod pa'i lam yig las/ lar bdag rang yang thos tshad yid ches pa'i blun ngo col chung zhig ma yin gyi/ rang bzhin gyis dbang ngo rno zhing mi tshe thos pa la skyel ba'i sprang po dpyod ldan zhig lags pas/ gang smras 'di kun la/ nor ba dang khungs med pa dang mgo skor ba'i dogs pa sum char yang ma dgos pa lags/ zhes dran dbang gang nyid rang yul kha pa can gyi rje 'bangs rnams la dang zhen gcig tu dkar zhing / rig gnas lo rgyus sogs la brtag cing 181

dbu ma'i spyi don zab don gsal byed 'phrul gyi me long /dpyad pa'i tshe na'ang khungs lung rigs pa zung du 'brel te dpyod blo zhugs pa las rang dgar rang snang gang dran du mi smra ba'i gzur gnas rigs pa'i rjes 'brang gi dpyod ldan zhig dngos su zhal bzhes gnang 'dug pas/ zab mo dbu ma'i gzhung la 'chad nyan byed dus dge ldan pa'i tshad ldan mkhas grub stag seng gnam du 'phyo ba lta bu rnams kyi bstan bcos chen po rnams la lan gcig tsam yang ma gzigs par skur 'debs kyi rdzun chen po 'di 'dra gtan nas lab mi srid par 'dod de/ rdo sbis dge bshes chen mos dge chos kyi rang lugs yin pa'i dbang du byas nas lung rigs brgya phrag bkod de dbu nas mjug bar sun 'byin mdzad 'dug pa'ang gzhung 'di'i mdzad byang du dge chos kyi zhal snga nas dbu ma'i zhal khrid bstsal bar khas blangs pa tsam la brten khungs byas par snyam ste da dung dpyad par bya'o/ /dran dbang /rsha /sa nee/ba byung bcu drug pa'i lcags mo yos (spyi lo1951)lor lha sar sku 'jigs med dam chos rgya mtsho ni/ rab byung bco lnga pa'i sa khyi (spyi lo1898)lor mdo smad reb gong du a bur du grags pa'i 'brog sde kham mdangs zhes pa'i yul du sku bltams/ skyabs mgon shar blo bzang skal ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dang zhwa dmar parnyi ta gnyis kyis rje 'jigs med bsam gtan gyi sprul skur ngos 'dzin gnang / zhwa dmar 182

bod gangs can gyi ljongs su dbu ma'i 'chad nyan ji ltar dar tshul/parnyi ta dge 'dun rgya mtsho las rab tu byung zhing / mtshan la 'jigs med dam chos rgya mtsho zhes su gsol/ skyabs rje 'di pa dang rje lcang lung khri rgan 'jam dbyangs thub bstan rgya mtsho/ sge'u steng blo bzang dpal ldan sogs mkhas dbang du ma las zab rgyas kyi chos rgyun mtha' yas pa gsan bzhes mdzad pas mkhas pa'i mkhas pa chen por gyur/lta ba'i legs bshad chen po (drang ba dang nges pa'i don rnam par phye ba gsal bar byed pa'i legs bshad snying po'i don mtha' dag rnam par 'byed pa'i bstan bcos legs bshad snying po'i 'jug ngogs〉dang —/ (drang ba dang nges pa'i don rnam par 'byed pa'i legs bshad snying po'i bsdus don drang nges lta ba'i mig 'byed〉 (zab mo lam gyi rim pa tshigs bcad du bsdebs pa 〉 (lta khrid nges don snying po〉 (dbu ma tshig rab tu gsal ba'i thal bzlog dang chos can mthun snang ba'i thad kyi sa gcod〉 (rang gzhan gyi grub nga 'i mtha' ma lus pa'i gnad don tshigs bcad du bsdebs pa grub mtha' rgya mtsho'i 'jug ngogs〉 (dbu ma rtsa ba shes rab kyi sdom〉'phro can du lus pa sogs thugs rtsom gnang nas dbu ma'i 'chad nyan shin tu dmar bar mdzad/ rab byung bcu drug pa'i me khyi (spyi lo/946)lor zhi ba'i dbyings su gshegs/bod sprul mdo sngags bstan pa'i nyi ma ni/ rab byung bco lnga pa'i sa khyi (spyi lo1898)lor bod ljongs lho kha sa khul rgya tshwa rdzong khongs sgo gzhi 183

dbu ma'i spyi don zab don gsal gyed 'phrul gyi me long /ka zhes par sku bltams/ sku na gzhon dus yab sngags 'chang rnal 'byor pa rig 'dzin 'jigs med mkha' spyod rdo rje'i mdun du yi ge 'bri klog dang cho ga chos spyod sogs mang du gsan/ dgung grangs bco brgyad yas mas su dbus nas rim gyis mdo khams ru dam rdzogs chen shrī seng chos grwa chen mor phebs/ mkhan chen thub bstan snyan grags dang —/ rto ru mkhan po dge rnam/ rdzogs sprul lnga pa thub bstan chos kyi rdo rje/ mkhan chen kun bzang dpal ldan/ g.yu khog bya bral rin po che sogs mkhan chen du ma'i zhabs la gtugs te snga 'gyur kun mkhyen rong klong gnyis dang mkhas dbang 'ju mi pham pa'i gzhung lugs rnams la thugs gnyer dpe med mdzad pas/ rnying ma'i ring lugs 'dzin pa'i mkhas pa chen por gyur/ (lta grub shan 'byed gnad kyi sgron me〉dang de'i rang 'grel(lta grub shan 'byed gnad kyi sgron me'i tshig don rnam bshad 'jam dbyangs dgongs rgyan〉(dbu ma bzhi brgya pa'i tshig don rnam par bshad pa klu dbang dgongs rgyan〉sogs brtsams—/ dam pa 'dis bstan pa'i btsas su bzhag pa'i gsung chos la pod chen gsum bzhugs so/ /rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa phag(spyi lo1959)lor zhi bar gshegs pa'i tshul bstan to/ /dge bshes ye shes rgya mtsho ni/ rab byung bco lnga pa'i me sbrul(spyi lo1917)lor mdo smad byang rgyud kyi ba yan gcan tsha'i ri nang zer ba'i 184

bod gangs can gyiljongs su dbu ma'i 'chad nyan ji ltar dar tshul grong sder sku bltams/ spyi lo19 34lor rje zhwa dmar sku phreng bzhi pa parnyi ta chen po dge 'dun bstan 'dzin gyis phyag btab pa'i mdo smad lde tsha bkra shis choji su sdings dgon du phyag phebs nas bsdus grwa blo rtags sogs tshad ma'i gzhung la thugs gnyer gnang ba dang / spyi lo1940lor mdo smad bla brang bkra shis 'khyil ba'i rmad byung thos bsam gling gi chos grwar zhugs/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen du ma'i zhabs la gtugs te sgra snyan sman rtsis sogs thun mong ba'i rig gnas dang thun min gzhung bka' pod lnga la thos bsam rgya chen mdzad de rdo rams pa'i dge bshes kyi mtshan btags bzhes/ spyir dam pa khong gi gsung rtsom la/ mngon rtogs rgyan gyi 'grel pa/ gtan tshigs rigs pa'i snang ba/ phar phyin rgya mtsho'i 'jug ngogs/ tshad ma rnam 'grel le'u gnyis pa'i 'grel pa rigs pa'i me long / mngon pa mdzod kyi mchan 'grel nyi ma'i 'od zer/'dul ba'i spyi rnam/ gso rig rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi 'grel pa/ ston pa shākya thub pa'i rnam thar pad ma dkar po'i phreng ba/ khyad par 'phags bstod kyi 'grel pa/ lha las phul byung gi 'grel pa sogs khyen bsdoms pas po ti chen po bzhi tsam bzhugs shing / dbu ma'i skor la(dbu ma 'jug pa'i 'grel pa〉ljags rtsom mdzad do/ /rab byung bcu bdun pa'i shing phag (spyi lo1995)lor re zhig gzugs sku'i bkod pa chos dbyings su bsdus pa'i tshul bstan to/ /185

dbu ma'i spyi don zab don gsal byed 'phrul gyi me long /rje shar gdong blo bzang bshad sgrub rgya mtsho ni/ bod rab byung bco lnga pa'i chu khyi (spyi lo1992)lor mdo smad dpa' lung rdzong khongs bya khyung dgon pa'i nye 'dabs gung ye dgon tshar zhes par sku bltams/sems dpa' kha gya 'jam dbyangs dpal ldan gyis shar gdong sku phreng bzhi pa'i yang srid du ngos 'dzin gnang / dgung grangs bdun bzhes pa'i tshe rje tsong kha pa chen mo'i yongs 'dzin chos rje don grub rin chen gyis phyag btab pa'i bya khyung dgon du gdan drangs te rje be si rin po ches blo bzang bshad sgrub rgya mtsho zhes gsol/ a lags yāng kyā blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dang / rje 'jigs med dam chos rgya mtsho/mkhas dbang tshe tan zhabs drung / bla brang bla kho rin po che/ rdo sbis dge bshes shes rab rgya mtsho sogs mkhas grub du ma'i zhabs la gtugs te mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas par sbyangs pa dpyis phyin pa mdzad pas mkhas pa chen por gyur/ rje'i lam rim chen mo'i shing par la zhus dag gang legs mdzad pas rje 'jigs med dam chos rgya mtshos mkhyen rab kyi dbang phyug shar gdong sprul pa'i sku zhes bstod tshig gi me tog phreng ba 'thor bar mdzad pa dang / phyis su rdo sbis dge bshes chen mos kyang bya khyung gi sa dkar nang gser ser po rdog rdog cig 'dug ces ngo thog don la gnas pa'i bsngags brjod nar mar gnang —/ dam pa khong nyid bod kyi slob grwa che 'bring chung gsum dang 186

bod gangs can gyi ljongs su dbu ma'i 'chad nyan ji ltar dar tshul/krung go'i bod brgyud nang bstan slob gling / dgon sde khag tu phebs te skal ldan gdul bya mtha' yas par rje'i lam rim chen mo sogs zab rgyas kyi chos 'khor rgya cher bskor te bod kyi rig gnas gong du spel bar bsub tu med pa'i phyag rjes rlabs po che 'jog gnang mdzad/spyir mkhas grub 'di pa'i gsung rtsom la zhal slob rnams kyis reg zig tu btab pa bcas bsdoms pas po ti drug tsam bzhugs pa da lta blo ldan kun gyi mjal yul du gyur pa ltar lags shing / zab mo dbu ma'i lta ba las 'phros pa'i legs par bshad pa'i bstan bcos ni rje 'di'i zhal slob mkhas dbang blo bzang snyan grags kyis sgra thag las yi ge'i ris su bstar ba'i lam rim chen mo'i bshad khrid blo bzang dgongs rgyan zhes pa las(lhag mthong chen mo'i bshad khrid〉dang (rten 'brel bstod pa'i 'grel bshad〉gnyis bzhugs so/ /dam pa gang nyid rab byung bcu bdun pa'i lcags sbrul(spyi 7001)lor bya khyung dgon du sku zhi bar gshegs so/ /rje lam rim pa ni/ rab byung bco lnga pa'i chu byi(spyi lo1992)lor yun nan bod rigs rang skyong khul rgyal thang rdzong gi mnga' khongs yul nags steng zhes par sku 'khrungs/ dgung grangs bcu'i steng rgyal thang dgon chen sum rtsen gling du spang lung gong ma'i drung du rab tu byung zhing mtshan la ngag dbang phun tshogs zhes su gsol to/ /mkhas grub a 187

dbu ma'i spyi don zab don gsal byed 'phrul gyi me long /bu rdo rje'i mdun nas rje'i lam rim chen mo dang paṇa chen blo bzang ye shes kyi lam rim dmar khrid myur lam sogs kyi khrid lung zhus/ dgung lo nyer gnyis bzhes pa'i tshe lha sar phyag phebs te dpal ldan 'bras spungs dgon blo gsal gling gi chos grwar zhugs te dge ba'i bshes gnyen du ma'i zhabs pad spyi bor bsten nas gzhung bka' pod lnga la gsan bsam rtag 'grus su mdzad/ bod sa phag(spyi lo1949)lor klong brdol ri khrod du bzhugs skabs zhal slob bdun bcas nyes med btson du bcug rig gsar gyi skabs su phal pa'i blo yul las 'gongs pa'i snying stobs phul du phyin pa'i rgyal sras kyi spyod pa rlabs po che lhur bzhes te rten gsum srung skyob mdzad pas rgyus yod kun gyi dad gus kyi yul dam par gyur/ bstan pa'i me ro slar bslangs rjes su rgyal ba'i gsung rab la gzigs rtog dang 'brel te rje'i lam rim che chung sogs zab rgyas chos kyi bdud rtsi'i char chen phab nas rjes 'jug gdul bya mtha' yas pa smin grol gyi lam bzang la bkod pa dang /chos gang gsung thams cad kha bshad skam po tsam du ma song bar 'dul ba dang lam rim sogs las ji skad gsungs pa de ltar nyams len gyi mthil du mdzad pas rje lam rim pa zhes grags snyan gyi lha'i rnga bo che gangs can 'dzin ma'i khyon kun tu ldir/ snga phyir lam rim zin bris mkhas pa'i yid 'phrog dang / lam sgron gyi 'grel pa yid kyi stegs bu/188

bod gangs can gyi ljongs su dbu ma'i 'chad nyan ji ltar dar tshul/'dul ba rgya mtsho'i mchan 'grel/ spyod 'jug chen mo'i 'grel pa tshig nyung don gsal sman gyi sdong bu/ tshad ma'i brjed byang gzur gnas dgyes pa'i mchod sprin sogs ljags rtsom mdzad pa ste/ deng sang par du bskrun pa pod bzhi tsam mchis shing / de dag las dbu ma'i lta ba'i skor gyi phyag rtsom(lta mgur gdung sel sman gyi myu gu'i rnam 'grel legs bshad sman gyi snye ma〉(phyag chen khrid yig bsdus pa yid kyi mun sel〉(lta ba bka' rtags kyi phyag rgya bzhi'i gnad don gsal ba'i sgron me〉(rten 'brel bstod pa'i 'grel pa mthar 'dzin snying gi mun sel〉sogs bzhugs pa dang / gzhan da dung dpe skrun khang gis dngos su dpar du 'khod med pa'i(dbu ma rtsa ba shes rab kyi 'grel pa〉(rtsod pa bzlog pa'i 'grel pa〉sogs dbu ma rigs tshogs kyi 'grel bshad kyang bzhugs pas/ rje 'di pa'i zhal slob rnams kyis dam pa khong gi legs par bshad pa'i bstan bcos gzhan dag gi dpe rgyun mi nyams pa'i phyir du klog 'phrul par sgrig bgyis te rgya cher spel bar shin tu rigs so/ /rje bdag nyid chen po gang nyid rab byung bcu bdun pa'i me glang (spyi lo1997lo'i zla5pa 'i tshe48nyin)lo'i bod zla bzhi pa'i tshes nyer gcig nyin dgongs pa chos dbyings su thim/ /189

dbu ma'i spyi don zab don gsal byed 'phrul gyi me long /(3)mjug bsdu ba/bod gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir gzhung lugs rab 'byams smra ba'i mkhas pa'i khyu mchog bstan 'gro'i dpung gnyen du gyur pa stag seng mkha' la 'phyo ba lta bu mtha' yas pa byon te bde bar gshegs pa'i chos tshul bla ma med pa phyogs dang ris su ma chad par 'dzin skyong spel gsum bgyis pa'i ngo mtshar ba'i lo rgyus ni gzhung chen por blo kha cung zad phyogs pa'i shes ldan yan chad la yongs su grags pa'i gtam du zad la/ mdo dbus kyi chos sde che phra rnams su gzhung bka' pod lnga la rtsal 'don mdzad pa'i phyag srol yod cing / de'ang mkhas pa so so'i rnam daphyod kyi rtsal dang rigs pa'i mdung rtse'i gtad phyogs/ tshul bzhin rigs pas dpyad pa/ gzhung don gyi gting ma dpogs par gya tshom du smras pa/ grub mtha'i gtsang zhen/ bla ma gong ma'i khrid rgyun/gzhung gang la ched dmigs kyis sbyangs pa'i 'bras rtags sogs kyi khyad par las 'chad nyan gtso bor mdzad pa'i gzhung dang / rang lugs kyi 'dod tshul/ lta ba dag mi dag legs par bshad pa'i yig 'jog gi skyes bzang 'dzad med du bstsal ba'i tshad sogs kyang za 'og gi ri mo ltar ches mi 'dra bar snang ngo / /'on kyang / gzhung rgyas bsdus sna tshogs su bzhugs pa de dag thams cad kyang thub pa'i dgongs pa mdzes byed kyi rgyan du gyur ba'i don mthun gyi gsung ngag tshad ma yin mi/9 pya ma ltos par dngos brgyud gang rung gi sgo nas bstan pa'i zhabs

bod gangs can gyi ljongs su dbu ma'i 'chad nyan ji ltar dar tshul/'degs dang skye bo'i blo gros 'phel ba'i thabs tshul du gyur pa sha stag yin te/ gzhan du na phyi rol ba'i gzhung lugs la lta klog byed pa'ang snying po til tsam yang med pa'i phyir ro/ /rten 'brel bstod pa las/ltos med nam mkha'i me tog bzhin/ /des na ma brten yod ma yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bzang ngan dang / spang blang / dge sdig skye 'gag sogs chos thams cad phan tshun stos pa can du grub pa yin pa'i phyir—/ lam dang lam ma yin pa/ sun byin yang dag dang ltar snang /rigs pa dang mi rigs pa/ lta spyod dag min/ mkhan blun gyi khyad par sogs kyang tshad mas mi bslu bar nges pa bde blag tu rnyed thub pa yin no—/ /de lta na'ang zhen lta'i u tshugs gyong bos log rtog gi 'dam rdzab tu bsam bzhin bying du bcug nas phyis mi 'dod bzhin du khrus tshegs kyi khol bor 'gyur ba las dang po nyid nas lta spyod gtsang ma'i rjes su 'brangs nas go 'phang mchog gi rgyal khams la dbang bsgyur bar brtson pa ni chos spyan nam mkha' ltar yangs pa'i gzur gnas dam pa rnams kyi rnam thar zla med pa nyid du shes par bya'o/ /grwa sa khag tu gzhung chen po rnams la 'chad nyan gnang dus chu 'go gangs la thug pa ltar gzhung de dang de'i khungs gtugs sa dang bla ma brgyud pa'i rnam thar rags bsdus re ngo sbyor byed srol yod par ma zad/ brjod bya gzhung bka' pod lnga las 'phros pa'i gzhung gang dang gang rtsom pa'i tshe 191

dbu ma'i spyi don zab don gsal byed 'phrul gyi me long /na'ang de'i byung 'phel gyi lo rgyus mdor bsdus tsam sngon 'gro'i tshul du bkod med pa mi srid pa lta bur snang la/ de ltar 'god pa'i rgyu mtshan yang gzhung khungs btsun pa dang grub mtha' so so'i lta ba'i bzhed tshul ma 'dzings par 'gangs 'chun pa'i go ba bogs chod du ster ba/skabs su bab pa'i gzhung gi brjod bya thun mong ma yin par ston pa/bla ma brgyud pa'i byin rlabs kyi tshan kha mi yal ba sogs dgos pa du mar dmigs pa yin no/ /de'i phyir gzhung gang la thos bsam gyis 'jug na'ang thog mar so so'i lugs kyi 'byung khungs kyi lo rgyus ma mtha' yang phyogs mthong tsam shes par bya rgyu ni shin tu gnad che bar mthong bas/ dbu ma'i gzhung la slob gnyer byed pa la rnams la mtshon na 'phags bod kyi yul du thun mong ma yin pa'i lugs khyad du 'phags pa 'di nyid ji ltar byung ba'i lo rgyus gsal bor nges dgos pa smos ma dgos shing / bod kyi mkhas pas mdzad pa'i 'brel yod dbu ma'i skor gyi gzhung rgyas bsdus ci rigs su zab mo dbu ma'i byung 'phel gyi lo rgyus sa bcad sa stong ba'i tshul du tho tsam bkod pa las logs su zhib mo'i lugs su bris pa'i rang rkya 'pher ba'i bstan bcos shig mjal yul du ma gyur pas/ cung zad rgyas par shes 'dod rnams kyi 'dod blo ji bzhin bskang thabs bral zhing / bstan pa yar 'phel gyi dus bzang mngon du gyur pa'i dbang gis zab mo'i don la thos bsam don gnyer 192

bod gangs can gyi ljongs su dbu ma'i 'chad nyan ji ltar dar tshul/byed pa'i skye bo mang po pad ma'i tshal la bung ba'i khyu tshogs ngang gis 'khor ba ltar nyin mtshan 'gran bzhin 'phel ba'i skabs nyid na/zab mo dbu ma'i byung ba brjod pa 'di lta bu zhig bri ba la dge ba rgya chen po yod par snyam ste/ dpyad gzhi'i khungs yig sna tshogs thod gtugs zhib bsdur bgyis te 'o ma'i rgya mtsho las mar gyi dkyil 'khor bton pa ltar kun gyi dga' ston du spel ba lags so/ /de ltar spros pa rnam par bskyangs pa'i tshul yang dbu ma'i 'chad nyan gyi thad la phyag rjes phul du phyin pa'i snga phyi'i mkhas dbang mtshan gyi yi ge'i dbyangs snyan dgung du mched pa dag gtsor byas pa ste/ dus phyis su byon pa'i dbu ma'i slob dpon rnams kyi mdzad pa'ang rtsad gcod mdzad nas zhib tu 'god par shin tu nas kyang rigs na'ang / g.yol thabs bral ba'i don chung gi g.yeng ba'i rgya ru tshud de bri ba'i skal ba dben par gyur pas/ 'di'i phyogs la blo gros kyi 'jug pa yangs pa'i daphyod ldan rnams kyis hor khongs su mi lus pa'i phyir du rjes sor ci nas kyang kha bskang bar bya'o/ /zhes gzi bo'i blos lan brgyar bskul lo/ /'dir bris dge bas rang gzhan thams cad kyis rgyal ba'i gsung gi gces mdzod zab mo stong pa nyid kyi don ji lta ba bzhin du khong du chud nas ṭwāṃ~X sdu/kā /rgyal/ ba'i go 'phang myur ba nyid du thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig /193
na zayong sa so

dbu ma'i spyi don zab don gsal byed 'phrul gyi me long /mchod brjod dang rtsom par dam bca' ba/༄7/ /dpal mgon bla ma dam pa dang rje btsun mkhyen pa'i gter ngo bo dbyer med pa la sgo gsum gus pa chen pos phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /skabs gsum dbang po gser gyi mngal dang mi yi seng ge gtsug na zla ba sogs/ /srid na mthu stobs 'dod rgur dbang sgyur dregs pas cher rlom mngon par 'gying rnams kyis/ /zhabs kyi pad mo gtsug gis rtag mchod zab rgyas chos kyi bdud rtsi'i char phab pas/ /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal tsha gdung rab sel zla bral ston pa lha yi lha la 'dud/ /gser 'od dra bas yongs bskor mdzes pa'i sku/ /thub dbang gsung rab rgya mtsho'i snying po'i bcud/ /sher mdo'i sbas don mngon rtogs gsal mdzad pa/ /rgyal tshab byams pa mgon por gus phyag 'tshal/ /rab 'byams zhing gi rgyal ba'i ye shes kun/ /gcig tu rnam rol rje btsun mkhyen pa'i gter/ /197

dbu ma'i spyi don zab don gsal byed 'phrul gyi me long /zab brling ngag rig mdzod 'dzin dbyangs ldan ma/ /blo spobs mchog stsol shes rab yab yum lha/ /gang zhig mkhyen pa'i gzi 'od 'bum 'khrigs pas/ /ma rig mun pa'i 'khrul 'khor 'jig byed pa/ /lta ba'i yang rtse mtha' bral dbu ma'i lam/ /gsal mdzad 'phags pa yab sras nyi zlar 'dud/ /rtsa she'i tshig don rgya cher dgrol ba la/ /'phags yul 'grel chen brgyad ces kun tu grags/ /thal 'gyur sgo nas dgongs don bkral srol phye/ /slob dpon sangs rgyas bskyangs la snying nas 'dud/ /klu sgrub dgongs pa 'grel la zla med cing / /thal 'gyur 'thad cing rang rgyud mi 'thad pa'i/dka' gnad mdud rgya legs par bkrol mdzad mkhan/ /dpal ldan zla ba'i zhabs rdul sus mi mchod/ /sems tsam shing rta'i srol 'byed thogs med zhabs/rang rgyud srol phye slob dpon legs ldan 'byed/ /zab rgyas gdams pa'i mdzod 'dzin zhi ba lha/ /'dzam gling mdzes rgyan rnams la phyag bgyi'o/ /gzhung bzang chu bo 'bum gyi legs bshad gter/ /198

dbu ma'i spyi don zab don gsal byed 'phrul gyi me long /skye rgu'i bsod nams zhing du 'dren mkhas pa'i/ /lnga brgya'i gtsug nor dpal ldan mar me mdzad/ /spyan ras gzigs dngos 'brom ston chos kyi rje/ /jo bo yab sras brgyud par bcas la 'dud/ /mdo sngags smra ba'i gtsug rgyan tsong kha pa/ /dri med rigs pa'i snang byed rgyal tshab rje/ /phas rgol 'joms pa'i khyu mchog dge legs dpal/ /rgyal ba yab sras srid mtha'i bar du mchod/ /rgyal bstan kha ba'i rdul brtsegs mthon po'i spor/ /lung rigs ngar skad mi bzad phyogs su bsgrags/ /log smra'i ri dwags tshogs rnams spa bkong ba'i/ /'jam mgon zhal skyin mkhas grub yongs la 'dud/ /lta ba nā gā rdzu na'i dgongs pa'i bcud/ /sgom pa zhi lhag zung du 'brel ba'i lam /spyod pa bka' gdams gong ma'i rnam thar gtsang / /dge ldan ring lugs zla med rgyas gyur cig /'chad pas legs bshad gter sgo 'bum phrag brdol/ /rtsom pas mdo rgyud pad tshal phyogs bcur rgyas/ /rtsod pas rgol ngan glang smyon tshar gcod pa'i/ /199

dbu ma'i spyi don zab don gsal byed 'phrul gyi me long /skyabs gsum kun 'dus rtsa brgyud bla mar 'dud/ /gzhung brgya klog pa'i ngal bar ma bsten par/ /tshegs chung 'bad pas nges don 'tshol 'dod pas/ /rmongs mun drungs 'byin dbu ma'i bstan bcos kyi/ /dgongs don gsal byed me long 'dir stos shig/de la 'dir srid na ches dkon zhing dri ma med pa'i rin chen me tog snyan tshig la sogs pa'i mchod rdzas bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnams kyis nam yang mchod par 'os pa'i tshad mar gyur pa'i skyabs mgon dam pa rnams la phyag bya ba sngon du btang nas skabs bab 'chad par bya ba'i gzhung don gyi khog dbub par bya ba la/dang po/ bstan brtsos 'di rtsom pa'i dgos pa bshadapa/mkhas pa la 'jug pa'i sgo las/ bstan bcos dam par bstan pa'i phyir/ /ston pas thog mar dgos pa bstan/ /yongs su rtogs pa de mthong na/ /dpyod pa la yang cis mi 'jug /ces gsungs pa ltar/'dir thog mar gzhung don dngos la ma zhugs pa'i sngon du bstan bcos 'di rtsom pa'i dgos pa 'chad par bya rigs te/ rigs mthun gyi gzhung gzhan dang brjod bya zlos pas dge ba lhag po cher med snyam pa dang / gsung rab dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa la gzigs pa'i 200

dbu ma'i spyi don zab don gsal byed 'phrul gyi me long /bsod nams ches dman zhing / grub mtha' phyin ci log pas rgyud bslad pa'i dbang gis rab tu byed pa 'di'i brjod bya tshe 'dir don du gnyer bya ma yin snyam pa dang / brjod bya shin tu zab pas rang gis ji bzhin dpog mi nus snyam pa dang / dgos pa yod kyang nyams su blang bar dka' 'o snyam pa sogs kyi dogs pa shes ldan la ngam ngam shugs kyis skye srid cing / 'thad ldan las/ gang phyir 'jig rten don gnyer niske/ /the tshom las kyang 'jug phyir ro/ /zhes dang / be'u bum sngon po las/ don 'gyur don mi 'gyur pa dag la/ /the tshom za na'ang 'jug ldog rgyur gsungs/ /zhes pa ltar/ de yang don mi 'gyur gyi the tshom skye ba la brten nas 'gro kun gtan du ba'i bde bar 'god par byed pa'i thabs tshul bla na med pa yang dag pa'i lta ba ston pa'i bstan bcos ji snyed pa dag rnam pa thams cad du spangs te/ don chung don log brtse bral sogs lhur len pa'i nyi tshe ba'i gzhung lugs kho na snying por 'dzin par byed cing / de'i dbang gis gtan gyi 'dun ma rtsa ba nas 'phyugs te 'dir snang gi bde ba tsam gyi phyir du ma rig pa'i gdon gyis bslus nas rang gzhan gyi bsod nams nyams par byed pa'i rgyu tshogs bsgrub pa la bsam sbyor mngon du byed par 'gyur bas/ 'dir de 'dra'i nyes pa las ldog pa'i ched du gzhung gi klad du dgos pa smos pa yin pa'i phyir te/ rnam 'grel las/ bstan bcos rmongs pa bzlog byed yin/ /201

dbu ma'i spyi don zab don gsal byed 'phrul gyi me long /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i bstan bcos ni 'chos skyob kyi yon tan gnyis dang ldan pa zhig yin dgos shing / de yang brjod bya rjod byed kyi rnam pa la brten nas mthong thos dran reg gi gdul bya'i rgyud kyi rmongs pa bzlog par byed cing / thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang thob par byed pa'i thabs su 'gyur ba zhig yin dgos pa'i phyir/ 'dir yang smos ma thag pa'i yon tan de dang de dag rtsal 'don gyis tshig gi phreng ba nye bar 'god pa yin pas/ gzhung 'di ci'i phyir brtsams pa'i dgos 'brel gyi ngag bstan pa don dang ldan par mthong na rtogs ldan rnams gzhug bya'i bstan bcos la thos sogs kyi shes 'dod zhugs nas don du gnyer bar 'gyur bas/ 'og tu shes ldan rnams la skye srid pa'i dogs pa lhag med du bsal bar bya ste—/ rgyal bas gsungs pa'i sher mdo'i dngos bstan stong nyid kyi rim pa gtan la 'bebs pa la dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis rtsa ba shes rab sogs dbu ma rigs tshogs drug mdzad nas dbu ma'i shing rta'i srol legs par phye bar mdzad cing / klu sgrub yab sras kyi dgongs pa 'grel pa la'ang 'phags pa'i yul du dbu ma thal 'gyur ba dang rang rgyud pa'i lugs chen po gnyis su gyes pa ltar/ dbu ma thal rang gi bshad srol 'dzin pa'i rgya bod kyi snga phyi'i mkhas grub rnams kyis mdzad pa'i dbu ma'i bstan bcos rgyas bsdus ci rigs pa mang du bzhugs 202

dbu ma'i spyo don zab don gsal byed 'phrul gyi me long /shing / gzhung de dag thams cad kyis de kho na nyid kyi don rkang btsugs te rtsal bshad mdzad pas brjod don gnyer tshul spyi khog tsam phyogs mtshungs su snang na'ang / lung gi dgongs par song yod med dang —/ rtsa 'grel sprags ma'i go stobs/ dngos shugs kyi bstan tshod zin ma zin/ dka' gnas kyi gting rgya chod ma chod/ rigs lam gyi zhib cha thon ma thon/ brjod tshul phra mor dbang 'byor min/ kun slong gzi bor gnas mi gnas/ dbu ma'i lta ba rnyed ma rnyed sogs kyi khyad par las 'dra 'bag gi phreng bstar ba lta bu ye ma yin par 'thag mkhan gyi ri mo ltar ches mi 'dra bar snang ba'ang mang du thos pa'i rnam dpyod can rnams la shin tu gsal zhing / gsung sgros de dag 'thad ldan yin min yang lung rigs smra ba'i mkhas dbang rnams kyis dgag bzhag gi lam nas legs bshad nyes bshad kyi shan gsal bar phye bas/dbu ma'i bstan bcos de snyed cig mchis pa mtha' dag dngos brgyud gang rung gi sgo nas gzhung don gyi sgo brgya 'byed pa'i lde mig lta bur gyur pa sha stag yin pas/ brjod don gtso bo spyi 'gros tsam mtshungs pas skyon du 'gyur ba'i nges pa gzhar yang ma mchis te/ gzhan du na mdzad pa pos gzhung de dang der bag chags 'jog pa dang rtsom pa la goms pa'i slad du brtsams par zhal gyis bzhes pa'ang bgrang gis mi lang bas so/ /paṇa chen bsod nams grags pas/ rnam dpyod lang 203

dbu ma'i spyi don zab don gsal byed 'phrul gyi me long /tsho'i cha shas ring nas yol/ /legs bshad gzugs mdzes lta ba'i mig dang bral/ /nga rgyal mkhar ba'i rtse mor gnas pa yi/ /blun po'i drang srong rgan la 'dis ci bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ phyi'i zang zing gi 'byor ba mtsho ltar brdol zhing nang sems kyi tshor ba 'khyag dar gyi spubs bzhin gzir ba'i dus 'dir/ rmongs zhen a 'thas dang rang mthong gis rgyud gang ba'i ma sbyangs blo gros chung ngu rnams kyis rton bzhi go ldog tu bzung nas ya nga bag tsha med par ngan rtog gi dri chu phyogs dang phyogs mtshams su ngo sor khyer bar byed cing / gser las bong ba brin pa'i dpe ltar las 'bras dang skye ba snga phyi med par dam bca' ba'i gzhung lugs phyin ci log pa dag legs bshad kyi snying por rlom zhing tshad mar gyur pa'i bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab dang de'i dgongs pa 'grel ba'i bstan bcos rnam par dag pa rnams rdzun gyi phung por bltas te tshe 'dir don du gnyer bya ma yin no zhes srin bya'i hung sgra ltar bsgrags te chos spong gi sdig pa tshabs po che 'dzem med du gsog par byed do/ /de 'dra'i log rtog skye ba'i rgyu mtshan ni zab rgyas kyi gzhung la sgrin po'i blos rtog pa ma chug pa dang rigs lam la rgyus chung ba'i lan du 'dug pas/ rtogs brjod 'dun legs ma las/tshad ma kun las btus pa'i mchod brjod don/ /tshad ma grub par lugs 'byung lugs ldog gis/ /rnam grol don du gnyer la bcom ldan 20

dbu ma'i spyi don zab don gsal byed 'phrul gyi me long /'das/ /tshad mar bsgrubs shing de las de yi ni/ /bstan pa kho nar thar 'dod 'jug ngogs su/ /nges pa gting nas rnyed pas theg gnyis kyi—/ /lam gyi gnad kun 'dril bar rigs lam nas/ /legs par thon pas lhag par dga' ba rnyed/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ rnam 'grel le'u gnyis pa tshad ma grub pa'i don 'chad pa'i skabs su lugs 'byung gi rigs pa bzhi dang / lugs ldog gi rigs pa bzhi ste gtan tshigs brgyad kyi sgo nas thub dbang bcom ldan 'das tshad ma'i skyes bur bsgrubs 'dug pa'i tshul la rnam dpyod can yin na gzu bo'i blos zhib tu bsam par bya rigs te/ rje thams cad mkhyen pas kyang lugs 'byung ldog gi gtan tshigs la brten nas thugs rtog mdzad pas ston pa la shes nas mi phyed pa'i dad pa spyan chab bsil ba zhig 'khrungs zhes gsungs pa ltar/ mthong thos thams cad la brtag dpyad til 'bru tsam yang mi gtong bar dad pa shar rer 'jog pa'i dbang rtul dad pa 'i rjes 'brang gi ngang tshul tsam du ma song bar dbang rnon chos kyi rjes 'brang gi rnam thar la bslab par bya dgos te/ rnam 'grel las/mi shes ston par byed pa la/ /'khrul par dogs pa can rnams kyis/ /des bshad nan tan bya ba'i phyir/ /shes ldan 'ga' zhig 'tshol bar byed—/ /ces dang / lha las phul byung gi bstod par/ bdag ni sangs rgyas phyogs mi 'dzin/ /ser skya sogs la mi sdang yang/ /gang zhig 205

dbu ma'i spyi don zab don gsal gyed 'phrul gyi me long /rigs par ldan pa'i tshig /de nyid la ni ston par 'dzin/ /zhes pa ltar / ston pa bstan pa lta ba gsum yang dag yin min gyi rnam dbye ni dri ma med pa'i rigs pa la brten nas legs par phyed dgos kyi/ skyon kun zad dang yon tan kun rdzogs yin te/ bdag cag gi ston pa yin pa'i phyir/ zhes pa'am/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i gzhung lugs rnams khas mi len te/ bdag gi lta tshul dang mi mthun pa'i phyir ro/ /zer ba lta bu'i u tshugs gyong po'i tshig gis gar yang phyin par mi nus te/rnam 'grel las/ tshad mas grub par smra rnams kyi/ /don gyis bzlog pa nyid las yin/ /zhes dang / drang nges legs bshad snying po las/rigs pa dang 'gal ba'i grub mtha' khas len na smra ba bo tshad ma'i skyes bur mi rung ba'i phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /dbu tshad kyi gzhung chen mo rnams su ston pa bcom ldan 'das nyag gcig rnam grol don du gnyer ba la mi bslu ba'i tshad ma'i skyes bu yin pa'i shes byed yang dag mang du bkod 'dug cing / phyir mi ldog pa'i 'khor lo'i mdo las/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi dpang gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi dpang ni chos yin no/ /de bzhin sangs rgyas rnams ni chos kyi stobs dang ldan 206

dbu ma'i spyi don zab don gsal byed 'phrul gyi me long /pa ste/ de dag gis chos de dag ji lta ba mngon du byas pa de ltar bstan to—/ /zhes dang / mdo las/ stong pa zhi ba skye ba med pa'i tshul/ /mi shes pas ni 'gro ba 'khyams gyur pa/ /de dag thugs rje mnga' bas thabs tshul dang / /rigs pa brgya dag gis ni 'dzud par mdzad/ /ces dang /tshig gsal las/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba ji skad bstan pa thugs su chud pa'i phyir de bzhin gshegs pa nyag gcig don phyin ci ma log par gsungs pa nyid du gzigs shing / pha rol po'i smra ba thams cad byis pa brdol thabs smra ba dang 'dra bar thugs su chud nas/ slob dpon shin tu dang ba dang ldan par gyur pas/ slar yang bcom ldan 'das la khyad par du mdzad pa ni smra ba rnams kyi dam pa/ zhes bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ de yang gtso bo rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i de kho na nyid ji lta ba bzhin du gzigs te gdul bya rnams la thugs brtse ba chen pos rjes su gzung ba'i phyir du thabs sna tshogs dang rigs pa mtha' yas pa'i sgo nas 'doms par mdzad pas yin te/ tshad ma kun las btus pa'i mchod brjod las/ tshad mar gyur pa 'gro la phan bzhed pa/ /ston pa bde gshegs skyob la phyag 'tshal nas/ /zhes dang /rten 'brel bstod pa las/ khyod kyis ji snyed bka' stsal ba/ /rten 'brel nyid las brtsams te 'jug /de yang mya ngan 'da' phyir te/ /zhi 'gyur min mdzad khyod la med/ /ces dang / slob dpon bde byed 207

dbu ma'i spyi don zab don gsal byed 'phrul gyi me long /bdag pos/ bde bar gshegs pa bdag gi pha min mu stegs gzhan dag dgra ma yin/ /de bzhin gshegs des bdag nor ma stsal gzegs zan sogs kyis cang ma 'phrog /'on kyang sangs rgyas bcom ldan de ni gcig tu 'gro la phan mdzad gsung / /dri med dri ma thams cad sel ba gang yin de la bdag dad lags/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ ston pa thugs rje can gyis chos kyi rnam grangs mtha' yas pa zhig bka' stsal ba thams cad zab mo stong pa nyid kyi tshul las brtsams pa dang / de ltar gsungs pa'i rgyu mtshan yang rigs drug gis bsdus pa'i skye dgu rnams zhi bsil mchog gi go 'phang la 'god pa'i slad du yin gyi/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las bskyab phyir ma yin pa'i 'jig rten chos brgyad sogs lhur len pa'i mdzad pa rnam pa thams cad du mi mnga' ba'i phyir/ ston pa skyabs gnas bslu ba med pa yin pa'i tshul la tshad ma'i stobs kyis nges pa drangs te yid ches kyi dad pa bskyed par bya ste/ dngos po'i mthar thug gi gnas lugs rjen par mkhyen cing thugs brtse bas gdul bya la ston par mdzad pa 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kho na'i khyad chos yin gyi phyi rol pa'i ston pa rnams la 'di lta bu'i yon tan yod pa ma yin zhing / sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa'i rten 'byung gi de kho na nyid kyi don yang rigs 'khyog skam pos gzhan mgo bskor te rgyam pham brtsad pa dang phyi rol mu stegs pa'i grub mthas sgro btags pa 208

dbu ma'i spyi don zab don sasal byed 'phrul gyi me long /ltar rigs pas brtag mi bzod pa dang dpyad mi rung ba zhig gtan ma yin par/ gzur gnas blo gros can gyis brtags shing dpyad tshe ji skad gsungs pa de ltar bden don la gnas pa'i nges shes pa rnyed thub pa zhig yin pas/ dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub dang rje thams cad mkhyen pa yab sras sogs rjes 'jug mkhas grub rnams kyi gzhung lugs rnams su rten 'byung gsungs pa 'ba' zhig gi sgo nas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la bstod phyag rgya cher mdzad pa'ang rgyu mtshan de dag la dgongs pa yin no/ /byang sa'i 'grel pa yon tan 'od kyis mdzad pa las/ nag po bstan pa dang chen po bstan pa rnams kyang yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so zhes bya ba ni/ mdo sde la 'jug 'dul ba la snang / chos nyid dang mi 'gal ba de ni chen po bstan pa yin la/ de las bzlog pa ni nag po bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs shing / de lta bu'i sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa yang dag yin min yang —/ rgyal ba'i gsung rab chos can/ dpyad gsum gyis dag pa yin te—/ mngon sum gyi don la mngon sum tshad mas mi gnod cing grub/rjes dpag ston pa'i yul la dngos po stobs kyis zhugs pa'i tshad mas mi gnod cing grub/ yul shin tu lkog gyur ston pa'i don la rang tshig snga phyi dang dngos shugs 'gal ba'i gnod pa med pa'i lung yin pa'i phyir—/ rnam 'grel las/ gtso bo'i don la mi slu'i phyir/ /gzhan la rjes 209

dbu ma'i spyi don zab don gsal byed 'phrul gyi me long /su dpag pa nyid/ /ces dang / rdo sbis dge bshes chen mos/ nga skyes lo lnga drug nas sangs rgyas kyi chos lugs 'di la zhugs/ 'di la sbyangs/'di nyams su blangs nas da lta rang lo brgyad cu lhag la slebs nas sangs rgyas chos lugs zhes pa bcos ma yin/ rdzun ma yin/ khungs med yin zhes smyos na ma gtogs bshad mi thub thag chod yin/ de ltar bshad pa las dkon mchog mchod pa'i tshul du da lta rang shi na dga'/zhes gsungs pa ltar/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i ston pa dang bstan pa tshad ma yin pa'ang rmongs dad tsam gyis yon tan med pa la yod par sgro btags nas che brjod mdzad pa lta bu gtan ma yin par nges pa don gyis mi bslu bar dngos po stobs zhugs kyi rigs pas 'grub pa yin phyir/ blang dor phyin ci ma log par tshul bzhin du 'doms pa'i rgyal ba'i gsung rab ni skye bo rnams kyis tshe 'di tsam du ma zad ji srid byang chub snying po ma thob pa de srid du don du gnyer bya kho nar shin tu nas kyang rigs te/ dkon mchog rjes dran gyi mdo las/ dam pa'i chos ni thog mar dge ba/ bar du dge ba/ tha mar dge ba/ don bzang po—/ tshig 'bru bzang po/ ma 'dres pa/ yongs su rdzogs pa/ yongs su byung ba/ yang dag pa mthong ba/ nad med pa/ dus chad med pa/ nye bar ston pa/ 'di mthong ba la don yod pa/ mkhas pa rnams kyis so sor rig par bya ba/ bcom ldan 'das kyis legs par gsungs pa'i 210

dbu ma'i spyi don zab don gsal byed 'phrul gyi me long /chos 'dul ba legs par ston pa/ nges par 'byung ba/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu 'gro bar byed pa/ mi mthun pa med cing 'dus pa dang ldan pa/ brten pa yod pa/ rgyu ba bcad pa'o/ /zhes dang / rin chen phreng ba las/ chos ni lugs kyi dam pa ste/ /chos kyi 'jig rten mngon dgar 'gyur/ /'jig rten dga' bar gyur pas kyang / /'di dang gzhan du bslus mi 'gyur/ /chos min pas ni lugs 'dod gang / /de yis 'jig rten mi dga' 'gyur/ /'jig rten mi dga' nyid kyi phyir/ /'di dang gzhan du dgar mi 'gyur/ /zhes dang / spel mar bstod pa las—/ gting mtha' med pa'i 'khor ba ni/ /rgya mtsho'i nang na rnam par gnas—/ /'dod chags la sogs mi bzad pa'i/ /chu srin gyis ni lus zos pas/ /de ring gang la skyabs su mchi/ /gang la nyes pa thams cad kun—/ /gtan nas yong ye mi mnga' zhing / /gang zhig la ni yon tan kunaske/ /rnam pa kun tu gnas gyur pa/ /gal te sems shig yod na ni/ /de nyid la ni skyabs 'gro zhing / /de bstod de ni bkur ba dang / /de yi bstan la gnas pa'i rigs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dam pa'i chos ni 'gro ba yongs kyi 'di phyi'i legs tshogs thams cad 'byung ba'i sgo gcig pu yin pas/ ston pa thams cad mkhyen pas ji skad bka' stsal ba de ltar phyag bzhes la sbyor nus tshe/ 'khor bar 'phen byed kyi rgyu gtso bo gdul bya'i rgyud kyi ma rig pa'i rmongs pa drungs nas 'byin par 211

dbu ma'i spyi don zab don gsal byed 'phrul gyi me long /byed cing / 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal thams cad las gtan du thar te rnam mkhyen rgyal ba'i go 'phang mngon du byed nus pa'i phyir ro/ /spyir rgyal ba'i gsung rab kyi tshig don gting mtha' mi mngon pa'i rgya mtsho ltar zab cing rgya che bas thos chung rang ga ba rnams kyi blo'i yol gor shong bar mi nus mod/ tshad ldan gyi mgon dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsam sbyor gnyis kyis tshul bzhin du bsten nas thos bsam la blo kha phyogs tshe/ rtogs pa'i yon tan gong nas gong du khyad zhugs te gzhung don bde blag tu khong du chud nus pa'i phyir te/ thos pa'i tshoms las/thos pas chos rnams shes par 'gyur/ /thos pas sdig las ldog par 'gyur—/ /thos pas don med spong bar 'gyur/ /thos pas mya ngan 'das pa thob/ /ces dang / rje dge 'dun grub pa'i zhal snga nas/ mang du thos pa'i sgron me ma bsten na/ /rmongs pa'i mun pa sel bar mi nus shing —/ /yang yang bsam pas dran pas ma bskyangs na/ /thos pa'i nor mchog srung bar nus ma yin/ /zhes dang / ji skad du/ rang dang gzhan la phan pa'i phyir/ /thos pas ngoms par mi bya ste/ /sa gsum brnyes pa'i sems dpa' yang / /thos pas ngoms pa med la stos/ /zhes sogs rgya cher gsungs pa ltar/ thos pa'i don rnams kyang shes lo dang thos lo'i rnam grangs bsags pa tsam dang brjed ngas rkun po'i dbang du ma song bar dran shes kyis rgyun mar bskyangs te thos bsam sgom 212

dbu ma'i spyi don zab don lasal byed 'phrul gyi me long /gsum gyi go rim ma 'phyugs par phyag len du ci thebs la lan brgya stong du 'bad dgos pa ste/ dngos po gang la rim gyis goms pas sla bar 'gyur ba'ang rang gi mngon sum gyi myong goms las rtogs nus so— /chos sde chen po khag gi gdan rabs dang dam pa gong ma rnams kyi rnam thar rnams la zhib tu mjal tshe/ bcos min gyi dad pa'i stobs shugs dang slob gnyer rting skul gyi blo skyed zung phan tshun 'gran pa'i tshul du gong du 'phel bar ma zad/ sprang ngo sa nor bu'i thang ma rnyed pa ltar gzhung brgya'i dka' gnad mang po zhig ngang gis rtogs par nus te—/ thun mong ma yin pa'i nang rig pa ni phyi'i go rgya gcod pa dang tshe 'di'i lto gos 'tshol ba'i thabs tsam ma yin par/ sdug bsngal thams cad spong bar byed pa'i nang blo sbyong gi rig gzhung zab mo zhig yin phyir / tshad ldan gyi gzhung dag las gsungs pa'i don rnams nyams len gyi mthil du dmar 'jus byed nus tshe/ gzod nyams rtogs kyi yon tan dang rig gzhung 'di'i rin thang sogs ma bu ngo 'phrod pa ltar 'gyur gyi/ ne tso'i klog dang sgyu ma'i ltad mo ba'i ngang tshul tsam la brten nas yin min gyi rnam gzhag byed pa ni mun nag 'dom 'jal byed pa dang 'dra bas/ gzur gnas blo ldan don gnyer ba rnams kyis rnam pa kun tu 'dzem par bya ba kho na'o/ /dbu ma 'jug pa las/ yon tan ma lus brtson 'grus rjes 'gro zhing / /bsod nams blo gros tshogs 213

dbu ma'i spyi don zab don gsal byed 'azul gyi me long /ni gnyis kyi rgyu/ /zhes dang / spyod 'jug las/ bdag gis byang chub ga la zhes/ /sbyid lug par ni mi bya ste/ /'di ltar de bzhin gshegs pa ni—/ /bden pa gsung bas bden 'di gsungs/ /sprang bu sha sbrang bung ba dang / /de bzhin srin bur gang gyur pa/ /des kyang brtson 'grus stobs bskyed na/ /byang chub thob dka' bla med 'thob/ /bdag lta rigs kyi mir skyes la/ /phan dang gnod pa ngo shes nas/ /byang chub spyod pa ma btang na/ /bdag gis byang chub cis mi 'thob ces gsungs pa ltar/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dkar po'i yon tan thams cad brtson 'grus yod med kyi rjes su 'gro ldog byed cing / brtson 'grus kyi lcag gis rang rgyud kyi cang shes ma bskul na le lo'i gzhan dbang du gyur nas 'dod don gyi sar nam yang slebs par mi nus pas/ le lo dang brtson 'grus kyi skyon yon shes par byas nas rgyal sras kyi spyod pa rlabs po che bslab pa la brtson 'grus bskyed par bya ste/ grog spur sogs sems can nyam chung ba dag gis kyang rjes nas rim gyis lus rten bzang po rnyed de brtson 'grus la bsten pas mthar mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur na/ bdag cag blo gros dang ldan pa'i mis sems mi zhum par brtson 'grus kyi stobs bskyed pas/ 'phrul gyis 'phur na lam seng slebs pa ltar lam dman pa la zhugs pas bskal pa grangs med pa mang por bsag dgos pa'i 214

dbu ma'i spyi don zab don gsal byed 'phrul gyi me long /tshogs rnams skad cig gis bsdus te myur du byang chub chen po cis reg par mi 'gyur te nges par reg ste/ rgyu stobs chen 'bras bu stobs chen la nam yang mi bslu ba dngos po'i chos nyid yin pa'i phyir ro/ /chos rje sa paṇa gyis/ rig pa nangs par 'chi yang bslab/ /tshe 'dir mkhas pa mi srid kyang / /skye ba phyi mar bcol ba yi/ /nor la rang nyid len pa 'dra—/ /zhes le lo sgyid lug can la lhag par thugs brtse bas gdams pa ltar/ tshe 'dir sngon las kyi dbang gis gos nag khyim pa'i rten blangs te gzhung lugs zab mo'i dgongs don ji bzhin du rtogs par ma gyur kyang / phyi ma phan chad du thub pa'i gsung rab dang rgya bod kyi shing rta chen po rnams kyi rab 'byams gzhung lugs thams cad kyi dgongs pa ji lta ba bzhin du rtogs pa'i thabs su/ rang gi ci lcogs kyis zab rgyas kyi gzhung lugs mang por thos bsam byed pa dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen la sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes 'dzin pa/ srin bu sogs sems can phra mo yan chad la snying rje bsgom pa/ kha ton dge sbyor sogs tshogs bsags sgrib sbyong la 'bad pa/ ji snyed bsags pa'i dge rtsa thams cad bstan pa rgyas pa'i phyir du bsngo ba/ mar gyur 'gro ba kun rdzogs pa'i byang chub la 'god pa'i slad du myur du 'tshang rgya bar smon lam 'debs pa sogs la rgyun chad med par 'bad par bya ste—/ de ltar byas tshe phyi ma'i rten la sngon sbyangs pa'i bag chags sad de 215

dbu ma'i spyi don zab don gsal byed 'phrul gyi me long /rtsol ba cher bskyed mi dgos par sa lam gyi yon tan thams cad gter spungs pa bzhin du rang rgyud la 'byor ba'ang dam pa gong ma dag gi rnam thar zla med pa ltar ro/ /gong du rigs lam dang mthun par cung zad spros pa 'dis rtogs ldan rnams la skye rung gi dogs gnas lhag ma med par bcad zin pas/ rgyal tshab rjes/ zab mo'i don 'di shin tu rtogs dka' na'ang / /rang nyid tshe rabs kun tu 'dris phyir dang / /lha dang bla ma'i byas shes drin gzo'i ched/ /bshad par bya yi rtse gcig gus pas nyon/ /zhes dang / ji skad du/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas zhes bya'i sgra 'di yang / /'jig rten dag na rab tu dkon gsungs pas/ /ne tso'i ma ṇi ji bzhin dam pa'i gsung / /rjes zlos shes pa 'di yang skal ba bzang / /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dus ngan snyigs ma'i yang mthar skye zhing rmongs dgu'i khol bor gyur pa kho bo cag lta bu la bstan bcos rtsom pa'i rgyu tshogs sna gcig kyang rang rgyud la mi ldan pa smos ci dgos / rtogs ldan rnams mgu ba skyed pa'i legs bshad tshigs su bcad pa gcig kyang bri ba'i 'khos ka zhan par ma zad/ rjod byed kyi sdeb sbyor skyon med ngos gtsang ba zhig kyang rgyun chags su spel ba'i blo gros kyi rtsal gyis 'di ltar mngon sum du phongs bzhin du smyon pa'i ngang tshul ltar tsham tshom med par rtsom pa la 'jug pa ni mkhas pa thugs rnams khril ba'i rgyu ru 'gyur ba gor ma chag mod/ 'on kyang sku drin 216

dbu ma'i spyi don zab don gsal byed 'phrul gyi me long /gzhal bar dka' ba'i mgon dge ba'i bshes gnyen du ma'i gsung gi bdud rtsi'i ro mngar la longs spyod pa'i skal ba cung zad ldan par gyur pa las bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa dang de 'dzin skyong spel gsum bgyis pa'i bstan 'dzin rnams la dad gus yar 'phel du mchis shing /sangs rgyas bstan pa la log par 'khu ba'i 'gong dgu'i spyod ngan rmi lam du'ang ma zin tsam gyi nang gi spro ba gtsor byas te gzhung lugs zab mo'i dgongs don gnad 'dril ba'i lugs su mdo tsam 'chad pa'ang sngon gyi tshad ldan mkhas pa'i gsung sgros chen mo dag gi rjes su brjod pa yin zhing / de tso'i yig drug rjes zlos lta bu'i smra lce cung zad ldem por bsgyur shes pa 'di tsam yang e ma rmad byung skal ba bzang bar mthong ste/ 'khor ba'i gnas su sangs rgyas kyi mtshan tsam yang brgya lam na thos pa shin tu dka' ba'i phyir ro/ /zab mo'i don 'di tshu rol mthong ba'i blos rtogs pa ra shin tu dka' na'ang / thos bsam sgom gsum ci nus kyis tshe 'dir bag chags brtan po 'jog pa dang tshe rabs kyi phreng ba gzhan du de kho nyid kyi don la goms pa'i slad du rgya chen gzhung la ngal brgyas 'bad khul byas pa ste/ mdo kun las btus pa las chos zab mo la mos pas bsod nams thams cad sdud pa yin te—/ sangs rgyas su ma grub kyi bar du 'jig rten pa dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i phun tshogs thams cad 'grub par 'gyur te/ khye'u 217

dbu ma'i spyi don zab don gsal byed 'phrul gyi me long /rin po ches byin pa'i mdo las 'byung ba/ 'jam dpal byang chub sems dpa' thabs la mkhas pa dang bral bas/ bskal pa brgya stong du pha rol tu phyin pa drug la dpyad pa pas/ gang gis chos kyi rnam grangs 'di the tshom dang bcas pas nyan pa 'di/ bsod nams de bas ches mang du bskyed na/ gang the tshom med par nyan pa lta ci smos/ gang yi ger bris nas lung 'bogs pa dang 'chad pa dang / gzhan dag la yang rgya cher ston pa lta ci smos/ zhes dang / rdo rje gcod pa las/ gang dag chos kyi rnam grangs 'di len pa dang 'dzin pa dang 'chang ba dang klog pa dang / kun chub par byed pa dang / gzhan dag la rgya cher yang dag par rab tu ston pa de dag ni de bzhin gshegs pas mkhyen de bzhin gshegs pas gzigs te/ sems can de dag thams cad ni bsod nams kyi phung po dpag tu med pa dang ldan par 'gyur/ bsod nams kyi phung po bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / mtshungs pa med pa dang /gzhal du med pa dang / tshad med pa dang ldan par 'gyur te/ sems can de dag thams cad nga'i byang chub phrag pa la thogs par 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang / gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mdo las/ byang chub sems kyi bsod nams dang / /dam chos 'dzin pa'i bsod nams gang —/ /stong pa nyid la mos pa yi/ /bcu drug char yang mi phod do/ /zhes zab mo stong pa nyid kyi don 'chad cing mos pa la bsod nams 218

dbu ma'i spyi don zab don gsal byed 'phrul gyi me long /mngon par 'du byed pa'i phan yon rgya chen po 'byung bar mdo rgyud bstan bcos rnams su lan gcig ma yin par rgya cher gsungs pas/de kho na nyid kyi don las brtsams pa'i gzhung 'di lta bu zhig rtsom pa la dgos pa mang du snang ba'ang bdag legs su 'dod pa 'i gzur gnas ༵rda/ /thogs mchog dman bar ma kun gyis shes par mdzad du gsol gnyis pa/ stong nyid rtogs pa'i phan yon dang ma rtogs pa'i nyes dmigs bshad pa/skye dgu rnams ni thog ma med pa'i dus nas rigs drug gi skye gnas ci rigs su bum nang gi bung ba'am zo chun gyi 'khyud mo bzhin du gcig nas gcig tu 'khyams te/ sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal dang /'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal/ khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal rnam pa gsum gyis rgyun chad med par mnar bzhin srog 'phrog par byed cing / de yang srin 'bu grog spur sogs srog chags phra mor skyes pa yan chad bde ba 'dod cing sdug bsngal skad cig tsam yang mi 'dod pa sha stag yin na'ang / sdug bsngal skyed byed kyi rgyu gtso bo dang de spong ba'i thabs tshul la rnam pa kun tu mgo 'thoms par gyur pas/ rma khar tshwa btab pa dang me phung la bud shing bsnan pa ltar bde ba sgrub pa'i thabs su 219

dbu ma'i khyi don zab don gsal byed 'phrul gyi me long /rang 'bras sdug bsngal skyed par byed pa'i rgyu sna tshogs sgo du ma nas bsgrub pa la rtsol ba brgya phrag lhur len par byed do/ /dug gi ljon pa chen po med par byed pa la yal ga dang lo ma tsam bcom pas mi chog par rtsa ba nas gdon dgos pa ltar/ gnas skabs 'tsho bzhin pa'i sems can 'di dag thams cad mthar gtugs na skye rga na 'chi sogs kyi sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin las ma 'das pas/ sdug bsngal gyi tsher 'obs dang 'chi bdag gi zhags pa 'di las gtan du thar ba'i thabs yod dam med/ med na phyogs der rtsol ba byed pa thams cad don med par 'gyur zhing / yod na thabs de ji lta bu zhig yin zhe na/ tshig gsal las/ bcom ldan 'das kyis dngos po rnams kyi 'byung ba dang /rgyu dang / rkyen la ltos pa yongs su gsal bar mdzad pa na/ dngos po rnams rgyu med pa nyid dang / mi mthun pa'i rgyu las byung ba nyid dang /rang dang / gzhan dang / gnyis las byas pa nyid bkag par 'gyur la/de bkag pas ni/ dngos po kun rdzob pa rnams kyi rang gi dngos po kun rdzob pa ji ltar gnas pa bzhin du gsungs par gyur to/ /zhes gsungs shing / rgyal bas gsungs pa'i lung don de nyid rigs pas ji ltar sgrub pa'i tshul yang / rnam 'grel las/ dngos po rnams ni re 'ga' zhig /'byung ba stos pa las yin no/ /zhes dang / rjes su 'gro dang ldog pa las/ /gang zhig gang gi rjes 'gro ba/ /de yi rang bzhin de 220

dbu ma'i spyi don zab don gsal byed 'phrul gyi me long /rgyu can/ /de phyir mi mthun las mi 'byung / /zhes dang / rgyu yi rang bzhin nges pa las/ /'bras bu'i rang bzhin nges pa ste/ /zhes sogs rgyas par gsungs pas/ rgyu med na rtag tu yod pa'am med par 'gyur bas—/ rtag pa la sdug bsngal sogs kyi bya ba byed pa'i nus pa yod pa ma yin zhing / gtan nas med pa'ang ma yin pa'i phyir na/ dngos po rnams ni rgyu med pa dang / mi mthun pa'i rgyu dang / phyi rol ba'i grub mtha'i gzhung las bstan pa ltar dbang phyug tshangs pa la sogs pa'i blo'i g.yo ba sngon du btang ba las byung ba ma yin par/ dngos po rnams rgyu yod med kyi rjes su 'gro ldog byed cing / bskyed bya 'bras bu tha dad pa de dag skyed par byed pa'i rgyu yi rang bzhin yang so sor nges pa'i phyir na/ sems can rnams 'khor ba'i gnas ris su yang yang 'phen zhing sdug bsngal mi bzad pa sna tshogs shig mi 'dod bzhin du 'di ltar nges par myong dgos pa'i rgyu gtso bo'ang yod pa yin te/ 'o na rgyu de gang yin zhe na/ mdo las/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba zhes bya ba ni 'di lta ste/ 'di yod pas ni 'di 'byung la/ 'di skyes pa'i phyir 'di skye ba ste/ gang 'di ma rig pa'i rkyen gyis 'du byed rnams—/ 'du byed kyi rkyen gyis rnam par shes pa sogs nas/ de bzhin du ming dang gzugs dang / skye mched drug reg pa/ tshor ba/ sred pa/len pa/ srid pa/ skye ba/ rga shi'i bar du sbyar zhing / mya ngan dang / smre 221

dbu ma'i spyi don zab don gsal gyed 'phrul gyi me long /ngag 'don pa dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / yid mi bde ba dang 'khrugs pa rnams 'byung ste/ de ltar sdug bsngal gyi phung po chen po 'ba' zhig po 'di 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /de la ma rig pa 'gags pas 'du byed 'gag sogs nas/ skye ba 'gags pas rga shi dang mya ngan sogs sdug bsngal gyi phung po chen po 'ba' zhig po 'di 'gag par 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ 'khor bar 'phen byed rgyu ni/ phyi nang gi chos thams cad rang mtshan gyis grub pa rdul tsam yang med bzhin du de ltar grub par lhag par sgro 'dogs pa'i blo ste sems can gyi rgyud kyi thog ma'i ma rig pa nyid yin zhing / rig pa ye shes bskyed pa'i 'gal zla mi mthun pa'i phyogs yin pas na ma rig pa zhes brjod do—/ nade la chos can gyi dbang gis gang zag dang chos kyi bdag tu rmongs pa'i ma rig pa gnyis su dbyer yod pa las/ dang po ni/ gang zag gi bdag med rtogs pa'i ye shes kyi 'gal zla mi mthun phyogs su gyur pa'i gang zag gi bdag 'dzin du gyur pa'i ma rig pa dang /gnyis pa ni/ phung po sogs chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i ye shes kyi 'gal zla mi mthun pa'i phyogs su gyur pa'i chos kyi bdag 'dzin du gyur pa'i ma rig pa ste/ de gnyis la brten nas las 'bras dang de kho na nyid la rmongs pa'i dbang gis bde 'gro dang ngan 'gro gang rung du 'phen par byed pa'i dge ba'i las dang mi dge ba'i las dang lung ma 222

dbu ma'i spyi don zab don gsal byed 'phrul gyi me long /bstan gyi las ci rigs pa gsog par byed cing / des thog ma'i rgyu dus kyi rnam par shes pa la bag chags bzhag pa dang / bag chags bsgos pa de la tshor ba bde ba dang mi 'bral zhing sdug bsngal dang bral bar 'dod pa'i sred pa dang / 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang / lta ngan dang 'brel ba'i tshul khrims brtul zhugs ngan pa dang / 'jig lta ma gtogs pa'i lta ngan gzhan dang / 'jig tshogs la lta ba bzhi la dmigs nas 'dun zhing lhag par zhen pa len pa'i rten 'brel gnyis kyis sos btab pas yang srid phyi ma 'grub pa'i nus pa mthu can du gyur pa srid pa'i rten 'brel yin zhing / de la brten nas rgyu dus kyi rnam par shes pa ma'i mngal du nying mtshams sbyar te ming gzugs kyi rten 'brel dang / skye mched reg pa tshor ba skye ba rga shi'i rten 'brel rnams snga ma snga ma brten nas phyi ma phyi ma mngon par 'grub pa yin zhing —/ /de ltar 'gro ba rnams rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis la brten nas rigs drug gi gnas ris su gcig nas gcig tu 'khor bas 'khor ba zhes bya'o/ /spyod 'jug las/ 'jig rten dag na 'tshe ba gang yod dang / /'jigs dang sdug bsngal ji snyed yod gyur pa/ /de dag bdag tu 'dzin pa las byung na/ /'dre chen de gas bdag la ci zhig bya/ /zhes dang / rnam 'grel las/ bdag yod na ni gzhan du shes—/ /bdag gzhan cha las 'dzin dang sdang / /'di dag dang ni 223

dbu ma'i spyi don zab don gsal byed 'phrul gyi me long /yongs 'brel las/ /nyes pa thams cad 'byung bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sems can rnams sdug bsngal che chung mi 'dra ba ci rigs kyis rgyun ring shugs drag tu mnar bzhin pa ni rang rgyud kyi las dang nyon mongs pa'i dbang gis byung ba yin zhing / de kun gyi rtsa ba bdag 'dzin ma rig pa'am 'jig lta lhan skyes la thug pa ste/ 'jam dpal zhal lung las/ nyon mongs thams cad kyi rtsa ba ma rig pa dang 'jig lta gnyis gcig tu byas kyang 'gal ba med mod/ spu ris 'byed tshe so sor bya ste/ dper na thag pa'i gnas lugs mi gsal bar byed pa'i mun pa de ma rig pa dang / de la brten nas thag pa la sbrul du 'dzin pa'i blo de 'jig lta lta bu yin pas 'di gnyis kyis nyon mongs pa'i rtsa ba byas nas chags sdang gi dbang gis nyes pa thams cad bskyed pa'i phyir/ zhes dang / 'jug 'grel las/ de la 'jig tshogs la lta ba ni nga dang nga yi snyam pa de lta bu'i rnam par zhugs pa/ zhes gsungs pa ltaraske/ de yang rang rgyud kyi nga dang nga yi ba gang rung la dmigs nas de rang gi mtshan nyid kyis grub par 'dzin pa'i sgro 'dogs pa'i blo ni 'dir 'jig lta lhan skyes yin pas/ sems can gyi rgyud kyi nga dang nga yir 'dzin pa'i 'jig lta lhan skyes kyis bdag dang gzhan zhes ris su bcad de bdag gi phyogs la rtag tu zhen cing chags pa dang gzhan gyi phyogs la sdang zhugs kyis kun nas bslangs te rang nyid bde ba'i 224

dbu ma'i spyi don zab don gsal byed 'phrul gyi me long /thabs su las 'bras la rmongs pa'i dbang gis sems can gzhan gyi srog gcod pa sogs mi dge ba'i las la bag med du spyod par 'gyur zhing —/ de dag la brten nas rgyu mthun gyi 'bras bu ste/ sngon srog gcod byas pa las tshe thung zhing nad mang ba dang / ma byin par blangs pas rgyu nor longs spyod kyis phongs pa sogs las gang dang gang byas pa de'i rnam smin gyi 'bras bu 'byin pa la gegs byed kyi rkyen dang ma phrad na skye ba dang tshe rabs su sdug bsngal rgyun mar myong bzhin 'khor ba mu mtha' med pa'i gnas su 'khyams par 'gyur ro/ /dbu ma 'jug pa las—/ nyon mongs skyon rnams ma lus la 'jig tshogs dang / /lta las byung bar blo yis mthong gyur nas/ /bdag ni 'di yi yul du rtogs byas te/ /rnal 'byor pa yis bdag ni 'gog par byed/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ 'khor ba'i skyon thams cad 'jig tshogs lta ba las byung bas nyes pa de dag las ldog pa la 'jig lta lhan skyes sun dbyung dgos na/de drungs nas 'byin par byed pa'i thabs yod dam med ce na/ dngos po gang gi rgyu'i rigs la gnod byed stobs dang ldan pa dmigs pas rang 'bras bskyed par mi nus te/ dper na/ snang ba chen pos mun pa stug po sel bar byed pa dang / rgyu'i sa bon mer bsregs pas rang 'bras myu gu bskyed mi nus pa dang / grang reg la tsha reg stobs can 'phrad pas rgyun gyi nus pa nyams par byed pa ltar/ dngos su gnod bya 225

dbu ma'i spyi don zab don gsal byed 'phrul gyi me long /gang la gnod byed stobs ldan zhugs pa'i sgo nas gnod bya'i rgyun med par byed nus pa dngos po'i chos nyid yin pa'i phyir ro/ /'o na 'khor ba'i rgyu 'jig lta lhan skyes kyi gnyen po stobs ldan de gang yin zhe na/rtsa shes las/ bdag dang bdag gi snyam zad na/ /nye bar len pa 'gag 'gyur zhing / /de zad pas ni skye ba zad/ /las dang nyon mongs zad pas thar/ /las dang nyon mongs rnam rtog las/ /de dag spros las spros pa ni/ /stong pa nyid kyis 'gag par 'gyur/ /zhes dang /stong nyid bdun cu pa las/ dngos po stong nyid nges rtogs na/ /yang dag mthong phyir rmongs mi 'gyur/ /de ni ma rig 'gog pa yin/ /de las yan lag bcu gnyis 'gag /ces dang / rten 'brel bstod pa las/'jig rten rgud pa ji snyed pa/ /de yi rtsa ba ma rig ste/ /gang zhig mthong bas de ldog pa/ /rten cing 'brel bar 'byung bar gsungs/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar/ chos thams cad rang bzhin med par rtogs pa'i shes rab ni 'dir bdag 'dzin lhan skyes dngos kyi gnod byed stobs ldan yin te/ de yang phyi nang gi chos thams cad rten 'brel yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis rang bzhin gyis grub pas stong pa dang / rang bzhin med pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba yin pa'i tshul 'di dngos po'i gnas lugs mthar thug pa yin pas/ rten 'byung stong pa dang stong pa rten 'byung gi don du rtogs pa'i blo yis 126

dbu ma'i spyi don zab don gsal byed 'phrul gyi me long /bdag 'dzin lhan skyes kyi zhen yul la gnod pa yin te/ bdag 'dzin lhan skyes dang 'dzin stangs dngos 'gal du zhugs pa'i sgo nas de'i zhen yul med par phyin ci ma log par rtogs pa ste bdag med rtogs pa'i blo yin pa'i phyir/ bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis bden 'dzin gyi zhen yul sun phyung nas bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya chen po dang 'brel ba'i lam bsgom stobs kyis sgrib gnyis gtan zad du spangs te 'tshang rgya bar nus te/ rnam 'grel las/ rgyu yod phyir dang rgyu yi ni/ /gnyen po goms pas zad phyir dang / /de shes pa yang grub pa yin/ /thugs brtse ldan phyir rtsom kun kyang / /gzhan gyi don du sbyor phyir ro/ /zhes dang / bzhi brgya pa las/ ji ltar sa bon mtha' mthong zhing / /de la thog ma yod min ltar/ /de bzhin du ni ma tshang phyir/ /skye ba'am 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de yang rigs can gsum gyi dbang du byas na nyan rang gis bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya chen po dang mi sprel bar rigs pa mdor bsdus tsam gyis bdag med pa'i don gtan la phab nas yun ring du goms pas mthar nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa spong bar byed pa dang / byang sems kyis dang po nas bsod nams kyi tshogs mtha' yas pas brgyan te bdag med rtogs pa'i don de nyid yun ring du bsgom pa la brten nas mthar nyon sgrib tsam ma zad shes bya'i sgrib pa'ang rtsad nas spong bar byed do/ /rin 227

dbu ma'i spyi don zab don gsal byed 'phrul gyi me long /chen phreng ba las/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi gzugs kyi sku/ /bsod nams tshogs las 'khrungs pa ste/ /chos kyi sku ni mdor bsdus na/ /rgyal po ye shes tshogs las 'khrungs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sangs rgyas kyi chos gzugs kyi sku gnyis las gzugs sku sgrub pa'i thabs ni bsod nams kyi tshogs dang / chos sku thob par byed pa'i rgyu ni ye shes kyi tshogs yin pas—/ 'bras bu sku gnyis mngon du byed par tshogs gnyis rdzogs dgos par ma zad/ shes bya'i sgrib pa spong bar byed pa la zab mo stong pa nyid la rtse gcig tu yun ring goms par byas pas mi chog par bsod nams kyi tshogs mthar phyin pa la rag las pa'i phyir te/ tshogs gnyis yongs su ma rdzogs pas stong nyid ji lta ba bzhin du khong du chud mi nus pa'i tshul yang / mdo sdud pa las/ ji srid tshogs gnyis dam pa de ni ma rdzogs par/ /de srid stong nyid dam pa de ni rtogs mi byed/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /des na nyan rang dgra bcom pas nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa ma lus par spangs zin kyang / de tsam gyis 'tshang rgya bar mi nus te/ shes bya'i sgrib pa da dung ma spang ba'i phyir/ de spong ba bsod nams kyi tshogs mtha' yas pa gsog pa la stos pas/ de ni theg chen thun mong ma yin pa'i gzhung las ma gtogs gsal bar bstan med pas/ nyan thos rigs can rnams kyis rang lam du nyon sgrib spangs zin par gyur na'ang / mthar thug 'tshang rgya ba la nges par 228

dbu ma'i spyi don zab don gsal byed 'phrul gyi me long /theg chen gyi lam du zhugs nas tshogs rgya chen po dang 'brel te shes sgrib spangs pa'i sgo nas dag pa gnyis ldan gyi sku mngon du byed dgos pas—/ mthar thug theg pa gcig tu grub pa'i tshul yang gnad 'dir thug pa yin no/ /spyir 'tshang rgya ba la bskal chen grangs med gsum du tshogs bsag dgos par gzhung las mang du gsungs na'ang / mtha' gcig tu de tsam du gsog dgos pa'i nges pa med de/ rdo sbis dge bshes chen mos/ gzhung la sbyangs na mkhas par 'gyur ba dang / /thabs la zab na don mang 'grub pa dang / /'phrul gyis 'phur na myur du slebs pa sogs/ /'bras bu rgyu la ltos pa'i dpe ru gsal/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ mthong grol/ thos grol/ btags grol/ myong grol/ma bsgom sangs rgyas sogs tshad ldan gyi gzhung gang dang yang mi mthun par snyan snyan rdzig rdzig gis ming btags pa la man ngag zab mor rlom khul gyis thos bsam sgom gsum gyi go rim thams cad spangs te ma brtags nyams dga'i ngang la rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i sar skad cig gis phyin par 'dod nas bla slob nang phan tshun bslus pa lta bu ma yin par/ snod ldan gyi slob mas yang dag pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen las nges don gyi gdams ngag zab khyad can gsan te lam gyi go rim ma nor bar ji bzhin du nyams bzhes mthar phyin par mdzad pas dus yun thung ngu tsam du 'ang 'tshang rgya nges yin te/ drung pa rgyal tshab pas/229

dbu ma'i spyi don zab don gsal byed 'phrul gyi me long /rje rin po che'i mdo sngags zung du 'jug pa'i lam rim 'di la mi la ltar gyi dka' spyad mi dgos/ brtson 'grus de 'dra'i sgo nas rje rang nyid kyi dgongs pa ji lta ba bzhin sgrub pa snying por byas na lo gsum phyogs gsum gyis sangs rgya ba la the tshom med kyang dam can chos rgyal gyi kha nang du 'deb rgyu tshos nyams su mi len par snang / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ tshe stod la sdig can gyur pa'i rje btsun mi la bzhad pa'i rdo rjes sgra sgyur mar pa la bsten pas sdig sgrib byang nas zung 'jug gi sku brnyes pa dang / rje blo bzang grags pa/ rtogs ldan 'jam dpal rgya mtsho—/ ba so chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ drung pa rgyal tshab pa/ rgyal ba blo bzang don grub dang / paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan/ drung pa rta phug pa sogs dben sa snyan brgyud kyi phreng ba rnams kyis rje bla ma la rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis dngos su gnang ba'i 'jam dbyangs sprul pa'i glegs bam las gsungs pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor srog shing du byas pa'i gdams ngag zab mo sku nyams su bzhes pas snyigs dus kyi sku tshe de nyid la rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang brnyes par yongs su grags shing grub pa ltar te/ zhib tu shes 'dod pas zung 'jug nor bu'i phreng ba zhes pa'i ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i rnam thar la blta bar bya'o/ /des na thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang don du gnyer bar 'dod pa rnams kyis rten 'brel lugs 'byung ldog gi sgo nas 'khor ba 'jug 230

dbu ma'i spyi don zab don gsal byed 'phrul gyi me long /ldog gi rim pa rnams ji bzhin nges par byas nas spang blang la 'bad par rigs shing / de yang mthar gtugs na yang dag pa 'i rigs lam la brten nas log pa'i lta ngan mtha' dag cig car du sel bar byed pa'i zab mo stong pa nyid kyi don 'tshol zhing rtogs pa'i thabs la rdo rus thug pa'i brtson 'grus bskyed dgos te/ rin chen phreng ba las/stong pa nyid la goms pa yis/ /chos rnams kun la chags med 'thob/ /g.yo med pas ni dran ldan 'thob/ /sems par byed pas blo gros 'thob—/ /bkur ste byas pas don rtogs ldan/ /chos bsrungs shes rab can du 'gyur/ /zhes dang / bsod nams chung ngus chos 'di la/ /the tshom za bar yang mi 'gyur/ /the tshom zos pa tsam gyis kyang / /srid pa hrul bor byed par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / rnam 'grel las/ 'di yul sun phyung med par ni/ /de spong bar ni nus ma yin/ /zhes dang / byang chub sems 'grel las/ gang dag stong nyid mi shes pa/ /de dag thar pa rten min pa/ /'gro drug srid pa'i btson rar ni/ /rmongs pa de dag 'khor bar 'gyur/ /zhes dang / lam gtso rnam gsum las/ gnas lugs rtogs pa'i shes rab mi ldan na/ /nges 'byung byang chub sems la goms byas kyang / /srid pa'i rtsa ba gcad par mi nus pas/ /de phyir rten 'brel rtogs pa'i thabs la 'bad/ /ces sogs dbu tshad kyi gzhung mtha' yas pa las gsungs pa ltar/ bdag dang bdag gir 231

dbu ma'i spyi don zab don gsal byed 'phrul gyi me long /'dzin pa'i 'jig lta lhan skyes ni 'khor ba'i rgyu'i gtso bor gyur pas/ji srid bdag 'dzin lhan skyes kyi zhen yul sun ma phyung ba de srid du 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho 'di las nam yang thar bar mi nus shing —/ 'khor ba'i rtsa ba gcod par byed pa'i 'gran zla dang bral ba'i thabs gcig pu ni stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab nyid yin zhing / de dang bral na sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang lta zhog byang chub gsum po gang yang thob pa med par sher phyin gyi mdo sde rin po che las gsungs shing /rje bla mas phul ba'i rje btsun red mda' ba'i dris lan las/ sngags kyi rdzogs rim rnams la'ang mtshan nyid kyi lta ba'i myong ba 'don lugs 'di med pas/ de rkyang pa byas na lta ba'i go yul tsam yod kyang lam du gtan mi 'gro/ zhes dang / rje bla mas dka' bzhi pa shes rab dpal bzang la gdams pa las/ zab mo spros pa dang bral ba'i don la ni sngags dang phar phyin khyad par med par mkhas pa gong ma rnams bzhed pa legs par mthong bas zab don gyi go ba ni dbu ma'i bstan bcos las btsal na sngags las rtogs sla bar mthong ngo / /zhes gsungs pa ltar—/ mdo sngags kyi lam gang la brten nas bla na med pa'i byang chub mngon du byed kyang zab mo stong pa nyid nges par du phyin ci ma log par rtogs dgos te/ de dang bral tshe thar lam gyi srog rtsa ma rnyed pa yin pas 'bras bu gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa rgyu phar phyin theg pa las ci 232

dbu ma'i spyi don zab don gsal byed 'phrul gyi me long /tsam zab par smos kyang 'tshang rgya bar mi nus so/ /mdo sngags kyi lta ba la mtho dman gyi khyad par cung zad kyang med par rgyu phar phyin theg pa las gsungs pa'i de kho na nyid kyi don 'di kho na las gzhan med la/zab mo'i don la go ba bde blag tu rnyed pa'ang sngags las dbu ma'i bstan bcos las btsal na nges pa ster phul che bar gsungs pas/ rtsa she'i 'grel pa tshig gsal las/ shes rab can rnams kyis srog dag kyang yongs su btang ste de kho na nyid btsal bar 'os pa yin te/ byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu ngus bcom ldan 'das ma ji ltar btsal pa bzhin no/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ stong nyid rtogs pa'i phan yon dang ma rtogs pa'i nyes dmigs rnams shes par byas nas/ de kho na nyid kyi don ston pa'i gsung rab dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa'i bstan bcos ji snyed pa dag la bcos min gyi dad gus dang rang gi spyan 'bras ltar gces par bzung nas/ tshe 'dir ma mthar yang thos bsam sgom pa la yang dag pa'i bag chags brtan po 'jog pa la phra zhib mdzangs pa'i blo gros kyi stobs bskyed par bya ste/ deng sang gi shes rlom gzhan dag zab don ston pa'i tha snyad ci rigs thun mong ba'i gzhung lugs kyi skabs don dang mi 'byor bzhin du nya dang nyung ma bsres pa ltar 'chol bar spyod pa dang / ku re rtsed mtshar gyi ched du byung rgyal du smra bar byed pa dngos su mthong yang / bdag nyid nyams par byed pa'i byur gyi sna 233

dbu ma'i spyi don zab don gsal byed 'phrul gyi me long /'dren du 'gyur ba las 'os gzhan ma mchis te/ chos dang chos smra ba po la ma gus pa shes rab 'chal ba'i rgyu ru tshad thub kyi gzhung las 'byung bas/ daphyod shes can yin na de 'dra'i log spyod dag la rnam pa thams cad du gzab par 'os so/ /'di dag gi tshul rgyas par ni rgya bod kyi mkhas grub rnams kyi gzhung khungs ma dag las shes par bya ste/'dir yi ger 'jigs pas de tsam las ma spros so/ /gsum pa/ zab mo stong pa nyid rtogs dka' bar bstan pa/mdo sde dgongs pa nges 'grel las/ zab mo byis pa'i spyod yul ma yin pa/ /brjod min gnyis min rgyal bas bstan mdzad kyang / /byis pa gti mug rmongs pa 'di dag ni/ /smra ba'i spros la dga' zhing gnyis la gnas/ /zhes dang / sangs rgyas phal po che las/ phra la shes dka' drang srong chen po'i lam/ /mi rtog rtog yul ma yin lta bar dka'/ /rang bzhin zhi zhing 'gag med 'byung ba med/ /mkhas gsal shes pas khong du chud pa yin/ /ngo bo nyid stong zhi zhing sdug bsngal zad/ /rgyud las rnam grol mnyam par mya ngan 'das/ /mtha' dang dbus med tshig gis brjod du med/ /dus gsum grol ba nam mkha'i mtha' dang 'dra/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ spyir dpal ldan dbu ma thal 'gyur ba'i lugs kyi rtag chad gnyis kyi mtha' dang bral ba'i zab mo stong pa nyid kyi lta ba 234
