dpyad gtam ngan rtog dug 'joms/rgyas chos lugs nang 'dren byas pa ni bod phyi rabs par bzos pa'i skyon cha ri bo lta bu zhig yin la/ khri srong lde btsan gyis sangs rgyas chos lugs 'dzin skyong spel sasum byas pa ni de bas kyang skyon gyi phung bo zhis tu 'khums pa red/ rgyal po srong btsan sum pos chos lusas nang 'dren byas nas dar spel btang ba ni kho rang nyid sangs 7sa chos lugs la mi phyed pa'i dad pa chen po zhig ldan pas min la/ mi rigs gcig gyur dang srid dbang sra brtan byas te mnga' khongs rgya chen por dbang bsgyur ba'i ched du yin/ rgyal ngo glang dar ma dang de'i blon ngo dag gis sangs rgyas chos lugs bsnubs pa ni bkra shis pa'i don chen zhig yin na'ang / yid phangs pa zhig ni mjug mthar rgyalapo kho rang sku gshesas nas dasongs don mtha' dag las bstar byed ma thub pa ni/ nga tsho'i bod mi rigs kyi las dbang ngan pa'i rtags su mi brjod thabs med las mi 'dug ces zer ro/ /rang nyid gzhan rigs kyi rig gnas lo rgyus sogs la thos pa che khul gyis rang dang rigs mthun pa'i shes 'chal rnams ngo mtshar skyed pa'i blun gtam 'ba' zhig smras 'dug kyang / don la rang gzhan gyi rig gnas kun la rgyus cung zad kyang med pa'i rdzob rtags phyir bstan pa yin te/ chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po rgyal srid la 'khod pa nas mnga' bdag khri ral pa can gser khri la gzims pa'i dus ni spyi lo629nas spyi lo36lo'i bar yin zhing / rgyal ngo srong btsan sgam po nas brtsis pa'i rgyal rabs bcu tsam gyi ring la rgyal bstan rim gyis bod du dar zhing chos srid kyi chu bo chen po gcig 'dres su gyur nas gangs ri'i khrod du chags pa'i mi rigs 'di'i srid 'byor rig gsum sogs gang ci'i thad nas dbyar gyi mtsho mo rgyas pa ltar 'phel rgyas kyi rtser son pa'i dus skabs shig tu snadi ba snga phyi'i lo rgyus mkhan po rnamardzu 5

dpyad gtam ngan rtog dug 'joms/thun (30mikhri 47 0sa nemyo)gyis rdul phran gyi rig pa'i srol btod pa dang —/ spyi lo1946lor 'jig rten 'dir thog dang por glog rdul sbu gu'i rtsis 'khor gsar gtod byas pa dang / spyi lo1958lor shel gzugs sbru gu'i rtsis 'khor dang / spyi lo1965lor gcig bsdus glog lam gyi rtsis 'khor—/ spyi lo1972lor gcig bsdus glog lam che rigs kyi rtsis 'khor dang rtsis 'khor dra ba/ dus rabs nyi shu ba'i mjug tu na mi'i lag rtsal(polkoṣṭha.oṃ)dang / khi lun lag rtsal(cho ṣṭha.oṃ)sogs rim gyis dar ba la brten nas mi rnams kyi blo yul las 'gongs pa'i 'phrul sbyor gyi dngos po sna tshogs pa dang shes bya gsar pa mang po zhig dbang po'i spyod yul du gyur pa lags pas/ mi rigs gzhan pa'i dus phyis kyi lag rjes dag ngo sor khyer nas rang gi snga rabs pa rnams la mchil zhags 'phen mkhan bdud rgyal glang dar lta bu'i mi re 'ga' ma gtogs su zhig mchis/ rigs gsar gyi phyogs nas bod mi rigs rjes su lus 'dug pa khas mi len pa min mod/ de tsam gyis thams cad la skyon du blta ga la rigs/ sangs rgyas chos lugs bod yul tsam du ma zad/ rigs gsar gyi thad nas gzhan gyis 'gran mi do ba'i nub phyogs kyi rgyal khab a me ri kha ru sangs rgyas chos lugs pa khri tsho lnga brgya tsam dang sa dge bka' rnying sogs kyi dgon sde bzhi bcu lhag mchis pa dang / 'jar pan du mi grangs yongs kyi sum cha'i gnyis tsam 547

dpyad gtam ngan rtog dug 'joms/sangs rgyas chos lugs pa yin zhing / gzhan yang / dbyin ji dang / hpha ran si/ 'jar man/ dbyi ta li/ kha na ta/ (mebasgolko)o si khri ri ya/(chorkilko)༅)u ri si/ 'bar ma/ ( ne)bhang ga la/ (rtsame07)su'i tser/(lkorwa )yo nan/ tan mag(7cho) khra'o zhan/ rgya gar/ ne pa la/ the go'abrug yul/ 'bras ljongs/ shang kang / the wan sogs rgyal khab dang yul gru khag mang por nang bstan sa khyab rdo khyab kyi tshul du rgya cher dar bzhin 'dug pas/ nang don rig pa'i gzhung lugs tshan rig dang mi mthun pa'i log bshad sha stag yin na/ rigs gsar gyi phyogs nas 'phel rgyas su phyin pa'i phyi gling pa de dag gis ci'i phyir dad pa bzlog med bskyed/ sangs rgyas chos lugs sems can bslu bar byed pa'i log chos 'ba' zhig yin par 'dod na/ dbu tshad kyi gzhung rnams las 'byung ba'i rigs pa rnams tshad thub kyi rigs lam phra zhing mdzangs pa'i sgo nas sun 'byin byed dgos pa las/ ji skad du/ lung rigs gtan tshigs mi ldan par/ /gzhan la bab col smra ba ni/ /skyes bu rdza yi khur thogs nas/ /rdo yi g.yul ngor 'jug pa 'dra/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rang nyid la shes byed yang dag rdul tsam yang ston rgyu med par sbom bshad chu mi thub pa 'dzem med du gzhan la sgrog cing rang dgar yi ger 'bri ba sogs shin tu mtshang che ba yin te/ blun po smra ba nyung na mdzes/ /zhes pa ltar/ kha btsum ste bsdad na bod kyi rig 548

dpyad gtam ngan rtog dug 'joms/gnas la gnod pa med cing lugs gnyis gang gi thad nas kyang mdzes rgyan du 'gyur ro/ /rje btsun sher rgyal gyi zhal snga nas/ da lta kho zho'i(lke4stsa)rigs pas srog chags kyi sa bon sna tshogs phar 'debs tshur 'debs mang po byed kyin 'dug pa 'dis zab mo'i don la go rigs mtha' yas pa sbyin no/ /zhes dang / sngar mthong thos med pa'i shes bya mig lam du son pa na med med mug mug gi tshub tshub sa lding gnam lding bya ba las rten 'brel bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i tshul la yid ches kyi dad pa cung zad re bskyed na yang khe spogs che'o/ /bsam gyis mi khyab pa bzhi gsungs pa'ang 'di 'dra la dgongs pa yin no bu/ zhes gsungs pa mkhas pa'i legs bshad dri ma med pa yin te/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa bzhi ni/ sangs rgyas byang chub kyi mthu bsam gyis mi khyab/rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi nus pa bsam gyis mi khyab/sems can rnams kyi las kyi rnam par smin pa bsam gyis mi khyab/sngags dang sman gyi nus pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa bcas la zer ba yin pasaske/ khyed ltar na bsam gyis mi khyab pa bzhi la rnar thos tsam yang med par zad de/ rje bdag nyid chen pos/ don ldan tshig ni re res kyang —/ /shes rab can la don kun byed/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ zab mo'i don rnams lta smos kyang ci dgos/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa bzhi tsam la 'ol spyi tsam gyi nges pa rnyed na'ang de 'dra'i log rtog 'byung ba'i 549

dpyad gtam ngan rtog dug 'joms/gnas med de/ 'phrul chas kyi rigs sna tshogs pa 'di dag kyang tshan rig pa rnams kyis rdzas kyi nus pa rags tsam zhig rtogs pa las byung ba yin pas/ bdag cag gi ston pas lo ngo stong phrag lhag gi sngon nas chings su gsungs 'dug pa la ci'i phyir ngo mtshar du mi 'dzin/ rgyal po srong btsan sgam pos sangs rgyas chos lugs nang 'dren byas te dar spel btang ba ni kho rang nyid sangs rgyas chos lugs la mi phyed pa'i dad pa chen po zhig ldan pas min la/ zhes brjod pa'ang chos rgyal la skur zhus kham po che byas pa ste/ rgyal po srong btsan sgam pos bod chos ldan gyi zhing khams su bsgyur pa ni bod yul gcig gyur gyi rgyal srid skyong ba'i dgos pa du mar dmigs pa yin par ma zad/ rgyal po rang nyid kyang mchog gsum la dad pa mi phyed pa zhig yod pa yin te/ chos rgyal gyis bzlog tu med pa'i bka' rbab rdo lta bu phab pa la brten nas chab 'bangs rnams kyis gnam na gsal ba rnam gnyis ltar yongs su grags pa'i rgya stag ra mo che'i gtsug lag khang dang ra sa 'phrul snang gi gtsug lag khang rnam gnyis legs par bzhengs pa dang / gzhan khra 'brug bkra shis byams snyoms kyi lha khang dang / spu ru ka rtsal mi 'gyur ba'i lha khang / gser shing rti'i lha khang / tsan thang gi lha khang / lho brag 'khon thang gi lha khang / gtsang 'bras byang chub dge gnas kyi lha khang /grub pa rgyal dri med rnam dag gi lha khang / kong po bu chu'i lha khang / bra 550

dpyad gtam ngan rtog dug 'joms/ngan tse'i lha khang / glang thang sgrol ma'i lha khang / byams chen dge rgyas kyi lha khang / bum thang skyer chu'i lha khang / mtshal rig shes rab sgron me'i lha khang / tshangs pa rlung gnon gyi lha khang sogs mtha' 'dul yang 'dul gyi gtsug lag khang mang du gsar bzhengs mdzad pa dang / rgyal po rang nyid kyi zhal snga nas kyang / rab tu byung ba'i rtags yod pa tsam la yang / mgo'i thod ltar du khur zhing gus par phyag byed la/ nga'i blon 'bangs rnams kyis kyang de bzhin gyis shig ces gsungs par chos 'byung lo rgyus rnams las 'byung ba dang / bod khams spyi la gdams pa/ phyi blon rnams la gdams pa/ sgyu ma'i dpe brgyad kyi gdams pa zhes pa'i brtsams chos rnams chos rgyal rang nyid nas mdzad par grags shing / brjod bya'ang dam chos dang 'brel ba'i gsung sha stag tu snang ba ljags rtsom rnams mthar chags su bklags pas rtogs nus pas/ btsan po khong nyid sangs rgyas bstan pa la dad pa yod med mig long ba dang rna ba 'on pa can zhig ma gtogs su zhig gis som nyi byed/ smras pa/sngon byon mes po zil gyis gshegs pa'i shul/ /gangs dkar ra ba'i mtha' la 'od du 'tsher/ /lag stong sgren mor rgyu ba'i blun po'i khyu/ /khrom gyi dbus su kun gyis mthong nas dgod/ /ces kyang smra'o/ /551

dpyad gtam ngan rtog dug 'joms/bod kyi rig gnas yod tshad dgon pa che chung tshang mas sger sdom byas shing / zhes zer ro/ /bod kyi rig gnas thams cad dgon sde'i rab byung ba rnams kyi spyod yul kho nar mthong nas dmangs byings rnams la slob tu ma bcug pa e yin/ de ltar min na sger sdom byas zer ba 'di ci yin/gangs ri'i khrod kyi shākya'i dge sbyong ba rnams kyis dam chos dmangs khrod du spel mi chog pa'i khrims bcas pa yin na/ rgyal ba'i gsung rab dang rgyab 'gal byas pa yin te/ ston pa'i zhal nas/ nga yi bstan pa 'di la rigs mi gtso/ rus mi gtso/ bslab pa gtso zhes bka' bstsal bas—/ ri kha'i zog rdzi dang zhing kha'i rgan rgon thams cad kyis rgyal ba'i bstan pa la thos bsam nyams len byed chog pa'i phyir/ bod ma ṇi phreng bzung gi lung ba zhes rlung ltar grags pa'ang dam chos dmangs khrod du khyab brdal du song bas de skad brjod pa yin pas/ spyon pa'i chig lab kha la mi shong ba 'di 'dra bya dgos pa'i khag khyod la sus bkal/ tha snyad rig gnas tsam dmangs khrod du spel ma thub pa la dgongs pa yin na / bod mi phal mo che blo sna thung ba dang / le lo sgyid lug gi dbang du gyur nas rig gnas slob gnyer byed par mi spro ba/ dgon sde rnams dben mthar chags pa sogs kyi rkyen las byung ba yin pas/ rig gnas yod tshad dgon pa tshang mas sger sdom byas/ zhes smras pa/brjod pa ha cang rtsing ba'i skyon du 'dug pa rang nyid nas shes par 552

dpyad gtam ngan rtog dug 'joms/mdzod cig /yang / log rtsom las/ dngos med kyi lha 'dre la stong bsam gyi gsol ba re btab nas 'dug pa red/ ces dang / rgya gar gyis mthar bskrad pa'i lha klu dang / rgya nag gis rgyang phud btang ba'i the'u rang / bal bo yis spyod khang du g.yug pa 'i lha gdon/ kha che yis bas mthar sgyugs pa'i lha tshogs dang de min yul gru gzhan dag nas khyer yong ba'i lha min 'dre min sogs ches shin tu nas mang po zhig gar 'gro gang 'dug ma rnyed par sangs ri dkar bo'i khrod du 'tsho zhing gnas pa'i mi rigs rjes lus pa 'di'i steng du 'du rub byas nas/ mi rnamasakyi don lnga snod drug la khrid ston dang kha lo bsgyur bzhin yod pa dang / bod mi dag gis de ni nga rang tsho'i thun mong ma yin pa'i rig gnas phul byung ba yin ces lab bzhin yod/ ces zer ro/ /lha 'dre rnams bod kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i ris gnas phul byung ba yin zhes gzhung gang las mkhas pa sus gsungs/ da smros shig sa skya paṇḍi tas/ ngan pa phal cher rang gi skyon/ /gang yin gzhan la 'god par byed/ /khu tas mi gtsang zos pa'i mchu/ /sa gtsang gzhan la 'bad nas 'byid/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ khyed rang la ngan rtog shar ba thams cad gzhan gyis kyang zhal gyis bzhes par smras pa brjod rgyus gtugs pa'o/ /cha le cho le sgrub byed yang dag til 'bru tsam yang 'god rgyu med par bod kyi rig gnas la 'os med kyi zur za dang sgro skur ya nga ba 'di 'dra byed don ci yin/ khyed kyis 'dod don ci zhig 'grub snyam pa yin/ 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir gna' nas da lta'i bar du skye bo khri phrag mang pos lha 'dre'i gzugs snang grangs med pa zhig mig 553

dpyad gtam ngan rtog dug 'joms/gi mngon sum gyi mthong snang du gyur par rlung ltar grags pas/ khyed la lha 'dre dag med pa'i shes byed yang dag spu nyag tsam yang ston rgyu e yod—/ kho bos lha 'dre yod pa mngon sum du ma mthong ngo / /zer na/ 'o na—/ khyed kyis lha 'dre med pa'ang mngon sum du mthong ba yin nam zhes dris na/ kha la rdo rje'i rgya btab pa min nam/ khyed kyis ma mthong ba'i rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul chos can/ khyed kyis med par kha tshon gcod nus par thal/ 'dod na/ med par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ yod pa'i phyir/ der thal/ ston pa shākya thub pas chos 'khor bskor pa'i yul yin pa'i phyir/ phyi rol pa'i rtag smra bcu gcig dang nang ba'i grub mtha' smra ba thams cad kyis ches sdug shos su brtsi ba'i rgyang 'phen pas kyang mngon sum tshad ma khas len pa yin mod/ khyed nyid 'di ltar mngon sum la bsnyon gding ba zhig 'dug pas/ mu stegs rgyang 'phen pa las kyang ches shin tu tha chad pa zhig go /rigs pa'i dbang phyug gis/ ma mthong phyir na med pa min/ /zhes dang / slob dpon zhi 'tshos/ kun gyis ma mthong the tshom dang / /rang gis ma mthong 'khrul pa ste/ /'bigs byed ri phug ngur pa sogs/ /ma mthong bar yang yod phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs pas/ khyed kyis ma mthong ba dang ma thos pa'i rtags kyis thams cad med par bsgrub ga la nus/ tshan rig pa dag gis lha 'dre med par 'dod do/ /zer na/ rdzun rlabs te/554

dpyad gtam ngan rtog dug 'joms a me ri kha'i dngos khams rig pa'i ched mkhas hphe man(510khyi1mu— ṣṭaṣṭangusmobasku8bamikro) na re/ don dngos su tshan rig gis lha med par bsgrub mi nus/ zhes dang / tshan rig gis lha med pa ra bsgrub mi nus pa 'di nged kyi blo la shin tu 'bab ste/ zhes dang / tshan rig lag rtsal gyis 'jig rten khams la rtog 'jug byas pa(lke4ṣṭhalkorsā re.oṃyiska)zhes pa'i brnyan 'phrin le tshan las / phyi gling gi gna' bo'i mkhar shul mang po zhig tu 'dre mang pos gnod pa sna tshogs byed pa dang / 'dre de dag kyang sngar gson pa'i gnas skabs kyi cha byad ji lta ba bzhin du 'dug par ma zad/ 'chi ba'i rkyen yang mnar gcod tshad med byas nas lnga lam du btang ba yin par sngar gyi lo rgyus dang sbyar nas ngo sbyo ra byed pa dang —/ tshan rig gis shes bya skog gyur pa/ mang po zhig la da dung 'grel rgyag mi thub ces tshan rig pa rnams kyis gsungs shing / gzhan a ri'i pho brang dkar po'i(khyelha)nang du'ang 'dre dag gis spyod tshul ya ma brla ston par khong tshos smra bar 'dug pas/ tshan rig gis mi rnams kyis mngon sum du mthong ba'i lha 'dre tsam yang med par bsgrub mi nus na/skye ba snga phyi dang / lams gsum/ sems can gyi ris mi 'dra ba/ las kyi rnam smin/ nyan rang dang byang sems 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi nus pa/ sangs rgyas kyi sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan sogs rigs gsar la mi tshe zad zad du 'bad kyang ji bzhin rtogs pa'i 555

dpyad gtam ngan rtog dug 'joms/gnas med de/ nang rig pa'i gzhung las gsungs pa'i rgyu tshogs gnyis goms pa la ltos dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /kye ma kye hud/ yul gru gzhan dag nas 'ong ba'i 'dre tshogs rnams glen pa 'di'i steng du 'du rub byas te don lnga snod drug la khrid ston dang kha lo bsgyur nas smyo gtam 'ba' zhig lab bzhin 'dug cing / de ni kho bo'i thun mong ma yin pa'i lta ba mchog tu gyur pa yin zhes gzhan la mgo skor gtong bzhin 'dug pas/ blo gros dang ldan pa rnams kyis mchil ma'i thal ba bzhin du rgyang ring du 'dor bar bya'o/ /smras pa/khron par gnas bcas sbal ba'i mig lam du/ /pha mtha' bral ba'i nam mkha' lag mthil tsam/ /'gal zla'i gzhi gyur chad smra'i grub mtha' la/ /shes bya ma lus mngon sum yul du 'dod/ /ces kyang smras so/ /yang — 'chal rtsom las bcings 'grol byas rjes nas da lta'i bar mi rigs slob grwa chen mo rnams su mthar phyin pa'i bod kyi slob grwa ba 95glibed med kyi dngos po (mme 7)yin pa dang / mthar phyin zhib 'jug slob ma (7waṃṣpeṭwāṃ4)985phan med kyi dngos po yin pa red/ mi rigs slob gling so so'i nang du ca'o hrigañtsa9ཿgang yang mi shes pa'i mkhas tshul 'dzin mkhan yin pa dang / ca'o grig gzhon paci7glisrol rgyun gyi sum rtags tsam las gang yang khrid mi shes pa'i khyi ming la song ge btags pa can sha stag red/ bod kyi mthar phyin zhib 'jug slob ma dag gis bris pa'i mthar phyin dpyad rtsom (lha༅྅4)98glini rin 556

dpyad gtam ngan rtog dug 'joms/thang gi snying po khyi lud kyi rdul tsam yang ma mchis pa'i blun po'i smyo lab nyid las gzhan gang du mi snang ba red/ ces dang / bod mi rigs kyi slob grwa chen mo'i ca'o hrig dang cang hri rnams kyis da dung sum rtags dang gna' rtsom/ chos lugs kyi grub mtha' sna tshogs khrid nas/ rang rang sa na mi rigs kyi zhabs 'dren yin pa ma shes par snang ba skyid po'i sgo nas/ zhes bod kyi shes ldan rnams la byung rgyal du tshig ngan mang du smras 'dug kyang /don la rang nyid mi'i gral nas bud de khyi'i gral du 'tshangs pa yin pas—/ rang phyogs 'joms pa ma gtogs gzhan la gnod pa spu tsam yang med de/ (rgyal gces ring lugs dang mi rigs kyi srol rgyun rig gnas〉zhes pa'i dpyad 'bras las/ mi zhig gis gal te mi rigs kyi srol rgyun rig gnas yongs rdzogs gzhi rtsa nas dgag ste nub phyogs kyi lugs srol lhur blangs na/ de la krung go'i mi yi la rgya yod dam/ zhes dang —/ gal te 'dzam gling gi spyi 'bangs byed 'dod de/ rang gi mi rigs kyi rig gnas gzhi rtsa nas dor na/ de lta bu'i 'dzam gling spyi 'bangs de sus kyang khas mi len te/ mi rigs so so'i srol rgyun rig gnas kyi gzhi rtsa brtan chags med pa'i 'dzam gling spyi'i rig gnas zer ba gzhi nas med pa'i phyir/ zhes gsungs pas/ bod kyi rig gnas thams cad zhe rtsis med par gcan gzan mdun gyi rtswa bzhin du dor nas rang byung tshan rig kho na don du gnyer 'dod pa ni/ mthar gtugs nas brjod na mi rigs kyi khyad chos dag khyad du bsad nas phung gsum pa zhig byed 'dod pa yin pas/ shin tu yi mug pa'i gnas 557

dpyad gtam ngan rtog dug 'ardzoms/so / /bod kyi slob grwa pa rnams sum rtags dang / gna' rtsom/ grub mtha' sogs la sbyangs pa'i pha rol tu son pa yin na/ dge rgan rnams kyis tshegs chen pos dpe khrid byed pa'i dgos pa ma mthong yang / don dngos su de ltar ga la yin te/ slob grwa che 'bring gi slob ma rnams ma zad / mkhas par rlom pa nyid nas kyang sum rtags dag yig sogs la da dung zhib tu sbyang brtson byed dgos par 'dug ste/ log rtog bang mdzod las/ kha lo bsgyur (sgyur)bzhin yod pa dang / mdun bskyod (skyod)kyi 'gro lam bkag pa/ dbang bsgyur (sgyupabyed pa'i ched du yin/dge bskul (skul)gyi snying khrag mi rgyas pa/ spyi tshogs sngon bskyod (skyod)kyi rig gnas/ bskyed bsring (skyed sring )byed sa zhig yod mod/ lo rgyus 'khyogs ('khyog)bshad dang / phul byung ba yin ces (zhes)lab bzhin yod mod/ rjes lus ba(pa)/ yig rmongs ba (pa)/ stong bsam (sems)gyi gsol ba re btab nas/ 'gran bsdur (sdur)gyi tshul gyis btab nas/ zhes pa lta bu'i brda log tshig 'khyal mang du 'dug pa 'dis mtshon nus pas/ 'gong mgo mal thul gyis btums te kha dig dig dang gdong gnyer gnyer byas nas 'dug na ma gtogs lan thebs pa'i go skabs ye nas med do/ /'di skad du/brda dag rags pa tsam la ches rmongs bzhin/ /558

dpyad gtam ngan rtog dug 'joms/zab mo'i gzhung don 'gog pa'i rlom sems kyis/ /dam par thal bas mchod sprin dkrigs pa 'di/ /mi yi rten la phyugs kyi 'du shes can/ /zhes kyang smra'o/ /yang / kho na re/ da lta'i bod kyi slob gso yis mi bran sayog tu bsgyur nas zog lug ltar 'tsho skyong byed bzhin pa dang / zhes dang / srol rgyun rig gnas kyis slob ma rnams bran g.yog tu btang yod la / zhes mang du smras nas 'og tu/ 'o na stong cha gang dag skong dgos pa red zer na/ srol rgyun rig gnas kyi khrod du (nang sgo sa su bon po'i chos lugs dang sangs rgyas chos lugs)thar thor yod pa'i sher rtogs rig pa 'i skor la dpyad pa btang nas/ zhes dang / srol rgyun rig gnas kyi nang na yod pa'i mdzes sdug ris pa'i skor la zhib 'jug gnang nas/ zhes dang / srol rgyun rig gnas kyi khrod na yod pa'i sems khams rig pa'i skor la dbya da pa btang nas zhes sogs rang tshig snga phyi nang 'gal can mang du smras 'dug pas/ rang gi nang khrol phyi ru phyung bar zad de/ da lta'i bod kyi slob gso yis mi rnams bran g.yog tu bsgyur bar 'dod na/ 'chal rtsom 'bri ba po chos can/ bran g.yog tu bsgyur nas dud 'gro ltar 'tsho skyong byas pa yin par thal/ da lta'i bod kyi slob gso'i 'og nas 'tshar longs byung ba yin pa'i phyir/ rtags zhal gyis bzhes/ 'dod na/ shin tu legs so/ /shes byed 'dra 'dra 'grig 'grig brgya phrag bkod kyang / dngos 'gal bla na med pa las 'gro sa med do/ /srol rgyun rig gnas kyis slob ma rnams bran g.yog 559

dpyad gtam ngan rtog dug 'joms/tu btang bar 'dod pa ni ches shin tu tha chad pa'i lta ngan yin te/srol rgyun rig gnas kyi khongs su skad dang yi ge rtsom rig sgyu rtsal/chos lugs dad mos/ gnam rig skar rtsis/ bzo bkod/ gso rigagatan tshigs rig pa/ dpal 'byor/ lo rgyus/ khrims lugs/ chab srid—/ mi chos kun spyod/ yul srol goms gshis sogs 'du ba yin pas—/ khyed kyis bod skad dang bod yig cung zad shes pa 'dis rang nyid bran g.yog tu btang yod med blo kha nang du phyogs la soms shigakhyed kyis sangs rgyas chos lugs la dgag pa byed 'dod nas kha ba ri pa'i rig gnas thams cad gad snyigs su brtsis pa 'di ltas shin tu ma legs te/ srol rgyun rig gnas yin na/ sangs rgyas chos lugs yin pas khyab zer na/ skad yig yul srol goms gshis sogs chos can/der thal/ de'i phyir/ khyab pa khas/ ma grub na/ de chos can/ der thal—/ srol rgyun rig gnas kyi bye brag yin pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod na/de chos can/ nang rig pa'i gzhung lugs ma yin par thal/ tha snyad rig gnas yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ de chos can/ der thal/ thun mong ba'i rig gnas yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ thun mong ba'i rig gnas thun mong ba'i rig gnas yin par thal/ thun mong ba'i rig gnas gzhi grub pa'i phyir/ sde bdun yid kyi mun sel las/ spyi khyab nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor dang / /sgos khyab rtsig pa'i bu ga gnyis/ /560

dpyad gtam ngan rtog dug 'joms/mtshungs pa/ra 'dod pa mkhas yin na/ /'di na mi mkhas su zhig yod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ spyi dang bye brag gi khyad par tsam la rmongs pa ste/rang nyid kyi thos rgya khab mig las dog kyang bdud las 'ba' zhig byas pa yin par shes par gyis la phyin chad bag yod par mdzad du gsol/ /smras pa/smyo chus 'du shes 'khrug pa'i kha rlabs dang / /rang tshugs mi brtan se'u bcu'i ldab ldib dang / /rmongs rtul snying khams can gyi bshad yam rnams/ /nang 'gal khres po lci la mtshar du ci/ /zhes kyang smras so/ /yang — kho na re/ deng skabs 'du shes kyi gzi byin snying kha ru 'bar ba'i spyi tshogs 'dir— lha srin sde brgyad/ chos skyong srung ma/ bla ma yi dam dkon mchog sa bdag klu gnyan/mo 'debs pa/ rtsis rgyag pa/ grub rtags ston pa/ mngon mkhyen yod pa sogs gtan nas gnas sa med/ ces zer ro/ /khyed kyis chos skyong srung ma yi dam sogs khas mi len yang / rang gi bla ma yang khas mi len pa 'di las than ltas shig gang na yod/'phags pa sdud pa las/ slob ma bzang po bla ma gus ldan de dag gis/ /bla ma mkhas pa dag la rtag tu bsten par bya/ /ci'i phyir zhe na mkhas pa'i yon tan de las 'byung / /zhes dang / rdo rje snying po'i rgyan las/561

dpyad gtam ngan rtog dug 'joms/rtag tu bla ma la gus pa'i/ /slob mas bla ma 'di ltar blta/ /bla ma sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /de nyid rtag tu rdo rje 'chang / /zhes dang /sdong po bkod pa'i mdo las/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen ni 'khor ba'i chu bo chen po las sgrol bas na gnyan pa lta bu'o/ /zhes gsungs pas/khyed kyis gong 'og kun tu phyin ci log 'ba' zhig smras 'dug pa 'di bla ma bsten tshul mi shes pa'i 'bras rtags yang dag yin te/ snying rje/rang gis klog slob pa'i gnas skabs nas da lta'i bar du bsten pa'i bla ma rnams gnas sa med par byas la lnga lam du thong dang / khyed kyis chos khrims khas mi len yang rgyal khrims kyis de ma thag tu tshar gcod byed nges/ ji skad du/ tshigs bcad gcig tsam nyan pa la/ /gang gis bla mar mi 'dzin pa/ /khyi yi skye ba brgyar skyes nas/ /rme sha can du skye bar 'gyur/ /zhes dang / mdo ting nge 'dzin rgyal po las/ gang gis 'dzam bu gling 'dir ni/ /mchod rten thams cad bshig byed pa/ /gang gis mdo sde spong byed pa'i/ /sdig pa de ni ches khyad 'phags/ /gang gis gaṅgā'i bye snyed kyi/ /dgra bcom bsad par gyur pa bas/ /gang gis mdo sde spong byed pa'i/ /sdig pa de ni ches khyad 'phags/ /zhes gsungs pas/ chos spong gi nyes pa shin tu lci ba yin te/ khyed kyis gong du smras pa thams cad rang gzhan gyi shes rgyud chud gzon pa'i bdud tshig kho nar mthong bas/ dus zas khong du song ba ltar nyes pa 562

dpyad gtam ngan rtog dug 'joms la nyes pa ra shes par byas nas phyin chad gnyen po stobs bzhi'i gnad tshang ba'i bshags sdom la 'bad par gyis shig de lta min na/ mdo las—/ lus can rnams kyi las rnams ni/ /bskal pa brgyar yang chud mi za/ /tshogs shing dus la bab pa na/ /'bras bu myur du smin par 'gyur//zhes dang / rgyas pa'i bstan bcos tshad ma rnam 'grel las/ ma tshang med rgyu de la ni/ /'bras bu gang gis bzlog par byed/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ las kyi rnam par smin pa chud mi za ba yin pas/ rgyu rkyen rten 'brel tshang dus sangs rgyas dngos su byon yang ngan song gi sdug bsngal mi bzad pa las bzlog par mi nus so/ /smras pa/pha bsad rgyal rnga rdung ba'i dpe/ /tsā ta'i yul gyi kla klo'i srol/ /bla ma'i srog la rgol pa 'di/ /klad med mgo stong dag gi lugs/ /zhes kyang smras so/ /khyed kyis mo ma ngan pa dang rtsis pa rdzun pa dag mthong nas bod kyi rtsis rig gi gzhung lugs rnams kyang khungs med rdzun bzo sha stag yin par 'dod pa ni shin tu 'khrul pa ste/ bod 'dir rtsis rig pa tsam ni dus snga mo zhig nas dar yod pa yin te/ rgyal po gnya' khri btsan po'i skabs su rgyu'i bon shes pa can bcu gnyis su gras su rtsis mkhan byung 563

dpyad gtam ngan rtog dug 'joms/'dug pa lo rgyus rnams su gsal zhing / chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i sku ring la rgya nag gi 'byung rtsis sam nag rtsis kyi gzhung lugs bod du dar 'go tshugs pa dang / rjes su rgya gar du dar ba'i dpal ldan dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud sogs bod skad du bsgyur pa la brten nas da lta'i bod kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i rtsis rig gi gzhung lugs 'di grub pa yin zhing / rig gzhung 'di la brten nas nam mkha'i gza' skar gyi 'khor bgrod dang / zla ba'i 'phel 'grib/ nyi ma'i lho byang gi bgrod pa/lo zla zhag gsum gyi rgyu ba/ dus bzhildi 'gyur ldog thad zhod/ sa chu me rlung gi 'jig pa sogs legs nyes kyi shes bya mang po lung du ston cing /bod kyi thon skyed nus shugs gong du spel bar gzhogs 'degs kyi nus pa mi dman pa bton dang 'don bzhin mchis pas/ bkol spyod kyi rin thang dang tshan rig gi rang bzhin ldan pa'i gzhung lugs khyad par can zhig yin par rgyal khab phyi nang gi mkhas pa rnams kyis gcig mthun du khas len pa yin pas/ g.yo can rdzu bag mkhan re zung gi skyon dag rig gzhung rang steng gi skyon du ga la 'gyur/ drang don mi rton nges don la rton/ rnam shes la mi rton ye shes la rton/ tshig la mi rton don la rton/ gang zag la mi rton chos la rton/ zhes gsungs pa'i rton pa bzhi la blo 'dris par byas na gol sar lhung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /grub rtags ston pa dang mngon mkhyen yod pa sogs gtan nas gnas sa med/ ces 564

dpyad gtam ngan rtog dug 'joms/brjod pa ni/ 'phags bod kyi mkhas grub rnams la skur pa 'debs pa'i chos spong gi las gsog pa'i ngag 'khyal yin te/ nadepa sangs rgyas pa'i zhi lhag zung 'brel gyi ting nge 'dzin gyi yon tan rnams slos ci dgos/ bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab dang bral ba'imustegs byed kyi mnyam bzhag gis kyang gnam la 'phur ba dang / sala'adzul ba—/ chu la mi bying ba/ bsam gtan bzhi dang gzugs med bzhi/mngon par shes pa lnga sogs mngon du byed nus par gzhung chen mo rnams su gsungs shing / 'phrul 'khor nyi zla kha sbyor gyi rtsa 'grel dang /rtsa rlung 'phrul 'khor/ rdor sems bsgom bzlas/ mdo rgyudakyi'agrel pa gzhan dang gzhan las dmigs rnam ji ltar skyong tshul dngagrub pa'i rtags mtshan ci 'dra 'byung ba sogs dpe ris dang bcas tergya cher gsungs 'dug pas/ mig gis mthong tshad lung 'dren gyi spungs skyed pas ga la lang / rang gis ma mthong ba dang mi shes pa/ rang rgyud la med pa'i yon tan rnams gzhan rgyud la med pa dang shes bya la'ang gtan nas mi srid par 'dod pa ni khron pa'i sbal ba'i rnam thar bskyangs pa las ma 'das pas/ mkhas pas mthong na ngo tsha ba'i gnas so / /rje btsun mi la bzhad pa'i rdo rjes/ bla ma tshad ma bsten/ gdams ngag tshad ma nyan/ ri khrod tshad ma 'grim/ nyams len tshadam byas/zhes gsungs pa ltar rang gis kyang de ltar byed nus na zagabacas kyi 565

dpyad gtam ngan rtog dug 'joms/mngon shes sogs phar zhog bde bar gshegs pa'i sa la'ang 'phur lding gar gyis bgrod chog pa zhig yin par gzur gnas rtogs ldan su zhig gis the tshom byed/ de ltar byed mi nus na'ang / 'phags pa'i yul gyi rgyan drug mchog gnyis dang / grub chen brgyad cu rtsa bzhi/ gangs ri'i khrod kyi rje 'bangs nyer lnga/ sgra sgyur mar pa/ rje btsun mi la bzhad pa'i rdo rje/ ras chung rdo rje grags pa/ mnyam med dwags po lha rje—/ karma dus gsum mkhyen pa/ 'gro mgon phag mo grub pa/ grub thob gling ras pa padma rdo rje/ rje btsun gtsang ba rgya ras/ grub thob thang stong rgyal po/ mthu stobs dbang phyug rwa lo tsā ba rdo rje grags/ rje thams cad mkhyen pa yab sras sogs kyi rnam thar rnams tshar re klog thub na'ang rang rgyud kyi log rtog thams cad dus gcig tu zhi bar 'gyur pas mang du brjod mi dgos so/ /'di skad du/log rtog rgyan du rlom pa'i 'pher sha yis/ /rtogs ldan rgad po blun po'i gnas su bkod/ /gzhan phan snyan 'gyur tshig gis kha bsgyur nas/ /skye bo phal cher sdig pa'i las la sbyor/ /zhes kyang smra'o/ /yang —/ kho na re/ sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi lta ba bkar btags kyi phyag rgya bzhi la skyabs su 'gro zhing / rje tsong kha pa'i lam rim la thod pa gtugs pa'i chos lugs pa dag gis/566

dpyad gtam ngan rtog dug 'joms/'jig rten gyi spyi tshogs 'dir rgyu 'byor ba'i longs spyod la 'dod rngam chags sems kyi bas ma pa gcig la sa sacig spyang stogs bzhin yin pa dang bdag 'dzin phrag dog 'du shes wa ltar yin pa zhes sogs zer ro/ /dge sdig 'chol bar spyod dgos par rje'i lam rim chen mo sogs nang rig pa'i gzhung gang las gsungs/ rigs pa/ gang gis sgrub/ de ltar gsungs 'dug pa'i tshig gcig kyang 'di zhes khyed la mdzub mo 'dzugs sa zhig e yod/ mdzod las/ spyod pa rnams kyi gnyen po ni/ /chos kyi phung po mthun par gsungs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bdag cag gi ston pas chos tshul ji snyed cig gsungs pa thams cad sems can ma rungs pa'i rgyud kyi nyon mongs 'dul ba'i thabs su bstan pa yin pas/ sman pa mkhas pas nad pa na ba'i sdug bsngal las skyob phyir sman byin yang / nad pas sman mi 'thung ba'i steng du da dung dug zas la 'dod rgur spyad na/ de sman gyi skyon du 'gyur srid dam/ 'dre shar sgor gnas pa la glud nub sgor gtong ba ltar du song 'dug pa sus mi shes—/ bod la med pa mi 'tshol bar yod pa brlag pa la rngam pa/ 'di khyed kyis maso myos myos su brjod pa'i bcos sgyur dang sngar med gsar gtod yin mchi/ khyed kyis bsnyon gtam lung ba gang smras 'dug pa 'di rgyal ba'i gsung rab la thos bsam ma byas pa 'i lan du 'dug ste/kun gzigs paṇa chen rin po ches/ bod rig pa zhib 'jug byed skabs sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi zhib 'jug gzhi rtsar ma bzung na5/67

dpyad gtam ngan rtog dug 'joms/bod kyi rig gnas kyi gzhi rtsa dor ba yin pas/ bod rig pa zer ba yang ming stong pa zhig tu 'gyur pa las 'os med / ces gsungs pas/bod kyi rig gnas spyi la dpyad pa lhur len skabs ma mthar yang nang don rig gzhung gi spyi khog tsam nges par du shes dgos pa yin te/ de tsam yang ma shes na/ bzo mi shes pas bzo byed pa dang / mgar mi shes pas mgar byed pa ltar phung grol gyi rgyu ru 'gyur pa las 'os gzhan mi srid de/ 'bras bu rang gi rgyu la ltos pa'i phyir ro/ /rdo sbis dge bshes chen mos/ thag ring yul la re ba yis/ /mdun gyi dong la ma bltas par/ /g.yang du lhung ba'i sdug bsngal gyis/ /srog gi dbang po shor ba mang / /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bod kyi rig gnas dag rlung gseb kyi mar me ltar shin tu nyams che ba'i dus skabs 'dir/ zhib 'jug par rlom pa'i shes 'chal mang pos gsar gtod kyi tshig tsam kha la khyer nas bod kyi srol rgyun rig gnas la sun 'byin ltar snang byed par snang yang / don du srol rgyun rig gnas mi shes pa dang rig gnas gsar bar yang rgyus med pa'i klad med col chung 'gas shul du cung zad lus 'dug pa ming gi lhag ma tsam du byed 'dod pa yin pas/blo gros dang ldan pa rnams kyis snying khams can dag gi mun sprul gyi bshad pa dag mu stegs byed kyi srin bya'i dzun drug ltar rtogs par byas nas rigs pas sun dbyung bar bya'o/ /mi rigs rang gi thun min gyi 568

dpyad gtam ngan rtog dug 'joms rig gnas mtha' dag dgag byar bzung nas rigs gsar la mtho snyeg byed pa ni 'dzam gling gi mi rigs so so'i rig gnas gong du spel ba'i lam srol rma med pa las rnam par 'khyams pa yin te/ rgyal khab kyi srid gros kru'u zhi le re had kyi gtam bshad las/ chos lugs kyi phyogs la da lta gsar du zhib 'jug bya dgos pa 'dug ste/ nga tshos sngar chos lugs dad pa ni dpal 'byor rjes lus dang tshan rig rig gnas mi 'phel ba'i rang bzhin can du bsdus mod/ 'on kyang / don dngos su chos lugs la dad pa byed pa 'di 'phel rgyas su phyin pa'i rgyal khab mang po'i spyi tshogs hril po'i snang tshul zhig tu gyur 'dug ces dang / rgyal khab kyi spyi khyab hru'u ci cang tse min gyis/ bod mi rigs kyi srol rgyun rig gnas dar spel gtong bar do snang byas te/ srol rgyun gyi sngon thon rig gnas dang deng rabs can gyi grub 'bras gnyis zung 'brel byas tshe/ bod ljongs su sngar las lhag par spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi rig gnas gsar ba 'phel rgyas su gtong bar phan thogs yod/ces dang / (rgyal gces ring lugs dang mi rigs kyi srol rgyun rig gnas〉zhes pa'i dpyad 'bras las/ rgyal gces ring lugs nyid ni srol rgyun rig gnas kyi cha shas shig dang / rgyal gces ring lugs pa zhig yin na/ thog mar nges par du rang gi mi rigs kyi srol rgyun rig gnas la brtsi 'jog byed dgos/ zhes gnad 'phigs pa'i gtam 569

dpyad gtam ngan rtog dug 'joms/bshad mdzad 'dug pas/ bod kyi srol rgyun rig gnas dang rigs gsar gnyis tsha grang ltar 'gal bar bzung nas mi rigs 'phel rgyas su gtong 'dod pa ni rang nyid bya rog lus dkar du sgrub pa'i ngal bar bsten pa tsam du zad pas/ gzur gnas dpyod ldan rnams kyis srol rgyun rig gnas kyi lcags gzhu la tshan rig lag rtsal gyi lcags mda' sbyar te/ rgyang ring gi dmigs 'ben la shes rab kyi mig zhags rkyong rgyu ni rjes lus kyi dgra las rnam par rgyal ba'i 'jug ngogs zla med pa yin phyir/ phyogs su ma lhung ba'i drang po'i lam du zhugs nas 'dod rgu'i dpal gyis gtams pa'i gangs can phun tshogs gling bla nas blar 'degs pa la che thang du 'bad par rigs so/ /rje btsun chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ phan tshun dam bca' 'gog pa'i lung rigs kyis/ /thal 'gyur 'phen pa rgya bod mkhas pa'i lugs//smod tshig ku re'i tshul smra rtog ge yi/ /ngang tshul yin gyi 'khon du 'dzin rnams rmongs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dgongs gzhi dgos pa khyad par can la dmigs nas log smra tshar gcod pa la lung rigs kyis 'phyor ba'i rnon po'i tshig gis ci thub tu dgag pa sngon gyi mkhas pa'i khyu mchog rnams kyi srol du snang yang / skyon la skyon du khas len mkhan stag tshang lo tsā ba lta bu'i gzu bor gnas pa'i mkhas chen nyin mo'i rgyu skar bzhin du dkon zhing / phyogs zhen sdang zhugs kyi dbang du gyur 570

dpyad gtam ngan rtog dug 'joms/nas rang gi shes rab 'phel ba'i gegs su song ba'i rigs pa smra ba mang du mthong bas/ kho bos spyir kha rtsing po 'di 'dra'i sgo nas smyug rtse bskyod 'dod gtan med mod/ 'on kyang / gang nyid kyis spel ba'i dpyad rtsom las bod kyi rig gnas spyi dang snga phyi'i shes ldan rnams la skur zhus tshad med byas 'dug pas/ khong gis phyin ci log tu brjod pa rnams la sman la stong thun gyi tshul du lan gyis skyon spong mdzad nas/tshig ngan smras 'dug pa'i thad ka thad sar de dang mthun pa'i lan cung zad zhu ba yin pas/ blo gros kyi glog 'od 'khyug pa'i smyug thogs pa rnams kyis bzod par gsol lo/ /smras pa/ skal chad dbang rtul ri bong cal rjes su/ /rgyug min blo gros 'dab gshog brkyangs stabs kyis/ /mkhas grub mkha' lding dbang po'i rjes 'brangs nas/ /legs bshad nyi zla gtsug tu bsten rnams mtshar /gzhung bzang pad dkar ljon pa'i tshal yangs su/ /rang bzo'i 'khyog bshad dug tsher 'khrigs pa na/ /rnam dpyod sprin phung rol rtsed las mched pa'i/ /lung rigs gnam lcags mtshon chas thal bar byas/ /tshul 'di'i dge bas mi srun skye bo yi/ /ngan rtog kun zhi rgyal bstan rin chen gtsos/ /571
gangs can gtsug lag ji srid bskal pa'i bar/ /mi nyams rtag tu 'bar ba'i bkra shis shog /sarba maṅga lo/ /

rtogs brjod mdun legs ma'i zin bris/༄rga /rtogs brjod mdun legs ma'i zin bris gzhan phan snyim pa'i me tog ches bya ba bzhugs so/ /tshad med thugs rje'i spyan gyis 'gro bar gzigs/ /tshad ma'i ston pa kun mkhyen gnyis pa'i zhabs/ /tshad ma'i bstan pa mtha' bral dge ldan lugs/ /tshad ma'i bstan 'dzin srid na rgyal gyurd cig /'chad pas legs bshad gaṅgā thur du 'bab/ /rtsom pas gzhung lugs bye ba'i pad tshal rgyas/ /rtsod pas tshul gsum rigs pa'i 'od snang 'gyed/ /drin can bla ma'i zhabs la mgos phyag 'tshal/ /zhes mchod brjod me tog chun pos mdun bsus te/ 'dir mnyam med chos kyi rgyal bo shar tsong kha pa'i rang rnam rtogs brjod mdun legs ma'i zin bris thor bu 'god par bgyi bar/ klad kyi don dang —/ gzhung gi don/ mjug gi don bcas gsum ste/ dang po la gnyis las/ oṃ bde legs su gyur cig ces pa ni shis par brjod pa'i tshig go /'jig rten zhes pa nas phyag 'tshal lo zhes pa'i sho lo ka gcig byung ba gnyis pa mchod par brjod pa ste/ de'i don ni/ 'jig 573

rtogs brjod mdun legs ma'i zin bris/rten te rgyu dge ba phun sum tshogs pa las mngon mtho lha mi'i ris dang /de las ldog ste rgyu mi dge ba bsags pa las 'bras bu ngan 'gro ste ris gnyis so/ /des na mngon mtho bde 'gro dang nges legs sgrib gnyis bag chags sa bon dang bcas pa byang zhing de las grol ba ste thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i sar bgrod pa'i lam ma nor bar lta ba'i mig gcig pu'am/ thog ma med pa nas srid pa'i mya ngan gyi thang chen po'i lam du rang dbang med par 'khyams pas shin tu ngal zhing dub pa'i 'gro ba rnams ngal gso ba'i gnas te/ mdor na/ bde legs te dge tshogs thams cad kyi 'byung gnas sam rtsa ba drin can gyi bla ma dang —/ rje btsun mkhyen pa'i gter gyi zhabs la bka' drin rjes su dran pa'i sgo nas 'dud cing phyag 'tshal ba ste/ gzhan la'ang rjes su 'doms par mdzad pa'o/ /gnyis pa gzhung gi don la/ rtsom pa la 'jug pa'i yan lag dang / rtsom pa dngos gnyis las/ dang po ni/'bad pa'am rtsol ba chung ngus kyang rlabs chen gyi tshogs bsogs pa'am sdud par byed pa la/ rgyu chung ngus 'bras bu dpag tu med pa bskyed pa'i las 'bras bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i tshul rnams bsams shing —/ khyad par du rang gis sngon goms shing byas pa'i dge ba rnams la rlom sems dang bral bas dga' ba cher bskyed na/ sngon byas pa'i dge ba rnams gong nas gong du khyad zhugs te 'phel lo zhes rgyal bas 574

rtogs brjod mdun legs ma'i zin bris/gsungs pa'i don de nyid sgrub pa'i phyir dang / dge ba gzhan yang rjes 'jug rnams la thos bsam gyi go rim ma 'chol bar gdams par mdzad pa sogs mang du mthong bas na/ sems khyod dga' ba 'di ltar bskyed na legs zhes rang la bskul ba'o/ /gnyis pa la/ mdor bstan pa dang / rgyas par bshad pa gnyis las—/ dang bo ni/ dang bor rgya chen thos pa zhes pa nas bstan pa rgyas pa'i ched du bsngos/ /zhes pa'i tshigs su bcad pa 'dis rje bdag nyid chen po'i mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi rnam thar yongs su rdzogs par bstan la/ tshul 'di bsams shing mdun ma legs nas gda' bas/bka' drin che'o rje btsun mkhyen pa'i gter zhes byas pa la drin gzo'i tshul brjod pa'o/ /gnyis pa rgyas par bstan pa la'ang thos pa 'tshol dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan bstan pa/ gzhung lugs spyi la thos pa mdzad tshul/bye brag tu dbu tshad sogs la thos pa mdzad tshul dang gsum ste/ dang po ni/ blang dor gyi gnas la rnam pa kun nas rmongs shing 'thoms pa'i mun pa de nyid/ yang dag pa ste drang nges rton rigs ldem dgongs bzhi bzhis rang sde grub mtha' gong 'og gi gzhi lam 'bras gsum gyi rnam gzhag sogs ma nor bar gtan la phab pa rnams legs par thos pa'i sgron mes ma bsal bar du/ gang du bgrod pa'i lam tsam yang mi shes na thar ba dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i grong mchog tu 'jug par 'gyur 575

rtogs brjod mdun legs ma'i zin bris/ba lta smos kyang ci zhig dgos/ zhes gsungs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ gong smos rgyu mtshan de'i phyir rgyal ba mi pham chos rje dang / 'dzam gling rgyan drug ste/ slob dpon klu sgrub dang arya de ba/(dbu ma'i rgyan gnyis)thogs med dang dbyig gnyen/(mngon pa'i rgyan gnyis)phyogs glang dang chos grags/(tshad ma'i rgyan gnyis)gzhan mchog gnyis te yon tan 'od dang shākya 'od/('dul ba'i rgyan gnyis)ces sa gsum na nyi zla bzhin grags pa de dag gi gzhung rnams dang / tshig zin la dngos su ma bstan pa'i slob dpon zla ba grags pa sogs kyi gzhung dag la sbyangs pa phyogs re ba dang tshig don gyi char go ba rags pa res yid tshim par ma byas par gzhung lugs kun la ris med zhib tu sbyangs te don gyi gting thag chod par bgyis pa yin/ zhes gsungs/ gsum pa bye brag tu tshad ma'i gzhung la thos pa mdzad tshul ni/ khyad par tshu rol mthong bas dngos po ste so so skye bo rnams kyis dngos po'i de kho na nyid mngon sum du rtogs mi nus shing —/ de yang bden gnyis kyi ngo bo'i de nyid gtan la 'bebs byed kyi rigs pa'i sgo gcig pu rjes dpag tshad ma'i rtags yang dag la brten nas don spyi'i tshul gyis rtogs dgos pas/ yang dag pa'i rigs pa ste rgyas pa'i bstan bcos tshad ma rnam 'grel dang 'bring du ston pa rnam nges/ shin tu bsdus pa rigs thigs te lus lta bu'i bstan bcos gsum dang / gtan tshigs thigs pa dang 'brel ba brtag pa/576

rtogs brjod mdun legs ma'i zin bris/rgyud gzhan sgrub pa dang rtsod pa'i rigs pa ste 'phros pa yan lag lta bu'i bstan bcos sogs tshad ma sde bdun gyi gzhung gi dka' gnas rnams la/ 'bad pa du mas yang nas yang du sbyangs te nang byan chub par byas pa yin/ zhes gsungs so/ /dbu ma'i gzhung la thos pa mdzad tshul ni/ mdo sngags kyi gzhung rnams la sbyangs nas ngal ba sogs mang du byas kyang / zab mo dbu ma'i don rang nyid kyis nyams su len pa dang ske/ gzhan dag la rjes su 'doms pa'i tshe/ gang yang ma bslabs pa dang ci yang mi shes pa'i mkhas rlom dag gi lta ba'i tshul las ring du ma song bar zhes gsungs te/ skabs 'di tsam la bod du dbu tshadakyi bshad rgyun shin tu nyams nas yod pa dang / ci yang yid la mibyed pa stong rkyang tsam bsgoms pas 'tshang rgya bar 'dod pa sogs phyagardzogs kyi lta ba bsre slad can mang du spel nas rgyal ba'i bstan pa nubal nye bar phyogs par mthong bas/ thugs kyis shin tu ma gzod nas lhag par du slob dpon klu sgrub dang de'i rjes 'brangs sangs rgyas bskyangs dang zla ba grags pa sogs kyi gzhung lugs kyi gnad las gsungs pa'i zab mo rnam par 'byed pa'i phra zhing zhib pa'i rigs pa'i lam nas/yang dag pa'i lta ba rang rgyud la 'dren pa'i phyir du gnad kun la legs par yang nas yang du sbyangs te the tshom gyi mtha' ni chod par byas pa yin no zhes gsungs la/ de yang dbu tshad kyi rigasapa 'i sgo 577

rtogs brjod mdun legs ma'i zin bris/thog mar rje btsun red mda' ba las gsan pas/ rje btsun 'di nyid 'gran zla med pa'i bla ma'i gtso bor mdzad cing / gsungs chos kyi skabs su gzhung gi dogs slong skor dri gtugs legs par mdzad pas/khyed la dpe 'khrid byed par shin tu gzab dgos pa 'dug ces gsungs pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i lo rgyus mang bo gda' 'o/ /gnyis pa/gsang sngags kyi theg pa la thos pa mdzad tshul la/ theg pa 'di nyid ches zab cing mchog tu gyur par bstan pa dang / thos pa ji ltar byas tshul gnyis so/ /dang po ni/ 'di na rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas zhes pa nas kye ma'o mtshar zhes pa'i sho lo ka gsum gyis bstan la/ de'i don ni—/ 'di na gang zhig rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas su bgrod pa'i lam stegs la 'bras bu zab mo rdo rje theg pa dang rgyu phar phyin theg pa rnam pa gnyis su mchis shing / gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa ni phar phyin theg pa las khyad par bdun ldan sogs kyis 'phags tshul mdo rgyud gzhung lugs rnams las gsungs shing / 'jig rten na nyi ma dang zla ba lta bur kun tu grags shing grub par/ gang zhig tshig de nyid bden pa'itshig tu 'dod bzhin du/ da dung yang zab mo'i theg pa de nyid kyi donaji lta bu zhig tu 'dug ces/ thos bsam gyis 'tshol bar mi byed paramakhas pa'i khur 'dzin pa ste ming 'dzin pa de dang de 'dra ba yang blo gros dang ldan pa'i shes rab can yin na/ de las gzhan pa'i dbang bo578

rtogs brjod mdun legs ma'i zin bris/rtul po gang / zhes gsungs shing / shin tu phrad dka' zhes sogs kyi don 'og tu yang rgyas par 'chad par 'gyur bas mi spro'o/ /gnyis pa la—/ spyi dang bye brag gnyis so/ /dang po ni/ rgyu mtshan de nyid kyi phyir na rgyal ba'i theg pa kun gyi mchog tu gyur zhing / sangs rgyas thams cad las kyang shin tu dkon pa'i zab mo rdo rje theg pa/ thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa dngos grub gnyis kyi gter du gyur pa'i zab mo rdo rje theg pa der/ zhes gsungs la/ de yang sangs rgyas thams cad la gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa 'di yod pa'i nges pa med pas shin tu dkon pa yin la/ de yang sangs rgyas stong las gsang sngags yod par grags pa ni rigs pas grub pa gcig ste sangs rgyas mos pa dang /lung gis grub pa gsum ste/ shākya thub pa dang / byams pa/ spyan legs bcas so/ /skabs 'di tsam na bod du mdo sngags gnyis tsha grang ltar 'gal bar 'dzin pa mang du byung zhing / mdo phyogs la mos pas sngags khyad du gsod pa dang / sngags phyogs la mos pas mdo khyad du gsod par byed pas/ rje bdag nyid chen pos mdo sngags gnyis phan tshun grogs su 'khyer shes pa'i slad du/ rdo rje theg pa la zhugs nas yun ring bar du sbyangs zhes gsungs so/ /gnyis pa bye brag la bzhi ste/dang po/ bya rgyud la thos pa mdzad tshul/ gnyis pa/ spyod rgyud la thos pa mdzad tshul/ gsum pa/ rnal 'byor rgyud la thos pa mdzad tshul/ bzhi 579

rtogs brjod mdun legs ma'i zin bris/ba—/ rnal 'byor bla med rgyud la thos pa mdzad tshul bcas so/ /dang po ni/ bya rgyud dang spyod rgyud/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud de rgyud sde 'og ma gsum gyi lam gyi tshul rnams legs par mi shes pa de yis rnal 'byor bla med kyi rgyud 'di nyid/ rgyud sde kun gyi mchog tu gyur par thag bcad kyang / dam bca' de nyid tshig tsam du zad par legs par mthong nas/ gsang ba spyi rgyud dang / legs par grub pa/ dpung bzang gis zhus pa dang / bsam gtan phyi ma la sogs pa/ rdo rje'i rigasaske/ padma'i rigs/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs te bya rgyud rigs gsum spyi dang bye brag gi rgyud sde rnams la yun ring du sbyangs shing 'dris par byas so/ /zhes gsungs/ gnyis pa ni/ rgyud sde gnyis pa spyod pa'i rgyud rnams sam tshogs rnams kyi gtso bor gyur pa rnam par snang mdzad mngon par byang chub pa'i rgyud la zhib tu sbyangs pas spyod pa'i rgyud kyi phyogs gang yin legs par nges par byas so zhes gsungs so—/ /gsum pa ni/ rgyud sde gsum pa rnal 'byor rgyud rnams kyi gtso bor gyur pa/ dpal ldan de nyid bsdus pa'i rgyud dang / bshad pa'i rgyud rdo rje rtse mo dang / ngan song sbyong rgyud dang de'i 'grel pa la sogs pa rnams la zhib tu sbyangs pas rnal 'byor rgyud kyi dga' ston myong /zhes gsungs/ bzhi ba ni/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud la/'phags pa'i yul gyi mkhas pa rnams la nyi zla ltar yongs su grags pa'i 580

rtogs brjod mdun legs ma'i zin bris pha ma'i rgyud gnyis las/ pha rgyud skor la dpal gsang ba 'dus pa dang —/ ma rgyud skor la kyi rdor dang / bde mchog gi rtsa rgyud dang bshad pa'i rgyud la sogs pa dang / mdo sde gzhan dang bshad srol mi 'dra ba'i dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud don gsal bar byed pa 'grel chen dri med 'od kyi bshad pa dang / rgyu mtshan rtsis dang lag len rnams la mkhas par sbyangs zhes gsungs/ mdor na/ skabs 'dir rje btsun red mda' ba dang / gong gsum bde chen pa chos kyi dpal ba/ rje btsun dam pa khyung bo lhas pa sogs la brten nas rgyud sde bzhi'i man ngag mtha' dag gsan nas thugs su chud par mdzad/ de yang btsun pa dam pa khyung bo lhas pa ni rje'i sngags kyi bla ma gtso bo yin pas/ dbang rgyud man ngag phal cher 'di las gsan pa yin/ rje bdag nyid chen pos bla mar bsten skabs dgung lo dgu cu lhag bzhes 'dug skad/rje'i mnal lam du khri chen po zhig gi steng du bla ma khyung bo ba yin zer ba zhig 'dug pa'i drung du rje rang nyid kyang bzhugs par/ bla ma des thugs ka'i na bza' bsal bas thugs kar sngags kyi phreng ba rim pa du mas bskor ba'i 'khor lo'i yig 'bru rnams gsal bor klog pa zhig rmis shing / rjes su mjal dus kyang de kho na ltar bzhugs pas dad pa rma med pa zhig 'khrungs zhes gsungs/ dang por rgya chen po'i thos pa mang du btsal ba'i skabs te dang po'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ gzhung lugs 581

rtogs brjod mdun legs ma'i zin bris/gdams par 'char phyir 'bad pa mdzad tshul/ gdams par ji ltar shar tshul gnyis so/ /dang po ni/ de nas gdul bya'i blo mun zhes pa nas rgyu tshogs kun la 'bad ces sho lo ka gcig gis bstan la/ de'i don ni/ skabs 'di tsam na rje nyid nas rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs la dbu ma'i rtogs pa phul bar/ bdag gi dbu ma'i lta ba 'di thal rang gang gi lta ba yin zhes zhus pas/ gang gi'ang min zhes gsungs shing —/ de yang rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ bla ma dang yi dam ngo bo dbyer med par bsgom la gsol ba thob/ tshogs bsags sgrib sbyong rgya chen po byos—/ yang dag rigs pa'i lam nas gzhung gi gnad rnams la dpyod pa gsum sum sgril gyis la nyams su longs dang / ring bor mi thogs par yang dag pa'i lta ba rnyed 'ongs zhes gdams pa ltar mdzad do/ /rgyu tshogs kun la 'bad ces pa'ang 'dir dgongs nas brjod pa yin no—/ /gnyis pa la/ phar phyin gdams par shar tshul ni/ gong smos rje btsun pas gsungs pa de ltar thugs nyams su bzhes pas slob dpon klu sgrub yab sras dang thogs med sku mched/ jo bo dpal ldan a ti sha la sogs pa rnams las rim bzhin du brgyud 'ongs pa'i byang chub lam gyi rim pa rnams la/ thun mong min pa'i nges pa ste lam gyi rim pa gcig tu dril nas ston par snang bas 'chad shes pa dang nyan shes pa sogs kyis zab mo'i gzhung mchog tu gyur pa dang / rgyu phar phyin theg 582

rtogs brjod mdun legs ma'i zin bris/pa'i lam gdams par shar te gcig grogs su gcig 'khyer shes pa byung ngo / /zhes gsungs so/ /gsum pa tshad ma ni/ byang phyogs gangs can gyi ljongs 'di na tshad ma'i gzhung lugs dag la thos bsam gyis sbyangs pa byas pa dang ma sbyangs pa du mas kyang mgrin gcig tu/ tshad ma mdo dang / rnam 'grel sde bdun kun la byang chub mchog tu bgrod pa'i nyams len gyi rim pa yod min zer ba'am de dag gis lam gyi rim pa mi ston zer zhing / rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis slob dpon phyogs kyi glang po la/ dngos su 'di rtsoms dang ma 'ongs pa'i dus su 'gro ba kun gyi mig gcig tu 'gyur ro zhes gsung gi gnang ba stsal ba'ang tshad mar 'dzin par byed do/ /tshul de ni shin tu mi rigs pa'ang 'gal ba smra ba'i phul du byung bar mthong nas/ lhag par du tshul der brtag cing dpyad pa na/ tshad ma kun las btus pa'i mchod brjod kyi don/ tshad mar sgrub pa lugs 'byung dang lugs ldog gi sgo nas rnam grol don du gnyer ba la sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das tshad ma'i skyes bur sgrub cing / de las de yi bstan pa kho na thar 'dod kyi 'jug ngogs su mthong zhing / theg pa gong 'og gnyis ka'i lam gyi gnad kun shin tu 'dril bar rigs pa'i lam nas nges pa legs par thon pas lhag par dga' ba rnyed ces gsungs/ de nas byams chos gzhan la 'phags pa thogs med kyi byang chub sems dpa'i sa dang / rje 583

rtogs brjod mdun legs ma'i zin zis/btsun gyi mdo sde rgyan gnyis po don dang mthun pa'i sgo nas legs par sbyar te ji ltar bshad pa'i tshul bzhin du nyams su len pa la rab tu 'bad pas/ rgyal ba mi pham chos rje'i gsung rnams dang de'i rjes 'brangs thogs med sku mched kyi gzhung kun nyams su len pa'i gdams par shar zhes gsungs so/ /bzhi ba/ dbu ma ni/ lhag par zab cing rgya che ba'i gsung rab rin po che'i tshogs rim pa ltar bsgrigs pa'i go rim nyid las lam gyi gnad kun la nges pa ster ba slob dpon zhi ba lha'i bslab btus la brten nas mdo sde kun las btus pa sogs slob dpon klu sgrub lags kyi gzhung mchog tu gyur pa du ma'i don nyams su len pa'i rim pa legs par mthong / zhes gsungs so/ /lnga ba sngags la bya rgyud dang spyod rgyud gnyis ni/ de nas bya rgyud kyi gtso bo bsam gtan phyi ma dang spyod rgyud gtso bo rnam snang mngon par byang chub pa'i mdo gnyis kyi don sangs rgyas gsang ba dang slob dpon byang chub mchog gnyis kyis legs par bshad pa'i man ngag la brten nas/lam gyi gnad kun nyams su len pa'i gdams par shar/ zhes gsungs so/ /rnal 'byor rgyud la/ gtso bo dpal ldan de nyid bsdus pa'i lam gyi gnad dang po'i sbyor ba dang / dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog las rgyal mchog ste ting nge 'dzin gsum gyis bsdus par mthong ba ni cung zad sla yang / lam der zab mo stong pa nyid kyi don sgom tshul shin 584

rtogs brjod mdun legs ma'i zin bris/tu rtogs par dka' ba de paṇa chen sangs rgyas gsang bas rtsa rgyud de nyid bsdus pa dang / bshad rgyud rdo rje rtse mo/ cha mthun gyi rgyud rnam pa gsum legs par sbyar te tshul bzhin du bshad pa dang / rgyud sde 'og ma gsum gyi zab mo'i nyams len rnams kā ma la shi'i sgom rim ji lta ba bzhin du bshad 'dug pas blo'i mun pa bsal zhing gdams par shar/zhes gsungs so/ /rnal 'byor bla med la/ sangs rgyas shākya thub pa'i legs par bshad pa kun gyi mthar thug pa ni dpal ldan rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud yin la/ de yi nang nas kyang ches zab pa dpal ldan gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po la/ smra ba'i mchog gam dam pa slob dpon klu sgrub kyis 'di skad gsungs te/ rtsa ba'i rgyud du lam thams cad kyi gnad rnams ni/ drang nges gnyis/ dgongs dang dgongs min gnyis/ sgra ji bzhin yin min gnyis te/ mtha' drug dang —/ yig don dang spyi don/ sbas don dang mthar thug gi don de tshul bzhi'i rgya yis btab ste gnas so/ /de'i phyir 'grel ba bshad pa'i rgyud rnams kyi rjes su 'brangs nas/ bla ma'i man ngag dag las ni zhib tu shes dgos par gsungs so/ /gong smos 'phags pa nyid kyis gsungs pa'i tshul de nyid rgyud don rtogs pa'i gnad du gal che bar bzung nas/ man ngag gi mthar thug pa 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i mdor byas dang / 'phags pa lhas mdzad pa'i spyod pa bsdus pa'i 585

rtogs brjod mdun legs ma'i zin bris/sgron me/ slob dpon klu'i byang chub kyis mdzad pa'i rnam gzhag rim pa/ sogs—/ 'dus pa 'phags pa'i lugs kyi chos skor gyi gzhung lugs phran bu kun la/ yun ring bar du shin tu nas 'dris par byas te/mthar slob dpon zla ba grags pas mdzad pa'i gsang 'dus sgron gsal te rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi don sgron me lta bur gsal bar mdzad pa la brten nas/ rgyud chen po dgongs pa lung ston/ rdo rje phreng ba/ rgyud phyi ma—/ lha mo bzhis zhus/ ye shes rdo rje kun las btus pa ste bshad rgyud chen po lnga dang ni legs par sbyar te 'bad pa chen pos sbyangs pa las/'dus pa'i bskyed rim dang rdzogs rim te rim gnyis spyi dang khyad par du ni/ ngag dbeen/ sems dben/ sgyu lus/ 'od gsal/ zung 'jug sogs rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i gnad kun la nges pa bde blag tu rnyed ces gsungs shing / rgyud de nyid gdams par shar ba yi mthu la brten nas bde mchog dang kye rdor/ dus 'khor sogs rgyud mang po'i gzhung don gdams par shar ro/ /tshul 'di dag ni rnam dpyod can rnams la sgo tsam zhig gam zur tsam zhig bstan pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs te/ bar du gzhung lugs thams cad gdams par shar ba'i skabs te gnyis pa'o—/ /de ltar gsung rab thams cad gdams pa'i gter du gyur pa ste rang rgyud la nyams su len rgyu 'ba' zhig tu skyel ba na/ theg pa chen po gnyis kyi thun mong ba'i lam dang thun mong min pa'i lam rim pa gnyis 586

rtogs brjod mdun legs ma'i zin bris/kyi gnad rnams bsdus shing tshang ba'i lam la 'dris par byas te sbyangs/zhes gsungs/ mtha' mar bsngo ba ni/ rgyal sras byang chub sems dpal rnams kyi smon lam gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed ltar lags pa thams cad kyang mthar gtugs na dam pa'i chos yongs su 'dzin pa'i smon lam gyi nang du 'dus par mdo rgyud gzhung lugs rnams las rgya cher gsungs pa'i phyir na/ bdag gis dge rtsa ji snyed bsags pa kun kyang thub pa'i bstan pa yun ring bar rgyas pa'i ched du bsngos/ zhes gsungs te/ tha mar nyin mtshan kun tu nyams su blangs pa dang / kun kyang bstan pa rgyas pa'i ched du bsngos pa'i skabs te gsum pa'o/ /mjug gi don ni/ rang gi dge ba mi nyams par rgya cher spel ba'i phyir dang —/ don gzhan yang rnam dpyod dang ldan pa'i skal bzang mang bo rnams la/ thar ba'i lam gyi 'jug sgo ma nor bar tshul bzhin du bstan pa'i phyir/ rang gi rtogs pa brjod pa mdun legs ma 'di mdzad do/ /ces gsungs shing / de las thob pa'i dge ba zhes pa nas lam la 'jug par shog ces pa'i bar ni mjug tu bkod pa'i smon tshig ste/tshig don rtogs sla'o/ /de ltar thun mong dang thun min gyi rig pa'i gnas kun la gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i gdengs brnyes pa'i mkhas dbang chen po/ don gyi slad du mtshan nas smras na/ dpal ldan bla ma rdo rje 'chang 7dor zhi gdong drug snyems blo gang nyid kyi zhabs rdul spyi 587
bos reg pa las/ rje bdag nyid chen po'i rang rnam rtogs brjod mdun legs ma'i zin bris nag 'gros su 'god par bgyis pa re zhig rdzogs so/ /sarba maṅgalo/

las 'bras kyi rnam sazhagakhug /las 'bras kyi rnam gzhag cung zad brjod pa lam bzang gsal byed sgron me zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /༄7/ /oṃ bde legs su gyur cigagaser zhun lhun po'i mdangs ltar mdzes pa'i sku/ /tshangs dbyangs zil gnon rten 'byung 'doms pa'i gsung / /mtha' bral rol mtsho'i 'jings ltar dpog dka'i thugs/ /mtshungs med ston par dang ba'i me tog brtsegs/ /rigs tshul 'phrul gyi gru rdzings la brten nas/ /lung rtogs yon tan mdzod brgya rang gir mdzad/ /gdul bya'i yid kyi gdung sel 'dod 'jo'i dpyid/ /ded dngo na mkhas rnams gtsug gi tog tu mdzes/ /'chad pas gzhung brgya'i sbas don kun tu gsal/ /rtsod rigs thog mda' log smra'i snying la gzir/ /rtsom pa'i gru char blo gsal rgya mcho1re gsos/ /yab gcig chos rjes shes rab snang ba stsol/ /rigs pa'i srang la bcal nas khas len pa/ /sngon byon rgya bod tshad ldan mkhas pa'i srol/ /589

las 'bras kyi rnam gzhaga'ol tshod 'dom gyis rdzun gyi phreng bsgrigs pa/ /da lta'i pho sgrob mgo mkhregs can gyi lugs/ /chos ldan zhing du skyes kyang chos kyis phongs/ /chos min rtsing spyod bdo bas chos mig ldongs/ /chos kyi rigs pas chos log sun phyung ste/ /chos tshul ji bzhin chos kyi char 'di phab/ /'dir mthar thug gi skyabs yul dam pa rnams la bsngags tshig pad dkar phreng bas mchod par brjod pa sngon du btang nas skye ba snga phyi dang las rgyu 'bras kyi tshul las brtsams pa'i gtam gyi sbyor ba cung zad mthar chags su spel ba la/ rgya cher rol ba'i mdo las/ srid sred ma rig dbang gis skye bo rnams/ /mi dang lha gnas ngan song lam gsum po/ /'gro ba lnga bo dag tu mi mkhas 'khor/ /dper na rdza mkhan 'phang lo 'khor ba bzhin/ /zhes dang / sdud pa las/ 'gro ba 'di dag ming dang gzugs kyi 'dam la chags/ /rlung gi 'khor lo lta bu'i 'khor ba'i 'khor lor 'khyams/ /'gro ba 'khrul ba ri dwags rgyar chud 'drar shes nas/ /shes rab ldan pa mkha' la bya bzhin rgyu/ /zhes dang / rgyal po la gdams pa'i mdo las/ rgyal po chen po/ srid pa 'di mi rtagasrid pa 'di ni 'gyur ba/ srid pa 'di sdug bsngal ba'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ skye dgu rmongs pa rnams ni thog ma med pa nas dug gsum gyi 590

las 'bras kyi rnam gzhagamyos 'gyur la bag med du rol drags pa'i dbang gis long ba'i khyu rnams dmigs bu med par mya ngan gyi thang stong du rnam par 'khyams pa ltar 'jigs su rung zhing skyi g.ya' ba'i khams gsum 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho chen po gting mtha' mi mngon pa'i klung du rang dbang med par bying nas sdug bsngal gsum gyi srin gdug pa can dag gis bstun mar gtses pa las/ da lam rang cag rnams ni sngon gyi dge rtsa stobs chen dus su smin pa'i mthus gnas skabs ngan song gsum gyi skye sgo khegs nas mngon mtho'i ris te thar pa sgrub pa'i rten la bde ba can gyi byang sems rnams kyis kyang ches cher smon pa'i yul du byed pa'i 'dzam bu gling pa'i mngal skye khams drug ldan gyi mi'i lus rten ni thob/ rab 'byams zhing gi rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i mkhyen brtse nus gsu ma gcig tu rnam par rol pa'i rang gzugs bdag cag gi dad pa'i me tog phog pa'i lha skal gcig pu7'phags pa spyan ras gzigs nyid sems can gyi khams dang mos pa'i dbang gis thun mong gdul bya'i snang ngor ngur smig 'dzin pa'i tshul gyis zam ma chad par byon pa'i mkhas grub gnyis ldan gyi skyes chen dam pa mang po'i zhabs kyis bcags shing byin gyis brlabs pa'i bod chos ldan gyi zhing khams su ni skye—/ srid pa'i chu bo'i pha mthar bde blag tu sgrol bar byed pa'i gru bo che bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa rin po che dang ni mjal/ mkhas 591

las 'bras kyi rnam gzhagabatsun bzang gsum gyi yon tan thugs rgyud la byur bur gtams pa'i mgon dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams kyis brtse ba chen po'i sgo nas rjes su ni bzung / gnas dang gnas ma yin pa la cung zad dpyod pa'i shes rab kyi mig ni ldan/ srid pa'i brgya lam na rnyed par dka' ba'i dal 'byor rin po che thob nas yang dag pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang mjal zhing rgyal ba'i gsung rab la thos bsam don gnyer byed pa'i rang dbang yod pa'i skal ba bzang po ldan pa'i skabs 'dir/nor bu rin po che'i gling du phyin nas nor ngo ma zin par lag stong du phyir ldog pa ltar mi tshe don med ngang ri grong du 'khyol dgos pa byung tshe de las rmongs tshabs dang bslus tshabs che ba med pas/ blo gros kyi 'jug pa rgya bskyed de gtan gyi mdun ma thar pa'i btsan sa zin pa la rang nyid rang gis ma bslus pa zhig byed rgyu ni gnad kyi don po yin te/don gyi dbang 'di la gzigs nas/ ston pa'i gsung las/ bdag nyid bdag gi mgon yin te/ /bdag nyid bdag gi dgra yang yin/ /legs dang ngan par byas pa la/ /bdag nyid bdag gi dbang po'ang yin—/ /zhes dang / snying rje pad ma dkar po'i mdo las/ mi khom pa spangs te dal ba phun sum tshogs pa thob pa ni brgya lam du zad pas na/bag yod pas legs par brtson 'grus brtsams par gyis shig phyis 'gyod par 'gyur ta re/ zhes dang / yul 'khor skyong gis zhus pa'i 592

las 'bras kyi rnam gzhasamado las/ sangs rgyas 'jig rten skyong ba drang srong che/ /bskal pa bye ba brgya lam 'byung bar 'gyur/ /da lta dal ba dam pa rnyed pa las/ /gal te thar 'dod bag med spang bar gyis/ /zhes sogs mdo rgyud bstan bcos rnams su dal 'byor don che zhing shin tu rnyed par dka' ba'i tshul lan gcig ma yin par mtha' yas par gsungs shing / da lta'i dal 'byor gyi snying po'i lus rten 'di yang ma'i mngal las skye tsam nyid nas skad cig tsam yang sdod dbang med par 'chi ba'i phyogs su mngon par rgyu bzhin yod par ma zad/ skye ba'i mtha' ma nges par 'chi dgos pa 'di sus kyang bcos su mi rung ba'i bzlog tu med pa'i chos nyid yin te/ 'dul ba lung las/ gang yang sangs rgyas rang sangs rgyas / /sangs rgyas rnams kyi nyan thos kyang / /sku lus 'di ni spong mdzad na/ /skye bo phal ba smos ci dgos/ /zhes dang / rin chen phreng ba las—/ 'chi ba'i rkyen ni mang ba ste/ /gson pa'i rkyen ni nyung zad cig /de dag rnams kyang 'chi ba'i yang / /de bas rtag tu chos mdzod cig /ces dang / spyod 'jug las/ de ring kho na mi 'chi zhes/ /bde bar 'dug pa rigs ma yin/ /bdag ni med par 'gyur ba'i dus/ /de ni gdod mi za bar 'byung / /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ khams gsum rigs drug gis bsdus pa'i gnas su skye ba zhig blangs phyin chad nges par 'chi ba dang / nam 'chi la nges pa med pa/ tshe la snon pa med pa/ 'chi rkyen 593

las 'bras kyi rnam gzhagamang zhing gson rkyen nyung ba/ btsan po'i dpung shed dang / phyug po'i rgyu nor longs spyod/ mngon shes dang rdzu 'phrul/ rdzas sngags dang sman dpyad sogs gang gis kyang 'chi ba bzlog par mi nus pas/ rtag 'dzin gyis kun nas bslangs te sos dal bag phebs ngang sgo gsum rgya yan du gtong ba ches mi rigs par dus rgyun du 'chi ba mi rtag pa bsam par 'os shing / 'chi ba mi rtag pa bsgom pa la phan yon dpag tu med de/ 'dul ba lung las/ dge slong brgya la gdugs tshod yon dang bcas pa sbyin pa bas/ 'dus byas mi rtag par sems pa skad cig ma mchog go /zhes dang / mya ngan las 'das pa'i mdo las/ zhing rmo ba rnams kyi nang nas kyang ston gyi lo tog rnyed pa mchog rjes thams cad kyi nang nas khyu mchog gi rjes mchog 'du shes thams cad kyi nang nas mi rtag pa dang 'chi ba'i 'du shes mchog go /'dis ni khams gsum gyi 'du shes thams cad bzlog par byed do/ /zhes dang / bka' gdams pas—/ mi rtag rgyud la ma skyes na/ /gsang ba 'dus pa mi zab ste/ /mi rtag rgyud la skyes pa na/ /skyabs 'gro'i tshig gsum zab pa yin/ /zhes dang —/ pha dam pas/ mi rtag pa 'di rgyud la skyes na/ dang po chos la 'jug pa'i rgyu byed/ bar du brtson 'grus kyi lcags byed/ mthar 'od gsal chos sku thob par byed/ ces gsungs so/ /'dir gzhan dag na re—/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa bsgom pa la snying po med de/ gal te 'khor ba 594

las 'bas kyi rnam gzhagarigs drug gi skye gnas su brgyud mar skye ba'i sems can yod na mngon sum du mthong rigs pa la sus kyang skye ba snga ma nas 'dir 'ong ba dang 'jig rten pha rol du 'gro ba ma mthong bas skye ba snga phyi med par 'dod ces zer ro/ /de ni log rtog gi tha chad yin te/ rigs pa'i dbang phyug gis/ ma mthong phyir na med pa min/ /zhes dang / slob dpon zhi 'tshos—/ kun gyis ma mthong the tshom dang / /rang gis ma mthong 'khrul ba ste/ /'bigs byed ri phug ngur ba sogs/ /ma mthong bar yang yod phyir ro/ /zhes dang / rtog ge 'bar ba las/ 'jig rten pha rol med pa ni mngon sum gyis rtogs par bya ba ma yin te/ med pa'i ngo bo nyid yin pa'i phyir/ dngos po med pa bzhin no/ /gal te rjes su dpag pas zhe na/ rjes su dpag pas kyang mi 'grub ste/ med pa ba mngon sum tsam tshad mar smra ba dag la khas blangs pas gnod pa'i skyon du 'gyur ba'i phyir/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rang gis ma mthong ba rgyu mtshan du byas nas thams cad kyis ma mthong bar brjod pa gang yin pa de dag thams cad skye ba snga phyi sus kyang ma mthong ba dang gtan nas med par sgrub pa la ma nges shing ma grub pa'i 'khrul ba'i rdzong 'ba' zhig yin no/ /slob dpon klu sgrub kyis/ tshe ni yun thung shes bya'i rnam pa mang / zhes dang / ji skad du/ khyod kyis ma mthong shes bya mang / /bong bus ma bgrod lam 'phrang mang / /zhes pa ltar/ 'jig rten gyi 595

las 'bras kyi rnam gzhagakhams na khyed cag gis ma mthong ba'i shes bya'i rnam pa mtha' yas pa zhig yod pas de dag thams cad kyang med ces 'brel med rgyu mtshan med pa'i 'gal khur phrag tu bzhes pa la 'bad par rigs sam ci/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying rje chen po nges par bstan pa'i mdo las/shing rta'i 'phang lo tsam gyi sa phyogs nang snang bar ma gyur sems can gang na de bzhin gshegs pa la snang bar gyur pa de dag ches ches mang gi / stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten khams kyi lha dang mi rnams ni de ltar ma yin te/ de ltar snang bar ma gyur pa'i sems can gyi khams ni tshad med do/ /zhes bdag cag gi ston pas mi'i gzugs phung dang ldum rigs tsam du ma zad/ shing rta'i 'phang lo tsam gyi phyogs na snang bar ma gyur pa'i sems can mang po dang / stong pa bar snang gi gzhir yang sems can grangs med cig yod par gsungs pa dang /deng sang gi tshan rig pa rnams kyis phra mthong me shel la brten nas me ri'i khong gseng dang chu tshan/ 'khyag dar gyi spubs rnams su 'ang gzugs can gyi srog chags grangs med pa yod par bshad pa rnams don mthun gyi ngag tshad ma yin pa sus kyang bsnyon mi nus shing /sems can phra mo de dag kyang rang cag tshur mthong skye bo rnams kyi mngon sum gyi spyod yul ma yin pas/ dpal chos kyi grags pas/ ngo bo nyid la phyin log gis/ /'bad du zin kyang mi bzlog ste/ /blo ni de 596

las 'bras kyi rnam gzhagaphyogs 'dzin phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rang gi rmongs pa'i zhe 'dod dang mthun pa'i phyir du mi 'dod bzhin du mna' chu btung na ma gtogs sems can de dag med nges su ji ltar sgrub nus te mi nus so//spyir gzhal bya'i bskal don de yod med ji srid tshul gsum tshad ma'i rigs pa yang dag gi lam nas gtan la ma phab pa de srid du so skye rang ga ba rnams la dogs pa'i gnas su che mod/ khyed cag rigs pa smra bar khas 'che bzhin du tshad ma la mngon sum tshad ma gcig pu las rjes dpag tshad ma mi 'dod na/ bar snang stong pa'i dbyings su rgyu ba'i nyi zla skar gsum sogs da lta rang cag rnams la mngon sum mthong snang du gyur pa 'di dag kyang dngos po de dag gi phyi'i rnam pa rags pa tsam zhig yin pa las zhib phra'i gnas tshul rnams rnal 'byor mngon sum dang tshan rig gi thabs 'phrul gzhan la ma stos par so skye rang ga ba rnams kyis lag mthil du skyu ru ra rlom pa bzhag pa ltar ji lta ba bzhin du rtogs pa'i gnas med cing / bskal don can du song ba'i gza' skar gyi rigs dang sa 'og gi gter sogs kyang thabs gzhan la ma brten par phal pa'i mig gis mngon sum du mthong mi thub pas/mngon sum du ma mthong na shes bya la gtan nas mi srid par 'dod pa'i dam bca' rdzig po de yang 'dam la btab pa'i phur ba bzhin du mi 'gyur grang / sngon rabs su gshegs zin pa'i mkhas grub lo paṇa 597

las 'bras kyi rnam gzhagadang rgyal rabs thams cad 'jig rten 'dir gtan nas byon ma myong ba dang / de dag gi rnam thar lo rgyus sogs ngo mtshar rtog bzo'i lha sgrung tsam du khas longs shig dang / mngon sum tshad mas ma dmigs pa'i phyir/ rtsig pa sogs kyis bar chod pa'i gzugs dang rang lus kyi don lnga yang med par khas len dgos te/ mngon sum du mthong mi nus pa'i phyir/ gzhan ma 'ongs pa'i 'dun ma'i ched du rtsol ba byed pa thams cad kyang don med par 'gyur te/ 'byung 'gyur gyi 'bras bu de rigs da lta sus kyang mngon sum du mthong mi nus pa'i phyir ro/ /khyed cag tshan rig pa dag gi rjes 'brang du rlom khul byed kyang / mu stegs tha chad pa'i rjes 'jug yin pa las nang pa sangs rgyas pa dang tshan rig pa gang gi lugs kyang min te/ de gnyis kas tshad ma la mngon rjes gnyis su khas len pa'i phyir/ tshad ma rigs gter las/ lan gyis bzlog par mi nus na/ /de yi rjes 'brangs de yi lugs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ snga rgol gyi yang dag pa'i dam bca' la phyi rgol gyis rigs pa'i gnod byed yang dag 'god mi nus pa'i tshe rang lugs ngan pa dor nas gzhan gyi rjes su 'brangs pa ni gzur gnas mdzangs ma'i spyi srol dam pa yin pa nges par mdzad du gsol/ rang gis ma dmigs pa tsam gyis thams cad med pas khyab pa bskal pa'i bar du sgrub lo byas kyang 'grub pa'i skabs med pa de lta na/ 'gro ba rnams shi ba'i 598

las 'a rgyas kyi rnam gzhaga'og tu bem rig gi rgyun chad nas gtan med du 'gro ba ma yin par skye ba snga phyi yod pa yin te/ mdo las/ rgyal po chen po 'jig rten 'di nas pha rol tu 'pho ste skye ba len pa na rtag pa 'pho ba yang ma yin no/ /zhes dang —/ rnam par 'byed pa'i mdo las/ 'di yod pas 'di 'byung /'di skyes pa'i phyir 'di skye ste/ 'di ma rig pa'i rkyen gyis 'du byed/ces gsungs shing / de'i don kun btus las/ mtshan nyid ji lta bu zhe na—/ g.yo ba med pa'i rkyen las byung ba dang ('jig rten ni dbang phyug dang khyab 'jug sogs kyi blo'i g.yo ba las byung ba ma yin par bstan pa'o)mi rtag pa'i rkyen las byung ba dang / nus pa'i rkyen las byung ba'i phyir ro/ /zhes dang /slob dpon zhi ba 'tsho'i de kho nyid bsdus pa'i tshig le'ur byas pa zhes pa las/ rtag rnams rim dang rim min pa/ /'gal phyir bya ba byed ma yin—/ /yul rnams rim can nyid kyi phyir/ /de shes rnams la'ang rim pa yod/ /shes bya rim can dang 'brel phyir/ /dbang phyug shes pa rim pas 'byung / /zhes dang / slob dpon ka ma la shi la'i de kho na nyid bsdus pa'i dka' 'grel las/ dbang phyug la sogs pa'i rtag pa'i dngos po rnams ni 'bras bu byed pa ma yin te/ rtag pa ni rim dang cig car dag gis don byed par 'gal ba'i phyir ro/ /de lta bas na mi rtag kho nas don gyi bya ba byed de/ de dag kyang skad cig re rer rang bzhin gzhan dang gzhan 'gyur ba yin pas mi rtag pa nyid dang / du 599

las 'bras kyi rnam gzhagam nyid kyi blo dang ldan pa'i byed pa po grub pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rtag pa ni don byed kyi nus pas stong pa kho na yin pas skye 'jig mi 'thad kyang 'dus byas rnams skye zhing 'jig pa'i chos can yin pa'i phyir—/ dngos po thams cad la 'bras bu skyed pa'i nus pa yod pa yin zhing —/ rgyus 'bras bu ji ltar skyed pa'i tshul yang rgyu glo bur ba las 'bras bu glo bur du byung nas gtan med du 'gro ba ma yin par rgyu 'bras rten 'brel gyi tshul du 'byung ba yin te/ dbu ma 'jug pa las/la lar las 'gag yun ring lon nas kyang / /'bras bu yang dag 'byung ba rig par gyis/ /zhes dang / de'i rang 'grel las/ las rnams 'gags nas yun ring du lon yang las rnams kyi 'bras bu dang 'brel ba ni kun gzhi rnam par shes pa'i rgyun dang chud mi za ba dang thob pa la sogs pa yongs su rtog pa med par yang 'thad pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ brgyud rgyu las snga ma zhig pa dngos por 'dod pasaske/ dngos por gyur pa'i zhig pa'i las la brten nas yun ring bor song yang 'bras bu 'byung ba shin tu 'thad pa yin te/ rang gi 'bras bu skyed par byed pa'i rgyu la dbye na nyer len gyi rgyu dang lhan cig byed rkyen gyi rgyu gnyis su dbye ba las/ nyer len gyi rgyu ni dngos po rang gi rdzas rgyun du rdzas su gtso bor skyed byed de yin pa dang / lhan cig byed rkyen rgyu ni/ dngos po rang gi rdzas rgyun ma yin par 'bras bu de dang 600

las 'bras kyi rnam gzhagader skye ba la phan 'dogs byed kyi rgyu la zer te/ dper na/ nas kyi myu gu lta bur mtshon na/ nas kyi sa bon ni rang 'bras myu gu'i rdzas rgyun du rdzas su gtso bor skyed byed de nyer len gyi rgyu yin zhing / nyi 'od dang mkha' dbugs/ chu lud dang skyes bu'i rtsol ba sogs ni myu gu'i rdzas rgyun ma yin par skye ba la phan 'dogs par byed pa'i lhan cig byed rkyen gyi rgyu yin no/ /spyir nyer len dang lhan cig byed rkyen gnyis mi 'gal ba yin yang / gzhi gcig gi nyer len dang lha na cig byed rkyen gnyis 'gal ba yin te/ rdzas rgyun yin pa dang ma yin pa 'i gzhi mthun yod mi srid pa'i phyir/ dper na/ gser bum gyi rgyur gyur pa'i gser kho na gser bum gyi nyer len du 'gyur ba las de las gzhan pa'i dngul dang / lcags/ skyes bu'i rtsol ba sogs gang yang de'i nyer len du mi rung bas/ gser ni lhan cig byed rkyen min te/ /gser bum gyi rgyur pa'i tho ba dang skyes bu'i rtsol ba la sogs pa ni lhan cig byed rkyen yin gyi de'i nyer len ma yin pa lta bu'o/ /rang 'bras skyed par byed pa'i nyer len gyi rgyu la rang rang gi rdzas rgyun zhig nges par dgos pas/rgyu rigs 'dra ba las 'bras bu rigs 'dra ba 'byung ba yin te/ rdo rje snying 'grel las/ rgyu 'drar de las skye ba yi/ /'bras bu thams cad du mthong gi /ko ṭa pa yi sa bon las/ /sa la'i 'bras bu 'byung ba med/ /ces dang / zhi 'tshos/ de phyir dngos po gzhan dag kyang / /rgyu bcas 601

las 'bras kyi rnam gzhaganges las skye phyir ro/ /zhes dang / mgon po klu sgrub kyis/ de 'dra'i sa bon thams cad las/ /rgyu dang 'dra ba'i 'bras bu 'byung / /sa bon med par 'bras yod pa/ /shes ldan gang gis sgrub par nus/ /zhes dang —/ rigs pa'i dbang phyug gis/ rnam shes min pa rnam shes kyi/ /nyer len min pa'i phyir yang grub/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ dngos po gang yin kyang rang gi 'bras bu de dang der 'gyur ba'i nyer len gyi rgyu la rang rang gi rdzas rgyun zhig dgos pa'i phyir na/ sems can rnams kyi yid kyi rnam par shes pa'i nyer len gyi rgyu ni rang rang gi skye ba thog ma med pa nas brgyud de 'ongs pa'i rnam par shes pa'i rdzas rgyun nyid yin zhing —/ skye ba phyi ma rnams su yang de dang 'dra bar tshe rabs snga ma snga ma'i rnam shes kyi rgyun de dang de/ skye ba phyi ma phyi ma'i rnam par shes pa'i nyer len gyi rgyur 'gyur te/ tshad ma rnam 'grel las/ nyer len can dag 'gyur ba ni/ /byed par mi nus dper 'jim pa/ /'gyur ba med par bum sogs bzhin/ /dngos gang 'gyur ba med pa na/ /dngos gang gang zhig rnam 'gyur ba/ /de de'i nyer len mi rigs te/ /ba glang ba min la sogs bzhin/ /zhes dang / skad cig snga ma snga ma ni/ /skad cig re re sngon med de'i/ /rgyu yin de yi phyir na rgyu/ /thams cad tshe na mthong ba nyid/ /ces dang / slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis/ 'bru yi rgyun dang chos mthun phyir/ /srid pa chad las byung ba min/ /zhes 602

las 'bras kyi rnam gzhasasogs gsungs pa ltar/ rtsi shing lo tog sogs kyi nyer len gyi rgyu yang rdzas rgyun chad na mi skye ba bzhin du/ rnam nga/ra shes pa'i rdzas rgyun chad pa las sems can 'byung ba'ang rnam pa kun tu rigs pa ma yin no/ /nyer len gyi rgyu la 'gyur ba med par rang gi 'bras bu skyed par byed mi nus pas/ ma'i mngal du nying mtshams sbyar ba'i gnas skabs kyi skye sems skad cig dang po ni skye ba snga ma'i 'chi sems skad cig tha ma 'gag pa sngon du song ba la brten nas byung ba yin te/ slob dpon legs ldan gyis/ mngal gnas sngon rol blo la ni/ /mdun rol kho nar 'gag blo yod/ /shes bya gzhan gyis de gzhan phyir/ /yang na blo phyir de 'og bzhin/ /zhes dang / zhi 'tshos/ de phyir thog ma'i rnam shes ni/ /rang gi nyer len stobs las byung / /rnam shes nyid sogs gtan tshigs kyis—/ /da ltar ba yi rnam shes bzhin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /'o na so so skye bo rnams 'khor bar skye byed kyi rgyu gtso bo gang zhe na/ mdo las/ 'di lta ste/ ma rig pa'i rkyen gyis 'du byed/ 'du byed kyi rkyen gyis rnam pa shes pa/ rnam par shes pa'i rkyen gyis ming dang gzugs/ zhes pa nas/sdug bsngal gyi phung po chen po 'ba' zhig pa 'di 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang / 'phags pa'i zhabs kyis/ ma rig nas bzung rga shi bar/ /rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis kyis/ /brten nas 'byung ba'i bya ba ni—/ /kho bos rmi lam sgyu 'drar 'dod/ /yan lag bcu gnyis 'khor lo 603

las 'bras kyi rnam gzhaga'adi—/ /srid pa'i lam du 'khor ba ste/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ srid par skye ba'i rgyu'i gtso bo ni/ chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis grub par 'dzin pa'i sgro 'dogs kyi blo 'di nyid yin te/ bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab dang 'dzin stangs dngos 'gal du zhugs pa'i 'dzin tshul yin pas ma rig pa zhes bya ste/ de la dbye na las 'bras la rmongs pa dang de kho na nyid la rmongs pa'i ma rig pa gnyis yod pa yin zhing / ma rig pa'i dbang gis mi dge ba'i las dang dge ba'i las dang mi g.yo ba'i las gsog pa dang / des rgyu dus kyi rnam par shes pa la bag chags bsgos par byas te/ bag chags de nyid la sred len gnyis kyis yang dang yang du gsos btab nas yang srid phyi ma 'dren pa la nus pa mthu can du gyur pa ni srid pa'i rten 'brel yin la/ des skye gnas bzhi ci rigs su rnam par shes pa nying mtshams sbyar te ming gzugs skye mched nas phung bo'i rigs mthun dor ba rnams rim gyis 'grub pa yin no/ /'o na mir skye bar 'gyur ba'i bar srid du 'khyams pa'i sems can de dag ma'i mngal du nying mtshams ji ltar sbyor ba yin zhe na—/ sde dge bla sman rin chen 'od zer gyis mdzad pa'i bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa'i 'grel pa las/ chags pa'i rgyu ngos bzung ba ni/pha ma'i khu ba dang khrag la rlung mkhris bad kan ldan 'dus sogs 'phel zad 'khrug pa'i skyon med pa dang / bar dor 'khyams pa'i rnam par 604

las 'bras kyi rnam gzhagashes pa de nyid dge ba gang rung gi las dang ma rig pa la sogs pa nyon mongs pa'i rlung shugs kyis nye bar bskul nas/ de'i tshe bud med zla mtshan dang ldan pa'i pha ma gnyis po nyal bo byas pa'i dus dang 'grigs shing / khu khrag sems gsum rang rang gi cha la gnas pa'i 'byung ba lnga po rang chas su ldan pa rnams kyang lhan cig tu tshogs shing 'dus par gyur pa ni mngal du bu la sogs pa chags par 'gyur ba'i rgyu yin te/ dper na pho shing gtsub shing dang mo shing gtsub gtan dang spra ba brlan med pa dang skyes bus bsrubs pa'i 'bad rtsol rnams lhan cig tu tshogs pa de dag las ni me 'byung ba dang rnam pa du ma'i sgo nas mtshungs pa yin no/ /'di'i skabs kyi 'byung lnga zhes pa ni/ spyir khu khrag sems gsum po rang rang gi cha la gnas pa'i 'byung lnga'i cha shas rnams la zer ba yin kyang / khyad par bar do'i rnam shes dang lhan cig gnas pa'i 'byung lnga shin tu phra ba'i cha dbang po'i yul las 'das pa rnal 'byor gyi yul du gyur pa zhig yod pa la bya'o gsungs/zhes dang / spyir las zhes bya ba ni dge mi dge lung ma bstan gang rung gis 'du byas pa las byung ba'i dngos po zhig gi don yin la de'ang bar srid du 'khyams pa'i sems can des mi lus len pa'i rgyu dge ba'i las bsags shing / pha ma de gnyis kyi las dang rigs mthun pa zhig yin na ni de 'dra ba'i mngal du 'jug la/ de las ldog pa'i las dang 605

las 'bras kyi rnam gzhagaldan pa rnams ni las ma 'dzom pa zhes bya ste/ de lta na ni skyes pa dang bud med gnyis ka'i khu khrag rgyu rung gi chos dang ldan zhing / rlung sogs nyes pa'i skyon gang yang med la/ 'byung ba chen po rnams kyang tshang yang bar srid de pha ma nge'i bur skye ba'i las ma 'dzom na pha ma de'i mngal du rnam par shes pa zhugs par mi 'gyur te las nyid dbang btsan pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ pha ma gnyis ka'i khu khrag skyon dang bral zhing / bar srid pa de'i skye ba snga ma rnams su mi lus len pa'i rgyu dge ba'i las bsags yod pa dang / tshe 'di'i pha ma gnyis kyi las dang rigs mthun pa'i rgyu rkyen lhan cig tu 'dus pa la brten nas mngal du lus len par 'gyur zhing / de yang pha ma'i khu khrag la rlung la sogs pa'i skyon dang bral yang pha ma de'i bur skye ba'i las ma 'dzom na mngal du rnam par shes pa zhugs nas lus chags par mi 'gyur ro/ /'ga' zhig pha ma gnyis ka'i gzugs byad legs kyang bu dbang po mi tshang ba sogs skyon dang ldan pa ni lus can de'i sngon gyi las mi dge ba bsags pa'i rnam smin yin pas/ gnas skabs kun tu las dbang nyid dbang btsan pa yin te/ ston pas bsam gyis mi khyab pa bzhi las sems can rnams kyi las kyi rnam par smin pa bsam gyis mi khyab par gsungs pa'ang 'di 'dra la dgongs pa yin no/ /deng sang gi tha snyad rig gnas phyogs re bar rtsing por sbyangs pa'i gzhan phyogs gyi mkhas 606

las 'bras kyi rnam sazhasarlom mang pos gtsigs po cher byed pa'i gzhung lugs dag las skye ba snga phyi dang las 'bras med par bshad pa mang du snang la/ bod kyi gas ra slob pa phal mo cher rang bzo'i grub mtha' ngan pa de rigs kyis rgyud bslad pa'i dbang gis lta ba rnam par dag pa ston pa'i bstan bcos chen mo rnams la khab 'gro 'bugs 'gro'i skyon brjod khul gyis khengs dregs ni ri las mtho bar 'dug kyang / log rtog gi tha chad 'di sngar med gsar du byung ba ma yin par sngon rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul gyi phyi rol pa'i rtag smra bcu gcig dang nang pa sangs rgyas pa thams cad kyis ches smad pa'i gnas su byed pa'i mu stegs rgyang 'phen pa'i lta ngan de'i rjes zlos byas pa kho na tsam du zad de/ rgyang 'phen pa na re/ skye ba snga ma nas 'dir 'ongs pa med de/ skye ba snga ma zhes pa sus kyang ma mthong ba'i phyir/ lus glo bur ba las sems glo bur du grub pa yin te/ mar me glo bur du grub pa las 'od glo bur du grub pa bzhin no/ /skye ba 'di nas skye ba phyi mar 'gro ba yang med de/ lus sems rdzas gcig pas lus 'jig pa na/ blo yang 'jig pa'i phyir/ dper na rdo 'jig pa na rdo'i ri mo 'jig pa bzhin no/ /zhes rang mgo gcog pa'i rigs 'chal rdo spungs su byas pa 'di la thug 'dug pas/ thar lam gyi srog rtsa gcod par byed pa'i grub mtha' phyin ci log pa 'di lung rigs gnyis kyi sgo nas sun dbyung bar bya ste/ chad par lta ba dag gis sems 607
